title: Koordynatorka | Koordynator Zespołu Recepcji i Administracji - CS Pawia
description:
Medicover to więcej niż miejsce pracy. Medicover to przede wszystkim ludzie pełni pasji, zaangażowania, ludzie o wielkich sercach, którzy chcą w życiu czegoś więcej. Naszym celem jest poprawa i utrzymanie dobrego stanu zdrowia pacjentów. Dołącz do nas!

Miejsce pracy: Medicover Stomatologia, ul. Pawia 7, 31-154 Kraków

Twój zakres obowiązków
  • codzienna praca na recepcji i zapewnienie najwyższej jakości obsługi pacjentów (około 75% czasu pracy),
  • skuteczne zarządzanie zespołem recepcji,
  • tworzenie atmosfery, w której każdy pacjent czuje się wyjątkowo i bezpiecznie,
  • organizacja harmonogramów pracy, dbanie o płynność i efektywność pracy recepcji,
  • nadzór nad realizacją celów zespołu recepcyjnego liczącego 3-4 osoby,
  • rozwiązywanie zagadek dnia codziennego, czyli bieżących problemów operacyjnych,
  • współpraca z zespołem medycznym w celu zapewnienia sprawnego przebiegu wizyt pacjentów.
Nasze wymagania
  • masz doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołem,
  • cechuje Cię pozytywne nastawienie do życia i pracy,
  • jesteś liderem, który potrafi inspirować i motywować pracowników,
  • lubisz pracować w środowisku z jasno określonymi celami,
  • komunikatywnie posługujesz się językiem angielskim.
Mile widziane
  • doświadczenie w branży medycznej oraz zarządzanie zespołem recepcyjnym

Oferujemy:

  • możliwość rozwijania kompetencji liderskich,
  • zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę lub umowę zlecenie,
  • pracę w systemie zmianowym w godzinach 7:30-15:30 lub 12:30-20:30,
  • wsparcie Kierownika Stomatologii i reszty zespołu w codziennej pracy,
  • możliwość zaangażowania się w wolontariat pracowniczy Fundacji Medicover,
  • angażujące akcje w ramach kampanii well-beingowych,
  • pakiet świadczeń dodatkowych: prywatna opieka medyczna dla Ciebie i Twojej rodziny, dostęp do platformy benefitowej i zakupowej Medicover Benefits,
  • duże wyzwania zawodowe i samodzielność w działaniu.

title: Product Manager, Travel Technology
description:
Own the product strategy for the technology powering corporate travel across 500,000+ Amazon employees in 64 countries — defining what gets built, making build-vs-buy calls, and shipping features that directly improve how Amazonians travel. You'll drive the roadmap with third-party technology partners, turn customer pain points into product requirements, and measure success through self-service adoption and platform health metrics at a scale few travel programs can match.

Key job responsibilities
- Define product requirements for travel platform capabilities that improve self-service, reduce support contacts, and eliminate manual processes.
- Own and drive the product roadmap with third-party technology partners: prioritize feature requests, facilitate deep-dive sessions, make trade-off decisions, and hold partners accountable to commitments and SLAs.
- Define, track, and report program-level success metrics (self-service rates, adoption, platform health, cost-to-serve) to measure product impact and drive prioritization.
- Drive platform migration and automation initiatives, informing build-vs-buy decisions and coordinating phased rollouts, stakeholder communication, and deprecation of legacy processes.
- Identify and resolve cross-functional blockers by partnering with internal teams (category management, customer care, customer engagement, data) and external vendor engineering and product teams.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to translate product vision into technical solutions, contributing to technology decisions and integration strategy.
- Produce data-driven narratives for leadership reviews (MBRs, QBRs), translating product performance into business impact and strategic recommendations.
- Anticipate bottlenecks, make trade-offs, and balance employee experience against technical and resource constraints.
- Write compelling requirements documents, strategy narratives, and business cases that contribute to executive alignment and cross-organizational decision-making.


A day in the life
You review platform health dashboards and adoption metrics, identifying what shipped, what's working, and what needs iteration. You spend time with your technology partners pressure-testing requirements and debating which features will move the needle most for travelers. You synthesize competing inputs — customer pain points, operational cost drivers, partner constraints — into a clear prioritization call, then align stakeholders on the path forward. You end the day checking adoption data from last month's release, turning what you learn into next sprint's input. You build first, then let the data tell you what to build next.

About the team
Amazon Travel & Events exists to make every business trip seamless, safe, and cost-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology & Data Solutions team designs the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel with as little effort as possible. We partner across Amazon's enterprise to improve the employee experience, reduce program costs, strengthen duty of care, and advance sustainability goals. We're a small, high-impact team — a mix of builders, analysts, and domain experts united by one principle: make it easy.

title: Staff Assistant III
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

The **Mechanical & Controls Systems Division** engages in research, technology development, and the creation of advanced mechanical, robotics, guidance & control, thermal, propulsion, and electronic packaging systems.

The **Thermal, Propulsion & Materials Engineering Section (353)** provides leadership and unique world-class expertise in a wide range of systems, technologies, and technical discipline areas of chemical and electrical propulsion, thermal and cryogenic systems, materials, contamination control, planetary protection, analytical chemistry, and multiphase flow. This section is responsible for design, analysis, fabrication, testing, integration, and operations of thermal and propulsion flight systems for JPL missions. This section is also responsible for providing materials and process engineering, contamination control engineering, planetary protection engineering, materials testing, and analytical chemistry support to technology and flight programs.

We are seeking a self-motivated, highly organized, and service-oriented individual to serve as a Section Staff Assistant III. This position provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to Section Management and multiple technical groups within Section 353 and Business Administration Team (7353).  This is primarily an administrative support position requiring solid customer service experience, great organizational skills, attention to detail, and being agile and flexible in a highly dynamic working environment.

As a member of the **Section 353 Business Administration Team**, the Section Staff Assistant III will report to the Group Supervisor, who also serves as the Section Business Manager.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

- Provide office operations support to the Section Management team and multiple technical groups within the section, while demonstrating the ability to multi-task and maintain patience and composure in a dynamic work environment that includes interruptions and changing priorities
- Preparing and processing foreign and domestic travel, generating travel reports, processing affiliate badge requests for domestic and foreign visitors and escorting visitors as necessary
- Process P-card purchases, requisitions and iProcurement orders, including ordering office supplies
- Coordinating meetings via Outlook and Teams, maintaining conference room schedules, arranging conference calls via Teams or equivalent
- Serve as the Section timecard Subject Matter Expert (SME)/Timekeeper and provide timekeeping guidance to personnel as needed.
- Assisting with preparation of presentations, graphics, and website inputs, including proofreading and editing
- Assisting with office moves and new hire preparations
- Assisting with offboarding actions including clearing checkpoints
- Prepare, maintain, and update Work Authorization Memos (WAMs).
- Coordinate on-site and off-site workshops, meetings, and other business events.
- Assisting with the coordination of candidate interviews including but not limited to preparing interview schedules, etc.
- Demonstrating a solid customer service orientation, great organization skills, and ﬂexibility in the performance of the job
- Prioritizing work and completing assignments accurately and in a timely manner
- Regularly supporting multiple and various ad hoc assignments.

**Qualifications:**

- Typically requires a High School diploma with a minimum of 8 years of related experience; Associates degree with a minimum of 4 years of related experience; or Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 1 year of related experience; or related required training.
- Solid understanding of general job aspects speciﬁcally in the secretarial/administrative support profession with strong organizational, computer and interpersonal skills
- Thorough understanding of oﬃce procedures and oﬃce automation applications: MS Oﬃce, Word, Excel, Power Point, Adobe Acrobat, Outlook and applies knowledge and skills in this area
- Strong meeting planning and scheduling skills
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively under pressure on multiple complex tasks, and work independently with minimal supervision to meet commitments to delivering high-quality products
- Motivated self-starter who takes the initiative to establish and implement process improvements
- Ability to evaluate situations and apply good judgement in any necessary resolution
- Must be a team player with excellent written and oral communication skills
- Ability to interact effectively with all levels of personnel and provide excellent customer service
- Must exercise proper discretion when dealing with sensitive information
- Proven success in the administrative support profession with the ability to maintain patience and composure in a dynamic work environment that includes interruptions and changing priories
- Willingness and ability to identify, learn, and apply new processes and enhanced tools to improve oﬃce operations
- Proficient in M365 Office suite, which includes, but not limited to, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

**Preferred Skills:**

- Extensive understanding of JPL/ESD policies, procedures, and practices
- Previous Staff Assistant experience in technical section office environment
- Experience using JPL-based tools such as Concur, Service Order Modules, Timekeeping, Requisitions, P-Card, UCS, WAMs, Property Manager Gateway Administrator, MS Teams, DocuShare, Alfresco and JPL-ID
- Experience with the JPL-ID process and on-boarding of volunteers, affiliates, and foreign nationals
- Knowledge of JPL foreign and domestic travel policies and experience with procedures.
- Familiar with MS Project, Access, Visio, SharePoint, Photoshop, and Publisher
- General understanding of JPL facilities, safety, and property policies and procedures
- Willingness to look for, learn, and apply new information technology tools to office procedures and processes

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. title: Working Student Category Management (m/f/d)
description:

As a Working Student Category Management you will be supporting the Category Management team in handling the Westwing shop portfolio through new product selection and maintenance of the existing offering to secure business and meet sales targets. This position is permanent and based in Munich.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Passion for Home & Living as well as a strong sense for products, trends, and aesthetics
  • Strong analytical and communication skills combined with a structured working style, high motivation, and a keen curiosity for continuous learning
  • Solid MS Office skills, especially in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Excellent written and spoken language skills in English

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

  • An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team
description:
Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team exist to ensure device and application customers have delightful experiences using the product by enabling swift, precise, and privacy-compliant observability and issue resolution across all devices and applications. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of device data into actionable insights that drive product stability and customer satisfaction. To achieve this mission, we provide comprehensive technology solutions spanning the entire observability lifecycle. This includes on-device crash and log management, high-scale data ingestion services, advanced analytics dashboards, and intuitive troubleshooting interfaces.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for the Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services team, you will drive critical initiatives that enhance the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues across Amazon's device ecosystem. This high-visibility role requires exceptional leadership in coordinating across several engineering teams, data engineers, applied scientists,BIEs and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable troubleshooting solutions that improve customer experience. You will be responsible for influencing feature priorities and getting buy in from engineering teams for delivery of large cross-organization programs. You will leverage your technical knowledge to drive technical trade-off decisions. You will represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to technical and business leaders to help them understand decisions and options. As a Technical Program Manager, you will be one of the key leaders on the team and have an impact by defining strategy & requirements, developing processes & schedules, and driving forward progress on major initiatives.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will bring strong project management skills to systematically drive programs and deliver results. You possess good technical skills to deal with ambiguous programs to drive clarity in scope and execution. You are have demonstrated ability in driving programs with multiple stakeholders, use escalation mechanisms and negotiation skills to drive the right outcomes. You have good communication skills, both written and verbal and are adept in communicating with stakeholders and executives with right level of detail and clarity.

Key job responsibilities
As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive key business collaborations critical to improving the customer experience with Amazon Devices.
* You will partner with Senior Leaders within Amazon Devices to identify opportunities to increase device stability, reduce device resource utilizations, save costs and improve efficiency.
* You will define and implement strategical partnerships that enables businesses in Amazon Devices scale faster, save costs, and improve efficiency.
* You will establish mechanisms and processes that drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
* You will establish metrics and design self-serve reports to keep stake-holders informed and excited about the progress

A day in the life
This role will drive engagement across different product lines to design and drive programs that will improve the stability, reduce the resource utilization of the devices. You will also help build mechanisms to prevent duplication of tools across teams for troubleshooting and analysis. As a direct result, this role offers the challenge as well as the opportunity to bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving space. This high visibility role is inherently cross-organizational in nature. You will be a champion of this product to senior leadership.

About the team
Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services (ADTS) team ensures that troubleshooting is quick, easy, and privacy-centric for device and application teams, so that end customers have delightful experiences with their Amazon Devices. We provide a single place for device and application teams to troubleshoot known issues, uncover emergent trends or regressions, and quantify the impact in the context of the customer journey. We build technology to deliver high-quality user experiences for troubleshooting and analysis, ensure stability of the device, and proactively present critical issues and root causes to relevant teams based on a wide range of health and customer journey data.

title: Head – Investor Relations & Corporate Development
description:
# HEAD – INVESTOR RELATIONS & CORP DEV

## Company Overview
*Not specified.*

## Job Summary
The **Head – Investor Relations & Corporate Development** will play a pivotal role in engaging with investors, driving strategic initiatives, and supporting high-impact business growth. Reporting directly to the CFO and working closely with founders and senior leadership, this role acts as a key interface between investors, leadership, finance, and other stakeholders. The position involves managing investor relationships, supporting fundraising efforts, executing mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and identifying strategic investment opportunities to accelerate the company's growth trajectory.

## Responsibilities
- **Investor Relations**
  - Manage relationships and engagement with existing and prospective investors, shareholders, and financial stakeholders.
  - Lead the preparation of investor updates, board materials, investor presentations, Management Information Systems (MIS), and performance reports.
  - Develop and communicate the company's business narrative, growth drivers, financial performance, and key metrics.
  - Track investor feedback, industry trends, competitor performance, and valuation benchmarks.
  - Maintain investor databases, sector intelligence, and communication repositories.

- **Corporate Development & Strategy**
  - Support CFO, founders, and leadership on strategic planning, mergers and acquisitions, investments, partnerships, and inorganic growth opportunities.
  - Identify and evaluate potential acquisition, investment, and strategic partnership opportunities.
  - Conduct market, sector, competitor, commercial, and financial analysis to inform strategic decisions.
  - Assist in due diligence, transaction evaluation, and preparation of investment/management presentations.
  - Build financial models, business cases, and valuation analyses including Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), comparable companies, and precedent transactions.

- **Fundraising & Strategic Projects**
  - Support fundraising and capital-raising initiatives, including investor decks, financial models, projections, data rooms, and transaction materials.
  - Collaborate with Finance, Legal, bankers, investors, and external advisors on strategic transactions.
  - Drive high-priority projects from analysis through execution within the Founder’s Office.
  - Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of strategic initiatives.
  - Translate complex financial and business information into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.

## Qualifications
- **Educational Background:** MBA/PGDM from a reputed Tier-1 institute, preferably in Finance, Strategy, or a related discipline.
- **Professional Experience:** 6–10 years in Investor Relations, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, Management Consulting, Corporate Strategy, Private Equity/Venture Capital, or similar roles.
- Experience working with founders, CXOs, investors, or Board-level stakeholders.
- Strong exposure to financial modeling, valuation, fundraising, M&A, or strategic investments.
- Experience in high-growth Technology, EdTech, or New-age organizations is an advantage.
- **Technical Skills:**
  - Strong understanding of Investor Relations, Corporate Finance, and Strategy.
  - Advanced Excel skills and financial modeling expertise.
  - Proficiency in PowerPoint and executive presentation development.
  - Strong analytical, valuation, and business acumen.
- **Soft Skills:**
  - Excellent communication, research, and project management skills.
  - Strategic thinking with a strong ownership and execution mindset.
  - Stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  - Problem-solving and structured thinking abilities.
  - High maturity, attention to detail, confidentiality, and professionalism.
  - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

## Preferred Skills
- Experience in a high-growth technology or EdTech organization.
- Prior exposure to fundraising, investor relations, or strategic M&A transactions.

title: Data Center Technician (DCO), Data Center Operations
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.

At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One!

Key job responsibilities
A Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

Key job responsibilities
A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

• You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
• your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
• You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
• You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
• You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
• You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
• You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
• You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
• More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

A day in the life
• You will support DC (Data Center) infrastructure equipment (e.g. racks, servers, networking devices, hardware components, cables, etc.),
• You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.
• You will perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
• Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
• You will be involved with site management and maintain tidiness in operation areas
• Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Digital Adoption & Communications Strategist
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Digital Adoption & Communications Strategist to support a major digital transformation programme in the UAE.

This role sits at the intersection of digital adoption, strategic communications, customer experience, audience strategy, and campaign planning.

You’ll be responsible for understanding how different audiences engage with digital services, identifying what drives or prevents adoption, and developing the strategies, messaging, channels, and activation approaches needed to move users from awareness to activation, engagement, repeat usage, and long-term retention.

You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders, product and experience teams, communications teams, and delivery partners to ensure communications and adoption activities are aligned with the actual digital service experience.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll be expected to conduct analysis, facilitate workshops, develop strategic frameworks, and produce clear, executive-ready deliverables.

The role requires predominantly on-site work in the UAE, with flexibility for off-site working when required.

Requirements

What You'll Do

❏ Review existing marketing, communication, engagement approaches, channels, campaigns, and communication assets to identify gaps and opportunities

❏ Analyze market trends, relevant benchmarks, audience behaviours, and the wider communications landscape

❏ Translate personas and user segments into communication-relevant audience groups

❏ Identify audience needs, behaviours, motivations, communication preferences, and barriers to digital adoption

❏ Define and prioritize audience segments based on adoption objectives

❏ Develop a multi-phase digital adoption strategy covering pre-launch awareness, launch activation, post-launch engagement, repeat usage, and long-term retention

❏ Define the appropriate channel strategy and channel mix across digital, social, owned, platform, and ecosystem channels

❏ Develop audience-specific value propositions, key messages, reasons-to-believe, calls-to-action, and messaging principles

❏ Define campaign and activation approaches tailored to different audiences, services, and rollout phases

❏ Develop integrated communications and activation roadmaps, including campaign waves, key moments, sequencing, dependencies, and stakeholder activities

❏ Ensure communications and engagement strategies align with the actual customer journey and service experience

❏ Coordinate messaging and activation approaches across multiple stakeholders and ecosystem partners

❏ Define adoption KPIs across awareness, reach, engagement, traffic, activation, conversion, repeat usage, and retention

❏ Connect communications performance with broader product and adoption objectives

❏ Plan and facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders to develop and validate segmentation, messaging, channel, campaign, and adoption strategies

❏ Turn complex research, analysis, and stakeholder inputs into clear strategic recommendations, frameworks, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations

You’re Our Match If You Have

❏ 6+ years of relevant experience across digital adoption, strategic communications, digital marketing strategy, customer experience, or related disciplines

❏ Proven experience developing digital adoption strategies that move users from awareness through activation, engagement, repeat usage, and retention

❏ Strong experience translating digital product and programme objectives into actionable communications and engagement strategies

❏ Strong experience with audience segmentation, personas, behavioural insights, and adoption barriers

❏ Proven ability to develop messaging frameworks and audience-specific value propositions

❏ Experience developing integrated channel strategies across digital, social, owned, platform, and ecosystem channels

❏ Strong campaign strategy and activation experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch stages

❏ Good understanding of customer experience and journey thinking, particularly how communications connect with the wider service experience

❏ Experience conducting market, landscape, competitor, and communications analysis

❏ Ability to translate strategy into practical, sequenced communications and activation roadmaps

❏ Strong understanding of digital adoption analytics and performance measurement

❏ Strong workshop facilitation skills and confidence leading sessions with senior stakeholders

❏ Excellent executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills

❏ Strong understanding of digital products, platforms, services, and product launches

❏ Experience working across complex stakeholder environments and coordinating multiple teams or organizations

❏ Experience working on large-scale digital transformation or public-service programmes in the UAE/GCC is highly preferred

❏ Arabic and English bilingual capability is highly preferred

❏ Comfortable working predominantly on-site in the UAE

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries HCLS, AWS Industries HCLS
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Healthcare Solutions Architect to join our Healthcare & Life Sciences (HCLS) organization within AWS Industries. In this role, you will partner with healthcare providers, health systems, and healthcare ISVs to design cloud architectures that solve critical industry challenges. From clinical AI and interoperability to population health and provider workflows, you will help some of the nation's largest health systems and most innovative digital health companies accelerate their transformation on AWS.

As a Solutions Architect, you will sit at the intersection of technology and healthcare delivery. You will bring technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead architecture discussions with Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, CMIOs, CTOs, Directors, VPs, and CXOs. You will articulate how AWS enables measurable outcomes across the healthcare value chain, from the point of care to back-office operations.

You will craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You will help organizations understand best practices for cloud-native healthcare solutions and guide migration of existing clinical and administrative workloads. You will define and build reference architectures for healthcare-specific use cases including clinical AI, ambient documentation, medical imaging, FHIR-based interoperability, real-time data pipelines, and generative AI applied to provider workflows.

In collaboration with account management, professional services, support, product teams, and the AWS healthcare partner ecosystem, you will formulate and execute strategies to expand AWS adoption across provider organizations and healthcare ISVs.

Key job responsibilities
nsure success in building, modernizing, and migrating healthcare applications, platforms, and services on AWS for health systems and ISV customers
In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a customer engagement strategy tailored to healthcare organizations and their unique regulatory, interoperability, and data challenges
Build prototypes, proofs of concept, and demonstration assets showcasing AWS capabilities in clinical AI, generative AI, ambient listening, medical imaging, FHIR interoperability, and healthcare analytics
Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS for healthcare, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions meet compliance, interoperability, and scalability requirements
Stay current on emerging health AI technologies, clinical AI models, and cloud-native patterns. Translate that knowledge into actionable guidance and reference architectures for healthcare customers
Engage with healthcare ISVs and digital health companies to help them build, scale, and go-to-market on AWS. Serve as a technical advisor across the partner ecosystem
Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to healthcare organizations considering or already using AWS
Author or contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focused on healthcare use cases
Act as a technical liaison between healthcare customers, service engineering teams, and support

A day in the life
Your morning starts with your AI agents already working. You open Amazon Quick, review overnight insights across your accounts, and jump into a call with a digital health ISV to architect their clinical AI platform for scale on AWS. Mid-morning, you build a generative AI prototype using Kiro that surfaces care gaps from unstructured clinical notes. After lunch, you walk a health system CTO through a live demo you built yesterday, not a slide deck. Between meetings, you're sketching a FHIR-native interoperability pattern and reviewing a medical imaging pipeline design. No two days look the same.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

The L3Harris Integrated Vision Solutions Sector is seeking a Product Manager to provide leadership for our night vision goggle-based product lines. This role is responsible for managing the cost and schedule requirements of a product line offering through all phases from proposal to fulfillment. The product manager analyzes and designs technical product enhancements, integrating the work of research and development, manufacturing, marketing, sales, and service functions for all or part of a new or potential product offerings.

description:

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI and robotics by developing robotic systems that offer state-of-the-art full-body force sensitivity and world-leading vision intelligence. This unique combination of technologies enables us to provide intelligent, easy-to-use and affordable robotic solutions with safe human-robot interaction.

We are a dynamic and innovative software development company dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that transform industries and redefine user experiences.

We are looking for motivated students interested in control and learning for humanoid robots. Depending on your background, interests, and the current project needs, you will contribute to research and development topics at the intersection of robot learning, control, simulation, and real-world robotic systems.

The work may involve developing and evaluating learning-based control policies, improving simulation and training pipelines, analyzing robot behavior, or supporting the transfer of algorithms from simulation to real robotic platforms.

This role is well suited for students who are curious, technically strong, and interested in working on open-ended robotics problems where not all requirements are known in advance.

  • Developing, testing, and improving control and learning algorithms for humanoid robots
  • Working with simulation environments for training, evaluation, and benchmarking
  • Supporting reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or model-based learning pipelines
  • Implementing and evaluating locomotion, manipulation, balancing, or whole-body control behaviors
  • Analyzing robot behavior, failure cases, and learning performance
  • Supporting sim-to-real transfer and experiments on robotic hardware
  • Integrating learned policies with perception, planning, control, and actuation components
  • Reviewing and reproducing relevant research from robotics, control, and machine learning
  • Documenting results clearly and presenting technical findings to the team

Your Profile

  • Strong interest in humanoid robotics, robot learning, control, or embodied AI
  • Good programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Basic understanding of robot kinematics, dynamics, control, or motion planning

  • Experience with simulation tools or robotics frameworks is beneficial

  • Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate in an interdisciplinary team

title: AI/ML & Data Engineer - Solutions & Business Development
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI/ML & Data Engineer with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to engage with clients and drive opportunities toward closure. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on engineering capabilities with strong business acumen - someone who can understand complex client requirements, architect the right solution, present it confidently, and help convert opportunities into successful projects.

Requirements

1. Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML and Data Engineering solutions.
2. Work hands-on with Python, SQL, machine learning, data pipelines, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms.
3. Develop solutions using Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, NLP, predictive analytics, and AI/ML frameworks.
4. Design and implement data warehouses, data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data processing solutions.
5. Evaluate technical requirements and recommend the most appropriate architecture, tools, and technologies.
6. Engage directly with clients to understand their business and technical challenges.
7. Lead technical discovery calls, presentations, solution discussions, demos, and POCs.
8. Prepare technical proposals, solution architectures, project scopes, estimates, and SOWs.
9. Work closely with Sales and leadership to identify, develop, and close new project opportunities.
10. Address technical objections and communicate complex solutions in a clear, business-focused manner.
11. Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities for upselling and long-term engagements.
12. Collaborate with engineering and delivery teams to ensure successful project handover and execution.

Qualification

1. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
2. 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in AI/ML, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related domain.
3. Strong hands-on technical expertise with Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and Cloud technologies.
4. Proven experience working on AI/ML and data-driven projects, preferably in a client-facing environment.
5. Strong communication, presentation, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
6. Ability to understand client requirements, propose technical solutions, and contribute to winning and closing projects.

Required Skills

1. Strong hands-on technical and problem-solving capabilities.
2. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
3. Strong client-facing, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
4. Ability to translate technical solutions into clear business value.
5. Proven ability to take ownership of opportunities and drive them from discovery to closure.
6. Commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.

title: Senior GTM Specialist Solution Architect AI/ML, GenAI, EMEA Data and AI Solutions Architecture
description:
AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based system
Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements, and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
AI/ML/GenAI Specialist Solutions Architects combine technical skills in AI/ML/GenAI business acumen, and technical sales skills. They are focused on supporting customers throughout the engagement lifecycle and work closely with the teams that support implementation including AWS Professional Services and Partners. SSAs unblock customers and help them get to production faster. Joining AWS as a Specialist Solutions Architect will give you opportunities to work on interesting and challenging problems, collaborate with a group of skilled practitioners focused on delivering outcomes for our customers, and be part of a diverse and inclusive community committed to being Earth’s Best Employer.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Key job responsibilities
The WWSO AI/ML/GenAI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while challenging the impossible, come build the future with us.

About the team
SSAs are part of the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) which builds and executes go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. Our teams include business development, specialist sales, and specialist solutions architecture, working together to provide customer-obsessed solutions that help people run their businesses more effectively. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in
the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path,
or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our
organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and
services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical
stores.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is
why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home,
there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to
continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek
out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
We are currently seeking a Senior Estimator with extensive experience in Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) projects to join our team.

Cone & Graham, Inc. is a well-established and well-respected leader in the Florida construction industry, specializing in Heavy Highway projects. Recognized for our commitment to quality and a legacy of successful projects, we've become a trusted partner for the Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) and local municipalities alike. Our journey began in 1979, and today, C&G boasts a dynamic team of over 200 skilled professionals, with offices strategically located in both Tampa and West Palm Beach.

Responsibilities:

Pre-Construction:

  • Lead the preparation of detailed and competitive project estimates, including analyzing project plans, specifications, and other bid documents.
  • Perform quantity takeoffs for earthwork, asphalt, concrete, drainage, utilities, and other components of heavy highway projects.
  • Evaluate subcontractor and supplier bids to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with project requirements.
  • Develop comprehensive cost analyses, including labor, materials, equipment, and indirect costs.
  • Research and maintain an understanding of current market conditions, pricing trends, and availability of materials and labor.
  • Collaborate with project managers and field teams to identify value engineering opportunities and mitigate potential risks.

Proposal Development:

  • Prepare complete and accurate bid proposals, including writing detailed scopes of work and assembling all required documentation.
  • Work with internal teams to ensure all proposals align with company goals, capabilities, and long-term strategies.
  • Assist in identifying and pursuing new project opportunities by reviewing RFPs, attending pre-bid meetings, and maintaining relationships with clients and agencies.

Post-Bid Coordination:

  • Review awarded project scopes to ensure alignment with the bid package and contract requirements.
  • Support the transition from estimating to operations by providing detailed breakdowns of costs, assumptions, and project insights.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in heavy civil estimating, specifically highway, road, or infrastructure projects.
  • Proficiency in estimating software such as HCSS, Bid2Win, or similar.
  • Extensive knowledge of FDOT standards, specifications, and design manuals.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify cost-saving opportunities while ensuring quality and compliance.
  • Experience in subcontractor solicitation, bid analysis, and proposal development.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple bids and deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across various teams and departments.
  • Proven track record of preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates.

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Eligible for Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Company 401(k) Matching Contributions
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Term Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Cone & Graham is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Disability / Veteran

title: Specialist, Integration and Test Engineer
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Specialist, Integration and Test Engineer**

**Job Code: 42561**

**Job Location: Melbourne, FL**

**Job Schedule: 9/80**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris Technologies is seeking a talented Integration and Test Engineer to support the design, integration, verification, validation, documentation, and deployment of advanced systems and services. This engineer will help drive and champion test and evaluation processes for mission-critical programs and will be responsible for the development, coordination, implementation, and enforcement of test processes across hardware, software, and networked system environments.

The ideal candidate will have experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Model-Based Testing (MBT), including the use of Cameo Systems Modeler to support test development, requirements verification, traceability, and validation activities. This role will support programs serving the global aviation community with advanced systems and services that increase the safety, security, and capacity of air traffic management operations.

**Essential Functions:**

- Provide daily integration and test engineering support for mission-critical government and Department of Defense customers.
- Support system integration, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution across hardware, software, and communications systems.
- Develop, document, and execute integration, verification, and validation test procedures for complex systems.
- Use Cameo Systems Modeler and model-based systems engineering methods to support model-based testing, requirements verification, use case validation, and end-to-end traceability.
- Translate system models, behavioral diagrams, requirements, and operational scenarios into test cases, test procedures, and verification artifacts.
- Maintain bidirectional traceability between customer requirements, system models, test procedures, and test results.
- Coordinate with systems engineering, software engineering, network engineering, and project leadership to ensure complete verification coverage.
- Support automated and manual test execution in lab and system integration environments.
- Develop test scenarios and acceptance tests for system-level and subsystem-level requirements.
- Troubleshoot integration and test issues involving hardware, software, interfaces, networking, and communications components.
- Support formal test events, system verification activities, customer demonstrations, and acceptance testing.
- Identify opportunities to improve test efficiency through automation, improved test architecture, and model-based approaches.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and reporting methods.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s Degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred and a minimum of 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
- Minimum of three (3) years of experience in Integration & Test Engineering Background (System/Network Integration Testing)
- Experience performing formal systems testing in a lab, integration, or operational environment.
- Experience interpreting and validating system requirements and maintaining requirements traceability.
- Experience using Cameo Systems Modeler or similar model-based systems engineering tools.
- FAA Public Trust Clearance

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Experience in applying model-based systems engineering principles to system design, verification, or validation activities.
- Experience developing or supporting model-based testing approaches using system models, use cases, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, state machines, or related artifacts.
- Experience translating requirements and system behavior into test procedures, test cases, and verification evidence.
- Ability to read and understand interface definitions, system architecture products, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.
- Experience working directly with Air Force, DoD, or government customers in fast-paced acquisition environments
- Background managing technical activities across multiple contractor teams and government stakeholders
- Experience with government requirements management systems (DOORS) and interface control processes
- Experience with Cameo Model-based Testing workflows and use of system models to derive or validate test cases.
- Experience with Unified Modeling Language (UML) and Systems Modeling Language (SysML).
- Experience with requirements management and traceability tools.
- Experience with verification cross-reference matrices and requirement coverage analysis.
- Experience integrating model-based systems engineering artifacts with verification and validation planning.
- Experience with automated testing tools or frameworks such as Selenium, PyTest, JUnit, Robot Framework, TestComplete, or similar tools.
- Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, Shell, or PowerShell.
- Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery tools such as Jenkins or GitLab Continuous Integration.

### Description

**This position provides technical and professional-level support to the Revenue Division within the Finance Department. The successful candidate will have a working title of Revenue Analyst, Senior.**

This role involves forecasting citywide sales tax revenue using various economic models and methods, conducting transaction privilege tax (TPT) analytics and research, monitoring revenue results, and reporting on outcomes. The position requires using financial models and databases to research and prepare recommendations, conducting independent research projects related to citywide initiatives and other revenue-based analyses, and researching statutes and other guiding principles to enhance forecasting methods. Additionally, this position entails attending training, conferences, and seminars to ensure the Town employs best practices and the most current financial philosophies related to revenue.

**IMPORTANT APPLICANT INFORMATION:**

_The advertised salary range provided covers the entire compensation spectrum for the position classification._ _The anticipated hiring range for this role is between $87,444.00 to $107,118.89 annually. It's essential to note that the actual salary offered will be determined based on several factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, training, and internal equity considerations._

**JOB CLASSIFICATION SUMMARY**

Positions assigned to this class are responsible for performing difficult to complex budget, financial and accounting duties.

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**

This is a fully qualified and experienced level professional classification in the financial services job family.   Incumbents perform the full range of duties that demonstrates knowledge of expected functional requirements or performance specifications within financial services. Work involves the application of sound principles and best practices associated with planning and problem solving. Works independently and performs varied assignments requiring broad knowledge in accounting/finance. Analyzes complex issues and makes recommendations to management.

### Examples of Duties

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

_The following are intended to describe core work functions of this classification.  While the level and broad nature of essential duties may not change, specific work tasks will vary over time depending on the Town’s needs._

- Collects, compiles and reviews applicable financial or budget information for accuracy, completeness and compliance with pre-determined targets, goals and policies, updates organizational charts, goals, and/or performance measures; prepares formal financial or budget documents, revenue and expense projections, and other specialized financial reports and analysis; prepares monthly and annual closing of financials and corresponding budget reports.
- Participates in the planning, implementation and evaluation of the assigned fiscal processes and develops strategies and alternatives that focus on continuous improvement, innovation and change.
- Prepares a variety of financial and/or budget analyses; recommends policy changes or actions based on analyses.
- Develops and updates financial or budget forecasting models; prepares multi-year financial or budget forecasts.
- Designs and conducts training seminars for staff, external attendees (Citizen Leadership, etc.) related to finance, accounting, budgeting, performance measures, and/or capital project management.
- Analyzes and prepares economic impacts of development, annexations and land use proposals; develops financial models used to forecast economic trends.
- Develops multi-year financing plans for capital improvements and infrastructure projects.
- Analyzes tax, rate and fee structures and recommends changes where appropriate.
- Presents financial analyses to applicable stakeholder groups; presents policy analysis or other financial feasibility studies to senior management.
- Assists internal departments in developing and evaluating performance measures and benchmarks.
- Creates and maintains a variety of financial and/or budget reports.
- Performs related work as assigned.

### Typical Qualifications

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**(at job entry)

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field and 4 years of journey-level, related experience; or an equivalent combination of directly related education and experience. Master’s degree preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE**

- Public sector accounting, budgeting, and finance principles and practices;
- Fiscal analysis and research principles and practices;
- Municipal budgeting principles and practices;
- Financial statement preparation methodologies and techniques;
- Customer service principles;
- Municipal accounting procedures, including general ledger, budget, capital assets, and long-term debt;
- Statistical analysis principles and practices;
- Research techniques;
- Forecasting and economic trending methods and techniques;
- Economic impact study principles, practices and techniques;
- Applicable Federal, state and local laws, codes, ordinances, rules and regulations;
- Standard office equipment including the computer and programs relevant to the performance of applicable duties and responsibilities.

**SKILLS**

- Researching a variety of fiscal and/or budget information;
- Developing financial data into useful reports and presentations;
- Forecasting and recognizing, following and analyzing trends;
- Tabulating, recording, and balancing transactions;
- Preparing financial statements and reports;
- Performing complex accounting calculations;
- Managing projects;
- Contributing to or leading part of a multi-functional team;
- Working independently;
- Analyzing, synthesizing and drawing conclusions from complex data;
- Using computers and related software applications;
- Arranging information into concise and logical reports;
- Giving presentations;
- Providing customer service;
- Operating standard office equipment;
- Preparing economic trends and forecasts;
- Conducing economic impact studies;
- Interpreting and applying applicable Federal, state and local laws, codes, ordinances, rules and regulations;
- Communication and interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, supervisor, the general public, and other interested parties sufficient to exchange or convey information and to receive work direction.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

title: Robotics Test Engineer (m/f/d) - Quality & Safety
description:
About the role

As a Robotics Software Test Engineer, you will play a central role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and predictability of our robotic systems. Your work will span the entire control pipeline—from low‑level C‑based APIs to ROS 2 interfaces and full hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) validation. Partnering closely with robotics software, controls, and hardware teams, you will define and execute a testing strategy that guarantees our robots behave consistently and safely across all operating conditions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop clear, scalable test plans for our robotics software including the ROS 2 wrapper around our low‑level arm and hand control APIs
  • Design unit, integration, system, and HIL tests that validate the translation between ROS 2 interfaces and the underlying C‑based control API
  • Build mock environments using frameworks/Tools such as gTest/gMock to isolate and test ROS 2 topics, services, actions, and parameter handling
  • Execute integration tests in simulation and on physical robotic hardware to verify the full control chain
  • Ensure state reporting, diagnostics, and error‑handling mechanisms operate reliably within the ROS 2 ecosystem
  • Test the ROS 2 hardware interface, including initialization routines, state interfaces, and command interfaces
  • Conduct structured hardware testing, progressing from unit tests to SIL (software‑in‑the‑loop) and HIL (hardware‑in‑the‑loop) for complete end‑to‑end validation
  • Develop automated test scripts and custom tools that extend standard ROS 2 utilities
  • Perform long‑duration stability tests, performance evaluations, and controlled fault‑injection experiments
  • Document results, analyze system behavior, and collaborate with developers to identify, track, and resolve issues
  • Continuously refine testing workflows to improve coverage, safety, and confidence in every software release

Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field
  • 2–3 years of hands‑on experience testing robotics software, ideally with ROS 2
  • Strong understanding of unit, integration, system, and hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing methodologies
  • Proficiency with C++, Python, Linux development, and ROS 2 tools (topics, services, actions, launch_testing, etc.)
  • Experience with gTest/gMock and mocking low‑level APIs
  • Ability to work safely around robotic hardware and evaluate system behavior in real‑world tests
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail‑oriented testing mindset
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience testing control systems, hardware interfaces, or robotic manipulators
  • Familiarity with ROS 2 hardware interface concepts (resource manager, controllers)
  • Exposure to real‑time systems or low‑level control APIs
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, or simulation tools (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, etc.)

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Individual and Legacy Assistant
description:
**ALDER HEY CHILDRENS CHARITY**

**Job title:** Individual and Legacy Assistant

**Salary:** £26,848 – £31,439

**Hours:** 37.5 hours per week

**Location:** Mix of home working and office based (office is at Alder Hey, Liverpool). Hybrid working available.

**About us**

Alder Hey Children’s Charity raises vital funds to help make Alder Hey Children’s Hospital a truly world-class, patient-friendly hospital for the 450,000 patients and families we care for every year.

The charity helps to fund a range of activities and projects that are designed to enhance and improve the lives of our amazing young patients. This includes the funding of specialist medical equipment to ensure our brilliant surgeons and clinical staff have the most up to date and cutting edge technology available and funding hi-tech distraction equipment designed and proven to reduce pain and anxiety in our patients. We also fund a range of programmes and special projects such as our ward musicians, our on-site magician and the play specialists we have on every ward.

**About this role**

This is an exciting opportunity for an Individual Giving and Legacy Assistant to join the Charity team here at Alder Hey, the UK’s busiest Children’s Hospital.

This role sits within the Individual Giving and Legacy team which includes an Individual Giving Fundraiser and a Legacy and In Memory Fundraiser. The role also works closely with colleagues across the community, marketing and finance teams to deliver supporter journeys, website content, and the smooth running of fundraising campaigns.

The post-holder supports the generation of income and delivers an excellent supporter experience. They ensure supporters and enquirers receive a prompt, warm, and appropriate response at every stage of their journey with the Alder Hey Children’s Charity.

The role is responsible for maintaining accurate supporter records on the Charity’s CRM system (Salesforce), helping supporter administration (including Gift Aid, tribute pages, and regular giving processes), and assisting with the coordination of legacy enquiries, pledgers, and the free Will Writing service.

Key Responsibilities will include:

**Administration, Processes and Data**

- Ensure supporter records are kept accurate and up to date on the charity’s CRM (Salesforce).

- Complete supporter administrative processes such as tracking and take actions on the cancelation of regular donations/lottery, setting up of tribute pages, and Gift Aid administration.

- Provide administration support for the management of legacy enquirers, pledgers and actively track the progress of live legacy cases.

- Provide administration support for the management of the free Will Writing service.

- To help ensure pages on the charity’s website are kept up to date and work with the wider team to enhance those pages.

- Monitor marketing resources, such as leaflets, to ensure stock levels are maintained.

- Diary management, minute taking and meeting organisation.

**Stewardship**

- Deal with incoming enquires prioritising, re-directing, or responding in a timely, sensitive and appropriate manner.

- Help deliver exceptional supporter care, ensuring that everyone who responds to the Charity’s campaigns and appeals receives a warm, timely and meaningful thank you, helping to build long-term relationships with Alder Hey Children’s Charity.

- Process and action established supporter journey and activities across a variety of programmes.

- Support the development and enhancement of supporter journeys.

- Support the planning and delivery of all campaigns and activities, helping to inspire supporters to make a difference.

- Assist with the arrangements for events to ensure that all supporters receive outstanding stewardship to establish long term commitment to the charity.

Please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification for more information.

**Our Values**

At Alder Hey Children’s Charity, our values guide how we work. Being courageous, working together, showing passion and embracing creativity enables us to support the hospital in delivering the very best care for young patients and their families.

**Courage**

We try new things, take risks and innovate. We speak up, take accountability and act with responsibility.

**Together**

We work as one team, sharing knowledge and learning. We partner with patients, families, supporters and colleagues.

**Passion**

We are passionate about what we do and inspire others.

**Magic**

We are creative, fun and child-led, creating special moments and going the extra mile.

**Additional Information**

In April 2025, the charity adopted a four-day working week policy. Staff previously working 37.5 hours now work 30 hours across four days, maintaining full pay while supporting a better work-life balance.

This job description outlines the general nature of the role and is not exhaustive. It may be subject to change in line with organisational needs.

Alder Hey Children’s Charity will make reasonable adjustments where required and is committed to equal opportunities and safeguarding children and vulnerable adults.

The post holder will be required to complete an enhanced DBS disclosure check.

title: Research Associate (GreenAVM Project)
