title: Specialist, Systems Engineer - Software Defined Radio
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**_Job Title: Specialist, Systems Engineer – Software Defined Radio_**

**_Job Code: 44308_**

**_Job Location: Yorba Linda, CA_**

**_Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week_**

**Job Description:**

Navigation Solutions delivers advanced military GPS and broader Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) capabilities that support mission requirements across weapon systems, ground platforms, airborne assets, maritime systems, and space environments. The engineer will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams to ensure these systems meet performance, reliability, and integration requirements across all operational domains.

A key responsibility of this role is field testing GPS receivers in contested and threat‑representative environments. This includes planning, executing, and analyzing tests that assess receiver performance under conditions such as jamming, spoofing, intentional interference, and degraded‑signal scenarios. The engineer will validate real‑world robustness, characterize system behavior under mission-relevant stressors, and ensure compliance with stringent military performance standards. These field activities require travel and coordination with external test ranges, customers, and mission partners.

Navigation Solutions products are engineered to provide resilient PNT performance for the warfighter operating in denied or degraded environments. This role directly ensures that GPS receivers and simulators maintain mission effectiveness when exposed to adversarial threats and operational challenges.

**Essential Functions:**

- Integrate, configure, and validate software defined radio (SDR) architectures used across all GPS simulators, ensuring accurate signal generation, modulation, and timing performance.
- Develop and execute RF test methodologies tailored to SDR-based systems, including waveform verification, calibration procedures, and over-the-air (OTA) characterization.
- Implement and maintain FPGA- and DSP based signal processing chains that support GPS, GNSS, and custom PNT waveforms within SDR platforms.
- Troubleshoot SDR hardware/software interactions, including RF front-end behavior, digital interface control, and embedded firmware issues affecting simulator performance.
- Create automated test scripts and diagnostic tools to evaluate SDR output fidelity, dynamic range, phase noise, and interference resilience.
-  Collaborate with system architects and RF engineers to define SDR integration requirements for next generation GPS simulators and PNT solutions.
- Support STE development for SDR-based systems, ensuring compatibility with high-speed digital interfaces, RF switching networks, and precision timing sources.
- Perform detailed data analysis on SDR-generated signals to confirm compliance with system specifications, military GPS standards, and program requirements.
- Participate in acceptance testing and configuration management of SDR firmware loads, FPGA bitstreams, and associated calibration files.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) or related discipline with minimum 4 years prior relevant experience, 2-year post-secondary/AA Degree and 8 years prior experience, or Graduate Degree with 2 years of prior related experience, or in lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.
- 2+ years’ hands on experience working with software defined radios (SDRs), including configuration, waveform development, RF front end integration, and digital signal processing (DSP) workflows.
- Active US Secret security clearance.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Proficiency in SDR frameworks or toolchains (such as GNU Radio, MATLAB/Simulink, Ettus/USRP platforms, or equivalent internal architectures).
- Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, including modulation schemes, filtering, signal generation, phase noise, dynamic range, and interference analysis.
- Experience with Python for automation, scripting, signal validation, and test control.
- Familiarity with FPGA or embedded‑processor‑based signal processing as used in SDR platforms, including interpreting firmware loads, bitstreams, and interface configurations.
- Demonstrated ability to isolate and debug issues across RF hardware, digital signal chains, and embedded software layers.
- Capable of working effectively both independently and in collaborative cross‑functional engineering environments.
- Strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
- Flexible work schedule but 4/10 is preferred.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in is $92,500 - $171,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

#LI-JK1

- lead a team comprising technical leads for managing design compliance and change, temporary works coordination and design, digital modelling and information management (BIM), materials management, quality assurance and handover.

- Collaborate with other members of the project leadership team to ensure safe, efficient design, delivery and handover

title: Head of Public Affairs (Germany & EU) @ AI Infrastructure Venture, Dresden
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We're building next-generation HPC and AI infrastructure for a world where brute-force compute is reaching its limits. Our chip and system architecture is designed to exploit sparsity at scale, focusing compute where it matters most and eliminating unnecessary computation everywhere else. That means orders-of-magnitude gains in performance and efficiency. We're based in Dresden and working at the intersection of deep tech, European industrial policy, and the global AI race.

About the Role

This is a senior hire at the centre of how we engage with government, regulators, and the broader European policy landscape. You'll lead our public affairs strategy across Germany and the EU, shaping how we're positioned in some of the most consequential policy debates of the decade: AI, semiconductors, digital sovereignty, and high-performance computing. You'll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, with real ownership over how we show up in Berlin and Brussels.

What you'll do

  • Define and execute our public affairs strategy across German federal and regional government, and EU institutions in Brussels

  • Monitor and anticipate regulatory, legislative, and geopolitical developments that affect our business

  • Build and maintain relationships with policymakers, institutional partners, and government stakeholders

  • Represent us in high-level meetings, consultations, and policy forums in Berlin and Brussels

  • Position us as a recognised voice in European AI infrastructure and deep tech

  • Engage with industry alliances, think tanks, and research institutions across Germany and the EU

  • Identify and support access to public funding programmes, including Horizon Europe, the Chips Act, IPCEI, and national innovation programmes

  • Drive participation in strategic consortia and collaborative European initiatives

  • Develop policy narratives around AI, compute infrastructure, and European competitiveness

  • Contribute to position papers, consultation responses, and public communications

  • Support CEO and leadership visibility in policy and industry discussions

  • Advise internally on regulatory risks and opportunities, helping align corporate strategy with the political landscape

About You

You understand how policy gets made in Berlin and Brussels, and you know how to get a deep tech company into the right rooms. You're equally comfortable briefing a minister, drafting a position paper, or working with an engineering team to translate what we do into language that resonates with policymakers. You think strategically but you're hands-on, and you're motivated by the idea of shaping European technology policy from inside a company that's building something genuinely new.

  • Significant experience in public affairs, government relations, or policy, with a strong track record across both Germany and EU institutions

  • Background in deep tech, AI, semiconductors, or advanced computing

  • An established network in Berlin and / or Brussels policy circles

  • Experience working within or alongside startups or scale-ups, not just large corporates

  • Able to translate complex technical topics into clear, accessible messaging for non-technical audiences

  • Professional fluency in both English and German

Nice to have:

  • Additional EU languages

  • Experience with IPCEI processes or large-scale European consortium programmes

  • Familiarity with German federal and regional funding landscapes

Why Join

We're at an inflection point. The European policy environment around AI, semiconductors, and compute infrastructure is moving fast, and we're right in the middle of it. This role gives you direct influence over how a deep tech company engages with some of the most important policy debates in Europe today. You'll work closely with the CEO, have genuine ownership of the strategy, and help shape how Europe builds its compute future. We offer relocation support and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

title: Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development
description:
The Industrial Application Group of Agile Robots is looking for a motivated Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development to support the development, testing, and commissioning of industrial vision systems for robotic and AGV applications. In this full-time internship, you will work hands-on across the entire lifecycle of our vision solutions — from software development and camera calibration at our Munich headquarters to on-site commissioning at customer production sites.

Your Responsibilities

  • Vision Software Development: Develop, test, and maintain software components for industrial 2D/3D vision systems, including API-based secondary development on top of vision vendor SDKs.
  • Camera Setup & Calibration: Configure and calibrate 2D area-scan/line-scan cameras and 3D sensors for robotic and AGV applications, performing nine-point, checkerboard, and 3D hand-eye calibrations.
  • Algorithm Debugging: Support the debugging and tuning of core vision algorithms, from QR-code and natural-contour (V-SLAM) AGV navigation to deep-learning-based detection models.
  • Testing & Automation: Write Python scripts for automated testing and data-log analysis, and validate vision system performance in the lab and in production-like environments.
  • System Integration: Configure and troubleshoot data exchange between vision industrial PCs (IPCs) and PLCs, supporting communication via TCP/IP sockets, Modbus TCP, and ROS/ROS2.
  • On-Site Commissioning: Travel to customer sites to install, commission, fine-tune, and troubleshoot vision systems on real production lines.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to integrate vision solutions into end-to-end robotic systems.

Essential Skills

  • Education: Ongoing Bachelor's or Master's studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Automation, or a related field (or recently graduated).
  • Camera Hardware & Calibration: Hands-on experience configuring and calibrating mainstream 2D area-scan/line-scan cameras (e.g.Basler) and 3D sensors (e.g.Intel RealSense, structured-light cameras), including nine-point, checkerboard, and 3D hand-eye calibration.
  • Vision Algorithms: Understanding of the underlying logic of vision-based AGV navigation — QR-code navigation and natural-contour navigation (V-SLAM) — as well as the deployment of deep-learning-based detection models (e.g.the YOLO series).

**As a Graduate Sustainability Consultant,** your day-to-day tasks will vary, as we’ll expose you to all aspects of our work so you can discover what suits you. You could be;

- Working on live projects from day one – [our exciting projects](https://hoarelea.com/projects/)
- In a variety of sectors from healthcare to hotels, retail to residential
- Undertaking building performance simulation and energy related workstreams, using a range of modelling approaches, tools, and techniques
- Developing energy strategies with our clients to lead sustainability innovation on a series of developments

- Developing an understanding and knowledge of whole life carbon reporting to support clients Net Zero Carbon strategies
- Undertaking site surveys
- Researching ground-breaking technologies
- Continuous CPD and learning opportunities
- Supporting the development of holistic Sustainability Strategies, where necessary

As well as project-related work, the Group engages directly with industry undertaking research and development studies, and authoring industry guidance. We hold key positions on national design commissions and influential industry bodies. The role also presents the opportunity for involvement in this aspect of the Group’s work to those keen to have a direct influence on the industry.

Communicating will span all of these, as we regularly liaise with project teams, meet clients or end users, and attend collaborative meetings.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, **_you’ll need to be serious about sustainability_**, and have…

- An expected or achieved 2.1 or above degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Architecture, or the Built Environment, or similar
- An appreciation of broader sustainability issues, such as sustainability governance and reporting, sustainability strategies, climate change adaptation, behaviour change, etc.
- Excellent communication, analytical and organisational skills
- Ability to work in a team environment and independently
- A friendly, ambitious and confident individual with a flexible and resilient approach

_It would be an advantage, but not necessary, if you also had…_

- A Masters or other relevant post graduate qualification
- Previous placement or work experience in a similar industry
- Knowledge / awareness of one or more of the following: BREEAM, WELL, Whole Life Carbon, Energy Modelling

**Our Benefits**

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer both core and flexible benefits, a competitive salary and industry leading training and development to support you throughout your career.  We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality.

You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

**How to Apply**

To apply simply complete a CV profile, answer a couple questions, and submit your application. For hints and tips in applying [click here](https://hoarelea.com/2018/10/02/tips-for-your-graduate-application/).

**Please only apply for one location for your discipline, if you are flexible with location, great! – you will have the chance to select your other location preferences, and this will be confirmed again with you at telephone interview.** If you apply for multiple locations, you will only be considered for the location you have applied for.

**_Please note:_** We do not offer visa sponsorship for this graduate role. Only candidates already authorised to work in the UK – e.g. British/Irish citizens, EU Settled/Pre-Settled, ILR holders – will be considered.

**Recruitment Process**

Our projects are human-centric, and so is our recruitment process. Once you’ve applied, you’ll speak to a person every step of the way. Here’s our planned timeline:

- Applications close – 6th November 2026
- Telephone Interviews – November/December 2026

**Adjustments and accommodations**

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to ensure you can participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence, or anything else) please let us know.

**Flexible working**

We are committed to enabling a healthy work-life balance for all employees. So, we welcome applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements to suit their particular needs and lifestyle, including part-time, term-time-only, and remote working.

**Data privacy**

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click [here](https://hoarelea.com/app/uploads/2024/08/Candidate-Privacy-Notice-August-2024.pdf) to find out more.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.

As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud-based system.

Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.

This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.

Key job responsibilities
The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead hands-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader engineering organization.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

As the Specialist Fitter, you will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, repair and construction of water and sewerage infrastructure and associated plant and equipment.

You are a skilled Specialist Fitter who takes pride in delivering high-quality maintenance work and understands the importance of keeping essential community infrastructure operating safely and efficiently.

- Experience working with pumps, conveyors, compressors, gearboxes, electric motors, chemical dosing systems, aeration systems, vacuum systems and other treatment plant equipment.

This is more than just a mechanical maintenance role. As part of Gympie Regional Council's Water Industry Operations team, you'll play a vital role in delivering safe, reliable and efficient water, wastewater and recycled water services that support our communities every day.

You'll work across a diverse range of pumps, motors, treatment plant equipment, pipelines and mechanical systems that are critical to the operation of our water and wastewater infrastructure. Working alongside experienced professionals and a well-equipped workshop you'll have opportunities to apply your technical expertise, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and help shape the future maintenance approach for our essential water assets.

title: Copyright Project Officer (Creative Content Exchange)
description:
**Summary**

Historic England is the public organisation that brings new life to heritage to build a better future for every place and everyone.

Historic England has a fantastic opportunity for you to join us as our Copyright Project Officer (Creative Content Exchange).

**This is a part time 0.7 FTE, 5 month fixed-term contract position.**

The location of this role is Swindon, inclusive with hybrid working.

We offer a wide benefits package including a competitive defined benefit **pension scheme to which we make 28.97% employer contributions,** a generous 28 days holiday, corporate discounts, free entry into English Heritage sites across the country and development opportunities to ensure you achieve your goals.

To view our full range of benefits please follow the link [here](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/employee-rewards-and-benefits/).

**What you will be doing**

We are the nation’s Archive of England’s historic environment.  We commit to be open, relevant and reflective of all stories and places so we can better understand the historic environment and how it has shaped our rich and diverse cultural identities.  We curate a dynamic collection that tells the story of the shared memories and lived histories of places in England.

The Copyright Project Officer (Creative Content Exchange) will provide specialist archive expertise to support the delivery of Historic England's Creative Content Exchange (CCE) pilot project.

The CCE is a UK government-backed initiative that aims to bring together UK-based creative content owners and businesses looking to use the wealth and range of digital assets held within the collections and archives of UK cultural institutions.

As Copyright Project Officer, you will review Historic England Archive collections to establish their suitability for inclusion within the CCE platform.  You will assess which collections can be enabled for the Cultural Content Exchange project (CCE), under what conditions and with what level of risk.

You will undertake rights research, provenance investigation and copyright assessment.  You will document decisions clearly and consistently, support risk‑managed access and reuse, and contribute to the Archive’s wider work to make collections more accessible, compliant and usable for internal and external audiences.

You will work closely with the Project Manager (Creative Content Exchange), Archive colleagues, Legal Services, Digital teams and external partners.

By providing a clear and evidence-based assessment of content availability and usage restrictions, the role will help enable Historic England to maximise the accessibility and value of its archive collections through the CCE, while ensuring compliance with legal, ethical and organisational requirements.

**Who we are looking for**

- Experience of copyright, intellectual property rights and rights management in an archive, library, heritage or similar environment.

- Experience of researching archive collections, provenance and ownership to support access and decision-making.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make evidence-based recommendations and assess risk.

- Experience of delivering work within a project environment, managing priorities and maintaining accurate records and documentation.

- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams and with external partners.

[https://historicengland.org.uk/media/ot0fj0ii/copyright-project-officer-creative-content-exchange.odt](https://cms.historicengland.org.uk/media/ot0fj0ii/copyright-project-officer-creative-content-exchange.odt)

Whether you are collaborating at our state-of-the-art Global Technology and Business Center (GTBC) or manufacturing iconic, award-winning vehicles in our world-class plants, you will find a culture evolving together, built on trust, passion, and shared purpose. Here, your work moves people forward, and your growth is personal. Join us, and let’s build what’s next together.

In this position...

Join our global Enterprise Product Systems & Engineering team at the Global Technology and Business Center (GTBC) to lead the modernization of mission-critical automotive service documentation and diagnostics platforms. In this role, you will architect and deliver high-performance cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), modernizing legacy .NET architectures into scalable Java and React applications. You will empower technicians and service teams worldwide with fast, reliable access to technical service documentation, directly improving vehicle quality and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do...

  • Architect, build, and deploy full-stack cloud applications utilizing Java, React, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Run.
  • Lead the migration and modernization of legacy ASP.NET/C# backends and SQL Server databases into modern, cloud-native services.
  • Design, configure, and maintain robust CI/CD automation pipelines utilizing GitHub Actions, API security tooling (such as 42Crunch), and automated testing suites.
  • Author comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests to ensure top-tier code coverage, reliability, and security compliance.
  • Partner cross-functionally with product managers, business stakeholders, and global engineering squads across Mexico, the US, and India to translate complex business requirements into user-friendly software solutions.
  • Champion Agile engineering best practices within a bi-weekly sprint cycle, actively leading story mapping, technical documentation, and code reviews.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of full-stack software engineering experience, including hands-on experience migrating enterprise applications to modern cloud environments.
  • Proficiency in modern Java development (e.g., Spring Boot) and Google Cloud Platform services (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL), alongside foundational experience with C# / .NET and relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server).
  • Strong working knowledge of modern front-end frameworks (React or Angular), RESTful API design, XML/JSON data processing, and Git-based workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing automated CI/CD pipelines (such as GitHub Actions) and operating effectively within Agile/Scrum delivery teams across distributed global time zones.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, both verbal and written, with strong cross-cultural communication skills.

Even better, you may have...

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
  • Hands-on experience with API security compliance testing tools (such as 42Crunch) and contract-driven API design.
  • Familiarity with structured Root Cause Analysis methodologies or Lean / Six Sigma continuous improvement frameworks.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Clinical Molecular Technologist
description:

This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

Clinical Molecular Technologist

**Job Profile Title**

Research Specialist B

**Job Description Summary**

The clinical molecular technologist will serve as a clinical technician in the laboratory of Dr. Arupa Ganguly. The employee will perform all aspects of DNA isolation, mutation detection in human disease associated genes, real-time Q-PCR analysis for gene dosage and mosaicism analysis, NGS library preparation, sequence analysis, and other relevant functions of the laboratory. Experience with performing or analyzing bioinformatics of next generation sequencing techniques on DNA or RNA preferred.

**Job Description**

**Job Responsibilities**

- Carry out clinical procedures associated with genetic diagnosis of human diseases, including Sanger and NextGen sequencing, copy number determination, Methylation analysis by RT-PCR

- Perform analysis of results of diagnostic analyses including variant annotation, RT-PCR and Illumina iSCAN data analysis

- Bioinformatic analysis skills desirable

- Routine DNA isolation, quantitation and Quality Control assays

- Maintain equipment, arrange service calls and monitor service contacts. Monitor supplies and order as necessary; monitor expenses.

- Assist in experimental design & project development

- Participate in lab meetings, journal club; attend relevant seminars and conferences

- Other duties as assigned


**Qualifications**

- Bachelor of Science and 1 to 3 years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

Perelman School of Medicine

title: Quality Assurance Associate - ANZ
description:
Within this role, you will drive and support the delivery of operational excellence and implementation of all Quality Assurance functions for the Link ANZ warehouse facilities, ensuring these functions are performed in compliance with company policies, ISO, GDP and GMP requirements and as required by local issuing authorities.

Major Tasks & Activities:

Product Release for Distribution

  • Review and approve product release for distribution in accordance with applicable GDP requirements, company procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Verify that all release requirements have been met prior to product distribution.
  • Identify, assess and escalate actual or potential non-conformances that may impact product quality, compliance or release status.
  • Ensure all release decisions are documented and supported by appropriate records.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to resolve issues that may impact timely product release.

Customer Approvals

  • Review and approve customer applications, as required
  • Ensure all documentation is saved and filed appropriately
  • Review and reapproved customers, as per the defined re-evaluation period

Complaint Management

  • Manage the receipt, review, investigation and closure of customer complaints.
  • Coordinate investigations with internal stakeholders, customers and product manufacturers as required.
  • Identify and implement corrective and preventive actions where appropriate.
  • Analyse complaint trends and escalate significant quality issues to management.

Reporting and Quality Metrics

  • Prepare monthly quality reports and quality performance metrics for the ANZ business.
  • Analyse and trend quality system data, including complaints, temperature excursions, returns and other quality indicators.
  • Prepare presentations and reports for management review meetings and other stakeholder forums.
  • Present quality data and trends to management and relevant stakeholders, highlighting risks and improvement opportunities.

Returns Management

  • Review and approve returned product assessments in accordance with GDP requirements and company procedures.
  • Determine disposition of returned goods based on available quality information and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure returned product investigations and decisions are appropriately documented.
  • Identify and escalate quality or compliance concerns arising from returned goods.

Temperature Excursion Management

  • Review, investigate and assess temperature excursions affecting medicinal products.
  • Perform quality risk assessments to determine product impact and disposition.
  • Liaise with customers, logistics providers, manufacturers and internal stakeholders to obtain information required for assessment.
  • Ensure excursion investigations are completed and documented within required timelines.
  • Trend temperature excursion data and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Quality Risk Management

  • Apply and continue to develop an understanding of Quality Risk principles, with respect to Premises, Equipment, Computerised Systems, Processes, Qualification, and Transportation
  • Support Quality Manager with the communication and review of risks to the quality of medicinal products.

Investigation and Reporting Nonconformances/Implementation of Corrective and Preventative Actions

  • Gather information and data to support the investigation all deviations and record root cause, impact assessment and trend analysis
  • Support the Identification of corrective and preventive actions, as well as system improvements
  • Facilitate the implementation of corrective actions in a compliant and timely manner

Training Activities

  • Manage and maintain the training matrix and reviewal of training records.
  • Drive the delivery of training to relevant company employees in the Code of GDP, GMP, SOP’s and other necessary procedures
  • Participate in internal & external training as required, to ensure Quality Assurance practices are up to date and compliant with best practice and legislation requirements
  • Manage and support internal compliance inspections

Inspection

  • Authorise release of incoming stock after determination of compliance
  • Inspection and processing of returned goods
  • Maintain and review complaints database
  • Log all entries and process responses, coordinating with Med Info and Customer Service if required
  • Work with the customer services team to investigate customer complaints & stock returns
  • Segregation and reconciliation of rejected stock

Auditing

  • Organise and participate in Internal Audits, as per a defined schedule
  • Support Quality Manager with writing audit reports and manage findings and audit related CAPAs
  • Support and participate in External Audits
  • Maintain accurate records and appropriate documentation of any audits relevant to QA
  • Support the implementation of any necessary actions as a result of a conducted audit

Vendor Management

  • Maintain a current Approved Supplier List (ASL)
  • Support the necessary business functions in the setup of new Vendors
  • Review documentation provided, and approve Vendors as required
  • Identify Vendors that require reapproval, defined by their risk to the business, and arrange for reapproval

Administration

  • Plan and undertake special projects and investigations as defined by the company
  • Support Quality Manager with any new global initiatives and projects.
  • Ensure filing and documentation is up-to-date and is compliant with standard processes and formats
  • Complete required reports within designated timeframes
  • Organise, support, and participate in meetings as needed
  • Liaise with the Quality Assurance Manager and internal stakeholders as required to ensure projects are conducted efficiently
  • Master computer skills and required software programs
  • Ensure all GDP requirements are within governmental regulation guidelines

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics providers and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide quality guidance and support to business functions on quality and compliance requirements.
  • Represent the Quality function in cross-functional meetings, projects and initiatives.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve quality issues and drive continuous improvement activities.

Knowledge and Compliance

  • Assist in identifying and solving compliance issues within the Company
  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness, tidiness and organization of work areas
  • Attend relevant industry conferences to expand knowledge of relevant therapeutic areas
  • Promptly notify Link’s pharmacovigilance unit of all adverse reactions reported on Link’s products
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Link standard operating procedures and policies and ensure compliance at all times
  • Carry out your duties in adherence to GDP regulations
  • Contributes to a Quality-focused mindset; Quality is everyone’s responsibility.
  • Ensure every team member has the opportunity to work in a safe and healthy work environment.
  • Ensure your Company related activities comply with relevant Acts, legal demands and ethical standards

Requirements

  • Tertiary qualifications in a technical discipline or relevant experience
  • Demonstrated experience in an operations roles within the pharmaceutical and allied industry
  • Experience of working within a GDP and GMP Quality Management Systems, an understanding of facility design and operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional relationships
  • Comfortable working autonomously (and in teams) with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

title: Country LPG Operations & LMD Lead - Zambia
description:
Job Location: Zambia

About the role:

This role oversees the end-to-end physical operations of Sun King’s PAYG LPG business in Zambia, covering supplier intake, bulk transport, depot management, cylinder asset lifecycle, shop replenishment, and last-mile delivery.

In parallel, the role will develop scalable Last Mile Delivery (LMD) capabilities to serve LPG operations today and accommodate additional product categories in the future. The position brings supply chain and asset management, depot infrastructure, and last-mile optimization into one integrated physical operations function.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product and Commercial teams to develop systems, processes, and features that enable the LPG supply chain to scale while maintaining a high standard of last-mile customer service.

1. LPG Supply Management
  • Coordinate LPG sourcing and intake with Commercial teams and supplier partners.
  • Oversee bulk transport from suppliers to refilling points or bulk storage facilities.
  • Maintain safe and timely movement of bulk LPG across the network.
  • Monitor refill turnaround times and maintain supply continuity.
  • Identify supply bottlenecks and implement measures to reduce stock-out risks.
  • Improve bulk transport costs and routing efficiency.
  • Provide market and operational insights to Commercial and Business Unit teams to inform supplier price negotiations.
  • Maintain continuous and safe LPG availability across the Sun King network.
2. Inventory Planning & Replenishment
  • Manage the flow of LPG-related inventory, including cookstoves, cylinders, FMCDs, accessories, and LPG, from suppliers to depots and shops.
  • Establish and monitor inventory levels across depots and shops.
  • Define and implement safety stock policies.
  • Minimize stock-outs while maintaining efficient working capital utilization.
  • Develop replenishment planning frameworks aligned with customer demand.
  • Coordinate demand forecasting with Sales teams.
  • Maintain service continuity while optimizing working capital.
3. Depot Infrastructure Management
  • Develop standardized layouts for cooking-related depots and shops.
  • Establish depot capacity benchmarks, including cylinder storage capacity and throughput limits.
  • Maintain compliance with safe storage standards.
  • Establish effective segregation of empty and full cylinders, including designated quarantine zones.
  • Improve depot workflows to reduce handling time.
  • Establish throughput targets for each depot.
4. Asset Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain cylinder tracking and visibility across markets.
  • Improve monthly cylinder working capital efficiency.
  • Ensure that more than 97% of assets recovered through repossession are redeployed.
  • Reduce asset shrinkage and the proportion of idle assets.
  • Manage the cylinder recertification pipeline.
  • Improve turnaround times from empty-cylinder collection to redeployment.
  • Maximize asset productivity and capital efficiency.
5. LPG Last Mile Delivery Performance
  • Improve rider productivity and delivery service quality.
  • Optimize delivery routing and geographic density.
  • Monitor and reduce cost per delivery.
  • Improve adherence to service-level requirements.
  • Optimize fleet utilization.
  • Improve LPG delivery performance and cost-to-serve efficiency.
6. Operational Safety & Compliance
  • Ensure compliance with depot storage requirements and safety limits.
  • Maintain adherence to rider safety protocols.
  • Coordinate incident investigations and follow-up actions.
  • Conduct depot safety audits and monitor corrective actions.
  • Maintain safe bulk LPG handling processes across operations.
7. Integrated LMD Infrastructure Across Product Categories
  • Develop scalable last-mile delivery infrastructure that can serve LPG and additional product categories, including inverters, mobile phones, and solar products distributed through agent stock points.
  • Develop a scalable last-mile operating model that accommodates LPG and future product categories.
  • Establish common routing frameworks and rider productivity standards.
  • Develop fleet utilization models across product categories.
  • Define cost-per-stop economics to guide distribution planning.
  • Standardize field performance management practices across the network.
8. Team Development & Capacity Building
  • Manage and develop multi-country LMD teams, building the capabilities required for scalable operations.
  • Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) to enable consistent execution and business growth.
  • Coordinate recruitment and training for depot, logistics, and LMD teams.
  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, and safety.
9. Financial & Performance Ownership
  • Oversee operational performance indicators including: LPG availability and stock-out percentage, Bulk transport costs, Depot throughput efficiency, Cylinder working capital, Cost per delivery, and Inventory loss percentage.
  • Develop and manage LMD operational budgets.
  • Monitor cost-to-serve metrics and distribution unit economics.
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities across transport, storage, and handling.
  • Establish relevant KPIs for the in-country team and monitor progress against targets.
  • Provide regular reports and evidence-based recommendations to senior management on delivery optimization strategies.
  • A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Finance, IT, or a related field.
  • Experience in LPG, downstream oil and gas, or FMCG distribution.
  • Strong knowledge of last-mile distribution networks and experience scaling operations in emerging markets.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including successful delivery of process improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with minimal supervision.
  • Experience monitoring and evaluating the impact of operational changes on delivery efficiency and rider productivity.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience managing cross-border teams and developing team capabilities across multiple markets.
  • Strong data interpretation and financial skills, with the ability to use operational information to inform business choices.
  • Familiarity with regulatory bodies, such as Energy Regulatory Authorities, is preferred.
  • Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high-social-impact industry
  • An open-minded, collaborative culture with enthusiastic colleagues driven by the challenge of innovation and making a profound impact on people and the planet.
  • A truly multicultural experience: you will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds.
  • Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun King Center for Leadership.
We place great importance on sustaining a diverse, inclusive work environment.

We believe that innovation and understanding comes from diversity on every spectrum. We work to make sure every Sun King team member knows that they belong, knowing that sustaining an inclusive workplace requires conscious effort and is a continuous journey, not an end-state.

Sun King recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes people based on their experience, skills, effort, and results. We explicitly prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, religion, caste, national origin, color, gender, marital status, family structure, sexual orientation, HIV/AIDS status, or disability.

_L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing diverse, high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries._

**Job Summary:**

Will be a dedicated resource that will participate in all aspects of operating special mission sensor aircraft in support of Multiple Department of War programs including experimental flight testing and operational support flights. The work involves extensive flight planning and work as part of a small team of pilots. Full time responsibility located at L3 Harris Aeromet’s Tulsa, OK Facility; however, will be required to travel to support operations worldwide with occasional deployment times of up to 30 days or more. Typical deployments are 10-14 days. Travel varies but is typically 50% annually.

**Essential Functions:**

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following duties:

·After an initial indoctrination and training period, perform as a Co-Captain on unique G550 special mission sensor aircraft operated by Aeromet on experimental and engineering test flights.

·Safely conduct training and operate the aircraft in accordance with all applicable FAA regulations and DCMA 8210 D requirements.

·Maintain professional standards of conduct at all times.

·Able to work any assigned shift or schedule, including mission support outside normal duty hours and travel worldwide as required to support mission requirements. Subject to on call status with a two-hour recall.

·Must be able to obtain a Department of War TS/SCI security clearance.

·US Citizenship required

**Required Qualifications**(one of the top 3 with an Active Top Secret/SCI) **:**

·Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience.

title: Commercial Counsel
description:
Our [mission](https://www.greenhouse.com/mission) at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a **Commercial Counsel**to join our team!

As Commercial Counsel at Greenhouse, you'll be a key legal partner to our Sales organization, owning day-to-day commercial contract negotiations from first draft through signature for a high volume of SaaS customer deals. You'll balance speed with sound risk management while reducing deal cycle times and building resilience into our commercial legal support as the business grows.

### **Who will love this job**

- **A deal-maker -** you enjoy finding the path from "we need to think about it" to "signed, sealed, delivered," while keeping sound legal judgment at the table.
- **A contract detective -** you can spot the important details, untangle tricky language, and turn legal fine print into clear, practical guidance.
- **A business partner -** you build strong relationships with Sales and cross-functional teams, bringing a collaborative mindset and knowing when to advise, negotiate, or escalate.
- **A workflow wizard -** you love making processes smoother, using smart tools to help the team work more efficiently without letting quality or compliance fall through the cracks.

### **What you’ll do**

- Draft and negotiate customer-facing SaaS agreements, including MSAs, order forms, DPAs, SLAs, and related documents, escalating complex or non-standard terms to senior counsel as needed.
- Support commercial negotiations end-to-end, helping structure deals that balance customer needs with Greenhouse's risk, operational, and compliance requirements.
- Partner with Sales and Deal Desk as a primary Legal contact for mid-market and enterprise transactions, answering questions, resolving issues, and unblocking deals.
- Manage data privacy and security aspects of deals by handling DPA negotiations and collaborating with Security/IT on customer security questionnaires and related reviews.
- Build and improve scalable contracting processes, workflows, templates, and playbooks (including through AI-powered tools) to reduce friction in the sales cycle and increase throughput over time.
- Enable the Sales organization by developing training materials, self-service resources, and guidance on common contract terms so reps can navigate routine issues independently.
- Advise internal stakeholders on contractual risk, liability, and compliance issues in a practical, business-oriented way that aligns with Greenhouse's strategic priorities.
- Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require.

### **You should have**

- A JD from an accredited law school and active bar membership in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
- 3-5 years of legal experience, with at least 2 years focused on commercial / transactional work (in-house SaaS experience preferred).
- Working knowledge of B2B SaaS agreements, including MSAs, SaaS terms, AI addendums, SLAs, and data processing agreements.
- Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent contract negotiations and prioritize effectively under time pressure with strong attention to detail.
- Experience using, or a willingness to adopt, AI-powered contract review and workflow tools, along with a comfort level navigating questions about AI in customer contracts.
- Working knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, and related privacy frameworks as they relate to commercial contracting.
- A track record as a strong relationship builder with sales leaders and business partner, and the judgment to know when to push back, compromise, or escalate.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain legal concepts in clear, plain language tailored to different audiences.
- Familiarity with HR tech, recruiting, or workforce software, a plus.
- Experience with AI/ML contract terms and emerging AI regulations, a plus.
- Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

_Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis._

_If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked_ [_here_](https://www.greenhouse.io/ccpa-candidate) _._

_The national pay range for this role is $128,300 - $166,900. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role._

_Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO)._

_The anticipated closing date for this role is October 16th, 2026._

title: Data Scientist IV
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **Artificial Intelligence Group (see ai.jpl.nasa.gov)** is seeking a **Data Scientist IV** to work on fundamental research problems leading to unique software applications in spacecraft autonomy, scientific data analysis, mission operations automation, and onboard analysis for real-time decisions. The Data Scientist IV will have the opportunity to work on development projects that include the automation of ground and flight operations for communications stations, space missions, marine vehicles, and aerial vehicles, including fleets of vehicles. You will use Artificial Intelligence technologies to partially and fully automate critical systems for scheduling, planning, and resource allocation. Our software is currently in use for numerous missions including but not limited to: ECOSTRESS, OCO-3, EMIT, NISAR, M2020, and the DSN.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

- Develop planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and execution algorithms for autonomous systems that interpret complex state, resource, constraint, and event data to take actions to achieve mission goals.

- Develop and use search-based, constraint-based, satisfaction and optimization systems to solve large scale planning and resource allocation problems.

- Develop software to represent and reason about complex geometric and operations constraints relevant to observation planning.

- Support broader team efforts in this automation and resource allocation areas.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related discipline with a minimum of 9 years of related work experience; Master's degree in similar disciplines with a minimum of 7 years of related work experience; or PhD in similar disciplines with a minimum of 5 years of related work experience.

- Broad knowledge in one or more related fields of the following areas: software development, artificial intelligence, operations research, resource allocation mechanisms.

- Experience in wide application of principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in programming languages (in order of preference) such as Rust, C++, C, Python, and Java.

- Background knowledge in Artificial Intelligence and/or Operations research techniques and concepts, as documented by software artifacts built, tested, etc.

**Preferred Skills:**

- Hands-on experience in automation and analysis systems for robotic autonomous systems.

- Extensive knowledge of applicable industry and/or academic practices and standards in Software design & development and Computer Science.

- Experience in interdisciplinary team leadership.

**Note: Must have an active Top Secret (TS) clearance based upon Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) within a 5 year scope and must be approved for Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) accesses.**

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. For benefits eligible positions, benefits are effective the first day of the month coincident with or immediately following the employee’s start date.

title: Network Dev Engineer III, InterDC services
description:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Core Networking team is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) team. As a Network Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying and scaling the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global datacenters.
AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.

Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.
• Create and implement changes on the network.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at a higher volume.
• Lead network projects in the areas of network sustaining engineering, network deployment/implementation, network scaling, technology refresh, best practices application, and/or network optimization.
• Sustain Amazon Web Services’ next generation networks for significant AWS customers by providing critical network support to diagnose, mitigate impact, and resolve large-scale networking events.
• Operate and troubleshoot network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configurations issues; including necessary low level application interaction, Unix systems, and new age networking software tools.
• Drive and support innovation from Top of Rack to the Network Border and everything in between.
• Partner with our broader Network/Infrastructure organization in the areas of network engineering, configurations standards, and tools.
• Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
• Maintain standards across the networking toolset and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
• Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
• Collaborate with highest tier escalation engineers/resolvers.
• Create and review documentation and process regarding network implementation/deployments, recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.

A day in the life
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
AWS NFE (Network Fabric Engineering) owns datacenter network services that provide unconstrained connectivity to our customers, such as EC2, EBS, S3 and Amazon CDO Services. They own the networks internal to the datacenters end to end, including scaling and operational functions, for both traditional datacenters. They also own newer AWS offerings such as Outposts and Local Zones.
Working at AWS in the Core Networking Team

- Meet Kensie, Network Development Engineer --- https://youtu.be/ezF3kpUAhWU(opens in a new tab)

title: Risk Specialist, Inventory Trust
description:
Amazon's Inventory Trust team works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. The team works to ensure that illegal inventory within our network is identified and destroyed rather than being returned to the stream of commerce, and to deny our fulfillment network as a means for bad actors to scale their abuse. If we successfully achieve our vision, then Bad Actors will stop committing misconduct on Amazon.

We are looking for an experienced Risk Specialist to own complex investigations, high judgement decisions and escalations associated with our programs. In this role you will work on investigations , manage escalations and communication with external teams to ensure that the Inventory Evaluation team (formerly IDAP) is accurately communicating its decisions to these key stakeholders, and that we are capturing and incorporating feedback related to Seller experience.
In addition to making the right inventory decisions, the candidate will need to be able to use basic SQL knowledge and use data as evidence to convince/influence key stakeholders.


Key job responsibilities
1. Performs investigation based on high judgement to identify bad actors with unsuitable inventory in Fulfillment Centre.
2. Risk mitigation by continuously giving process improvement, enforcement review, risk mining, queueing improvement etc. ideas.
3. Creates, updates learning modules and support the program in driving improvements to ensure the best customer experience.
4. Identifies & manages small to mid-scale process improvement opportunities at process or team level.
5. Communicates to business leaders on pre-defined guidelines with data and resolves issues with reduced guidance.
6. Work in sync with Program Managers, Risk Managers/Business Analyst and create mechanisms, strategies to achieve the program goals.
7. Tracks and reports progress on key goals specific to the program.
8. Adheres to set targets on productivity and quality.
9. Manages escalations on routine and predefined tasks with minimal supervision.
10. Learns new tools / SOPs / processes with minimal supervision.
11. Effective write up skills and stakeholder management.

title: Applied Scientist, AWS Infrastructure Services Science
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services Science (AISS) researches and builds machine learning models that influence the power utilization at our data centers to ensure the health of our thermal and electrical infrastructure at high infrastructure utilization.

As an Applied Scientist, you will work on our Science team and partner closely with other scientists, data engineers and Software teams to accurately model and optimize our power infrastructure. Outputs from your models will directly influence our data center topology and will drive exceptional cost savings. You will be responsible for researching and deploying machine learning models that optimize our power and thermal infrastructure, working across AWS to solve data mapping and quality issues and contribute to our Science team vision.

You are skeptical. When someone gives you a data source, you pepper them with questions about sampling biases, accuracy, and coverage. When you’re told a model can make assumptions, you proactively try to break those assumptions.

You have passion for excellence. The wrong choice of data could cost the business dearly. You maintain rigorous standards and take ownership of the outcome of your data pipelines and code. You raise the bar on the software code standards to delivery faster and efficient solutions.

You do whatever it takes to add value. You don’t care whether you’re building complex ML models, writing blazing fast code, integrating multiple disparate data-sets, or creating baseline models - you care passionately about stakeholders and know that as a curator of data insight you can unlock massive cost savings and preserve customer availability.

You have a limitless curiosity. You constantly ask questions about the technologies and approaches we are taking and are constantly learning about industry best practices you can bring to our team.

You have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with product owners to understand key business questions and earn the trust of senior leaders. You will need to learn Data Center architecture and components of electrical engineering to build your models.

You are comfortable juggling competing priorities and handling ambiguity. You thrive in an agile and fast-paced environment on highly visible projects and initiatives. The tradeoffs of cost savings and customer availability are constantly up for debate among senior leadership - you will help drive this conversation.

This position requires superior analytical thinkers, able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply their technical and statistical knowledge to identify opportunities for further research. You should be able to independently mine and analyze data, and be able to use any necessary programming and statistical analysis software to do so. title: Fuel Delivery Manager
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Role Summary:

Amazon is looking for a results-oriented individual to join the AWS Energy Team as an Fuel Delivery Manager. In this role, you will support AWS’s infrastructure expansion by leading natural gas infrastructure projects that supply fuel to large-scale natural gas generation facilities across AWS regions. This role will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver reliable, cost-effective natural gas supply to power AWS data centers.

The candidate must be able to manage the execution of multiple large-scale natural gas infrastructure projects across different US geographies. The candidate will manage interactions with gas utilities, pipeline operators, and local distribution companies (LDCs), and work with internal and external engineering, real estate, and planning teams to deliver gas infrastructure to serve AWS campuses. This includes but is not limited to managing EPC vendors, gas utility interconnects, metering and regulation stations (M&R), and pipeline laterals to meet AWS’s needs. The candidate will work as part of an integrated team to implement fuel program requirements and deliver tangible reliability and cost-saving results.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong natural gas infrastructure background and a proven track record of permitting, constructing, and commissioning gas pipelines, interconnects, and related facilities. The candidate will have experience working with gas utilities, pipeline operators, and regulatory agencies to develop, permit, contract, and deliver natural gas infrastructure. The right candidate will have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, operations, and technical challenges, with the skill set to drive tactical execution of project schedules, contracts, initiatives, and team goals. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships, and managing day-to-day interactions with these partners, you will be responsible for ensuring the fuel infrastructure requirements needed to support AWS’s global infrastructure expansion are met.

A key focus of this role is proactively identifying and flagging risks to natural gas delivery schedules and ensuring those risks are communicated and mitigated in a manner that informs overall datacenter delivery timelines.

This role requires domestic travel (up to 20%).


Key job responsibilities
• Manage multiple EPC vendors, gas utilities, pipeline operators, and Owner’s Engineers to deliver a portfolio of in-flight natural gas infrastructure projects including pipelines, laterals, metering and regulation (M&R) stations, and interconnect facilities.
• Oversee the permitting, construction, and commissioning of natural gas infrastructure to ensure on-time delivery aligned with datacenter commissioning schedules.
• Proactively identify, flag, and mitigate risks to project schedules, communicating impacts to datacenter delivery timelines to internal stakeholders.
• Manage capital budgets for natural gas infrastructure projects.
• Collaborate with internal teams and gas utilities on the implementation and management of fuel infrastructure projects in a timely and accurate fashion.
• Coordinate project schedule and risks with internal teams to ensure data center build timeline is informed by gas delivery.
• Identify and develop innovative cost-saving projects and initiatives related to natural gas infrastructure and supply.
• Work with gas utility regulators, pipeline operators, and permitting agencies to develop policies and guidelines that enable broader AWS strategies and objectives.


A day in the life
Our team is accountable for the full lifecycle of energy delivery to existing and future AWS data centers throughout North and South America. We are uniquely positioned and encouraged to execute innovative energy solutions that accelerate our sustainability goals, improve reliability, and optimize costs.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Here at AWS, we embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion.


About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
