title: EMEA Partner Lead, Data Foundations for AI, EMEA Partner Specialist team
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a world class partner strategy leader to join the EMEA Partner Specialist team to lead the partner strategy for Data — the database, analytics, and data services that form the foundation of the AI stack. As an EMEA Partner Lead, Data Foundations for AI, you will have an exciting opportunity to deliver on our strategy to accelerate adoption of the AWS data layer within partners of all types. You will help them identify and create data use cases and capabilities across the value chain — from getting data onto AWS and modernising it onto purpose-built engines, to unifying it in an Iceberg-native lakehouse, governing it for AI, and consuming it through AI-powered analytics — developing and executing go-to-market and enablement plans that lead to a healthy business pipeline, joint customer wins and market success.
Where a customer’s data lives determines where their AI runs. In this role, you will work with partners to help them establish AWS databases and analytics as the persistence and intelligence layer for every AI and agentic workload, building growth-oriented and strategically focused offerings that deliver on these customer and market expectations. In this endeavor, you will collaborate with a number of AWS internal teams including partner managers, solution architects, sales, BD, marketing, and solution teams to position and deliver these capabilities internally and to customers. The AWS Partner organization will look to you as the expert on the data domain, partner types, use cases, and how to drive AWS market success through partners. You will also act as a mentor to regional Data and Analytics experts, bringing your substantial experience in coaching and guiding the team into delivering customer and partner success.

Focus Areas
The EMEA Data Foundations for AI Partner Lead will focus on the following actions to address the data partner needs in the EMEA territory:
1. Identify industry-specific and horizontal data use cases and solution offerings across the six pillars — database migration and modernisation, Iceberg-native lakehouse, vector and agent-memory workloads, data governance, and AI-powered analytics — in the EMEA region;
2. Actively engage with mature and emerging Data & Analytics partners whose offerings align to these use cases (e.g. lakehouse and analytics ISVs such as ClickHouse, Snowflake, Neo4j and SAS positioning AWS-native alternatives against Databricks Unity Catalog and Snowflake-mediated Iceberg);
3. Identify and recruit horizontal or niche data partners we need in the ecosystem;
4. Lead enablement of our partner ecosystem (ISVs, SIs and GSIs) on native AWS data offerings including Amazon Aurora and Aurora DSQL, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3 Tables / Iceberg REST, AWS Lake Formation, and AWS Glue, and drive attainment of the new AWS Data Competency (launching at Partner Equip London, Sep–Oct 2026);
5. Enablement of the ASP organization on AWS and technology-partner data services and solutions. Success will be measured by # net new “must win” partners building Data Foundations for AI practices, # partner practitioners enabled on Data in EMEA (via PDM/PSA or PDS), # partners solutions launched, # customer references / case studies , # thought leadership (tech content, public speaking), # AO + PO Launched $ARR.

Role could be based in other EMEA AWS offices.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and lead the partner strategy and execution plan to grow the AWS-based Data partner community in EMEA
• Drive AWS Data Competency attainment — guiding DB SDP partners, existing Data & Analytics competency partners, and high-propensity AI-only partners through cross-skill validation
• Collaborate with AWS teams and with partners to bring data solutions to market to meet customer needs, with measurable ROI results
• Prioritise AWS engagement with partners who focus on the data domain, including leading startups, consulting companies, and established ISV technology vendors
• Build C-level relationships with our top data partners
• Work with cross-functional groups in AWS to deliver training, enablement and go-to-market programs that scale the partner business across the data domain


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job
description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or
includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered
cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500
companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is
why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home,
there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and
empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative
teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to
everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find
endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-
rounded professional.

title: Ecosystem & Partnerships Lead
description:
**We are recruiting for an Ecosystem & Partnerships Lead to join Nesta’s Mission Studio**

🚀 [Mission Studio](https://missionstudio.vc/) is creating the future of mission-driven tech startups. We're tackling the UK's toughest social challenges - from net zero to obesity - by building commercially successful businesses. We have a great team of ex-founders, venture designers, builders and experienced studio operators and are looking for an exceptional Venture Ecosystem Lead to add to our team as we move into our next iteration of growth.

As our venture Ecosystem & Partnerships Lead, you will help us rapidly build and mobilise networks around the ventures we are creating. As we develop new investment theses, you’ll work out who we need to know, from sector experts and potential users to prospective founders, and find creative ways to reach and engage them. You’ll be part researcher, part relationship-builder and part talent scout: quickly getting the lay of the land in new sectors, opening doors, building communities and developing relationships that give our venture teams access to the right people at the right time.

🌟 **Who You Are:**

**Essential skills**

- **Exceptional network builder:** You have a track record of rapidly building strong partnerships or networks, with individuals and organisations. You’re a natural connector who enjoys meeting people, joining the dots, and creating relationships that lead to valuable opportunities and collaboration. This could look like: 3+ year experience in a partnerships, community, business development or similar role

- **Ecosystem and stakeholder mapping:** You are excellent at getting up to speed on an unfamiliar market, sector or topic. You can quickly identify the key stakeholders: organisations, individuals, communities, events, networks and centres of influence within an ecosystem, and understand how they relate to one another.

- **Proactive outreach, relationship development and management:** You’re confident building relationships from scratch through cold outreach, warm introductions, events and networks. You know how to turn initial conversations into lasting relationships, and manage them systematically so the right people are re-engaged at the right time.

- **CRM:** You build and maintain repeatable processes (like CRM hygiene and re-engagement cadences) rather than relying on memory and instinct alone.

- **Community building and engagement:** You have experience bringing people together around a shared interest or challenge, and turning networks of contacts into useful, engaged communities.

- **Talent scouting:** You have a strong eye for people and can identify talent across key roles: founders, advisors and collaborators. Experience in founder scouting, executive search, startup recruitment or similar is a plus.

- **Existing network:** Ideally, existing relationships and exposure to either the UK startup ecosystem, or ecosystems within Nesta’s mission areas: Family life & Early years, Health and Food systems, or Climate and Home ownership.


**Core competencies**

- **A super-connector:** You are energised by people and relationships. You remember who does what, spot useful connections others miss and instinctively think, “I know someone we should speak to.”

- **Proactive and externally oriented:** You don’t wait for the network to come to you. You are happy getting out into the market, attending the right events, speaking to new people and creating connections for Mission Studio.

- **Comfortable with ambiguity:** One month you might be mapping the ecosystem around a healthcare problem; the next, exploring a completely different technology or market. You enjoy starting with a blank page and quickly working out where to look and who to speak to.

- **Commercial and strategic judgement:** You can distinguish between a prestigious contact and a genuinely useful one. Able to prioritise ruthlessly between urgent venture-team requests and longer-term ecosystem investment - and communicate trade-offs when both can't happen at once.

- **Clear communicator:** You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and can engage credibly with key stakeholders from prospective founders and users to senior industry leaders and investors.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.

The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
- Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
- Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
- Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.

About the team
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.

Reporting to our Chief People Officer and sitting on the People Leadership Team (PLT), you will serve as the strategic and operational leader for our People Operations and People Systems function. You will drive data integrity, compliance, technology enablement, and operational excellence across the entire employee lifecycle, from onboarding through offboarding.

As a champion of continuous process improvement, scalable automation, and you will operationalize Greenhouse's AI-forward approach to how we run our own People function. You will partner closely with COEs — the teams who own hiring, development, rewards, and belonging — to unlock one continuous and coherent employee experience.

### **Who will love this job**

- **An innovative builder –** you are energized by new technology and exploring ways to elevate existing processes with new tools, you thrive when designing seamless and elegant employee processes.
- **A systems thinker –** you are passionate about HR tech, process automation, and analytics, and see AI as a tool for removing friction, not adding it
- **A data-driven decision maker –** you leverage metrics to drive continuous improvement and help leaders retain their best people
- **An influential champion —** You effectively manage relationships across all levels and functions. You drive clarity, empower others and enable business outcomes to support Greenhouse in its next stage of growth. A cross-functional collaborator – you build trust and engagement across teams without needing to own every piece of the outcome
- **A change architect –** you are energized by leading through systems upgrades, AI adoption, policy refreshes, and new ways of working
- **A growth mindset evangelist —** You cultivate winning teams that thrive by unlocking potential and instilling a culture of continuous up-skilling, within your team and throughout the organization.

### **What you’ll do**

- Set the strategy and roadmap for Greenhouse’s HR technology ecosystem from implementation, configuration, integrations, user experience, continuous improvement, and vendor relationships.
- Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for employee data. Drive automation, data accuracy, governance, stakeholder adoption, and reliable downstream connections to payroll, benefits, analytics, and other People systems.
- Use the employee journey to improve the moments that matter—from offer and onboarding through promotions, leaves of absence, and offboarding. Partner with program owners across People to make candidate, manager, and employee experiences more connected and effective.
- Build scalable people analytics, dashboards, and self-service tools that give leaders the insight to make better workforce decisions, address retention risks early, and improve information flow to employees and managers.
- Own People-related compliance across the employee lifecycle (immigration, leaves of absence, audits, and evolving labor requirements) as Greenhouse grows globally. Serve as the escalation point for complex policy questions, compliance issues, and high-priority employee matters, partnering with Legal as needed.
- Lead Greenhouse’s AI-forward evolution within People processes and operations. Apply our AI Principles Framework to People Operations, pilot Greenhouse AI capabilities in our own workflows, and translate learnings into structured feedback for Product.
- Champion experimentation and continuous improvement by testing new tools, processes, and workflows in contained ways before scaling them. Partner across IT, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition & Planning, Talent Management/Org Development, Total Rewards, and IDEA to align People Operations with company priorities.
- Contribute the People Operations perspective to company-wide People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team, while developing and empowering a high-performing team through clear priorities, coaching, performance management, and growth opportunities.
- Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

### **You should have**

- 8+ years of progressive People Operations experience, including 3+ years leading People Operations, HRIS, and/or People Systems teams at the manager or director level.
- Deep experience administering and optimizing relevant, global HRIS platforms (Workday, Rippling, HiBob, etc) including implementations, integrations, automation, data integrity, and reporting.
- A track record of designing and scaling People processes that improve efficiency, data quality, compliance, or employee experience, with measurable results.
- Experience with payroll and benefits integrations, cross-border employee data and reporting requirements, and workforce data privacy; global experience is a plus.
- Hands-on experience evaluating, piloting, or implementing AI and automation in a People operations context.
- Strong project management, change leadership, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to create structure and momentum in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- An analytical, data-driven approach and proficiency with HR reporting, dashboarding, and self-service tools — paired with the ability to turn workforce data into clear recommendations for leaders.
- Experience building and leading high-performing, diverse teams, and the ability to operate as a strategic partner at the leadership-team level while staying close enough to the details of a workflow, system, or dataset.
- Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

Agile Robots SE is a high-tech startup based in Munich. Our mission is to bridge the gap
between AI and robotics by developing robotic systems that offer state-of-the-art full-body
force sensitivity and world-leading vision intelligence. This unique combination of
technologies enables us to provide intelligent, easy-to-use and affordable robotic solutions
with safe human-robot interaction.

We are a dynamic and innovative software development company dedicated to pushing the
boundaries of technology. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that transform
industries and redefine user experiences.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and implement deterministic real-time platform software on Embedded Linux using
    C++17/20 for ARM and x86 architectures
  • Develop low-level drivers for EtherCAT and serial protocols as part of a deterministic control
    platform supporting model-based control and learning policies
  • Develop firmware for EtherCAT-based robotic devices
  • Drive platform development on ARM-based SOC, including participation in carrier board
    design and hardware bring-up
  • Optimize real-time system performance using PREEMPT_RT, CPU isolation, scheduler
    policies, and priority tuning
  • Develop robotics middleware using publish/subscribe, server/client architectures
  • Act as a technical owner for the robotics platform — driving architecture decisions and crosscomponent system integration
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines including automated package management and release
    workflows
  • Collaborate with robotics software, hardware, and control teams on system-level integration

Essential Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development experience in robotics or industrial systems
  • Proficient in C++17/20 for embedded and real-time targets
  • Strong experience with Embedded Linux and PREEMPT_RT real-time optimization
  • Hands-on experience with EtherCAT and serial communication protocols
  • Experience with ARM and x86 architectures; familiarity with Nvidia Jetson platforms
  • Proficient with CMake and Conan for build and package management
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong debugging and fault analysis skills at the system and driver level
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience with publish-subscribe middleware frameworks e.g. ROS2
  • Familiarity with model-based control or reinforcement learning policy deployment
  • Hardware bring-up and carrier board co-design experience
  • Scripting with Python and Bash
  • Mandarin knowledge is a plus

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Startup Solution Architect, Startups
description:
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all by giving founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With experience gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups that have come before, we help founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth or level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, build on AWS.

We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with early stage startups to help them as they grow. In this role, you’ll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You’ll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.

As a member of the AWS Startups team, you will work directly with customers to help them successfully leverage AWS technology at scale.

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you’ll also get plenty of time to learn new technologies and keep your skills fresh. We have 200+ services across a range of different categories and it’s important that we can help startups take advantages of the right ones. You’ll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products and features for the startups you work with. And for the customers you don’t get to work with on a 1:1 basis you’ll share knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.

Key job responsibilities
* Help a diverse range of startups to adopt the right architecture at each part of their lifecycle
* Support startups in architecting scalable, reliable and secure solutions
* Support adoption of a broad range of AWS services to deliver business value and accelerate growth
* Support the evolution and roadmap of the AWS platform and services, connecting our engineering teams with our customers for feedback
* Establish and build technical relationships within the startup ecosystem, including accelerators, incubators and VCs
* Develop startup specific technical content, such as blog posts, sample code and solutions, to assist customers solve technical problems and reduce time-to-market

A day in the life
Startups are the large enterprises of the future. These young companies are founded by ambitious people who have a desire to build something meaningful and to challenge the status quo. To address underserved customers or to challenge incumbents. They usually operate in an environment of scarcity: whether that's capital, engineering resource, or experience.

The AWS Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with startup companies as they build their businesses. We're here to help them deploy the best, most scalable, most secure, cost effective and easy to operate architectures.

title: Program Manager I, INTL Physical Security Innovation Solutions
description:
Amazon's Worldwide Physical Security team is looking for a Program Manager to help deliver physical security projects across our international network. Working within the team, you will own the day-to-day delivery of assigned projects end-to-end. Coordinating with site security teams, vendors and stakeholders to plan work, manage funding and approvals, track delivery and keep projects on time, on budget and to standard. It is a hands-on delivery role for someone early in their program-management career who enjoys turning plans into delivered outcomes in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end delivery of physical security projects across assigned sites and programs — from intake and funding preparation through deployment and handover.
• Support the team's senior program managers on their larger, more complex initiatives — tracking actions, chasing dependencies and helping keep delivery moving.
• Prepare and maintain project documentation, including statements of work, responsibility matrices and requirements.
• Support capital funding requests and manage the approvals workflow through to sign-off, tracking spend against approved funding, flagging variances and keeping stakeholders informed.
• Work directly with vendors and installers to schedule works, monitor progress and confirm delivery meets the agreed scope, standards and quality bar.
• Coordinate with site security teams and cross-functional partners to align on requirements, dependencies and timelines, escalating issues appropriately.
• Track project milestones and risks, driving early resolution or ensuring a clean hand-off to the right owner, and report accurate status and metrics into regular business reviews.
• Support proof-of-concept and pilot activity for new physical security technologies, gathering data and documenting outcomes.
• Ensure solutions are delivered in line with Amazon physical security standards and relevant regulatory, legal and safety requirements.
• Contribute to team process improvements — optimising the templates, trackers and workflows the team relies on to deliver.



A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing progress across your program and catching up with partners on solutions being validated across the worldwide network. Mid-morning you join a working session with field security teams and stakeholders to define the problem behind an upcoming initiative and shape the requirements for a pilot, working through how a solution will integrate into live operations without slowing throughput. After lunch, you prepare a capital funding request for a program, pull together data from a recent proof-of-concept to strengthen the business case, and update your senior PM on key risks. Later you coordinate with a partner on a deployment timeline and capture the lessons from a completed pilot to inform the next rollout. Throughout it all, you balance careful planning with hands-on execution, moving solutions from pilot to network-wide reality.

About the team
The Worldwide Physical Security Innovation Solutions team develops security solutions across Amazon's network. We start from the problem, understanding our customers and the risks they face. We then develop, validate and scale solutions that remove manual security processes and let the network operate securely and efficiently. We take ideas from proof-of-concept through to fully-realized network-wide deployment solutions. We partner with field security teams, operations, and technology partners to prove what works and roll it out at scale. This role works alongside senior program managers and cross-functional partners to turn physical security innovation into reality across the Amazon network.

title: Security Engineer
description:
### **About Assembled**

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust [Assembled](https://www.assembled.com/customers). We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London.

### **About the role**

Assembled operates at the intersection of tens of millions of untrusted customer conversations annually, hundreds of thousands of support professionals, and the sensitive data and privileged access they need to get issues fixed.

You'll lead application security across our SaaS and AI products as part of our infrastructure team within Engineering. Working directly with product managers and other engineers, you'll establish our product security practices, influence architecture, and build tooling to manage vulnerabilities from discovery and prioritization through remediation and verification. This is a high-ownership role with broad scope to reshape security at Assembled.

### **What you'll be responsible for**

- **Product and application security.** Lead threat modeling, secure design reviews, and vulnerability management across our SaaS and AI products and the underlying infrastructure.

- **Tooling and automation.** Integrate and automate controls for secrets, access, and dependency security within our engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

- **Application security testing.** Establish and maintain code, dependency, and secrets scanning, alongside dynamic application security testing. Partner with third-party penetration testers and manage external vulnerability reporting and triage.

- **Secure practices.** Develop secure design and coding training for engineers. Establish clear processes for routing security issues to engineering owners and following through on fixes.

- **Incident response.** Respond to security incidents involving application vulnerabilities, coordinating remediation efforts and post-incident improvements.

- **Partner on security assurance.** Bring technical depth to customer security conversations and partner with Finance/Ops on the technical side of SOC 2 and assurance work. Turn recurring customer needs into better product and engineering decisions.


**Examples of projects you could lead:**

- Ship adversarial detection for our customer-facing voice agents.

- Build an automated dependency-patching pipeline connected to our AI code generation tools (Devin, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor).

- Secure workforce actions like time off and shift swap requests initiated through Slack, calendar, and HRIS integrations.


**Our tech stack:**

- **Frontend:** TypeScript, React

- **Backend:** Go, Python

- **Data:** PostgreSQL, Redis, Snowflake

- **Cloud and infrastructure:** AWS, Kubernetes, Karpenter

- **LLMs:** Claude, GPT, Gemini Flash, and open-source models


### **About you**

- Security engineering expertise. You have 5+ years of hands-on application security experience, including threat modeling, security code reviews, and vulnerability remediation.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals. You have experience writing and reviewing production code in a complex codebase.

- Good risk judgment. You understand the tradeoff between security and shipping velocity. You’ve operated in programs that preserved speed (or can speak to why past programs destroyed it). Engineers trust you as a partner.

- AI-pilled. You actively use AI tools for security investigation, testing, or remediation and can evaluate their limitations. You have a point of view on how this changes the product threat model and how the security role evolves.


People get to this kind of role through many paths. Your background might be in product security, application security, security engineering, DevSecOps, infrastructure, technical consulting, or something less conventional. We care most about how you think and what you have owned.

### **Nice to have**

- Background with large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS applications handling sensitive customer data

- Familiarity with our tech stack (described above)

title: Senior Open-Source Python Engineer, ML Developer Tools - EMEA Remote
description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 11 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million Gradio apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Roles at Hugging Face are very fluid and dynamic — we are looking for someone who is comfortable taking on different challenges that will evolve over time.

You'll join the Applications team, whose goal is to build the tooling that helps developers create machine learning applications on top of the primitives we offer on the Hub: Gradio, Spaces, Inference Providers, Datasets, Xet, and more. Concretely, that means maintaining and growing libraries like Trackio, a local-first, agent-friendly experiment tracking platform, FastRTC, our library for real-time audio and video streaming in Python, and Gradio itself, used by more than 1 million developers each month. These tools have made machine learning accessible to a wide audience — for the first time in history, anyone with an internet connection can use cutting-edge models right from their browser.

Several of these libraries are still early in their life, and new ones will start from scratch. A large part of this role is taking a project from its first users to widespread adoption: shaping the API, shipping fast, and getting it into developers' hands.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining core features across the team's libraries, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use for ML developers.
  • Architecting complex Python projects and frameworks that serve as foundational tools for the ML community.
  • Growing early-stage libraries: defining the API surface, writing the demos and documentation that make them click, and driving adoption in the developer community.
  • Working on real-time streaming and networking capabilities, a core priority for Gradio 7 and beyond.
  • Collaborating with open-source contributors and engaging with the broader community through code reviews, discussions, and support.
  • Integrating modern frontend technologies to create seamless and intuitive user experiences for Python-based web applications.
  • Adapting to evolving engineering challenges and contributing to the direction of our developer tools as the landscape changes.

Requirements

If you love open-source, are passionate about making machine learning more accessible, have experience building Python frameworks, and want to contribute to some of the fastest-growing libraries in the ML ecosystem, then we can't wait to see your application!

What you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional Python development experience
  • Experience architecting complex Python projects or frameworks
  • A track record of taking early-stage libraries or products from first users to broad adoption
  • Professional experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Professional experience with a modern frontend framework such as React or Svelte
  • Experience core-contributing to or maintaining open-source software projects

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time audio/video streaming or networking (WebRTC, WebSockets)
  • Contributions to libraries such as pipecat, LiveKit, FastAPI, or Starlette

If you're interested in joining us, but don't tick every box above, we still encourage you to apply! We're building a diverse team whose skills, experiences, and backgrounds complement one another. We're happy to consider where you might be able to make the biggest impact.

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

We support the community. We believe major scientific advancements are the result of collaboration across the field. Join a community supporting the ML/AI community.

title: AI Compiler Engineer
description:
EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.

About the Role

EnCharge AI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Compiler Engineer to spearhead the efforts in developing and optimizing graph compilers tailored to cutting-edge AI and ML workloads. You will collaborate with hardware architects, and AI researchers to enhance performance, optimize computation graphs, and enable efficient model deployment on EnCharge’s Inference Accelerators.

Responsibilities

Architect, design, and implement optimizations for AI model execution on graph compilers to improve performance, reduce latency, and maximize hardware utilization.

  • Work closely with ML researchers, hardware engineers, and software developers to design and deploy AI models, understanding and addressing hardware-specific challenges.
  • Work on performance optimizations for neural network models, such as layer fusion, operator fusion, and graph-level transformations.
  • Develop compiler optimizations and passes that convert high-level AI models (e.g., from TensorFlow, PyTorch) into intermediate representations (IR).
  • Implement parsing, semantic analysis, and IR generation for deep learning frameworks.
  • Research and integrate the latest advancements in compiler design, ML model optimizations, and hardware acceleration into graph compilers.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to a team of engineers focused on graph compiler optimizations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Ph.D. preferred).
  • 3+ years in compiler development, with a strong focus on AI or ML graph compilers.
  • Proficiency in AI graph compiler frameworks (e.g., MLIR, Torch-FX)
  • Solid background in hardware architectures (e.g., GPUs, TPUs, ASICs) and optimization techniques such as fusion, quantization, and tiling.
  • Familiarity with neural networks operators and code generation.
  • Strong understanding of intermediate representations, code parsing, and semantic analysis in compiler design.
  • Proficiency in C++, Python, or other programming languages commonly used in compiler development.
  • Open-source contributions to AI software frameworks and libraries is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with successful project delivery.

EnCharge AI is an equal employment opportunity employer in the United States.

The salary range for this position is $190,000 to $255,000 USD per year. (Per Year: $195,000 to $265,000 CAD | €110,000 to €160,000 EUR | 1,206,458 to 1,754,848 NOK)

title: Power Electronics Engineer
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

JPL’s **Power Electronics Group** within the **Avionics, Power, & Instrument Electronics Section** is dedicated to developing power subsystem electronics concepts, implementing power system architecture designs, designing and ensuring implementation of hardware for flight projects, and supporting project formulation and proposals. We are seeking a creative, experienced **Power Electronics Engineer III**, with expertise in space hardware development and task leadership, to join the group and participate in developing the next generation of space power hardware.

The **Power Electronics Engineer III** will lead power electronics tasks within JPL's Power Electronics Group, taking designs from concept through build, test, and delivery for space flight hardware. This role carries task-level leadership responsibility, including planning and executing budgets and schedules, developing system designs and requirements, and reporting technical progress to Line, Project, and Institutional Management. Candidates should bring several years of hands-on power electronics design and test experience, with a strong preference for prior aerospace or space hardware development.

As a Power Electronics Engineer in the JPL Power Electronics Group, you will be designing and testing electronics subsystems and support equipment and will be involved in all aspects of power electronics development from concept to delivery.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

- Participate as part of a subsystem electronics development team and helping with reviews of electronics, electronics test equipment, and test plans.

- Develop and execute task plans and budgets for power and sensor space flight electronics through development, build, test, and delivery to higher level of integration

- Developing system designs and requirements for space power systems and power electronics.

- Design and develop power and sensor electronics for space missions and other high-reliability applications.

- You'll have responsibility for all documentation related to conceptual development, reliability, structural, and thermal analyses, design drawings, and build, assembly, and test.

- Report on technical progress, schedule, and budget to Line, Project, and Institutional Management.

- Developing  advanced electronics technology and improving and enabling future missions and supporting the development of mission proposals through expertise in the current state-of-the-practice in space electronics.


**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or similar technical discipline with typically a minimum of 6 years of related work experience, a Master’s degree in similar disciplines with typically a minimum of 4 years of related work experience, or a PhD in a similar discipline with typically a minimum of 2 years of related work experience.

- Deep understanding and experience in Analog, Digital and Mixed-Signal Electronics, Controls, or Power Systems Design, including power control systems.

- Proven experience in crafting, developing, fabricating, assembly and testing of analog or power electronics hardware.

- Experience with test software and hardware, particularly using LabView and Python test equipment, including the selection, assembly, and use of electronic bench test equipment.

- Knowledge of circuit design and board design software associated (Altium and LTspice) with electronics development.

- Industry and/or academic practices and standards across a range of applications related to the development, testing and integration of electronic assemblies for space applications.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills in relating to both internal and external customers.

- Strong ability to multi-task with an established track record of meeting schedules with milestones.

- Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to work with fluctuating and competing environments.

- Must be able to obtain and maintain any required U.S. Government security clearance, and be able to work with export-controlled (ITAR) hardware and technical data, which may require U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency


**Preferred Skills:**

- Design, build, and test Power Converter Units (PCUs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs) for space applications

- The use of computer aided engineering tools to support the electronics design process

- The application of principles, theories, concepts and techniques in electronic circuit design, simulation, and test, particularly focused on analog electronics in space environments

- Experience taking a design from concept to Design, Build, Test and Deliver for a Space mission

- Military, Aerospace & Space hardware development experience

title: Senior Associate Director, Venues
description:
The George Washington University was founded in 1821 in response to a vision that the nation’s foremost founder spelled out in his last will and testament. He dreamed of a university that would educate the citizen leaders of the new nation he had done so much to create. Today the university that bears his name is different in many ways from what George Washington could have imagined. He could not have imagined the sheer size of its enrollment, now 26,000 students, including women as well as men from all 50 states and more than 100 countries. Nor could he have envisioned a university with multiple campuses and 14 schools; with more than 120 departments and 95 centers and institutes; with a half-million-square foot science and engineering building; with a school of public health, located on a circle that bears his name; or with a museum housing a world-class collection of textiles and the history of the great capital city he had only begun to plan.

GW Venues (a department in the Division of Safety and Operations) produces and manages events in specialty venues on the Foggy Bottom Campus. We provide services to a broad spectrum of clients both in the community and outside of the community. We provide spaces for our students, faculty, staff and guests to host events, meetings and gatherings. We highlight university traditions, produce memorable guest speaker events and coordinate many other activities unique to our campus with local, national and international acclaim. Our record of excellence, support and cooperation is one that we are proud of.

Reporting to the Director, Venues, the Sr. Associate Director, Venues assists with supporting the GW Venues Team that manages the logistics for events and activities booked on campus by an Event Hosts. These events provide support for both internal and external partners who require logistical assistance in specialty event venues, outdoor spaces and other emerging partner campus venues. This position serves as the strategic lead for sponsored and external events booked at the University Student Center (USC). The Sr. Associate Director manages two Venue Managers as direct reports to manage the events at USC and other emerging partner venues on campus.

Responsibilities include:

- Serves as the lead Venue Manager for sponsored and external events at USC and other specialty venues on campus overseeing assigned events from the planning stage through live execution.
- Partner with leadership to strategically market the unique abilities and resources of the USC, actively engaging with high-value prospective clients to pitch capabilities, overcome objections, and successfully bring in new clients.
- Manages two Venue Managers as direct reports.
- Partners with event hosts to plan and execute campus events while actively enforcing all university compliance policies, safety guidelines, accessibility standards, and operational excellence expectations.
- Assists in the development, enforcement, and updating of venue usage policies, event safety procedures, scheduling protocols, operational guidelines, and SOPs for new venues.
- Contributes to weekly team meeting agendas and participates actively in cross-functional coordination meetings to align on upcoming event requirements and coordinating with USC operational staff.
- Ensures spaces are utilized at optimal capacity during events.
- Works with event hosts on logistical planning, direction, and execution, including but not limited to consulting on vendor selection, script review, and budgeting.
- Serves as the primary liaison between clients, contractors, caterers, administrators, and university partners to manage all logistical aspects of events.
- Conducts pre-event walk-throughs with clients, vendors, and security to familiarize them with the venue.
- Supervises event onsite, acting as the primary point of contact for troubleshooting and last-minute adjustments.
- Conduct post-event walkthroughs with clients to ensure the venue, furniture, and equipment are returned in their original condition, documenting any discrepancies or maintenance issues that require resolution.
- Coordinates and cultivates relationships with shared services and partner departments across campus (e.g., Facilities, Campus Safety, GWPD, AV, Housekeeping, USC staff, etc.) to execute event logistics, including room setup, vendor/attendee access, staffing, and crowd management to ensure all operational needs are addressed efficiently.
- Works with clients to determine room setups and create/update diagrams for each event.
- Provides guidance to clients regarding third-party vendors for additional services (e.g., décor, entertainment, rentals) and work along with the Production Team to provide guidance on vendors for additional AV services.
- Assists with interviewing candidates, training, and supervising venue staff.
- Assists with the development and management of trainings and templates for venue staff.
- Creates detailed event orders—including comprehensive timelines, setup logistics, furniture and equipment needs, and labor requirements—to clearly communicate operational expectations and final costs to the client.
- Consults with the scheduling department to assess availability for requested events and staffing needs at venues on campus.
- Maintains accurate records of event details, incidents, and client feedback for continuous improvement, assisting with the development, distribution, and analysis of post-event evaluation surveys.
- Creates and sends all appropriate reports in a timely manner.
- Performs other related duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position. The position is based at GW’s Foggy Bottom Campus in Washington, DC.

## Electrical Inspector

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems

Poway

California

Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

We are looking for a First Shift Electrical Quality Inspector to join our Poway, CA team. Under general direction, this position is responsible for receiving, in-process and final inspections of electronic/electrical cables, wiring, printed circuit boards (PCB), printed wiring assembly components, assemblies, and system installations in accordance with engineering requirements using associated drawing, schematics and parts lists. Maintains proper records of tests and inspections and configuration of systems under tests. Uses hand tools, small power tools, and various measuring and testing devices in performing job duties. Monitors and verifies quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedures, and may perform source inspections. May recommend and develop inspection procedures. May act as a lead while providing guidance and direction to less experienced staff.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Visually inspects electronic circuit boards, cables, and assemblies. Performs in-process and final inspection or tests of major components, subsystems and systems.
- Verifies proper records of tests and inspections.
- Performs inspection of installed equipment into control shelters.
- Performs source inspections in supplier facilities, in-house inspection, and follow up. Interfaces with and assists customers' inspectors during their on-site source inspection.
- Interface with manufacturing, quality engineering, software engineering, and procurement for corrective actions and inspection criteria.
- May recommend and develop inspection procedures for all electrical product types when requested.
- May act as the inspection leader when requested. Provides guidance, training, and direction to other staff.
- Responsible for observing all laws, regulations and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company. Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.
- Other duties as assigned or required.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

- Typically requires high school diploma, technical trade school training or equivalent and two or more years experience in electronics inspection and testing, including experience with printed circuit board assembly, cable assembly and electromechanical assembly.
- Familiar with IPC 610 Standards and soldering inspection.
- AOI programming skills preferred.
- Must be customer focused and possess:
  - Ability to read and interpret a variety of complex engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions and manuals.
  - Complete knowledge of inspection equipment
  - Basic knowledge of IPC standards for acceptability of electronic assemblies and MIL standards for soldering and assembly requirements.
  - Ability to perform complex mathematical calculations.
  - Skills to maintain the flow of work within the unit.
  - Good interpersonal skills and written communication skills to interface with employees and to identify, document and resolve non-compliance issues.
  - Basic computer skills.
- The ability to work both independently and in a team environment is essential as is the ability to work extended hours as required.
- Ability to obtain and maintain DoD Security clearance required.
