title: 2026-0121 SATCOM Network Engineering Services (NS) - FRI 2 Oct RELAUNCH
description:
Previously proposed candidates were not compliant for the following reasons:

  • Lacks experience in SATCOM Network Architecture and Design
  • Lacks technical expertise in the design, integration, operation, and optimisation of SATCOM network architectures
  • CV lacks evidence of expertise in the design and implementation of Layer 2 and Layer 3 services, including VLAN tagging (IEEE 802.1Q), VLAN mapping (Q-in-Q), VLAN translation, trunking, and traffic segmentation
  • CV lacks evidence of technical expertise in the design, integration, operation, and optimisation of SATCOM network architectures

BIDDING INSTRUCTIONS

1.1 Bidding Options

Suppliers may bid for this Statement of Work by proposing a candidate to deliver the scope of work outlined in Section 3 (Scope of Work) and who meets the required qualifications outlined in the Requirements section. The Contractor shall provide one (1) qualified SATCOM Network Engineering personnel profile to deliver the services described in this Statement of Work. Such profile must meet all mandatory technical, professional, and soft-skill requirements.

1.2 Technical Proposal

Bidders shall include in the Technical Proposal the CV of the proposed candidate, clearly indicating relevant experience that demonstrates compliance with the required qualifications.

Bidders shall include in the Technical Proposal a compliance matrix for the proposed profile, demonstrating how the candidate meets all required qualifications, supported by evidence from their professional experience.

Deadline Date: Friday 02 October 2026

Requirement: Provision of SATCOM Network Engineering Services

Location: SHAPE Mons, Belgium (100% onsite, NATO Class I and II Security Areas)

Period of Performance:

2026 Base: 09 November 2026 (tentative) – 31 December 2026, with the possibility to exercise the following options:

2027 Option: 01 January 2027 – 31 December 2027

2028 Option: 01 January 2028 – 31 December 2028

Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET

1. INTRODUCTION

The NATO Integrated Mission Services Centre (NIMSC) is responsible for the coordination, planning, and delivery of engineering and operational support capabilities across Mobile CIS Infrastructure, including Deployable CIS Services (DCIS), Dispersible Systems, Highly Mobile Systems, SATCOM, and Wireless Communications. To ensure the sustained availability, performance, and resilience of these mission-critical capabilities, NIMSC requires specialized SATCOM Network Engineering Services aligned with NATO governance, interoperability requirements, service management processes, and operational priorities.

Through this Statement of Work (SoW), the NIMSC seeks industry support to deliver SATCOM Network Engineering Services. The Contractor, through the selected personnel, will provide dedicated SATCOM engineering support for SATCOM projects and services, including the development of detailed project proposals, technical assessments, and engineering artefacts supporting NATO communication and space domain capabilities. The support shall ensure alignment with operational requirements, interoperability standards, emerging technologies, and NATO policies, while ensuring that SATCOM capabilities remain operationally effective, secure, resilient, and aligned with NATO standards.

2. INTENDED BUSINESS OUTCOME

The intended business outcome of this Statement of Work is to ensure the reliable, secure, and continuous operation of SATCOM Network Engineering Services through proactive support and continuous service improvement.

Specifically, the main objectives are:

  • Ensure reliable end-to-end SATCOM service delivery by maintaining secure, resilient, and highly available network infrastructure supporting operational and mission-critical services.
  • Reduce operational disruptions through proactive performance monitoring, early identification of trends, technical analysis, and timely escalation to resolver teams.
  • Enable proactive engineering support through continuous coordination, technical assessments, and the production of documented engineering artefacts supporting SATCOM capabilities and infrastructure evolution.
  • Maintain the operational readiness and performance of the terrestrial infrastructure supporting SATCOM services, by supporting backbone networks, control segment connectivity, transmission systems, and associated hardware and software platforms.
  • Strengthen governance and compliance by ensuring that all engineering activities, technical deliverables, and service support functions are executed in accordance with NCIA processes, NATO standards, and applicable governance frameworks.

The successful delivery will result in a highly available, secure, proactively managed, and continuously improving SATCOM Network Engineering Services capability, capable of supporting mission-critical SATCOM operations.

3. SCOPE OF WORK

The scope covers the Provision of SATCOM Network Engineering Services, including the design, integration, implementation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimisation of SATCOM network infrastructure and associated communication systems. The Contractor shall deliver the services in a structured and proactive manner, ensuring alignment with operational priorities, interoperability requirements, emerging technologies, and NCIA governance processes.

The Contractor shall provide services contributing to the availability, performance, resilience, and continuous operation of SATCOM networks and associated communications infrastructure. The services shall be delivered through the assignment of one (1) qualified personnel as set out in the Requirements section. The assigned personnel shall perform the activities defined herein and contribute to the achievement of the agreed technical objectives, engineering deliverables, and performance requirements.

The Contractor shall ensure that the assigned personnel possess the required qualifications and experience; perform the tasks in accordance with NCIA processes and procedures; and maintain continuity and quality of service delivery.

3.1 SATCOM Network Engineering Activities

The Contractor shall provide SATCOM Network Engineering Services contributing to the availability, performance, and continuous operation of SATCOM network infrastructure and associated communications infrastructure.

This includes, but is not limited to, the following:

SATCOM Network Architecture and Design

Provide technical expertise in the design, integration, operation, and optimisation of SATCOM network architectures supporting operational, commercial, and mission-critical communication services.

Support the design and evolution of SATCOM network topologies, including hub-and-spoke, mesh, point-to-point, and point-to-multipoint architectures.

Support the integration and management of hybrid SATCOM services, including military and commercial SATCOM capabilities.

Network Connectivity and Infrastructure Engineering

Provide technical expertise across network connectivity, including IP networking, routing and switching, transmission systems, network security, transport technologies, and associated communications infrastructure required to support operational and customer-facing services.

Support end-to-end IP service design across satellite and terrestrial network infrastructures.

Provide expertise in the design and implementation of Layer 2 and Layer 3 services, including VLAN tagging (IEEE 802.1Q), VLAN mapping (Q-in-Q), VLAN translation, trunking, and traffic segmentation.

SATCOM Access and Transmission Engineering

Support the configuration, operation, optimisation, and troubleshooting of SCPC, MCPC, TDMA, and other satellite access schemes.

Support the operation and optimisation of transmission systems and associated network components.

SD-WAN and Hybrid Network Engineering

Provide technical expertise in the design, deployment, integration, operation, monitoring, and optimisation of Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN) solutions supporting SATCOM and hybrid communication environments.

Support SD-WAN architecture, deployment and lifecycle management, integration of SD-WAN with SATCOM, terrestrial and hybrid WAN connectivity, centralised policy-based routing, application-aware traffic steering, dynamic path selection, and link optimisation across multiple transport technologies.

SATCOM Control Segment Integration

Support the networking, connectivity, and integration of the SATCOM control segment, including the respective hardware and software tools and applications located at distributed NCIA facilities.

Operations, Troubleshooting, and Optimisation

Provide technical expertise to support the reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimisation of the network infrastructure supporting SATCOM service delivery.

Perform technical analysis, identify performance issues, support fault resolution, and provide engineering recommendations to improve service reliability and operational effectiveness.

Support technical coordination with relevant resolver teams and stakeholders as required.

All activities shall be performed in accordance with NCIA processes and procedures, ensuring compliance, traceability, and auditability.

3.2 SATCOM Network Engineering Deliverables

The Contractor shall produce and maintain the following deliverables as part of the SATCOM Network Engineering Services:

SATCOM Network Engineering Documentation: Technical documentation supporting SATCOM network design, architecture, integration, operation, and optimisation activities.

Technical Assessments and Engineering Reports: Technical analyses, documented findings, and engineering recommendations supporting SATCOM service performance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.

Network Architecture and Integration Documentation: Updated architecture diagrams, interface documentation, and technical artefacts supporting SATCOM network connectivity, control segment integration, and associated infrastructure.

Operational and Technical Support Documentation: Technical records, recommendations, and supporting documentation generated as part of incident resolution, troubleshooting, optimisation, and change implementation activities.

All deliverables shall be produced in accordance with NCIA requirements and shall be subject to review and acceptance as part of the service performance validation process.

3.3 Continuous SATCOM Network Engineering Improvement

The Contractor shall identify opportunities for SATCOM engineering optimisation, performance enhancement, and operational efficiency improvements; propose and track corrective and preventive technical actions; and monitor technical trends, recurring issues, and stakeholder feedback to support long-term SATCOM capability improvements.

All improvement actions shall be documented; reviewed during technical and governance meetings; and tracked to completion.

3.4 SATCOM Network Engineering Reporting

The Contractor shall establish, maintain, and operate a structured reporting framework to ensure full visibility of SATCOM network engineering activities, operational status, service performance, and compliance with the requirements of this Statement of Work (SoW).

The reporting framework shall provide transparent and auditable evidence of progress against agreed deliverables, performance objectives, and defined KPIs; enable continuous monitoring of network engineering activities, service availability, technical risks, dependencies, and operational issues; provide visibility of operational and engineering activities, including technical assessments, network integration activities, troubleshooting, optimisation activities, technical documentation, and stakeholder coordination; support governance, decision-making, and prioritisation of SATCOM network engineering activities; and facilitate performance validation and application of service credits.

3.4.1 SATCOM Network Engineering Report

The Contractor shall produce monthly SATCOM Network Engineering Reports, including, as a minimum: progress status against agreed deliverables, milestones, and planned activities; status of SATCOM network engineering activities; summary of engineering analyses and technical assessments performed; status of network architecture, interoperability assessments, and standards compliance activities; risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and mitigation actions related to SATCOM network engineering activities; status of corrective, preventive, and improvement actions; summary of stakeholder coordination activities, workshops, technical meetings, and review outcomes; and operational topics, including configuration management, documentation updates, and security compliance status.

3.4.2 Technical Issue Reporting

For high-priority technical issues or risks impacting SATCOM network engineering activities, the Contractor shall provide support to initial notification through timely technical input; regular technical status updates to relevant stakeholders and project management; and Technical Issue Reports including root cause analysis, impact assessment, and corrective and preventive actions.

The Contractor shall ensure that all technical communication is timely, clear, and aligned with NCIA governance and project management practices.

3.4.3 KPI Reporting

The Contractor shall provide KPI measurement data and supporting evidence; identification of KPI breaches; and calculation of applicable service credits.

This report shall serve as the basis for performance validation and payment.

3.4.4 Reporting Obligations

The Contractor shall ensure that all reports are completed and submitted no later than the fifth (5th) working day following the end of the respective reporting period, unless otherwise agreed.

All reports shall be accurate, complete, and aligned with data recorded in the NCIA ITSM toolset; suitable for performance validation, KPI assessment, and payment adjustment; produced using NCIA-approved formats and tools; traceable and auditable; and reviewed during regular service review meetings.

NCIA reserves the right to request clarification of reported data, validate reported information against system records, and require corrective actions in the event of discrepancies or deficiencies.

3.5 Governance Model

The Contractor shall establish and operate a structured Governance Model to ensure effective oversight, control, coordination, and continuous improvement of the services delivered under this Statement of Work.

The Governance Model shall ensure visibility of SATCOM network engineering activities and associated operational and technical risks; provide a structured mechanism for reviewing technical quality, interoperability considerations, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and overall engineering effectiveness; enable timely technical input to support decision-making, prioritisation, and escalation of network engineering and service-related matters; support continuous improvement of SATCOM network engineering activities, including tracking and closure of improvement actions, risks, and mitigation measures; ensure alignment with NCIA processes, applicable NATO governance frameworks, interoperability requirements, and operational priorities; and support coordination and collaboration with NCIA, ACO, and other relevant NATO stakeholders involved in SATCOM network engineering activities.

3.5.1 Governance Structure

The governance structure shall include the following levels:

Operational Level (Day-to-Day Management): Focus: to ensure effective execution, coordination, and control of daily SATCOM network engineering activities. Scope: review of ongoing SATCOM network engineering activities and escalations; coordination with NCIA and relevant stakeholders for technical issue resolution and alignment of deliverables; monitoring of engineering activities, technical risks, dependencies, assumptions, and emerging issues; coordination and execution of planned engineering activities, technical reviews and documentation updates; and identification of technical or operational issues requiring escalation or follow-up actions. Frequency: Daily or as required.

Service Review Level (Performance Management): Focus: to provide structured oversight of SATCOM network engineering activities, service performance, and continuous improvement. Activities: review of KPI performance and compliance against agreed deliverables and milestones; validation of Monthly SATCOM Network Engineering Reports; review of major technical issues, risks and engineering analyses; review of stakeholder feedback, technical review outcomes, and escalations; review and prioritisation of corrective, preventive, and improvement actions; identification and management of risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; and alignment on upcoming engineering activities, technical reviews, technical risks, and forward planning. Frequency: Monthly (or as agreed).

3.5.2 Security Clearance

The assigned personnel by the Contractor shall possess valid NATO-SECRET Personal Security Clearance for the duration of the Period of Performance.

3.6 Working Provisions

3.6.1 Place of Performance

The primary place of performance shall be Mons, Belgium, in designated NATO Class I and II Security Areas.

3.6.2 Hours of Performance

The services shall be performed during standard NCIA working hours from Monday to Thursday from 08:30 until 17:30 and Friday from 08:30 until 15:30.

3.6.3 NCIA-Furnished Property and Services

NCIA shall provide access to necessary tools, data, and NATO networks, subject to applicable Agency policies, security authorisation, and coordination requirements.

3.6.4 Travel Requirements

This Task Order requires scheduled travel consisting of up to 12 visits to NCIA sites per year, excluding overseas travel, for a maximum of 3 working days each visit. The travel, lodging, and associated expenses for travel are included in the price of the bid (NTE), such that the purchaser shall not be invoiced.

Extraordinary Travel may be required (to other NATO or non-NATO locations) as necessary. In the event of such unforeseen meetings being called, the cost of all travel and subsistence will be addressed through a contract amendment. Expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with Article 5.5 of the AAS+ Framework Contract. Such costs will be set as a separate PO line to cover and reimburse actual expenses upon submission of all receipts and invoices in line with NCIA processes.

4. SERVICE PERFORMANCE

The performance of each assigned personnel shall be measured against the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) defined in this Section. Performance shall be assessed through the following indicators: KPI 1 - Deliverables Submission Timeliness, ensuring that all required deliverables, including SATCOM Network Engineering documentation, technical reports, engineering reports, architecture documentation, and other technical deliverables, are submitted in accordance with agreed schedules and milestones; KPI 2 - Technical Quality of Documentation, ensuring that all deliverables meet required standards of clarity, completeness, technical accuracy, and consistency with NATO and NCIA expectations; KPI 3 - Responsiveness to Tasking and Change Requests, ensuring timely and effective response to tasking, evolving requirements, clarification requests, and adjustments to deliverables or scope; KPI 4 - Stakeholder Coordination Effectiveness, ensuring active and effective contribution to coordination activities with NCIA and relevant stakeholders, including participation in meetings, workshops, and technical exchanges; and KPI 5 - Customer Satisfaction, ensuring satisfactory performance as reflected through feedback from NCIA leads and relevant stakeholders regarding quality, collaboration, and overall support effectiveness.

All KPI thresholds, performance monitoring, and associated Service Credits shall be applied as defined in this Section and linked to the reporting and payment mechanism.

4.1 KPI Measurement

The performance of the assigned personnel shall be measured on a monthly basis as follows:

KPI 1 - Deliverables submitted on schedule: Compliant (Met) where ninety-nine-point-nine percent (99.9%) of deliverables are submitted in accordance with agreed milestones and deadlines. Non-Compliant (Not Met) where less than ninety-nine-point-nine percent (99.9%) of deliverables are submitted on time. Frequency: Monthly.

KPI 2 - Technical quality of documentation: Compliant (Met) where ninety-nine-point-nine percent (99.9%) of deliverables meet the required technical quality standards. Non-Compliant (Not Met) where less than ninety-nine-point-nine percent (99.9%) of deliverables meet the required standards. Frequency: Monthly.

KPI 3 - Responsiveness to tasking and change requests: Compliant (Met) where one hundred percent (100%) of tasking and change requests are addressed within agreed timelines. Non-Compliant (Not Met) where less than one hundred percent (100%) of tasking and change requests are addressed within agreed timelines. Frequency: Monthly.

KPI 4 - Contribution to stakeholder coordination: Compliant (Met) where ninety-nine-point-nine percent (99.9%) of required stakeholder coordination activities are effectively supported. Non-Compliant (Not Met) where less than ninety-nine-point-nine percent (99.9%) of coordination activities are supported. Frequency: Monthly.

KPI 5 - Customer satisfaction (feedback from NCIA leads): Compliant (Met) where the average stakeholder satisfaction rating is equal to or greater than four (4) out of five (5). Non-Compliant (Not Met) where the average rating is below four (4) out of five (5). Frequency: Bi-annually.

4.2 Service Credits

4.2.1 KPI Weighting

Each KPI shall contribute to the overall service performance as follows:

KPI 1 - Deliverables submitted on schedule: 2.5%

KPI 2 - Technical quality of documentation: 2.5%

KPI 3 - Responsiveness to tasking and change requests: 2.5%

KPI 4 - Contribution to stakeholder coordination: 2.5%

KPI 5 - Customer satisfaction: 5% (bi-annual)

4.2.2 Calculation of Service Credits

Where a KPI is determined to be Non-Compliant (Not Met) in accordance with Section 4.1, the corresponding percentage specified in Section 4.2.1 shall be applied as a Service Credit.

Service Credits shall be calculated based on validated KPI results; be documented in the Service Performance Report; be reviewed and confirmed during service review meetings; and be deducted from the corresponding invoice.

For KPI 1 to KPI 4: Where one or more KPIs are assessed as Non-Compliant during the applicable reporting period, the corresponding KPI weightings shall be cumulative. The Total Service Credit applicable for the reporting period shall be calculated as follows: Total Service Credit (%) = Sum of the KPI weightings for all KPIs assessed as Non-Compliant. The monetary value of the applicable Service Credit shall be calculated as follows: Service Credit Value = Total Service Credit (%) x Monthly Performance-Based Fee.

For KPI 5 - Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): As it is measured on a bi-annual basis, the associated Service Credit shall be assessed separately from the monthly KPIs. Where KPI 5 is assessed as Non-Compliant, the applicable Service Credit shall be calculated as follows: CSAT Service Credit Value = KPI 5 Weighting (%) x Six (6) x Monthly Performance-Based Fee. The applicable CSAT Service Credit shall be calculated once per bi-annual assessment period; be documented in the corresponding Service Performance Report; and be deducted from the first applicable invoice following completion of the bi-annual assessment period.

4.2.3 Cap on Service Credits

The total service credits applied in any reporting period shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the applicable monthly service fee.

4.3 Audit and Verification

The Contractor shall ensure that all KPI measurements and service credit calculations are accurate, transparent, and auditable.

The Purchaser reserves the right to verify KPI results; request supporting evidence; and challenge any calculation deemed incorrect.

5. PAYMENT

5.1 Monthly Service Fee

The work carried under this Statement of Work shall be delivered on the basis of a fixed monthly service fee. The monthly service fee shall cover all costs associated with the delivery of the services, including personnel, management, tools, overheads, and travel as defined in this SoW.

The Monthly Service Fee shall be structured as follows:

Monthly Fixed Fee: Equal to eighty-five percent (85%) of the Monthly Service Fee and payable upon acceptance of the services delivered during the applicable reporting period.

Monthly Performance-Based Fee: Equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the Monthly Service Fee and subject to performance assessment against the applicable KPIs defined in Section 4.1 and shall be adjusted through the application of Service Credits in accordance with Section 4.2.

5.2 Payment Adjustment

The monthly payment shall be subject to adjustment based on the Contractor's performance against the KPIs.

The payable Monthly Performance-Based Fee shall be calculated as follows: Payable Monthly Performance-Based Fee = Monthly Performance-Based Fee - Service Credit Value.

The final payable amount shall be calculated as follows: Final Payment = Monthly Fixed Fee + Payable Monthly Performance-Based Fee.

5.2.1 Invoicing

The Contractor shall submit invoices on a monthly basis in arrears. Each invoice shall correspond to the services delivered during the relevant calendar month; include the applicable monthly service fee; clearly identify any applicable service credits in accordance with Section 4.2; and be supported by the Service Performance Report for the same period.

Payment of the monthly invoice shall be subject to delivery of the services in accordance with the provisions of this Statement of Work; submission of the Service Performance Report; and validation of KPI performance and service credit calculations.

6. PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE

This Statement of Work is expected to commence as soon as possible but no later than 09 November 2026 (tentative) until 31 December 2026. The Period of Performance may be extended through the exercise of the following option periods, at the sole discretion of the NCIA: Year 2 (Option Year 1), a period of twelve (12) months immediately following the completion of Year 1; and Year 3 (Option Year 2), a period of twelve (12) months immediately following the completion of Year 2.

7. REPLACEMENT

Any replacement of the personnel assigned shall be subject to prior written approval by NCIA and shall meet or exceed the qualifications, experience, and security requirements defined for the respective profile. In the event that assigned personnel become unavailable during the Period of Performance, the Contractor shall propose a suitable replacement candidate and ensure seamless continuity of the services at no additional cost, including the provision of appropriate knowledge transfer.

The Contractor shall ensure an orderly handover of services both in the case of personnel replacement and at the conclusion of the Period of Performance. This shall include the transfer of all relevant documentation, data, work products, system configurations, and operational procedures necessary to maintain continuity of service delivery. The Contractor shall also provide reasonable support to NCIA and, where applicable, to any follow-on contractor, including clarification of activities and assistance in mitigating disruption.

All transition activities shall be completed within a timeframe agreed with NCIA and in accordance with NCIA instructions. All applicable NCIA Terms and Conditions shall apply.

8. QUALIFICATIONS

[See Requirements]

Requirements

3.5.2 SECURITY CLEARANCE

The assigned personnel by the Contractor shall possess valid NATO-SECRET Personal Security Clearance for the duration of the Period of Performance.

8. QUALIFICATIONS

Specific Technical Qualifications

  • University Degree or Higher Vocational Training in Telecommunications, Electronics, Information Technology, Network Engineering, SATCOM Engineering, or a related field.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in IP networking, including routing, switching, WAN technologies, and troubleshooting of complex network environments.
  • Experience supporting SATCOM, WAN, or deployed communication systems in operational or mission-critical environments.
  • Proven understanding of network concepts, including TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, TCP and UDP protocols, MTU and MSS considerations, and Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking fundamentals.
  • Practical experience with routing and switching technologies, including static routing, OSPF, IS-IS, VLANs, Layer 2 and Layer 3 services, and the ability to analyse routing tables, forwarding decisions, routing convergence issues, and end-to-end traffic paths.
  • Basic understanding of BGP fundamentals and route redistribution concepts.
  • Practical experience with tunnelling technologies, including GRE, IPSec, GRE over IPSec, and L2TP.
  • Ability to deploy, troubleshoot, and validate tunnelled environments, including diagnosis of encapsulation issues, connectivity problems, MTU and MSS-related issues, and end-to-end communication across multiple network domains.
  • Proven understanding of SATCOM architectures, including SCPC and MCPC systems, SATCOM transport characteristics, satellite latency and bandwidth constraints, and integration of SATCOM transport into enterprise IP networks.
  • Experience with VLAN tagging, mapping, trunking, traffic segmentation, SD-WAN technologies, and hybrid WAN architectures.
  • Understanding of the impact of packet loss and jitter on operational services and applications.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve end-to-end connectivity issues, including routing issues, tunnel failures, packet loss, high latency, application connectivity problems, and asymmetric routing.
  • Experience supporting operational deployments, exercises, and mission-related activities.
  • Experience with Cisco routing and switching platforms.
  • Understanding of network monitoring and performance management tools.
  • Experience with service management processes, including incident management, problem management, and operational support processes.
  • CCNA certification, or equivalent practical experience.

General Technical Qualifications

  • Solid understanding of NATO operational standards, procedures, responsibilities, and communication protocols.
  • Experience with SATCOM operations, engineering support, deployed communication systems, or related defence communication environments.
  • Strong analytical capability applied to system performance, interoperability, troubleshooting, technical assessments, and fault isolation activities.
  • Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms and service reporting tools in complex enterprise environments.
  • Knowledge of SLA, OLA, and underpinning service management concepts.
  • Proficiency in service performance reporting, trend analysis, and customer communication.
  • Familiarity with network and unified communications technology domains to provide technically credible service support.
  • English language proficiency at minimum C1 level.

Professional Competencies

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with NCIA teams, technical teams, customers, and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively as part of a team.
  • Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and support end-to-end fault isolation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Customer-focused approach in operational and service delivery environments.
  • High level of motivation, adaptability, and collaboration.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Relevant industry certifications are desirable; a CCNP Enterprise certification, or equivalent experience, is preferred.
  • Experience in NATO or multinational military environments is strongly desirable.
  • Knowledge of NATO and NCIA structures, roles, and organisational context is desirable.

title: Junior Salesforce / CRM Administrator - Semarang
description:
We are looking for…

Hopefully, you! We’re hiring a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Salesforce / CRM Administrator to join our Technology team in Semarang. You’ll own day-to-day administration of our Salesforce environment — user setup, access, configuration, data quality and small enhancements — working closely with our Technology team and external technology partner in Australia and supporting our local Indonesian team on the ground.

This is a deliberate junior role. We’re hiring for curiosity and craft over years on a CV. If you’ve been working through Trailhead, hold (or are close to) your Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201), and want a clear runway into senior admin — read on.

Junior Salesforce / CRM Administrator’s key responsibilities will include:

  • Salesforce administration: user setup, profiles, roles, permission sets and record type assignments; objects, fields, validation rules, flows, approval processes, saved reports and dashboards.
  • Data hygiene: imports (CSV via Data Loader), exports, deduplication and clean-up across Salesforce and (with guidance) NetSuite.
  • User support and training: triage and resolve support tickets, deliver short training sessions, and write simple how-to guides that drive adoption.
  • Documentation: keep our system docs, SOPs and admin guides current and useful.
  • Testing: participate in UAT for Salesforce releases, sandbox refreshes, and small enhancements.
  • Cross-system curiosity: learn how Salesforce talks to NetSuite, our website and middleware — we’ll teach you the integration side as you go.
  • Reporting and dashboards: build and maintain reports and dashboards that give the sales and ops teams clear visibility of pipeline and performance.
  • Local IT support: help the Semarang team with day-to-day IT issues when needed.

Requirements

We need you to bring…

  • Excellent English — written and verbal. You’ll be working daily with our Australian team.
  • 1+ year hands-on with Salesforce in an admin, support, business analyst or consulting capacity. Internships, capstone projects and serious self-study portfolios count — tell us what you’ve actually built.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) (or actively working towards it). We’ll fund your next cert once you’re in role.
  • Core CRM concepts — lead-to-opportunity, sales stages, forecasting, account and contact management. You don’t need deep sales operations knowledge, but you need to be comfortable talking to sales teams.
  • Curiosity about multi-system environments — CRM, ERP, website, middleware. You don’t need experience with NetSuite or integrations; you do need to be interested in how the pieces fit together.
  • Structured, detail-minded approach to data and configuration, with strong problem-solving and clear communication.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Kanban ways of working is a plus, not a must.
  • Eager to grow — we’re looking for someone who wants to be a senior Salesforce admin or consultant in 2–3 years.

Please note that we require full permanent working rights for this position.

Benefits

In return, we’ll give you…

Perks, benefits and the space to grow. We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package and plenty of opportunities for career growth and development. This includes:

  • The opportunities you need to grow, develop and craft a career you’re proud of within the global Eco Outdoor business
  • Company-sponsored events and activities to connect with your colleagues
  • The opportunity to give back via our internal Social Housing and Sustainability initiatives

OK, you want to know what you’re getting yourself into? Let us introduce ourselves.

Established in 2001 by expert minds from the landscape design and construction industries, Eco Outdoor is an Australian-founded global brand with showrooms in Australia, New Zealand and North America. We’re constantly experimenting, innovating and pushing creative boundaries, delivering the highest-quality natural stone and architectural surfaces (and outdoor furniture collections) to the international architecture market.

We employ around 130 people across the globe, all of whom are dedicated to innovating, crafting and providing remarkable products and unbelievable hospitality to our clients and collaborators in the architecture and design space. We thrive on constant reinvention, regular development opportunities and a passionate culture grounded in connection and involvement.

We’re a tribe of collaborators, critical thinkers, problem-solvers and challenge-embracers, and we nurture our incredibly talented people to put their best foot forward every day. That starts with our core values – Be a Game Changer, Only Accept Awesome, Play as a Team, Be Curious, Get Fired up – which are deeply ingrained in our culture. Basically, we’re all about fostering an innovative, industry-leading, collaborative, creative, passionate team to reach their fullest potential. That’s good for humans and good for business.

If this sounds like your kind of gig…

We’d love to hear from you. If you need more information before you apply, check out our website, LinkedIn or Instagram. If you have questions those sites don’t answer, flick us a line at people@ecooutdoor.com.au unless you’re a recruitment agency, in which case: no, thanks. We’ve got this one covered.

title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect , Professional Services - ASEAN
description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Senior ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our ASEAN team based in Singapore. In this role, you'll work closely with customers across Singapore and the broader ASEAN region to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, designing and implementing tailored cloud solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes.

As a Senior PCA, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers accelerate their cloud adoption journey — from migration and modernization to building cloud-native applications and leveraging emerging technologies such as generative AI. You will be a key player in the pre-sales process, providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the customer's cloud journey.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Solution Design
- Lead cloud solutioning during the pre-sales motion, providing demonstrations, initial scoping, designing, and managing AWS solutions while providing technical guidance and best practices

- Architect and design scalable, resilient, and secure cloud solutions that address complex customer challenges across industries including public sector, financial services, telecommunications, and enterprise

- Drive cloud modernization and AI/ML transformation initiatives, including generative AI adoption strategies

- Define and lead technical workstreams across multiple concurrent engagements

Customer Engagement & Advisory
- Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions to address customer challenges
- Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, and proof-of-concept implementations
- Build deep customer relationships and identify opportunities to expand AWS adoption and Professional Services engagement
- Collaborate with AWS account teams, solution architects, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions

Delivery Excellence
- Lead and deliver complex cloud engagements including migrations, modernizations, data & analytics, and application development projects
- Ensure delivery quality, manage technical risks, and drive customer satisfaction
- Define project scope, estimates, and technical approaches for statements of work (SOW)
- Mentor and guide junior architects and consultants on the team

Thought Leadership & Community

- Contribute to the development of ProServe best practices, frameworks, and accelerators

- Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to apply new AWS services and features to customer challenges

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Embedded Software Development Engineer II (C/C++), AWS EC2 VPC NX
description:
Do you want to shape the future of virtualized (SDN) networking in the world’s biggest public cloud?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) VPC Packet Pipeline team owns the packet pipeline that runs right beneath all our customer's EC2 VPC instances, adding features like firewalling (security groups), billing and monitoring as we touch every single packet on every single host across our massive worldwide fleet. Our vision is to combine the performance of bare metal networking while maintaining all the benefits of the cloud, including delivering features not possible on bare metal i.e. true Software Defined Networking (SDN).

We are seeking an Embedded Software Development Engineer II (C/C++) to join our EC2 Nitro Fairness team, where you'll help ensure equitable resource allocation in our multi-tenant cloud infrastructure while maintaining the single-tenant experience customers expect. In this role, you'll develop sophisticated algorithms and systems that intelligently manage shared compute, memory,
and network resources across diverse customer workloads. You'll design and implement sophisticated fairness algorithms, real-time resource schedulers, and performance isolation systems that operate at microsecond latencies across millions of concurrent EC2 instances within the Nitro hypervisor. This position requires deep understanding of virtualization technologies, distributed systems, and performance optimization, as you'll be directly impacting how millions of EC2 instances share underlying hardware while appearing completely isolated to end users. You'll collaborate closely with hardware teams, hypervisor engineers, and service owners to implement fairness policies that balance resource utilization efficiency with strict performance guarantees.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Development:
• Lead architecture decisions for fairness algorithms and resource allocation systems within the Nitro hypervisor
• Mentor junior engineers on low-level C/Rust programming and embedded system development practices
• Conduct design and code reviews for performance-critical fairness mechanisms
• Drive implementation of resource isolation and scheduling policies in embedded Nitro environments

Performance Analysis & Optimization:
• Analyze customer workload patterns to identify fairness violations and noisy neighbor scenarios
• Design and implement hardware-aware fairness algorithms leveraging CPU cache locality, memory bandwidth, and network resources
• Collaborate with hardware engineering teams to optimize packet-pipeline software and hardware offloads for equitable resource sharing
• Set and achieve fairness performance goals for new instance types and Nitro hardware generations

Cross-Team Collaboration & Strategy:
• Partner with hardware/firmware teams on co-designing fairness enforcements
• Collaborate with other engineering vertical teams to ensure fairness features integrate seamlessly across the stack
• Communicate fairness requirements and technical designs to senior management and product teams
• Evaluate emerging technologies for ML-based instance types and their impact on resource fairness

System Design & Implementation:
• Develop real-time fairness monitoring and enforcement systems operating at microsecond latencies
• Implement dynamic resource allocation policies that adapt to changing workload characteristics
• Design telemetry and observability systems to measure and validate fairness across multi-tenant environments

Für unseren Produktionsstandort in Fürstenfeldbruck suchen wir motivierte Mitarbeitende, die unser Team im Bereich Qualitätssicherung verstärken möchten. Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis, Ihrem Qualitätsbewusstsein und Ihrer strukturierten Arbeitsweise tragen Sie maßgeblich zur Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung unserer hohen Qualitätsstandards bei.

Your Responsibilities

  • Durchführung von Wareneingangsprüfungen sowie Erstellung und Optimierung von Prüfanweisungen für mechanische Bauteile
  • Analyse interner und externer Reklamationen, Ableitung geeigneter Korrektur- und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen sowie Nachverfolgung deren Wirksamkeit
  • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Qualitätskriterien, Test- und Prüfverfahren sowie Unterstützung bei der Freigabe neuer Produktionsprozesse

  • Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Produktqualität
  • Durchführung von Schulungen und Unterstützung bei qualitätsrelevanten Fragestellungen innerhalb der Organisation
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards, Prozesse und Dokumentationsanforderungen

Your Profile

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches oder kaufmännisches Studium bzw. eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, idealerweise im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre) in der Qualitätssicherung sowie erste Kenntnisse der DIN EN ISO 9001:2015
  • Analytisches und qualitätsorientiertes Denken sowie eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe für komplexe technische Zusammenhänge
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Qualitätstechniken und -methoden wie FMEA, 8D, Ishikawa oder Ursachenanalyse
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office-Anwendungen

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Senior Database Administrator (ClickHouse)
description:
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.

We’re looking for a Senior Database Administrator to join our Infrastructure team. You’ll work on high-impact projects in a high-growth environment, alongside a world-class remote engineering team spread across 20+ countries.
  • Own the reliability and performance of our production ClickHouse clusters, whether self-hosted on Kubernetes or running on managed ClickHouse services.
  • Design a standard architecture and tooling that let us grow to dozens of multi-node clusters without the operational work growing at the same pace.
  • Manage the whole cluster lifecycle as code: provisioning, configuration, scaling, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Build monitoring and alerting that catch problems before users notice them.
  • Own backups and disaster recovery, and test restores regularly.
  • Keep clusters secure by default.
  • Plan capacity and keep infrastructure costs under control.
  • Be the go-to person on ClickHouse for developers, DevOps engineers, other DBAs, and engineering leadership, from schema design and data ingestion to query performance.
  • Handle routine database requests and automate as many of them as you can.
  • Step in during rare production emergencies, including outside business hours. Afterwards, lead the root-cause analysis on the database side and contribute to the postmortem.
  • Keep documentation and runbooks up to date, and share what you know with the team.
  • Deep, DBA-level knowledge of ClickHouse from running it in production. You should understand how it stores, merges, replicates, and queries data, and be able to explain why a cluster behaves the way it does. Strong SQL is part of this, including optimising complex analytical queries and reviewing schema design.
  • Ability to design architecture and automation that holds up across dozens of multi-node clusters. Experience running a large fleet of databases (dozens or hundreds of instances) is a strong advantage, and the engine does not have to be ClickHouse.
  • You have run and maintained stateful workloads on Kubernetes in production, well beyond the initial deployment.
  • Production use of a Kubernetes operator to run databases. Any engine counts, for example CloudNativePG, Zalando Postgres Operator, Altinity, or the official ClickHouse operator.
  • Experience with version upgrades, backup and restore, and migrating large datasets between clusters or regions with zero or minimal downtime.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across the whole stack, from queries and schema design down to Kubernetes, Linux, storage, and networking.
  • A proactive approach to database health. You have built monitoring and alerting with any modern observability stack, and you act on early warning signs before they turn into incidents.
  • Database security in practice: encryption in transit and at rest, access control, and secrets management.
  • Infrastructure as code with any mainstream tool, plus at least one programming or scripting language for automation.
  • You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure on any major provider, as opposed to only using a platform that another team runs.
  • Clear communication, written and spoken, with engineers and with leadership, whether the subject is architecture, performance, an incident, a risk, or a cost. You should be able to take a problem from investigation to production fix on your own.

Nice to have:
  • Hands-on work on the source code of a Kubernetes operator for databases, as a developer or contributor.
  • Practical use of AI tools for database observability or for automating routine operational tasks.
  • A background in highly regulated environments.
  • Any Kubernetes or cloud certifications.
  • Full-time B2B contract
  • Fully remote setup
  • Up to 20% tax allowance
  • 22 paid leave days annually
  • Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company
  • Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning
  • Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn
Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, Poland and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed).

title: Application Builder, Ring Application Services

We frequently collaborate with cloud, firmware and other mobile teams to solve problems, come up with solutions and delight our customers. We are data driven, value and promote ownership, working backwards from our customers to bring them an innovative and seamless home security experience.

title: Data Engineer - Music DISCO, Music DISCO
description:
Description

Amazon Music is awash in data! To help make sense of it all, the DISCO (Data, Insights, Science & Optimization) team: (i) enables the Consumer Product Tech org to make data driven decisions that improve the customer retention, engagement and experience on Amazon Music. We build and maintain automated self-service data solutions, data science models and deep dive difficult questions that provide actionable insights. We also enable measurement, personalization and experimentation by operating key data programs ranging from attribution pipelines, northstar weblabs metrics to causal frameworks. (ii) delivering exceptional Analytics & Science infrastructure for DISCO teams, fostering a data driven approach to insights and decision making. As platform builders, we are committed to constructing flexible, reliable, and scalable solutions to empower our customers. (iii) accelerates and facilitates content analytics and provides independence to generate valuable insights in a fast, agile, and accurate way. This domain provides analytical support for the Consumer Product Tech org to make data driven decisions while launching new features and evaluating existing features with the end goal of improving the customer experience. DISCO team enables repeatable, easy, in depth analysis of music customer behaviors. We reduce the cost in time and effort of analysis, data set building, model building, and user segmentation. Our goal is to empower all teams at Amazon Music to make data driven decisions and effectively measure their results by providing high quality, high availability data, and democratized data access through self-service tools. If you love the challenges that come with big data then this role is for you. We collect billions of events a day, manage petabyte scale data on Redshift and S3, and develop data pipelines using Spark/Scala EMR, SQL based ETL, Airflow services.

We are looking for a talented, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Data Engineer, who knows how to take on big data challenges in an agile way. Duties include big data design and analysis, data modeling, and development, deployment, and operations of big data pipelines. You'll help build Amazon Music's most important data pipelines and data sets, and expand self-service data knowledge and capabilities through an Amazon Music data university. DISCO team develops data specifically for a set of key business domains like personalization and marketing and provides and protects a robust self-service core data experience for all internal customers. We deal in AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EMR, EC2, DynamoDB, Kinesis Firehose, and Lambda. Your team will manage the data exchange store (Data Lake) and EMR/Spark processing layer using Airflow as orchestrator. You'll build our data university and partner with Product, Marketing, BI, and ML teams to build new behavioural events, pipelines, datasets, models, and reporting to support their initiatives. You'll also continue to develop big data pipelines.

Key job responsibilities

You will work with Product Managers, Data scientists and other Data Engineers to help design, develop and deliver scalable data analytics platform and data pipeline solutions to support various Science, ML initiatives and at the scale and speed of Amazon Music. In addition, you will help design, develop, and deliver components for the analytics platform at the broader org level and streamline/automate workflows for the broader DISCO organization.

A day in the life

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data scientists, business intelligence engineers, to design and architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS, utilizing the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK).
  • Develop robust and scalable data pipelines using SQL/PySpark/Airflow to efficiently ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources into a structured format, ensuring data quality and integrity.
  • Design and implement an efficient and scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using appropriate NoSQL/SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data.
  • Automate ETL/ELT processes to streamline data integration from diverse data sources and ensure the platform's reliability and efficiency.
  • Create data models to support business intelligence, providing actionable insights and interactive reports to end-users.
  • Enable advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities within the platform to derive predictive and prescriptive insights from the data through tools like EMR/SageMaker Notebooks
  • Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, databases, and applications, ensuring low-latency data access for analytics and machine learning tasks.
  • Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to safeguard sensitive information.
  • Work closely with data scientists and business intelligence engineers to understand their requirements and collaborate on data-related projects.
  • Create comprehensive technical documentation for the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintainability.

About The Team

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of data engineering experience
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
  • Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Job Summary

General Atomics Systems Integration, LLC (GA-SI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a provider of military and commercial engineering services. GA-SI is a leading-edge expert in systems integration technologies, reliability improvements, and controls system design.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Field Avionics Technician to join the GA-ASI team located at Creech AFB, and rotate between 2nd and 3rd shift every 3 months. In this position, you will support MCE Maintenance.

Under limited supervision, this position is responsible for technical and operational support in the installation, application and maintenance of unmanned aerial vehicle electronic equipment to include ground control stations, ground data terminals and ground support equipment in accordance with technical specifications, engineering instructions and technical orders, procedures and regulations.

Conducts technical analysis and evaluation of product implementation to ensure customer specifications are met.

Troubleshoots technical problems and issues and determines solutions to a wide variety of difficult problems.

Provides guidance and training to internal and external customers regarding equipment.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Operates UAV, ground control stations and ground support equipment and all subordinate systems at operation locations.
- Analyzes customer requirements and evaluates product implementation to meet specifications and end user applications. Assesses customers' needs for data interface and recommends actions for coordinative product solutions.
- Provides technical expertise on the installation, configuration, application and repair of products and systems to customers at operational locations.
- Performs high level troubleshooting and repair of ground and airborne electronic equipment.
- Utilizes product knowledge, sound judgment and logical reasoning to determine technical solutions complex problems.
- Repairs or replaces components based on test results, advanced system knowledge, technical documents, engineering instructions, schematics, blueprints or written/verbal instructions.
- Performs installation, configuration and test of computer hardware, software and networked systems.  Diagnoses and corrects malfunctions as required.
- Performs inspections and preventative maintenance on ground and airborne systems.  Maintains required records and forms in accordance with company and customer specifications.
- Validates and verifies accuracy of technical documents and procedures.
- Recommends changes to technical documents and procedures based on system expertise and best industry practices.
- Fabricates, installs, troubleshoots and repairs wire harnesses and assemblies.
- Ensures proper routing and clamping of wire harnesses and assemblies.
- Represents group as subject matter expert with internal and external customers and other personnel.
- Conducts training and practical instruction of peers and customers in the use of ground and airborne electronic systems.
- May provide guidance or training to less experienced staff.
- Performs other duties as assigned.
- Responsible for observing all laws, regulations and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.
- Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Qualifications

- Typically requires education or formal training equivalent to the completion of a two-year technical degree or trade school equivalency as well six or more years' experience in aviation or electronics. Equivalent professional experience may be substituted in lieu of education.
- Must be able to perform a variety of non-routine tasks and demonstrate considerable knowledge of avionics and electronic procedures and principles.
- Must possess the ability to troubleshoot at the component level.
- The ability to analyze data and recommend solutions.
- Considerable knowledge and use of electronic test equipment, hand and soldering tools, voltage or amperage measuring and recording devices.
- The ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, schematics and technical orders.
- Strong analytical, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills to accurately document, report and assess situations and make judgments.
- The ability to work both independently and in a team environment is essential as is the ability to work extended hours and travel as required.
- Knowledge and experience of Linux and Windows Operating Systems is highly desirable.
- Experience with maintaining, troubleshooting and repairing RF systems is desirable.
- Experience with session layer protocol used on the Internet or local area networks to provide a bidirectional interactive text-oriented communication facility using a virtual terminal connection also known as TELNET is highly desirable.
- Knowledge in File Transfer Protocol (FTP) is desirable.
- Certification in A+, Network+ and Security+ is highly desirable.
- Must be able to work a rotating 2nd and 3rd shift schedule. Three to four months on 2nd shift (12pm - 12am) then three to four months on 3rd shift (12:00am - 12pm), and so on.
- Ability to obtain and maintain an adjudicated polygraph TS/SCI is required.

Under the direction of the Cyber Project Management Section Head the contractor shall:

  • Identify, plan, request and manage the deployment of resources to meet project milestones and initiate corrective actions when necessary.

  • Provide regular status reports on the progress of projects to leadership, senior executives, and NATO committees.
  • Take responsibility for understanding customer requirements, collecting data, delivering analysis and problem resolution.
  • Propose appropriate actions to provide an increased level of confidence and reduce risks such that the project will meet its objectives in terms of deliverables (scope and quality), schedule, and costs.
  • Provide effective and positive leadership to the project team.
  • Take appropriate action when project performance deviates from agreed tolerances through risk management.
  • Contribute to other project related activities to support the continuous improvement of Project Management within the NCI Agency.

Specific Working Conditions: If working from a remote location, the contractor shall provide IT equipment for the processing of public and unclassified information in support of their duties, including the capability to participate in video meetings using Microsoft based collaboration tools.

The contractor may be permitted to perform work remotely, from a different NATO nation than the duty location, for up to a maximum of twenty percent (20%) of their total working time, subject to prior approval by their Resource Manager (to which they will be assigned upon contract start) and the Cyber Project Management Section Head. The contractor may work from their home in the duty location subject to the NCIA teleworking policy and in coordination with the Section Head of S&R.

Travel required: The contractor may be required to travel to NCIA locations in Allied Nations for meetings with internal or external stakeholders. In such cases the contractor will be reimbursed for travel costs according to NATO regulations for traveling on NATO duty.

Occasional travel to customer or contractor locations within the 32 NATO Allied Countries, but travel outside Belgium and The Netherlands is rare. Local travel within Belgium and to The Hague, The Netherlands roughly 3x per month.

Contractors traveling for work purposes shall initiate travel requests from their designated duty station only.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • A minimum requirement of a Bachelor's degree at a nationally recognised/certified University in a related scientific or engineering discipline (such as computer science/engineering, information systems, physics, electronics, etc.) and 3 years post-related experience;
  • Or exceptionally, the lack of a university degree may be compensated by the demonstration of a candidate's particular abilities or experience that is/are of interest to NCIA, that is, at least 10 years extensive and progressive expertise in duties related to those in this Statement of Work
  • Recent experience as a Project Manager for a large organization-focused on the delivery of C4ISR capabilities within the defence sector;
  • At least 2 years direct experience with NATO or a National Ministry of Defense in the delivery of military, CIS, or IT capabilities;
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with good briefing skills.
  • Proficient in the use of in the use of MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, and Power-BI for the visualization and communication of project status and milestones.
  • A detailed understanding of the NATO Security Investment Programme (NSIP).
  • Significant and recent experience in the development of Statements of Work used as the basis for competitive bidding from industry. This includes the detailed development and collection of technical and non-technical project requirements.
  • Language proficiency in English: meet or exceed the NATO STANAG 6001 Level 3 "Professional Proficiency".
  • A recognised formal Project Management qualification, such as PRINCE2 Foundation, PMP, US DAWIA Program Management Level II, Managing Successful Programmes, Risk Management Professional, Lean Six-Sigma, etc;
  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP);
  • Relevant IT certifications such as ITIL 4, Agile PM, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud Practitioner, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), etc;
  • Certification in the use of MS Project, Power-BI, or other project management/reporting software;

Desirable Experience:

  • Experience leading teams of 3-5 personnel;
  • Experience in the management of Cyber Security or ICT projects;
  • Experience working in an international environment comprising both military and civilian elements;
  • At least 3 years' experience working with the NATO Security Investment Programme (NSIP) or Military Budget (MB);
  • Extensive knowledge of NATO's Common Funded Capability Governance Model (CFCDGM) and/or Capability Package process;
  • Extensive knowledge of NATO responsibilities and organization, including NATO's Strategic Commands (ACO & ACT)

### Description

**Join a  team of dedicated professionals who help protect the systems that support one of our community's most essential resources: water.** Cucamonga Valley Water District (CVWD) is seeking a skilled and strategic Network Administrator to build, secure, and strengthen the technology that helps deliver safe, reliable water to our community. This is a critical role supporting enterprise systems, network infrastructure, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity.  If you're an experienced IT professional with advanced technical expertise and a passion for protecting mission-critical systems, we'd like to hear from you.

**FILING DEADLINE**

This recruitment is **open until a sufficient number of applications are received**.  Candidates are highly encouraged to apply early. **The first round of interviews is tentatively scheduled for Thursday, September 3, 2026** **.**

_PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS RECRUITMENT MAY CLOSE AT ANY TIME WITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE._

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**DEFINITION**

To perform a wide variety of specialized professional support duties for the Information Technology Division including but not limited to configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting network systems, servers and enterprise systems to support the operational needs of the District; assisting in diagnosing and resolving network hardware, software, and connectivity issues; and performing related duties as assigned.

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**

The Network Administrator is the experienced advanced journey level. Incumbents in this class are distinguished from the Information Technology Specialist II by the performance of the full range of duties assigned. At this level incumbents perform the more complex and specialized workloads while exercising broader discretion and independent judgment within established guidelines. Emphasis is on enterprise systems, network equipment, security and WAN equipment. Employees at this level assist the Information Technology Manager with budget, Cyber Security mitigation, Master Plan, and Disaster Recovery plan activities and may act on his/her behalf in his/her absence if appointed.

**SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED**

Direct supervision is received from the Information Technology Manager.

**ESSENTIAL AND MARGINAL FUNCTION STATEMENTS**

_Essential and other important responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:_

**Essential Functions:**

01. Install, support, provide maintenance of networks and servers; participate in training other I.T. staff members on servers, network equipment, firewalls, and enterprise systems.

02. Maintain and operate a variety of office equipment like phone systems, backup appliances, VOIP desk phones, scanners, and other peripheral equipment.

03. Develop and maintains  enterprise software,  database programs, support Microsoft and other cloud infrastructure needs.

04. Maintain documentation of data systems and network infrastructure.

05. Monitor network, systems, printers, job queues, spooled output, job logs and historical logs; adjust as necessary.

06. Experience in security, operations, control assessment, risk management, auditing, and/or internal controls.

07. Modify or enhance existing programs to meet users’ needs; troubleshoot and perform repairs and adjustments to computer systems and peripheral equipment.

08. Support office machines such as copiers, phone systems, cell phones, and mail processing equipment.

09. Administrate system backup, data retention and recovery of data files.

10. Maintain current knowledge of computer systems and software.

11. Perform needs analysis; determine project feasibility; estimate programming and implementation time for database applications.

12. Perform systems support functions for Windows-based servers and network equipment operating in a LAN/WAN environment.

13. Prepare specifications, process and system requirements for network; firewalls, core systems, develop new or revised procedures to attain desired objectives.

14. Expert-level knowledge of security systems such as SIEM, IPS firewalls, and related network security tools.

15. Ability to manage effectively and work closely with business leaders in a high-pressure, fast-paced, highly collaborative environment with multiple deadlines and competing priorities.

16. Strong understanding of encryption, security certificates and advanced authentication measures.

17. Knowledge of common information security management frameworks, such as NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, COBIT, or PCI DSS.

18. District employees are expected to work overtime, weekends, evenings, and holidays as required to accommodate the District's needs, in addition to serving as Disaster Emergency Service Workers.

19. Regular attendance at the work site.


**Marginal Functions:**
