title: Seniorkonsulent til bistand forvaltning Atlassian portefølje
description:
Bakgrunn

Bakgrunnen for denne minikonkurransen er Statens vegvesens behov for bistand i forbindelse med forvaltning av Atlassianporteføljen som består av Confluence, Jira og Bitbucket med tilhørende apper. Det er også behov for at konsulenten bistår i oppfølging av verktøyet Unleash.

Kort beskrivelse av bistanden og Kundens behov

Oppdragsgiver ønsker en teknisk systemforvalter som skal jobbe med Atlassian-porteføljen vår. Ressursen vil jobbe tett med utviklere og forvaltere i seksjonen vår og kontorene/seksjonene som vi samarbeider tett med.

Systemforvalter vil ha ansvar for forvaltning og videreutvikling av våre verktøy fra Atlassian, for tiden Confluence, Jira og Bitbucket med tilhørende tredjepartsapper brukt i disse verktøyene. I dette ligger planlegging, koordinering og oppfølging teknisk og merkantilt, for at tjenestene til enhver tid tilfredsstiller funksjonelle og tekniske krav.

Eksempel på oppgaver er:

  • Lisensforvaltning av produktene.

  • Design og gjennomføring av tilgangsstyring for brukere.

  • Implementasjoner av nye system konfigurasjoner, f.eks SSO, innkommende mail, integrasjoner mellom produktene, clustering.

  • Brukerstøtte: veiledning, endringer i prosjektkonfigurasjoner, opplæring i produktene og 3.part apper.

  • Vedlikehold og feilsøking av produktene.

  • Oppgradering av produktene til nye versjoner.

  • Opprydning av gamle Jira prosjekter, inaktive brukere og konfigurasjoner.

  • Automatiseringer ved Jira Automations og ScriptRunner (groovy skript) for både Jira og Confluence.

  • Integrasjoner med eksterne systemer, f.eks Slack, Teams, CMDB, ServiceNow, eksterne Jira instanser.

  • Data migrering fra eksterne instanser til intern Jira og Confluence.

  • Gi innspill til verdivurdering og risikovurdering av produktene.

  • Deltagelse i vurderinger rundt migrering til Atlassian Cloud, samt eventuelt migreringsløp.

Konsulenten skal yte bistand til økonomisk planlegging og oppfølging (budsjett/regnskap).

Konsulenten vil arbeide med forvaltningsdokumenter, systemdokumentasjon, rapportering, planlegging, avtaler, budsjettarbeid, koordinering på tvers av systemer samt å følge opp leveranser. God teknisk erfaring er en forutsetning samtidig som erfaring fra leverandøroppfølging også er ønskelig.

Kunden har for tiden innleid ressurs som håndterer oppgavene, det vil være en periode med kompetanseoverføring.

I den utstrekning Kunden ønsker det skal Konsulenten også delta i andre relaterte aktiviteter.

Kompetanse/erfaring

Må krav

  • Høyere IT-utdanning fra universitet eller høyskole, minimum 3 år

  • Allsidig teknisk forståelse

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner både muntlig og skriftlig på norsk

  • Dokumentert erfaring med forvaltning av Atlassianverktøyene Confluence, JIRA og Bitbucket, herunder både teknisk og merkantil forvaltning.

  • Dokumentert erfaring fra koordinering og/eller teknisk prosjektledelse

  • Dokumentert erfaring med budsjettplanlegging og avtale- og leverandøroppfølging

  • Dokumentert erfaring fra arbeid i store organisasjoner

Personlige egenskaper

  • Har evne til raskt å sette seg inn i en ny organisasjon

  • Er strukturert og ansvarsbevisst

  • Ha gode samarbeidsevner og kommunikasjonsevner

Oppstart og varighet: Oppstart etter avtale og frem til 31.12.2028

Omfang: 100%

Opsjon: 1 + 1 år

Arbeidssted: Arbeidssted vil være etter avtale, fortrinnsvis østlandsområdet, med forventning om oppmøte i kundens lokaler i Drammen etter avtale.

A day in the life
You will split your time between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. Mornings might involve reviewing pipeline health dashboards, triaging data quality issues, or pairing with a teammate on a complex ETL problem. Afternoons often shift toward design discussions with partner teams, reviewing architecture proposals, or presenting data strategy updates to senior leadership. You will regularly evaluate how your team's data solutions can evolve to support agentic AI workloads, making architectural recommendations that shape the team's roadmap.

About the team
SPIA's mission is to shorten the path from data to insight for 200+ internal customer teams across Selling Partner Support, helping them move faster and act with more confidence. We are building the data foundation for both current analytical needs and tomorrow's AI-powered experiences. The datasets, models, and pipelines we build shape decisions that touch millions of customers and sellers every day. This role offers a clear growth path: you will act as a team lead, engage with senior leadership, and help design the transition of our data platform into the agentic AI era.

title: İkinci El Oto Ekspertiz Uzmanı - Esenyurt
description:
VavaCars'ta biz sadece bir teknoloji şirketi değiliz. Bizler, Türkiye'deki otomotiv sektöründe devrim yaratmaya kararlı, kullanılmış otomobil endüstrisinde vizyoner, yenilikçi ve öncüleriz. Şirketimiz, derin bir bağlılık, proaktif inisiyatif ve girişimci ruh kültürüyle büyümektedir. Çalışanlarımız sadece bir iş yapmıyor, sınırları zorluyor ve normları çiğniyor. Pratik, departmanlar arası işbirliğinin gücüne ve sadece kendi sektörümüzde değil, ötesinde statükoya meydan okumanın gücüne inanıyoruz.

Mesleki geçmişiniz, eğitim geçmişiniz veya sektörünüz ne olursa olsun, istisnai bir çalışma geçmişiniz ve yenilik tutkunuz varsa, sizi ekibimizde görmek isteriz. VavaCars'ta mesele sadece ne yaptığınız değil, neler yapabildiğinizdir.

Otomotiv endüstrisinin geleceğini yeniden tanımlarken bu heyecan verici yolculukta bize katılın. İşimiz sadece araba alıp satmak değil,

insanların kullanılmış araba pazarını nasıl algıladıklarını yeniden şekillendiren benzersiz bir kullanıcı deneyimi yaratmak. Sadece oyunu değiştirmiyoruz - yeni bir oyun yaratıyoruz.

Kariyerinizi hızlı şeride yönlendirmeye hazır mısınız? VavaCars yolculuğuna bugün başlayın!

OPERASYON

Alanında uzman ekspertizler, mekanik teknisyenleri, üretim çalışanları ve operasyon profesyonellerinin yer aldığı küresel bir ekibe katılın ve gezegenin en çeşitli araçlarını yenileyin.

Requirements

VavaCars'ta İkinci El Oto Ekspertiz Uzmanı pozisyonundan ne beklenir:

Araçların kaporta ve mekanik aksamına dair detaylı incelemeler yapar, gerekli fotoğraf ve raporları düzenleyerek bilgi akışına katkıda bulunur, VavaCars araç parkında hedeflenen kalite seviyesinin yakalanmasını sağlar.

  • VavaCars’ın standartlarına uygun bir şeklide araçların ekspertiz süreçlerini yürütmek
  • Araçların kaporta kondisyonunu incelemek, orijinal dışı herhangi bir onarım, boya, değişim olup olmadığını tespit etmek
  • Araçların mekanik aksamını ve elektronik donanımlarını kontrol ederek, bakım ihtiyacı veya aktif arızaların tespit edilmesi
  • Aracın VavaCars sistemlerinde kayıtlı olan versiyon/donanım/paket/opsiyon gibi değişken bilgilerini kontrol etmek, varsa önceki ekspertiz bilgileri ile karşılaştırmak, eksiklik ve/veya farklılıkları tespit etmek
  • Araçların ilk ekspertizleri ile ortaya çıkan her türlü farklılıkların değerlendirmesini yapmak.
  • Sürecin gerektirdiği tüm ölçümleme ve fotoğraflama işlemlerini gerçekleştirmek
  • Araç anahtar sayısı, dijital ekipmanları, yedek lastik, avadanlık ve kilitli bijon gibi detayları kontrol etmek

Bize ne katacaksın?

  • 3 yıl ve üzeri ikinci el araç ekspertiz deneyimi
  • Otomobil kaporta ve mekanik aksamları konusunda bilgi ve tecrübe sahibi (Boyalı yüzey/değişen parça kontrolü, mekanik arıza tespiti, diagnoz)
  • Ekspertiz süreçlerinde gerekli ekipmanı kullanabilen (Boya kalınlığı ölçüm cihazı, diagnostik test cihazları)
  • B sınıfı sürücü belgesi ve temiz sürüş kaydı
  • Teknolojiye yatkın, iyi seviyede bilgisayar ve tablet kullanabilen
  • Gelişime ve değişime açık

Biz Kimiz?

VavaCars olarak, Türkiye'de ikinci el araç alım satım işlemleri için bir platformdan daha fazlasıyız; otomotiv endüstrisinde devrim yaratıyoruz. Misyonumuz, otomobil alım satım deneyimini sorunsuz, şeffaf ve güvenilir bir sürece dönüştürmektir.

Sadelik, şeffaflık ve rahatlığa öncelik vererek, müşterilerimizin evlerinin rahatlığında çevrimiçi olarak arabalara göz atmalarını, değerlendirmelerini ve satın almalarını mümkün kıldık. Kapsamlı hizmetlerimiz sadece işlemlerin ötesine geçiyor, VavaServis ve VavaGaraj gibi girişimlerle, bakımdan lastik satın almaya kadar araçla ilgili her türlü ihtiyacı karşılıyor, kullanıcılarımıza stressiz bir deneyim sağlıyoruz.

2019'daki lansmanımızdan bu yana, VavaCars yalnızca binlerce otomobilin ticaretini başarıyla yapmakla kalmadı, aynı zamanda müşterilerin, küresel sponsorların ve yatırımcıların güvenini kazandı. Sadece istisnai hizmet sunmaya değil, sürekli yenilik yapmaya ve mümkün olanın sınırlarını zorlamaya inanıyoruz.

Başarımızın temelinde özverili ve deneyimli Vavan ekibimiz yer almaktadır. Büyümeye ve pazarı yeniden tanımlamaya devam ederken, inovasyon yolculuğumuza katılmaya hazır, ileri görüşlü bireyleri aramızda görmeyi dört gözle bekliyoruz. VavaCars'ta mesele sadece başardıklarımız değil, birlikte inşa ettiğimiz çığır açıcı bir gelecek. Sizi işbirliği fırsatlarını keşfetmeye ve heyecan verici devrimimizin bir parçası olmaya davet ediyoruz.

Benefits

Benzersiz ve heyecan verici bir paket sunuyoruz - yerel otomobil alanında böyle bir şey denenmedi ve en iyisini istiyoruz. Rekabetçi bir paket ve çalışan mutluluğuna odaklanan bir kültür sunuyoruz.

  • Performans bonusu
  • Bireysel özel sağlık sigortası
  • Ulaşım desteği
  • Yemek ücreti
  • Sıcak bir çalışma ortamı ve sosyal etkinlikler
  • Müşteri Merkezimiz Esenyurt lokasyonludur.

title: University Bursar
description:
**University Overview**

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

University Bursar

**Job Profile Title**

Director D, Business and Finance

**Job Description Summary**

The University of Pennsylvania is seeking a strategic and collaborative leader to serve as University Bursar within Student Registration and Financial Services (SRFS). In this key leadership role, the Bursar oversees student billing, accounts receivable, collections, and student financial operations supporting more than $1.4 billion in student account activity. Responsibilities include ensuring accurate and compliant financial transactions, partnering with university stakeholders to enhance financial processes, supporting financial wellness initiatives, and leading efforts to improve the student financial experience. The position also provides leadership in budgeting, financial reporting, policy development, and continuous improvement of student financial systems and services. Candidates should possess significant experience in higher education finance, student accounts, and financial systems administration.

To learn more about Student Registration & Financial Services (SRFS), visit: https://srfs.upenn.edu/

**Job Description**

The University of Pennsylvaniaseeksa highly professional, experienced, and strategic leader to serve as theUniversityBursar within Student Registration and Financial Services (SRFS). This critical leadership roleis responsible foroverseeing the billing and collection of over$1.4 billionin student accounts receivable, including tuition, financial aid disbursements, housing, meal plans, and various student fees. Additionally, the Bursar will manage student loan receivables and collections for a portfolio totaling over $4 million.

As a collaborative leader, the Bursar will partner with academic and administrative stakeholders across the university to ensure efficient, transparent, and compliant financial processes related to tuition, fees, and student accounts. This position also leads initiatives to strengthen financial operations andassistin financial wellness, working closely with university leadership to improve accessibility. This includes billing and receivables oversight, tuition collections,assistingwith financial aid disbursement, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of allstudentfinancial transactions. Additionally, the position supports budgeting, financial reporting, and general financial operations within the university.

The Bursar will report to the Associate Vice President of Student Registration and Financial Services, collaborating with senior university leadership to develop long-term financial strategies, operational policies, and student financial system improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

The University Bursaris responsible formanaging student accounts and financial operations to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with institutional and regulatory policies. This includes overseeing student billing, receivables, collections, and tuition payments while ensuring seamless coordination with financial aid disbursement processes. The Bursar also plays a vital role in financial reporting, budgeting, and compliance auditing, ensuring transparency and adherence to financial regulations. Providing excellent customer service, the Bursar educates students and families on financial processes and policies while addressing inquiries and resolving billing concerns. Additionally, the position supports financial wellness initiatives, enhances operational efficiency, and collaborates with external agencies to manage collection efforts. The role also includes participation in university-wide committees, vendor contract negotiations, and continuous improvement of financial systems and processes.

**Qualifications & Skills**

Required Qualifications:

- The University Bursar role requires abachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Candidates should have 7 to 10 years of progressive experience in higher education finance, student accounts, or tuition management.
- Expertisein Ellucian Banner AR, particularly with tuition and fee assessment modules, is essential.
- Strong technicalproficiency, including the ability to configure and manage student financial systems, is necessary.
- Additionally, candidates mustdemonstratethe ability to collaborate with university stakeholders and providedata-driven policy recommendations.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills arerequiredto effectively convey complex financial information to a broad audience.

Preferred Qualifications:

- A master’s degree in Finance, Higher Education Administration, Business, ora relatedfield.
- Extensive experience in higher education student financial services and tuition management is highly desirable.
- Comprehensive knowledge of federal, state, and institutional regulations governing tuition and fees is preferred, as well as experience withTouchNetsystems and international payment vendors.
- Strong background in financial compliance, audit processes, and tax reporting (e.g., 1098-T regulations) isadvantageous.

**Job Location - City, State**

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

**Department / School**

Division of Finance

**Pay Range**

$135,327.00 - $150,000.00 Annual Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin(including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protectedunder applicable federal, state or local law.

**Special Requirements**

Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

**University Benefits**

- **Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts**: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.

- **Tuition**: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.

- **Retirement:** Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.

- **Time Away from Work:** Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.

- **Long-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.

- **Wellness and Work-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.

- **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.

- **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.

- **Discounts and Special Services**: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.

- **Flexible Work Hours:** Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.

- **Penn Home Ownership Services:** Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.

- **Adoption Assistance:** Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.


​

_To learn more, please visit: [https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay](https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay)_

title: Engineering Operation Technician, DCC Communities
description:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Whether we’re helping a resident with a home project, guiding a business through expansion, or preserving the character of a neighborhood, our goal is the same: to support growth that’s safe, orderly, and respectful of Fullerton’s rich heritage — while creating opportunities for today and for generations to come.

**_Join the Community and Economic Development Department and help shape the future of Fullerton!_**

Our Planning team is looking for an **Associate Planner** who’s ready to take on exciting, hands-on work that makes a real difference in our community. This is a journey-level role where you’ll dig into complex projects, work with great people, and see your efforts take shape in the neighborhoods, businesses, and public spaces around you. Candidates with experience or a background in historic preservation or historic planning are especially encouraged to apply.

**_What You’ll Be Doing_**

- Coordinating environmental and community planning projects.
- Reviewing residential, commercial, and industrial development plans.
- Visiting sites to make sure projects meet City standards and zoning rules.
- Preparing reports, drafting ordinances, and making recommendations.
- Presenting your work to community groups, committees, and commissions.
- Helping residents, architects, and developers understand our planning process.

**_What We’re Looking For_**

- **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Planning, Architecture, Public Administration, Engineering, or Geography.
- **Experience:** Minimum of one year (two years preferred) of professional planning experience at the Assistant Planner level.
- **Knowledge of:**
  - Urban and regional planning principles
  - CEQA & Subdivision Map Act
  - Zoning codes, land use regulations, and plan review processes
- **Skills:**
  - Strong analysis and report-writing
  - Reading/interpreting maps, site plans, and engineering scales
  - Clear, professional communication with a wide range of people

Your work will directly shape the growth and character of our city, providing you with a unique opportunity to see the real-world impact of your contributions. Every day offers variety — from conducting on-site inspections to researching policies and drafting reports — so the work stays fresh and engaging. You’ll join a team in a dynamic and supportive environment where your expertise is valued. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, opportunities for professional development, and the satisfaction of knowing your efforts will contribute directly to enhancing the lives of Fullerton’s residents.

**The Position**

Under general supervision, performs a variety of professional-level and technical municipal planning work of above average difficulty, to include analyzing planning assignments, reviewing proposals/projects in progress, and coordinating planning projects; compiles data and drafts reports, ordinances, and correspondence, and performs related work as required.

### Employment Guidelines

**SPECIAL** **REQUIREMENTS**

- A valid Class C California driver's license or the ability to arrange necessary and timely transportation for field travel is required. Employees in this classification who drive during the course and scope of City business will be enrolled in the Department of Motor Vehicle Government Pull Notice Program.

- Must be able to work a flexible schedule to accommodate City needs.


**Physical Tasks and Working Conditions Include the Following** **:**

Work is performed indoors in an office environment, at a public counter, and outdoors in the field.  When work is performed outdoors, there may be exposure to the elements.  An incumbent travels locally on City business, sits for extended periods of time, uses basic hand tools, operates a camera, computer, keyboard, and related equipment, stands, walks, reaches, bends, twists, kneels, reaches and grasps, and may lift and move boxes of records weighing 30 pounds or less. An incumbent must be able to meet the physical requirements of the class and have mobility, balance, coordination, vision, hearing, and dexterity levels appropriate to the duties to be performed.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Position Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive technical excellence, architect complex systems, and elevate our engineering team. You will own critical technical decisions, lead major initiatives from conception to delivery, and set the standard for engineering quality across our products.

As a senior engineer, you will architect and lead the development of sophisticated AI-enabled features and infrastructure. This includes designing MCP server architectures, building advanced RAG systems, implementing agentic AI workflows, and establishing patterns that scale across our product portfolio. You will combine deep technical expertise in both traditional software engineering and AI/ML to deliver production-grade solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and implementation of AI integration infrastructure (MCP servers, orchestration layers, API gateways)
  • Build sophisticated AI features including advanced RAG systems, agentic workflows, and multi-step reasoning
  • Establish AI engineering best practices, security patterns, and quality standards
  • Lead technical initiatives from requirements through production deployment
  • Make critical architectural decisions balancing performance, scalability, cost, and maintainability
  • Design AI evaluation frameworks and implement quality benchmarks
  • Debug and resolve complex production issues across traditional and AI systems

Required Qualifications

Tech Stack

Core: Node.js, React, TypeScript, AWS, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Docker

AI & Integration: Python, MCP, AWS Bedrock, LangGraph/Semantic Kernel, Vector Databases, RAG

Core Technical Skills

  • 5+ years professional development with proven track record of delivering complex systems
  • Strong Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript expertise
  • Advanced React and frontend architecture skills
  • Extensive AWS architecture experience
  • Expert PostgreSQL database design, optimization, and performance tuning
  • Deep understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and API design
  • Mastery of software design patterns and clean code practices

AI/ML Expertise (1+ years required)

  • 1+ years hands-on experience building and deploying production AI/ML features
  • Strong Python development with AI/ML framework expertise
  • Deep understanding of AWS with strong AWS Bedrock exposure
  • Expert-level experience designing and implementing MCP servers and AI integration architectures
  • Advanced prompt engineering skills including chain-of-thought, few-shot learning, and optimization
  • Experience building agentic AI systems with multi-agent orchestration and tool use

AI Production Excellence

  • Designs comprehensive AI evaluation frameworks with quality metrics
  • Deep understanding of AI challenges: hallucinations, context limits, latency, costs
  • Implements robust monitoring and observability for AI systems
  • Expertise in AI security: prompt injection prevention, data leakage mitigation
  • Champions responsible AI: bias detection, fairness, transparency

Technical Leadership

  • Leads technical design discussions and drives consensus
  • Identifies systemic issues proactively
  • Makes sound judgment under uncertainty
  • Mentors junior engineers

Note: We're looking for 1+ years of production AI experience with depth in integration architectures, RAG systems, and agentic workflows. You'll own and deliver features with AI capabilities across our product portfolio.

About Us

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

What Diligent Offers You

  • Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
  • We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
  • We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.

title: Manufacturing Associate Technician
description:
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.

As a Bioprocess Technician, you will join our dynamic cGMP manufacturing team, directly impacting patient lives by producing innovative biotherapeutic medicines using state-of-the-art automated systems. Operating across cell culture, purification, or manufacturing services, you play a vital role in maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and inspection preparedness.

**The Opportunity:**

- Operate, monitor, and troubleshoot automated production systems, cleaning/sterilization equipment, and benchtop analytical tools.

- Perform core biomanufacturing activities, including cell culture growth, sampling, harvesting, protein purification, formulation, freeze-thaw, and transfer processes.

- Prepare essential media and buffer solutions according to precise production guidelines.

- Maintain cleanroom environments, fixed tank systems, and filtration units in strict compliance with cGMP, SOP, and safety standards.

- Perform detail-oriented documentation by accurately reviewing process tickets, equipment readings, and calculations.

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional team members and supervisors to quickly resolve minor equipment and operational deviations.

- Foster a positive, proactive safety culture by immediately reporting incidents, near misses, and environmental concerns.


**Who you are:**

- You hold a High School Diploma or equivalent qualification.

- You bring background knowledge or experience in bio-processing and biopharmaceutical technology.

- You possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to document process information accurately.

- You are comfortable using computer-based systems and operating automated equipment.

- You thrive in a physically active cleanroom environment, which includes standing for 8–10 hours, climbing stairs, lifting up to 30 lbs, and adhering to strict gowning requirements (e.g., scrubs, bunny suits, steel-toe boots).


**Preferred:**

- A Biotech certificate from an approved program or 1–2 years of hands-on biopharmaceutical manufacturing experience.

- Demonstrated proficiency in at least one key manufacturing functional area (e.g., bioreactor operation, column chromatography, or automated CIP/SIP).

title: Embedded Software Engineer, Ring
description:
Ring builds home security products used by millions of customers worldwide. Our firmware engineers own the software that runs on those devices, from first boot through to the features customers use every day. We are looking for engineers who design and build software systems that happen to run on embedded targets, and who think carefully about correctness, maintainability, and the long-term health of a codebase as much as they think about performance.

You will own firmware components end to end, from architecture through to delivery and maintenance, working closely with hardware, cloud, and mobile teams to ship products that work reliably in the real world.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement firmware for battery-powered and wired IoT devices running on microcontrollers and RTOS environments
- Own components end to end: design, implementation, code review, testing, and maintenance across product generations
- Define and implement software interfaces consumed by other teams and services
- Debug and resolve issues across the full stack, from hardware bring-up through to production defects in the field
- Contribute to and maintain CI pipelines, build systems, and automated test infrastructure
- Work closely with hardware engineers, cloud engineers, and product managers to translate requirements into reliable firmware

A day in the life
You will spend your time designing and implementing firmware features, reviewing code, debugging production issues, and working through technical trade-offs with your team. New products bring new hardware, new constraints, and new problems to solve. The work is hands-on and the decisions you make end up in devices in customers' homes.

About the team
The Ring Firmware team develops and delivers firmware for Ring's camera-centric devices across new products, existing device support, and new feature development. We are a large team with sites in Europe and Asia and stakeholders in the US.

title: Customer Experience Executive
description:

Luxmi Tea Estate is a legacy tea company rooted in some of India’s most celebrated tea-growing regions. With decades of craftsmanship and estate ownership, the brand blends heritage with modern sensibilities—bringing premium teas to a new generation of discerning consumers in India and globally. title: Meta Ads Specialist

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Data Engineer III, Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS)
description:
Do you want to turn manufacturing data into decisions that move physical parts through a factory? Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) runs 135+ machines producing custom parts for over 100 Amazon organizations, and nearly every machine, order, and operator action generates data worth analyzing. You will join a small, growing data engineering team that owns the pipelines, warehouse, dashboards, and ML workflows that turn raw signals from our services and enterprise systems into throughput, utilization, and quality insights for shop floor users and AMS leadership. The scope is broad, the stakeholders are in the building, and your models will influence how Amazon makes things.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and operate data pipelines on AWS Glue (PySpark), Kinesis, S3, and EventBridge to ingest DynamoDB streams and enterprise system data into the AMS data lake
- Model and maintain the Redshift warehouse and S3/Athena data lake that power analytics across AMS services
- Build ingestion and modeling layers for enterprise data sources including SAP S/4HANA, JobBoss, Siemens Teamcenter, and Dot Compliance
- Develop QuickSight dashboards for shop floor operators, planners, and AMS leadership, covering operational metrics and executive KPIs
- Build and deploy ML models and pipelines for manufacturing use cases such as demand forecasting, machine health prediction, and scheduling optimization
- Own data quality, lineage, and documentation across the AMS analytics stack
- Collaborate with senior SDEs on architecture, service event schemas, and integration patterns, while holding significant ownership over your part of the data domain

A day in the life
Your day starts with a standup alongside SDEs, data engineers, and manufacturing stakeholders. You pick up where you left off on a React component that displays real-time resource status for shop floor planners. After lunch, you shift to a backend service, designing a DynamoDB schema for part versioning. A code review comes in from a senior engineer working on an enterprise integration bridge, and you spend time understanding how AMS connects to external manufacturing platforms.

Some weeks lean more frontend — building interactive data visualizations or responsive layouts for shop floor devices. Other weeks lean more backend — implementing event-sourced entity patterns or integrating with third-party APIs. The mix depends on the sprint and your strengths.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS)
description:
Amazon's supply chain catalog data covers product barcodes, package configuration, quantity, dimensions, expiration, and more, directly impacting operational efficiency across supply chain workflows. Today, catalog data defects create fulfillment challenges that drive hundreds of millions of dollars in operational costs and limit our ability to grow selection. Are you passionate about building software systems that operate at massive scale on the largest catalog on earth? We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and delivery of systems that ingest high-fidelity physical product observations (images, OCR text, barcodes, dimensions, expiration) for millions of inventory units flowing daily through Fulfillment Centers, then leverage that data to improve catalog data quality. This initiative impacts multiple programs visible to Amazon senior leadership, reduces operational costs for Sellers and Fulfillment Centers, and drives revenue growth through expanded selection.

Key job responsibilities
Lead architecture of large-scale distributed systems that process hundreds of millions of transactions daily, owning design, implementation, and operation across the full software lifecycle.
Partner with Applied Scientists to translate ML research into production inference infrastructure that extracts product information from images at scale.
Define a multi-year technical roadmap, sequence delivery to balance near-term customer impact with long-term platform investment, and drive architectural consistency across engineering and science workstreams by influencing teams you depend on but do not directly control.
Establish measurable quality, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency standards so systems continue to perform as expected while scale grows.
Mentor engineers through hands-on code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance. Influence product technical direction by articulating architectural trade-offs, tech debt, and their business impact to stakeholders and partners.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing operational dashboards for your team's ingestion pipelines, then jump into a design review where you help engineers evaluate trade-offs for a new image-processing service. After lunch you pair with an Applied Scientist to prototype an integration between a new ML model and your production inference stack. Later, you draft a technical document outlining your recommended approach for an upcoming cross-team migration, preparing to align stakeholders across catalog and fulfillment systems. Your work balances hands-on coding with strategic guidance, keeping the team focused on delivering reliable, high-quality systems.

About the team
Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds and operates the world's largest e-commerce product catalog. We are the primary source for product, relationship, and offer data, and the accuracy of our catalog is foundational to everything Amazon does, from the detail page a customer sees to the fulfillment center that ships their order. We support hundreds of internal clients and businesses that contribute to the Amazon catalog.

Our team values inclusivity, transparency, and customer-centric problem solving. We continuously invest in scalable mechanisms, software systems, Generative AI models, and agentic workflows to sustainably meet evolving business demand. If you are excited about shaping technical strategy at catalog scale, this is the place to do it.

- Work side‑by‑side with RF and systems engineers to make sure the digital and RF pieces fit together cleanly.

- Design and refine FPGA solutions for RF communication systems, including key functions like filtering, mixing, signal conversion, and error‑correction.

- Build and verify DSP algorithms for modulation, demodulation, and other communication processing tasks.

- Prepare designs for target FPGA devices, run place‑and‑route with the right constraints, and analyze timing and resource usage.

- Contribute to and improve consistent development practices, including peer reviews and firmware processes.

- Create clear technical documentation—design review materials, block diagrams, interface documents, and test plans.

- Confirm performance through simulation, then integrate and test FPGA designs on the actual circuit‑card hardware.

- Active Secret Security Clearance or ability to obtain once hired.

**Required Qualifications (one of the following):**

- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience
- Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience.
- In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- 9 years of experience with VHDL development and high-speed digital design and timing analysis.
- Experience with RF principles, including filtering, mixing, and signal conversion.
- Experience with digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms and their implementation on FPGAs.
- Experience with debugging tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and signal generators;system-level simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink.
- Experience with embedded systems and microcontroller interfacing
- Designing for space environments
- An active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance
- Exceptional communication skills with ability to clearly document and present designs and implementations

title: Safety Coordinator

title: APAC Regional Medical Affairs Associate Director, International Markets
location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong, Hong Kong
description:
Are you ready to step into regional leadership across the APAC region? Do you thrive at the intersection of science, partner collaboration, and medical affairs? Would you like to play a key role in launching innovative treatments while expanding your leadership impact in a multicultural, fast-paced environment? Then join Ascendis Pharma and help bring innovation to life across international markets

Ascendis Pharma is a fast-growing global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patient’s lives. We have locations in Denmark, Germany, the United States, the UK, Italy, Spain, and France.

Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we use our TransCon® drug development platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies, selecting only those that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

Today, we are advancing programs in Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology. In addition, we collaborate with partners around the world on the development of TransCon-based products for other therapeutic areas and markets.

This position will be placed in the International Markets region, which is a key strategic endeavour by Ascendis to expand our global footprint in partnership with indirect affiliates across the globe but focussing on China, Japan, Australia, South Korea and South East Asia.

We are seeking a passionate Associate Director to play a high-impact role within the International Markets team, primarily supporting APAC partners. This regional leader will build and manage long term relationships with key physicians, sites and partners while also leading medical strategy and tactics across APAC. This individual will be a strategic partner to indirect affiliates as well as internal teams across Ascendis pharma ensuring that the international markets medical perspective is reflected.

You will report to the Head of International Medical Affairs and work closely with the respective medical directors in IM for Hypoparathyroidism and Growth Disorders and the APAC commercial manager as well as other internal teams across Ascendis. The role should be based in APAC in a large hub with preference to Hong Kong, Singapore or Malaysia. This is expected to be a remote role that may require some travel (~25%). Flexibility in work hours will be necessary to accommodate global time zones.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Regional Leadership

  • Serve as the scientific expert for medical affairs across APAC
  • Design and implement medical strategies and tactical plans
  • Support the development of clinical and real-world evidence
  • Input into lifecycle management activities as needed
  • Oversee compassionate use programs and grants as needed
  • Deep understanding of compliance in APAC markets

External engagement

  • Establish and nurture relationships with KOLs and key centres in international markets
  • Stay up to date on competitive landscape, new therapies, clinical trend
  • Lead medical education programs target to the APAC region in collaboration with the therapeutic area medical leads

Cross-functional and Global Collaboration

  • Collaborate with IM medical, commercial and business operations and other functions as needed
  • Manage relationships with key external vendors and agencies to ensure optimal delivery

Team leadership

  • Provide mentorship and functional leadership to medical teams and other stakeholders, fostering a culture of functional excellence

Qualifications and Skills

  • Advanced degree (MD / PhD / PharmD) in life sciences with 7+ years of experience in medical affairs
  • Substantial knowledge / experience in rare diseases
  • Must speak English and Mandarin
  • Demonstrated leadership and stakeholder management skills as well as the ability to perform effectively in a dynamic environment
  • Proven strategic and critical thinking
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and proven organizational skills
  • Ability to lead directly and indirectly by influence, including strong problem solving, conflict resolution and analysis
  • Flexibility to adapt culturally

Key competencies

You are a highly motivated self-starter with a strong foundation in scientific communication and a natural ability to collaborate across cultures and functions. You bring a clear customer focus and thrive on working in a complex, matrixed environment where attention to detail and a can-do attitude are key.

You are able to communicate technical information effectively to a broad audience and adapt your approach depending on the stakeholder. Whether working independently or as part of a team, you perform well in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.

You have strong leadership and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to identify business opportunities and take initiative. With an entrepreneurial mindset, you’re excited by innovation and comfortable navigating a multicultural environment.

Your excellent interpersonal skills enable you to work efficiently with colleagues at all levels of the organization, supporting both urgent priorities and long-term goals

Apply now

Applications will be evaluated when received, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you are passionate about contributing to the field of rare diseases and eager to make a difference at Ascendis Pharma, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in our mission to advance therapeutic innovations and improve patient lives worldwide.

title: Plant Operators
description:
- **Earn $60,143 - $69,259 + Award Allowances + 12% Super**
- **9-Day Fortnight, 4 weeks' Annual Leave and 1 week MyLeave**
- **Multiple opportunities across Tenterfield and Urbenville, NSW!**
- **Build your skills and career with further learning and development opportunities**

#### **Proudly Serving Tenterfield – Where Your Work Matters**

Tenterfield Shire Council is located in the picturesque New England region of New South Wales and proudly holds the title “Birthplace of the Australian Nation.” As a rural medium-sized council, it offers the perfect mix of lifestyle and career with easy access to Northern NSW’s beaches, Queensland’s Granite Belt, and the wider Brisbane region. Here at Tenterfield Shire Council, our mission is to showcase "quality nature, quality heritage and quality lifestyle". We are a close-knit and dedicated team that cultivates a community spirit and promotes a quality lifestyle, equal opportunities and access to all services. We really live and breathe our values each and every day -  **Integrity, Community, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence** – and foster a workplace culture that empowers staff to lead, innovate, and thrive.

Our people are at the heart of everything we do and are central to our success. In this role, you will be working with a team that feels empowered and challenged while fostering an emphasis on work/life balance.

_For more information, visit: [www.tenterfield.nsw.gov.au](https://www.tenterfield.nsw.gov.au)_

#### **Build Roads. Build Community. Build Your Career.**

**Tenterfield Shire Council** is currently recruiting for **multiple** reliable and safety-focused **Plant Operators** to join its Infrastructure team across **Tenterfield and Urbenville, NSW.**

In these hands-on roles, you will support road construction and maintenance activities, operate and maintain a variety of plant safely and efficiently, and contribute to high-quality infrastructure outcomes for the community.

More specifically, your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Operate and maintain road construction and maintenance plant and machinery
- Assist with road construction, pothole patching, concreting and general maintenance
- Complete daily pre-start checks and basic plant maintenance
- Install and maintain road signage, guideposts and erosion control measures
- Perform traffic control duties and work safely around live traffic
- Complete plant checklists, timesheets and other required documentation
- Follow WHS requirements, safe work practices and risk controls
- Work collaboratively as part of a safe, reliable and productive crew

_**Please Note:** Applicants will have the opportunity to indicate their preferred location as part of the application process._

#### **Is This You?**

To qualify, you will need a **Certificate II in Civil Construction** (or equivalent) and **demonstrated experience in road construction, maintenance and/or plant operations.**

We’re interested in hearing from operators with experience across a range of civil plant and machinery, so tell us about the equipment you’re competent and experienced in operating.

Additionally, the following skills, qualifications and experience will be highly valued:

- Certificate III in Civil Construction (or willingness to obtain – Council support provided)
- Safework NSW Traffic Controller qualification
- General Construction (White) Card
- Certificate of Competency for the type of plant to be operated
- First Aid Certificate

#### **Who Thrives in This Role?**

This role requires more than just plant skills. We are seeking someone who:

- Brings a strong safety mindset, particularly when working in live traffic environments, and takes responsibility for keeping themselves and their crew safe
- Communicates clearly and respectfully, contributing positively to site discussions and working well with supervisors, operators and apprentices
- Is reliable, prepared and ready to follow the works program with care and consistency
- Works well within diverse crews, building trust and backing their teammates each day
- Is comfortable speaking up when something does not look right and contributing to a strong safety culture
- Is open to learning, gaining additional tickets and building a long-term career within civil infrastructure

#### **The Rewards of Joining Our Team**

You will receive a competitive salary of **$60,143 - $69,259** per annum + **Award Allowances** + **12% Superannuation**, based on skills and experience.

You will also have access to:

- **9-Day Fortnight** for better work/life balance
- **4 weeks** Accumulative **Annual Leave**
- **2 weeks** Accumulative **Sick Leave**
- **1 week MyLeave**
- Further **Learning and Development** opportunities
- Access to onsite monthly counselling through Council's **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**
- Access to Health and Wellbeing programs
- **Genuine pathways into higher plant roles, Leading Hand positions and broader infrastructure opportunities**

#### **Be Part of Tenterfield’s Story**

If you're looking for stability, opportunities to develop your skills and a role where your work makes a visible difference to the community, this is your opportunity to become part of a Council that values safety, teamwork and development. **APPLY NOW!**

**_Please Note: As part of the recruitment process, candidates will be required to undergo vehicle assessment and competency checks. Successful applicants must also complete a current National Police Check and a pre-employment medical assessment prior to commencing employment._**

- develop a technically proficient understanding of natural hazard policy in broader land use planning contexts and QLD planning frameworks.
- contribute to the preparation of high-quality reports and briefings on natural hazard policy and land use planning issues.
- support the wider team in representing the Natural Hazards Team in various forums, working groups, and projects as required.
- support the delivery of a high level of customer service to clients and stakeholders.
- contribute to the development and maintenance of productive collaborations and relationships with key stakeholders within the Branch, across Council Departments and external agencies.

- be curious, motivated and keen to contribute to the future of the Gold Coast.
- bring new ideas, perspectives and a continuous improvement mindset.
- take ownership of your learning and professional development.
- embrace new challenges and adapt as you build your experience.
- analyse information, think critically and approach problems with curiosity.
- communicate with confidence, build strong relationships and contribute to a positive team culture.

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia for the duration of the program and be able to work full-time.

title: Mobile Apps Marketing Executive

This is a hybrid role, working 2 days per week from our Bath Office.

Internal job family level P6

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) Organization is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our EDGE team. Network Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global
AWS network. Focused on controlling the internet traffic that allows users to access their information
and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and
designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data
centers and customers.


Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers will:
• Be responsible for deploying network infrastructure across all of our network fabrics that supports the Amazon Retail Service, Kindle, Payments and multiple AWS services.
• Deploy, scale and automate our network across multiple global datacenters. This includes existing footprints and greenfield locations.
• Drive scaling of current network designs to meet the demand of our customers.
• Create simple, repetitive deployment processes that increase both velocity and quality.
• Work closely with our internal customers on designs/solutions; bringing those designs/solutions from concept to production.
• Create and update our network standards and ensure that the network is deployed to these standards.
• Create and implement changes on the network.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at higher volume.


A day in the life
Engineers in the Internet Edge organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the Internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish that, our engineers develop automation, write software, and work with a wide range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our Internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Internet Edge engineers make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon’s products.
• Support an off-hours operations escalation pager rotation.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
Internet Edge provides high-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more.

Within AWS Networking, the Internet Edge organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs.

title: Transportation Specialist, Transportation Integrity Operations (TIO)
description:
The transportation network behind Amazon’s operations spreads over hundreds of countries, reaching millions of customers. It’s our Amazon Transportation Services team that ensures products are efficiently transported where they need to be before their final delivery. As a Transportation Specialist, you’ll be working closely with teams across Amazon and external logistics partners to ensure enough delivery vans are available, processing new cases and acting quickly on escalations where necessary.

This position involves working in a rotating three-shift system, which may include Saturdays, night shifts and on-call duty.

Key job responsibilities
- Facilitate communication between stakeholders to find root causes and resolve issues quickly
- Produce and deliver reports on key delivery metrics
- Mentor or coach team members to help them develop new skills
- Maintain high standards of work by following policies and procedures
- Continually review processes to find areas for innovation

A day in the life
As a Transportation Specialist in TIO, you’ll be responsible for resolving delivery performance issues that could negatively affect our customers. You’ll understand the unique challenges of the transportation team and manage them collaboratively with other cross-functional teams. Your motivation and commitment to our customers will ensure that our response to delivery issues is timely and efficient. You will be required to make real-time decisions effectively, by doing your research, weighing up your options and learning as you progress. The result of your work will be the timely delivery of Amazon packages to millions of customers around the world.

About the team
Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) team. As part of ATS, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.
We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Job Summary

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to take on Koru's most ambiguous, highest-leverage design problems, the ones that span multiple client accounts, cross multiple teams, or don't have a defined brief yet. You'll set the standard for design quality and AI-informed practice across the accounts you touch, and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where creating structure is part of the job, not something handed to you.

We're also looking for genuine fluency with AI in product design and not just familiarity with AI tools, but real judgement about when AI actually helps a user and when it quietly doesn't, backed by a track record of shipping AI-powered features responsibly, and comfort using AI tools as part of your own workflow, not just designing AI for others.

Key Responsibilities

Owning ambiguous, high-leverage work

  • Lead and ship large, cross-team or cross-account projects independently, often without a fully defined brief, adjusting scope as it changes rather than waiting for someone to hand you clarity.
  • Diagnose problems nobody has framed yet, spotting opportunities before they're assigned, not just executing what's already on the roadmap.
  • Set the quality bar and visual direction for an account or product line without personally executing every piece of it.
  • Apply deliberate leverage: know when a task is worth doing yourself versus building something, a pattern, a template, documentation, that helps everyone doing similar work after you.
  • Own design decisions across multiple surface areas or product lines at once where needed, not just a single feature in isolation.

Shaping how Koru designs with AI

  • Set AI UX standards for a client or product line, and build or maintain the pattern library and evaluation checklists other designers use.
  • Treat AI as a multiplier for your own design process, not a shortcut around it: use AI tools to speed up exploration and prototyping without letting them substitute for your own judgement.
  • Actively evolve Koru's own AI design practice as the field moves

Influence without authority

  • Build followership across teams through consistently clear thinking, not seniority or volume.
  • Mentor designers across projects, not just your own team, and act as a sponsor as well as a mentor, advocating for people in rooms they're not in, not just guiding them one to one.
  • Get Koru treated as a strategic partner through the calibre of your thinking as much as your output.

Contributing beyond the project

  • Lead initiatives that expand Koru's visibility or offerings
  • Extend and improve Koru's own internal design frameworks and processes, not just follow them.

Requirements

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in product or UX design, the majority of it operating at a senior level or beyond.
  • A portfolio that shows genuine breadth of scope, not just polished screens, but measurable business outcomes and evidence of leading ambiguous, cross-functional work end to end. Strong enough to stand on its own without a verbal walkthrough.
  • Experience with B2B products and enterprise applications; HealthTech experience is a strong plus.
  • Real, hands-on experience designing AI-powered features or AI-native product ideas, not just using AI tools day to day. We'll ask you to speak to this specifically, ideally with a portfolio piece that shows it.
  • Comfortable prototyping in code, or close enough to front-end development to validate ideas without waiting on engineering.

Skills

  • Craft & judgement - deep design skill combined with the judgement to know when to apply it personally and when to build something that scales it to others.
  • AI fluency - genuine, applied understanding of AI capability and limitation in product design, not just enthusiasm for the space.
  • Influence without authority - a proven ability to set direction and raise the bar for people who don't report to you.
  • Business acumen - comfortable operating as a strategic partner to client leadership, not just a design resource.
  • Communication - able to make a case clearly enough that people who don't already agree with you can be moved.

Benefits

Why join us?

  • Own Koru's hardest, most ambiguous design problems, the ones that don't fit neatly inside one project or one team.
  • Shape how Koru designs with AI, for clients and internally, at a formative moment for the practice.
  • Be part of a collaborative, high-performance team that values your expertise and ideas.
  • Work remotely with flexibility, on meaningful, challenging work.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a 5-minute introductory video. In the video, walk us through your most interesting project, where you are in your career right now, and what you're hoping to get out of your next role. We'd rather hear this in your own voice than read it in a cover letter.
