title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Sponsored Products Global Optimization
description:
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry-leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of reinventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising!

Amazon Sponsored Products and Brands is looking for a talented Sr. Software Development Engineer to join the Global Optimization engineering team at the forefront of advertising technology innovation. We are working backwards from emerging markets to reimagine Amazon's advertising stack from the ground up — building highly scalable, low-latency systems that leverage multilingual and multi-modal GenAI technologies (including semantic hash designs, LLMs, and more) to deliver solutions that scale to non-US marketplaces from day one.

This is your opportunity to be part of a small, high-impact team that architects, builds, and ships production systems powering state-of-the-art solutions that will define the future of digital advertising.

The ideal candidate combines entrepreneurial drive with deep technical expertise, thriving in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you define the path forward with minimal structure. Our team regularly goes from ideas on the whiteboard to production-grade systems in weeks.

- Customer Obsession - fuels your passion for building systems that deliver real-world value for millions of advertisers and customers worldwide. You think end-to-end — from the scientist's notebook to the customer's experience.

- You are consistently Right, A Lot - when navigating complex technical decisions, demonstrating the rare ability to identify architectures and solutions that drive maximum impact with minimal complexity. You cut through ambiguity to find the approach that delivers the most results.

- Your systems experience goes beyond textbook knowledge — you have successfully designed and operated large-scale distributed systems at Amazon scale, understanding both the promise and practical challenges of deploying ML-powered services in production (model serving, A/B experimentation infrastructure, real-time feature computation, etc.).

- You're not just an engineer — you're a builder - who sees the bigger picture. You partner deeply with scientists and product leaders, translate ambiguous business problems into crisp technical solutions, and know how to make it all reality.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build at scale — Own the end-to-end architecture of distributed systems that serve millions of advertisers across global marketplaces, handling high-throughput, low-latency workloads at Amazon scale.

- Bring GenAI to production— Partner closely with Applied Scientists to take models from prototype to production — building robust serving infrastructure, training pipelines, feature stores, and evaluation frameworks that turn research breakthroughs into real customer value.

- Invent from the ground up — Help reimagine the advertising technology stack for international markets, designing systems that are multilingual, multi-modal, and globally scalable by default.

- Drive operational excellence — Establish best practices for reliability, observability, and deployment, ensuring our systems maintain the highest bar for availability and performance.

- Raise the bar — Mentor engineers across the team, lead design reviews, and shape our engineering culture as we scale.

title: Data Engineer, Marketing Tech BI, Stores Finance Analytics & Insights
description:

Our ultimate goal is to build a robust/scalable data infrastructure and automated reporting system to empower users have maximum flexibility to play with the data in order to maximize Long Term Free Cash Flow(LTFCF).

The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex technical contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. He/she is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), and enjoys working in a fast-paced and global team. It's a big ask, and we're excited to talk to those up to the challenge!

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of data pipelines and datasets within an assigned domain
- Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT workflows using SQL, Python, AWS services, and big data technologies
- Operate and improve data infrastructure, including Redshift clusters, data lake tables, orchestration workflows, monitoring, alerting, and data quality controls
- Improve operational reliability by identifying recurring failures, reducing manual intervention, automating recovery steps, and creating clear runbooks
- Partner with Data Science, Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Engineering, Privacy, and Legal stakeholders to translate business and compliance requirements into scalable data solutions

- Clarify ambiguous requirements, identify data quality or source-of-truth gaps, and escalate broader trade-offs to senior engineers or managers when appropriate

- Participate in on-call and product support for business-critical pipelines and datasets
- Own the design and operation of the data foundations that power GenAI, RAG, and agentic analytics within an assigned domain

- Apply AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to your daily work and share effective patterns with the team to raise overall engineering velocity.

title: Senior Scientist- Translational PKPD
description:
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

This opening is for a Senior Scientist position in the translational Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics (tPKPD) department within the Development Sciences division in Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) unit.

The focus of this position is to support the preclinical pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamics  (PKPD) efforts to guide the design, delivery and development of biologics in the Genentech  pipeline. Core responsibilities include providing technical support for the PKPD assessment of  drug candidates and marketed products and working independently or under the direct  supervision of a Scientist.

**The Opportunity:**

**The responsibilities of this Senior Scientist position will :**

- Design, conduct, analyze and interpret all in vitro and in vivo ADME and PKPD studies  that are necessary to understand the pharmacology of drug candidates in animals and  predict their behavior in humans

- Prepare summary tables and reports for non-clinical studies; may prepare documents  for regulatory agencies, including INDs and BLAs under the supervision of a Scientist

- Present data at project teams and department meetings and conferences as appropriate

- Publish innovative PKPD focused research in high quality scientific, technical or medical  journals.

- Manage an active laboratory program that supports basic research in PKPD and also  supports pipeline projects

- Collaborate with other departments such as Clinical Pharmacology, Research,  Bioanalytical Sciences, Safety Assessment, PD Biomarker/OMNI, Antibody Engineering,  Non-clinical Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Development, and others

- Participate in compliance and safety related activities. Perform other duties, as assigned


**Who You Are:**

- Ph.D., or M.D., or PharmD degree or equivalent curriculum in pharmacology, pharmaceutical science, biology, bioengineering, chemistry, physiology or related disciplines is required (experience is specific to job level). Persons without a formal degree who have comparable depth and breadth of training and experience (gained at Genentech or  elsewhere), and who meet job-specific criteria, are eligible for consideration

- 1-2 years of relevant industry experience in translational PKPD/pharmacology or equivalent Postdoctoral experience is preferred

- Outstanding record of accomplishment in his/her field as evidenced by his/her co authored publications, patents, internal reports and/or regulatory filings.

- Strong knowledge of laboratory techniques and safety is required; Regular GLP and laboratory safety training is required

- Experience in quantitative PKPD software (e.g., WinNonlin, NONMEM, ADAPT II,  Matlab, Simbiology, R)

- Demonstrated independent thought and creativity in relevant discipline; independently  designs, carries out, analyzes, interprets, and documents studies and experiments.

- Good communication skills, independently presents at department and project team meeting


Relocation Assistance benefits are available for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of San Franscico, CA is $ 120,700 – $224,100Annual.  Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.  A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

Grants Specialists (GS) play a vital role in the sponsored project life cycle, ensuring that research proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and are successfully submitted. The GSII supports faculty, center directors, and staff throughout the pre-award stage of sponsored projects, including proposal preparation and submission, just-in-time requests, and compliance.

May assist with activities associated with a portfolio of faculty post award and payroll sourcing with minimal supervision/oversight, particularly for research-intensive departments.

## **Job Description**

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

Proposal / Grant Management

- Performs pre-award job duties in response to specific proposal guidelines and terms and conditions.
- Works with faculty in proposal preparation and submission.
- Manages budgeting, analysis, justifications for proposals; gathers information for protocols and non-technical proposal components as needed.
- Serves as a liaison between the Chair, Faculty, and Department Administrators (DAs).
- Stays current on federal and university developments regarding research administration and complex regulations.
- May coordinate the submission, work with PI to prepare budget, and obtain pricing quotes from other departments.
- Compiles and ensures accurate regulatory compliance of necessary data collected from various sources.
- Works with Principal Investigator to compile and submit the entire grant according to established agency/university guidelines.
- Prepares and reviews all agency forms for submission.
- Enters grant budgeting documents on line, as needed.
- Obtains PI and institutional signatures for proposal submissions.

- Coordinates with the Post-award unit and OSRS to ensure timely implementation of contracts and subcontracts by examining and supplying the necessary requirements in the SUBS system.

Award Management

- Monitors and works with PI to submit annual agency reports (e.g., Research Performance Progress Reports/RPPRs).
- Teams with the Post-Award unit on revised budgets.
- Oversees and coordinates the proper transfer of PI grants and contracts into Wash U.

Research Compliance

Research Reporting

- Tracks and maintains online database of grants submitted, awarded, rejected, etc.

Grant Closeout

- Submits final progress report and invention statement (if applicable) to the appropriate agency.
- Follows up with PI and facilitates submission of delinquent final technical, outcomes, patent, and property reports.

May assist with some post award activities

- Prepares monthly financial reports on all research accounts and distribute/discuss with PIs and senior leadership.
- Assists DA in reconciling funds and monitoring spending levels, overdrafts, and cost sharing commitments.

Assists senior leadership with special projects as requested.

Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Head - Legal and Compliance
description:
# Head - Legal and Compliance

## Company Overview
Credit Wise Capital Pvt. Ltd. is a consumer finance Registered NBFC established in 2019, focused on providing technology-driven loans to customers. The company leverages both offline and online sourcing models to become a market leader, with a primary product in two-wheeler financing. Headquartered in Mumbai, it has rapidly expanded to over 180 locations across 10 states in India, making it one of the fastest-growing NBFCs in the country.

## Job Summary

This role involves providing legal guidance to senior management, managing compliance programs, and mitigating legal and regulatory risks associated with business operations. The position plays a critical role in fostering a culture of compliance and safeguarding the organization’s interests.

- **Compliance Management:** Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive compliance programs aligned with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Conduct regular assessments and audits to identify and address compliance gaps.
- **Risk Management:** Assess and mitigate legal risks related to business decisions and operational activities. Monitor changes in laws and regulations, advising management on necessary adjustments.

- **Regulatory Knowledge:** Strong understanding of NBFC regulations, labor laws, and compliance requirements.
- **Legal Skills:** Excellent legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
- **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team effectively.
- **Professional Attributes:** High integrity, professionalism, and adherence to ethical standards.

## Preferred Skills
- Experience working with regulatory authorities and external legal counsel.
- Knowledge of corporate governance best practices.
- Ability to develop and implement compliance frameworks.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Effective stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

## Experience
Minimum of **10 years** in a legal role, preferably within the NBFC or financial services sector, with a track record of managing legal and compliance functions at a senior level.

The role is based in **Mumbai, Worli**, with a typical office setting. The position may require occasional travel to different locations or regulatory bodies. The work environment is fast-paced, requiring high levels of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

title: Technical Program Manager, Kuiper Ground Systems Engineering
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

The Ground Systems Engineering team is responsible for the ground segment infrastructure that connects Amazon Leo satellites to the terrestrial internet. As Amazon Leo scales into international markets, each piece of ground segment equipment must be certified and type-approved for operation in the destination country — a process known as homologation.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own and drive the homologation program for GGT equipment across all target markets. You will be the central coordination point between engineering, regulatory, legal, trade compliance and third-party test laboratories, to ensure that all required certifications (EMC, safety, RF, environmental) are obtained on schedule. In addition to homologation, you will work with Software and Hardware Development teams, multiple suppliers, and other Kuiper Engineering teams to ensure internal and external requirements are met for the development and production of Gateway and TT&C terminals.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
- Own the end-to-end homologation program for Ground System equipment across all target countries
- Manage relationships with third-party test laboratories (e.g., TÜV SÜD, UL, Intertek) and coordinate test scheduling, sample logistics, and report reviews
- Track and maintain a certification matrix mapping each equipment type to applicable standards (EMC, safety, RF, environmental, RoHS) by country
- Identify and escalate gaps in test coverage or standard edition mismatches, and work with engineering to resolve
- Maintain a living schedule of homologation milestones aligned to country launch timelines
- Provide TPM support to the newly formed Ground Technical Operations team
- Relentlessly simplify and demonstrate significant innovation, creativity, and good judgment when solving challenging problems
- Drive best practices on the team, deal with ambiguity and competing objectives, and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks
- Write effective narratives and present them concisely and effectively to senior management





About the team
The Ground Systems team is developing globally located high data rate satellite communication terminals which operate off of automated software driven systems and which maintain critical connectivity from the ground to the complete Kuiper constellation. This team is driving the development, deployment and long-term operability of Kuiper ground station terminals.

description:

**<u>Rehabilitation and Wellbeing Business Partner</u>**

Council is seeking to appoint a maximum term part time Rehabilitation and Wellbeing Business Partner to contribute to Council’s success. This is a job share opportunity working 21.5 hours per fortnight, with a projected end date of June 2027.

- Be at the forefront of creating a safer, healthier workplace by managing rehabilitation and return-to-work programs
- Enjoy a balanced work environment that values both independent decision-making and teamwork, allowing you to leverage your strengths in both settings
- Engage in innovative initiatives aimed at improving psychological safety and wellbeing, contributing to a more supportive and inclusive workplace

**About the Role**

The purpose of this position is to support Council’s people agenda, contributing to the proactive management of health, wellbeing and rehabilitation strategies, process and policies.The Rehabilitation and Wellbeing Business Partner is responsible for supporting injury management cases and working with leaders to effectively manage the return to work program.This position is also accountable for developing, supporting and implementing health and wellbeing initiatives across the business.

**Ideal candidate:**

- Comfortable engaging with a diverse range of teams and stakeholders, building strong relationships to support rehabilitation and wellbeing initiatives.
- Able to work autonomously when needed, while also being a supportive and proactive member of a team.

**You will bring:**

1. Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Occupational Health & Safety, Allied Health (or related discipline) and/or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar role.

2. Current Queensland Rehabilitation and Return to Work Coordinator accreditation or ability to attain on appointment.

3. Demonstrated comprehensive knowledge and the ability to coordinate WorkCover claims management processes and early intervention strategies at an individual and an organisational level.

4. Demonstrated ability to develop highly effective working relationships by building credibility, respect and rapport with internal and external networks.

5. Remain abreast of contemporary practices and statutory requirements of the Workers Compensation and Rehabilitation Act 2003, Work, Health and Safety Act 2011 and Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 and any other state and federal legislation delegated to Council for enforcement and ensure precise application and continued organisational compliance.

6. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team and independently.

7. Advanced communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

8. Proficient keyboard skills and experience using Microsoft Office Suite and operating corporate business systems.

9. Legally able to drive a motor vehicle in Queensland.

**_Please note: due to the maximum term nature of this opportunity, we welcome applications from individuals who may not meet all requirements._** **_If you don’t meet all the essential criteria, we may consider making an alternative offer that aligns with your skills and experience._**

This could include reference checks, pre-employment medicals (including drug and alcohol testing), vaccinations, visa checks, licence verifications and psychometric testing. For questions related to the role or recruitment process, please call Council on (07) 4970 0700 or email the Talent Acquisition Team at [employment@gladstone.qld.gov.au](mailto:employment@gladstone.qld.gov.au).

title: Learning Experience Designer, Vendor Education
description:
This is not your typical Learning Experience Designer (LXD) role. We are building the future of vendor education at Amazon - designing AI-native learning solutions that help thousands of vendors across Europe succeed on our platform. Our team doesn't build courses and hope vendors find them. We design intelligent, data-informed learning experiences embedded directly where vendors work - surfacing the right content, to the right vendor, at the right moment.

The LXD will work at the intersection of learning theory, instructional design, product thinking, and AI to create solutions that scale across multiple marketplaces and languages. Day to day, you will design and produce learning content (eLearning modules, videos, playlists, job aids) while increasingly shaping how that content is structured, delivered, and personalized through AI and platform integration. You will use vendor to inform what you design and measure whether it works.

We need someone who is curious about technology, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by solving for learning gaps in ways that have not existed before. If you want to push e-learning modules through a traditional ADDIE pipeline each week, this isn't the role for you. If you want to design AI-native learning solutions that directly reduce vendor errors, accelerate their growth, and drive measurable business impact then read on.



Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop across multiple modalities: eLearning, video, job aids, playlists, and in-tool embedded content.
- Apply design judgment to determine the right solution for each problem. Recommend the format, modality, and channel that will drive the most impact with the least friction
- Translate complex vendor processes into clear, accessible learning content for a diverse, multilingual audience across European marketplaces
- Design learning products: embedded contextual guidance, adaptive paths, modular components, not just standalone courses.
- Work with AI as the default, not an add-on. Use generative AI to draft, iterate, localize, and scale content.
- Structure content for machine consumption: create modular assets with clear metadata so they can be surfaced by AI tools, chatbots, and platform surfaces.
- Experiment continuously. Evaluate emerging AI tools and workflows and bring proposals to the team.
- Inform requirements for how educational content integrates with Vendor Central, working with central tech teams.
- Manage multiple concurrent projects from needs analysis through launch and iteration.
- Facilitate scoping sessions with SMEs. Drive efficient review cycles that maintain quality without unnecessary bottlenecks.
- Drive adoption, continuous improvement and maintain content freshness across your portfolio. Own the quality bar for everything you ship.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a product team working session - a vendor workflow is driving errors and you work backwards from the data to define the right intervention and where it needs to live. Then you're building: scripting a video with AI, structuring a learning path, designing an in-context prompt. Later, you review adoption data on your portfolio and propose iterations. Between builds, you coordinate with partner teams to integrate content where vendors actually work -chatbots, Vendor Central pages, onboarding flows.

About the team
The vision of the EU Stores Learning Team is to be the most trusted partner in functional capability development, building the best negotiators in Retail and vendors who are able to expertly self-serve through intelligent learning solutions. We have a diverse team working across both internal (employee) and external (vendor) populations to drive tangible business results though educational solutions

description:

**Job Title: Lead, Info Security Systems Engineering**

**Job Code: 44526**

**Job Location: Salt Lake City, UT**

**Job Schedule: 9/80 (employees work 9 out of every 14 days - totaling 80 hours worked - and have every other Friday off)**

**Job Description:**

As a Lead, Information Security Systems Engineering at L3Harris Technologies, you will support the systems engineering team by providing **security architecture and requirements** oversight, as well **verifying security requirements** are met using a mix of manual and automated techniques.

You will work closely with software, networking, FPGA, and hardware engineers to integrate security requirements, verify requirements have been met, and build the body of evidence to showcase how the system you helped design meets the customers’ needs. This position is ideal for engineers with a strong foundation in **cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and who have experience as an engineer** who are interested in contributing to high-assurance defense systems.

**Essential Functions:**

- Interpret and apply security controls from NIST SP 800-53, CNSSI 1253, and related guidance into requirements that functional engineers can design to meet
- Support implementation and validation of Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and other configuration baselines
- Execute and support RMF lifecycle activities (categorization, control selection, implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring) as needed
- Develop, maintain, and review RMF documentation (e.g., SSPs, SARs, POA&Ms, Security Plans)
- Review high-level system design to ensure it meets security requirements within software, networking, and hardware
- Interface with internal stakeholders, Authorizing Officials (AOs), and external assessors to support authorization efforts
- Track and report compliance status, risks, and remediation activities to program leadership
- Travel up to 10% as needed
- **Must have a minimum of a DoW Secret Clearance**

**Required Qualifications (one of the following):**

· **Bachelor’s degree** in any engineering discipline including cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, etc. with minimum **9 years** of relevant experience

· **Graduate degree** in a related field with **7 years** of relevant experience

·In lieu of a degree, **13 years** of relevant experience

**Required Certifications:**

·One DoD 8140 / 8570-compliant certification (e.g., Security+, CISSP, SSCP, GSEC), or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Experience with the systems engineering lifecycle as it relates to security objectives; particularly requirements analysis, design, and testing
- Exposure to cryptographic systems, FIPS 140-3, or NSA certification processes
- Experience with high-assurance or classified systems
- Hands-on experience executing RMF within DoD environments
- Experience applying NIST SP 800-53 security controls and STIGs
- Experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes
- Strong technical writing and documentation skills
- Familiarity with TEMPEST, Anti-Tamper, or related system security disciplines
- Experience supporting government customers in a SETA/A&AS role
- Additional certifications (CISM, CISSP-ISSEP, CISA, CEH, GIAC, etc.)
- Active TS/SCI clearance or ability to obtain

**Systems & Technical Context**

- Understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, network architecture, boundary defense)
- Experience working with embedded systems and/or communications systems
- Familiarity with DevSecOps environments
- Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams

description:

**Job Title:** Specialist, Manufacturing Engineer (Optical Processing)

**Job Code:** 44614

**Job Location:** Rochester, New York

**Job Schedule:** 5/8, Employees work 8 hours per day, 5 days a week Monday-Friday

**Job Description:**

L3Harris’s Optics department in Rochester, NY, is seeking a dedicated Optical Process Engineer to support the production of top-tier optical components for advanced astronomical, high-energy laser, and earth imaging applications. As an Optical Process Engineer specializing in conventional optical fabrication, you will play a key role in developing and improving manufacturing processes used to produce mission-critical optical components. You’ll leverage your expertise in conventional grinding, lapping, and polishing to improve process consistency, product quality, and throughput across our optical fabrication work center.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will support production, troubleshoot process issues, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help ensure our conventional optical fabrication operations meet demanding optical tolerances and production goals. You’ll have the opportunity to improve manufacturing capability, support new product introduction, and directly influence the quality and repeatability of next-generation optical products.

**Essential Functions:**

•    Develop, optimize, and sustain conventional fabrication processes for high-precision optical components, including grinding, loose-abrasive lapping, and polishing of optical materials such as fused silica, Zerodur, ULE, or SiC.

•    Support fabrication improvement projects that enhance yield, repeatability, throughput, and process capability.

•    Introduce new optical designs into manufacturing by creating process plans, selecting tooling, defining workholding methods, and establishing in-process inspection steps.

•    Establish and optimize blocking and deblocking processes for a range of optical geometries and materials, with consideration for alignment, bond integrity, thermal effects, removal forces, and risk of part damage during fabrication.

•    Apply structured problem-solving to diagnose fabrication issues using root-cause analysis, process data, operator feedback, and metrology results.

•    Partner with quality and metrology teams to verify product conformance and improve correlation between in-process measurements and final optical requirements.

•    Collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and planning to standardize best practices and implement process improvements.

•    Provide daily technical support to operators, technicians, and manufacturing personnel within the conventional optical fabrication area.

•    Practical knowledge of conventional optical fabrication processes, including grinding, lapping, and polishing.

•    Demonstrated ability to support and improve technical processes in a manufacturing environment.

•    Experience working with optical materials such as glass, crystals, or ceramics.

•    Proficiency with process troubleshooting, root-cause investigation, and interpretation of metrology results.

•    Ability to collaborate across functions and support adoption of process improvements.

**Qualifications:**

•    Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Optical, or related engineering field and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.

•    Ability to obtain a federal security clearance.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

•    Experience with conventional optical fabrication methods such as curve generation, fine grinding, lapping, pitch polishing, and related finishing processes.

•    Familiarity with optical materials such as fused silica, BK7, Zerodur, ULE, sapphire, silicon, or optical ceramics.

•    Working knowledge of optical metrology methods including interferometry, profilometry, spherometry, thickness measurement, and cosmetic inspection.

•    Ability to interpret optical drawings and specifications, including figure, power, wedge, thickness, centration, scratch-dig, and surface quality requirements.

•    Experience with root-cause analysis, SPC, process capability analysis, and continuous improvement methods.

•    Understanding of tooling, fixtures, consumables, and workholding methods used in conventional optical grinding and polishing.

•    Background in design for manufacturability for optical components.

•    Strong, specialized knowledge of optical fabrication consistent with mid level technical roles.

title: Power Systems Engineer V
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

Challenge yourself to take a significant role in the development of JPL’s next generation of electronics, power systems, and technology to reliably propel JPL missions to the inner and outer solar system.  As a **Power & Electrical Systems Engineer V** for the **Power Systems Engineering** **group**, you will be working within the **Avionics, Power, & Instrument Electronics Section**. This section is responsible for design, analysis, fabrication, testing, verification and operations of electronics, electrical ground support equipment, and power flight systems for JPL missions. This section is JPL's technical center of excellence for advanced computing, instrument electronics, motor control electronics, advanced power electronics, thermoelectric, electrochemical, and photovoltaic technologies.

We are seeking an innovative, experienced **Power Systems Engineer V** to develop and implement end-to-end power subsystem solutions, including supporting business development, and flight delivery oversight.  As a systems engineer, you will be involved in all phases of the mission life cycles including technical concept development, cost and schedules, hardware implementation, delivery, and operations. A systems engineer is highly motivated, creative, and experienced with the ability to oversee, balance and integrate technical and program-related issues in an end-to-end manner to ensure that the total system satisfies the project and mission requirements.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

- Development and manage power system and electrical system requirements and V&V plans on JPL lead projects/missions

- Develop power system architectures and power subsystem definition on new mission proposals

- Lead power system sizing & resource management

- Manage electrical interfaces across a spacecraft to ensure a self-compatible, robust design implementation and to support the fabrication of flight harnesses

- Work effectively with power designers in defining optimum architectures

- Lead architectural trades and make decisions to optimize systems across technical, schedule, and cost constraints

- Develop the grounding architecture and implementation in support of a compliant EMI/EMC approach

- Produce detailed and accurate design products in support of hardware development and to document the as-built configuration

- Maintain, develop, and enforce standards for power and electrical systems engineering architecture, design, and execution including clear expectations for quality

- Present complex power system concepts to different levels of line management, project management, and other technical personnel

- Providing mentorship, insight and oversight of systems engineering practices

- Representing the section and JPL as a Power and Electrical Systems expert and making decisions critical to project and mission success

- Interacting regularly with flight projects and counterparts on systems engineering definition and development.

- Convenes review boards and leading peer reviews as necessary


**Other requirements include:**

- Sophisticated knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Analog Electronics, Controls, Power Systems Design, Systems Engineering, Electrical Systems Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Integration and Test

- Deep understanding and wide application of advanced principles, theories, concepts and techniques in Power Systems Engineering

- Experience in power electronic designs including schematics, reliability analysis, board layout, and testing

- Experience delivering flight hardware, supporting ATLO operations, and in-flight operations.

- Expert knowledge of grounding, EMI/EMC, harness design, electrical compatibility, signal integrity, safety and inhibit architectures, battery management, pyros and propulsion drivers, and multi-stage vehicles

- Knowledge related to the development, testing and integration of solar arrays and batteries for space applications

- Experience with standard electronic test equipment: oscilloscope, power supply, logic analyzer, etc

- Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose complex problems to determine the root cause

- Experience in power converter topologies, power switching, and closed-loop power control systems and their implementation using microcontrollers and/or FPGAs

- Excellent oral and interpersonal skills


**Qualifications:**

- Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, or related technical subject area, typically with a minimum of 12 years of related  work experience, or Masters in a similar discipline with a minimum of 10 years of related work experience, or PhD in a similar discipline with a minimum of 8 years of related work experience.

- Recent demonstrated experience in defining a deliverable and managing a team that meets schedule and cost constraints to produce the deliverable.

- Demonstrated leadership abilities with excellent oral and written communication skills.

- Extensive knowledge in JPL flight electronics and harness development processes and manufacturing flows.

- Strong interpersonal skills with ability to interface with institutional and project management at all levels, as well as mentoring technical staff.

- Recent experience developing a task plan that includes an integrated schedule, cost estimate and phased development plan.

- Extensive knowledge on the observables in electronic control systems and data acquisition systems.

- Proven ability to plan the strategic development of new products.


**Preferred Skills:**

- Experience with development of JPL power subsystem hardware, electrical interfaces, and complex integrated systems

- Complete knowledge of industry and/or academic practices and standards across a range of applications in embedded system development.

- Demonstrated capabilities in hardware development, process improvement and leadership.

- Complete knowledge of Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations across a range of applications.

- Previous experience with flight project practices on JPL missions.

- Familiarity with Altium Designer, LTSPICE, and PLECS

- Knowledge of industry and or academic practices and standards across a range of applications related to the development, testing, and integration of electronic assemblies for space applications

- Validated ability to multi-task with an established track record of meeting schedule milestones

- Military, Aerospace & Space hardware development experience

- Experience with power conversion designs for harsh radiation environments and mitigation strategies

This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. title: Counsel, Business Affairs
description:
Who We Are:

Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge:

The selected candidate will be responsible for business affairs legal work for a dynamic entertainment company and will work closely with internal business clients and senior in-house counsel. This position will negotiate, draft, and track a high-volume of legal agreements relating to entertainment, technology, advertising, intellectual property and related matters. This position is an in-person role based in our London office. This role will focus on the mobile games industry working with colleagues across EMEA, the US and the world, and the selected candidate should be commercially minded and pragmatic.

What You’ll Take On:

  • Draft, analyze and negotiate commercial agreements for all aspects of entertainment content creation, production, marketing and distribution.

  • Advise our internal teams that focus on game development, engineering, mobile platforms and app stores, user acquisition, ad tech, monetization, IP licensing and product distribution.

  • Bring expertise to a wide range of commercial agreements applicable to mobile gaming (such as MSAs, Monetization Agreements, IOs, and DPAs) including AdTech and MarTech vendors, analytics and attribution service providers, outsourcing and software vendors.

  • Independently handle contract negotiations with a pragmatic orientation and with multi-jurisdictional awareness. Partner with our business clients to meet commercial goals.

  • Structure and analyze deals within a matrix of rights held by third parties, such as content distributors, hardware manufacturers, sports leagues, record labels, music publishers, actors and other talent, technology licensors, software developers, entertainment companies, advertising agencies, ancillary merchandise vendors, data analytics providers, information technology vendors and similar entities.

  • Advise internal clients regarding general business and contract issues, as well as copyright, technology, corporate, regulatory and related matters.

  • Provide day-to-day legal and business affairs counsel to highly creative business units.

  • Assess risks associated with highly complex legal issues in a fast-paced environment.

  • Serve as part of the Legal team helping Take-Two’s publishing labels create the most innovative and creative products in the most efficient way possible.

What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of post-qualification experience in-house or within a law firm.

  • Expertise in contracting issues, with excellent drafting skills.

  • Experience with complex corporate or intellectual property transactions, including content creation, production, clearance, marketing and distribution.

  • Experience with software and technology licensing and development.

  • Experience with entertainment or technology matters, or significant corporate experience with a strong desire to transition to entertainment and technology matters.

  • Must have the ability and desire to evaluate and advise on complex agreements and contractual issues, and effectively distill information for clients.

  • Must possess common sense, patience, good humor, and a commitment to teamwork.

  • Strong communication skills; ability to convey complex matters in clear terms to clients and colleagues.

  • Enthusiasm for the videogame industry.

  • Eagerness to embrace AI and other new technologies in the legal practice.

  • Remains calm and confident despite deadlines and challenging priorities.

  • Qualified and in good standing as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or relevant jurisdiction.

What We Offer You:

  • Great Company Culture. We pride ourselves as being one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
  • Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
  • Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees’ bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, our onsite Gym, company parties, our Office bar, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
  • Benefits. Include, but aren't limited to, private medical and dental insurance, virtual GP, a health cash plan for preventative medical costs, matching pension policy up to 4%, a workplace savings scheme for short-term savings, £50 monthly fitness reimbursement, 24/7 mental wellbeing support, family building and menopause support, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan with 15% discount, Cycle to Work scheme, 4x salary death in service insurance, 66% of salary income protection, charitable donation matching and volunteer leave, 26 days of annual leave, and enhanced family policies.
  • Perks. Onsite Gym, an office bar, employee discount programs, free games and events, stocked pantries, and a dog friendly workplace.

Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Take-Two’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a take2games.com email domain). If you need to report an issue or otherwise have questions, please contact -----

(“Take-Two”) is committed to fostering and celebrating the diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds of its talent, partners, and communities throughout its organization. title: İkinci El Oto Ekspertiz Uzmanı - Cennet / Küçükçekmece
description:
VavaCars'ta biz sadece bir teknoloji şirketi değiliz. Bizler, Türkiye'deki otomotiv sektöründe devrim yaratmaya kararlı, kullanılmış otomobil endüstrisinde vizyoner, yenilikçi ve öncüleriz. Şirketimiz, derin bir bağlılık, proaktif inisiyatif ve girişimci ruh kültürüyle büyümektedir. Çalışanlarımız sadece bir iş yapmıyor, sınırları zorluyor ve normları çiğniyor. Pratik, departmanlar arası işbirliğinin gücüne ve sadece kendi sektörümüzde değil, ötesinde statükoya meydan okumanın gücüne inanıyoruz.

Mesleki geçmişiniz, eğitim geçmişiniz veya sektörünüz ne olursa olsun, istisnai bir çalışma geçmişiniz ve yenilik tutkunuz varsa, sizi ekibimizde görmek isteriz. VavaCars'ta mesele sadece ne yaptığınız değil, neler yapabildiğinizdir.

Otomotiv endüstrisinin geleceğini yeniden tanımlarken bu heyecan verici yolculukta bize katılın. İşimiz sadece araba alıp satmak değil,

insanların kullanılmış araba pazarını nasıl algıladıklarını yeniden şekillendiren benzersiz bir kullanıcı deneyimi yaratmak. Sadece oyunu değiştirmiyoruz - yeni bir oyun yaratıyoruz.

Kariyerinizi hızlı şeride yönlendirmeye hazır mısınız? VavaCars yolculuğuna bugün başlayın!

OPERASYON

Alanında uzman ekspertizler, mekanik teknisyenleri, üretim çalışanları ve operasyon profesyonellerinin yer aldığı küresel bir ekibe katılın ve gezegenin en çeşitli araçlarını yenileyin.

Requirements

VavaCars'ta İkinci El Oto Ekspertiz Uzmanı pozisyonundan ne beklenir:

Araçların kaporta ve mekanik aksamına dair detaylı incelemeler yapar, gerekli fotoğraf ve raporları düzenleyerek bilgi akışına katkıda bulunur, VavaCars araç parkında hedeflenen kalite seviyesinin yakalanmasını sağlar.

  • VavaCars’ın standartlarına uygun bir şeklide araçların ekspertiz süreçlerini yürütmek
  • Araçların kaporta kondisyonunu incelemek, orijinal dışı herhangi bir onarım, boya, değişim olup olmadığını tespit etmek
  • Araçların mekanik aksamını ve elektronik donanımlarını kontrol ederek, bakım ihtiyacı veya aktif arızaların tespit edilmesi
  • Aracın VavaCars sistemlerinde kayıtlı olan versiyon/donanım/paket/opsiyon gibi değişken bilgilerini kontrol etmek, varsa önceki ekspertiz bilgileri ile karşılaştırmak, eksiklik ve/veya farklılıkları tespit etmek
  • Araçların ilk ekspertizleri ile ortaya çıkan her türlü farklılıkların değerlendirmesini yapmak.
  • Sürecin gerektirdiği tüm ölçümleme ve fotoğraflama işlemlerini gerçekleştirmek
  • Araç anahtar sayısı, dijital ekipmanları, yedek lastik, avadanlık ve kilitli bijon gibi detayları kontrol etmek

Bize ne katacaksın?

  • 3 yıl ve üzeri ikinci el araç ekspertiz deneyimi
  • Otomobil kaporta ve mekanik aksamları konusunda bilgi ve tecrübe sahibi (Boyalı yüzey/değişen parça kontrolü, mekanik arıza tespiti, diagnoz)
  • Ekspertiz süreçlerinde gerekli ekipmanı kullanabilen (Boya kalınlığı ölçüm cihazı, diagnostik test cihazları)
  • B sınıfı sürücü belgesi ve temiz sürüş kaydı
  • Teknolojiye yatkın, iyi seviyede bilgisayar ve tablet kullanabilen
  • Gelişime ve değişime açık

Biz Kimiz?

VavaCars olarak, Türkiye'de ikinci el araç alım satım işlemleri için bir platformdan daha fazlasıyız; otomotiv endüstrisinde devrim yaratıyoruz. Misyonumuz, otomobil alım satım deneyimini sorunsuz, şeffaf ve güvenilir bir sürece dönüştürmektir.

Sadelik, şeffaflık ve rahatlığa öncelik vererek, müşterilerimizin evlerinin rahatlığında çevrimiçi olarak arabalara göz atmalarını, değerlendirmelerini ve satın almalarını mümkün kıldık. Kapsamlı hizmetlerimiz sadece işlemlerin ötesine geçiyor, VavaServis ve VavaGaraj gibi girişimlerle, bakımdan lastik satın almaya kadar araçla ilgili her türlü ihtiyacı karşılıyor, kullanıcılarımıza stressiz bir deneyim sağlıyoruz.

2019'daki lansmanımızdan bu yana, VavaCars yalnızca binlerce otomobilin ticaretini başarıyla yapmakla kalmadı, aynı zamanda müşterilerin, küresel sponsorların ve yatırımcıların güvenini kazandı. Sadece istisnai hizmet sunmaya değil, sürekli yenilik yapmaya ve mümkün olanın sınırlarını zorlamaya inanıyoruz.

Başarımızın temelinde özverili ve deneyimli Vavan ekibimiz yer almaktadır. Büyümeye ve pazarı yeniden tanımlamaya devam ederken, inovasyon yolculuğumuza katılmaya hazır, ileri görüşlü bireyleri aramızda görmeyi dört gözle bekliyoruz. VavaCars'ta mesele sadece başardıklarımız değil, birlikte inşa ettiğimiz çığır açıcı bir gelecek. Sizi işbirliği fırsatlarını keşfetmeye ve heyecan verici devrimimizin bir parçası olmaya davet ediyoruz.

Benefits

Benzersiz ve heyecan verici bir paket sunuyoruz - yerel otomobil alanında böyle bir şey denenmedi ve en iyisini istiyoruz. Rekabetçi bir paket ve çalışan mutluluğuna odaklanan bir kültür sunuyoruz.

  • Performans bonusu
  • Bireysel özel sağlık sigortası
  • Ulaşım desteği
  • Yemek ücreti
  • Sıcak bir çalışma ortamı ve sosyal etkinlikler
  • Müşteri Merkezimiz Küçükçekmece lokasyonludur.

title: Coordinator Regional Planning
description:
- **Full-Time Fixed Term until September 2027/ 9-Day Fortnight / 36 Hours per week**
- **Stream A Level 8**
- **Salary: $121,839 to $137,304** plus Superannuation
- **Position Brief** - [Coordinator Regional Planning](https://applynow.net.au/jobs/COG2143/assets/32417611 "Coordinator Regional Planning")

**Lead strategic planning. Shape sustainable growth. Help build the future of our City.**

**About the team:**

Within the City Planning branch, the Strategic Urban and Regional Planning unit leads the future growth and strategic planning for one of Australia’s fastest growing cities. This includes delivering regional planning advice and preparing key planning assumptions, such as population and dwelling forecasts.

The Regional Planning team is one of three teams in this unit and is known for its commitment to flexible work practices and delivering impactful strategic planning outcomes. Working on complex citywide and regional planning initiatives, the team leads the development of growth strategies, implementation plans and statutory planning frameworks that influence where people live, work and connect, while helping to balance growth, infrastructure, environmental values and community aspirations. Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, State Government agencies and regional partners, the team helps shape planning outcomes that respond to growth pressures and emerging challenges while protecting and enhancing the Gold Coast's unique character, lifestyle and natural environment.

**About the role:**

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking planner to fill the role of **Coordinator Regional Planning.** The successful applicant will provide strategic leadership to a high-performing team and help shape the City’s long-term growth and development.

You will lead a team of 8 with 3 – 4 direct reports and will provide strategic direction across regional planning, growth management and strategic land use policy. You will play a key role in influencing major planning initiatives, providing high-level policy advice and contributing to the continued enhancement of the City’s Planning Scheme and related Council strategies.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine your expertise in strategic planning with your leadership capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for the city and its community.

**Key responsibilities include:**

- Drive a coordinated approach to managing growth across the City by integrating land use, infrastructure, housing, employment and environmental planning considerations into strategic policy and planning initiatives.
- Monitor, analyse and interpret demographic, employment, housing and land use data to assess the City’s growth trends, inform decision making and track progress towards population, employment and dwelling targets.
- Provide expert strategic planning and policy advice on citywide growth, land use planning and development matters to support organisational decision making and planning outcomes.
- Coordinate the preparation of project management documentation including project initiation forms, feasibility studies, business cases, project management plans and budgets.
- Lead the delivery of complex city-shaping strategic planning projects ensuring effective management of scope, budget, schedule, quality, risk, procurement, stakeholder engagement and project outcomes.
- Develop and implement growth strategies and planning frameworks that respond to emerging challenges and opportunities associated with population growth, housing demand and employment needs
- Foster strong partnerships with State Government agencies, regional stakeholders and internal business units to influence regional planning outcomes and advance the City's strategic interests.
- Lead the administration of the City’s Social and Health Impact Assessment Policy and provide referral advice to development assessment officers.

**About you:**

You are an experienced strategic planner and people leader who can operate confidently at a senior level and influence outcomes across a complex local government environment.

**You will have:**

- Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing growth management strategies including planning for population growth, housing supply and employment land.
- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic planning policy into practical implementation programs, actions and measurable outcomes.
- Strong knowledge of Queensland planning legislation, regional planning frameworks and contemporary growth management principles.
- Experience leading complex, multi-disciplinary strategic planning projects.
- Demonstrated people leadership capability, including the ability to lead, develop and motivate a specialist team.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, including the ability to interpret demographic, employment, housing and land use trends to inform growth management and city shaping decisions.
- Proven project management, governance and budget management capabilities.
- Highly developed written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear advice to senior decisionmakers.
- Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to work strategically while managing competing priorities, complex issues and tight deadlines.
- Bachelor Degree in Regional and Town Planning or equivalent and relevant experience

**Be part of shaping the Gold Coast’s future**

The Gold Coast is inspired by lifestyle and driven by opportunity. We are the second largest Council in Australia.

We care about being the most flexible government organisation in Australia. We have a range of benefits to help you create the right balance:

- 9-day fortnight

- Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle, including hybrid/work from home options, flexible working hours and locations

- Personal and professional development courses

- Access to 350+ fitness facilities through Fitness Passport

- 4 free confidential counselling sessions a year for you or an immediate family member

- 1 free nutritionist and financial advice session per year

We pride ourselves on our shared mission of being a high-performing, customer-focused organisation which delivers value-for-money services to the community.

**How to apply:**

To submit your application, please click apply now and complete the application form. You will be required to upload your resume and a cover letter (no more than two pages) outlining how your skills, experience and personal attributes will enable you to be successful in this role. Please note that you may also be asked to provide relevant qualifications, where applicable.

**Contact Person:** Sam Bonney

**Contact Email:** [SBONNEY@goldcoast.qld.gov.au](mailto:SBONNEY@goldcoast.qld.gov.au)

**Closing Date:** Monday 5th October 11:59pm AEDT

Our selection process may include a one-way video interview via Criteria, a face-to-face or virtual interview via Microsoft Teams, reference checks via Xref and additional checks including police checks, employment history checks, qualification checks, pre-employment medical reviews and drug and alcohol testing.

_We’re committed to creating a diverse workplace and inclusive culture. We take pride in people who align with our high-performance principles. We believe that the diverse makeup of our workforce reflects the community we serve. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities, and encourage candidates to discuss any support or adjustments they may need throughout the recruitment process._

title: PPC Specialist
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We’re looking for an experienced PPC Specialist with 3–4+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns.

You’ll take ownership of PPC campaigns from strategy and setup through optimization, reporting, and scaling. This role is ideal for a data-driven performance marketer who understands how to turn advertising budgets into measurable business results.

You should be highly confident working with Google Ads, campaign analytics, conversion tracking, keyword strategy, and performance optimization. Experience with additional paid media platforms such as Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, or LinkedIn Ads is a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize PPC campaigns across Google Ads and other relevant paid media platforms.
  • Manage Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, remarketing, and other campaign types as required.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, audience research, and search-term analysis.
  • Develop and continuously improve campaign structures, targeting, bidding strategies, ad copy, and landing-page recommendations.
  • Monitor and optimize key performance metrics including CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, and overall advertising spend.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scale high-performing campaigns.
  • Set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking using tools such as Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Conduct A/B tests across ads, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages.
  • Manage budgets and allocate spend based on campaign performance and business objectives.
  • Produce clear performance reports and translate campaign data into actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with marketing, creative, sales, and client-facing teams to ensure paid acquisition supports wider growth objectives.
  • Stay up to date with advertising platform changes, automation, attribution, and PPC best practices.

Requirements

  • 3–4+ years of professional PPC / paid media experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing meaningful advertising budgets and delivering measurable performance improvements.
  • Strong understanding of paid search strategy, keyword research, bidding, targeting, and campaign optimization.
  • Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and conversion tracking.
  • Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, CVR, and CAC.
  • Ability to analyze campaign data and make evidence-based optimization decisions.
  • Experience creating performance reports and communicating results clearly to stakeholders or clients.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance in a remote environment.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or other paid acquisition channels.
  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, B2B lead generation, or high-growth digital businesses.
  • Google Ads certifications.
  • Familiarity with Looker Studio or other marketing reporting and visualization tools.
  • Experience with landing-page and conversion-rate optimization.

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

title: (Mid/Senior) Robotics or Mechatronics Technician/Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

We are seeking a driven technician (m/f/d) with proven hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, soldering, desoldering, wire harnesses, and troubleshooting mechanical and electronic tasks. In this role, you will support and maintain existing products to ensure they remain fully operational and improve and develop new solutions for robust hardware.

Success in this role requires both technical excellence and the ability to adapt and make decisions under uncertainty.

Your Responsibilities

  • Ensure that the robotics systems are ready to be used at all times
  • Create detailed documentation, technical drawings, and assembly instructions for testing rigs or needed components
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, software, manufacturing) to ensure seamless system integration
  • Maintain Bill of Materials (BOM), assembly instructions, and quality control documentation, support and creation of SOPs
  • Troubleshoot and resolve mechanics and electronics issues during development and production phases
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices in robotics and mechanical/electronics design
  • Perform assembly and disassembly of robots components, cables, and PCBs and other devices
  • Carry out soldering, desoldering, wiring, and basic troubleshooting tasks (e.g. oscilloscope, signal analyzers)
  • Support procurement activities by identifying suitable products which meet requirements, sourcing suppliers, and obtaining quotations
  • Open to travel to China for business trips
  • The role involves significant travel (approximately 50%) to client sites
  • Work autonomously on open-ended, evolving tasks

Essential Skills

  • Hands-on experience with soldering SMD components
  • Proficiency in Altium / Solidworks is recommended
  • Proficiency in English, Spoken and written
  • Knowledge of electronics design principles
  • Knowledge of actuators and sensors using robotics, familiarity with sensor integration (force/torque sensors, encoders, IMUs) is recommended
  • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping (3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting) is recommended
  • Able to find fast solutions to common problems

Beneficial Skills

  • Minimum 3-5 years of proven work experience in related fields
  • Experience in robotics, mechatronics, or automation industries
  • Background in designing robust cabling solutions and cable harnesses
  • Familiarity with electronics design and PCB production stages
  • Knowledge of structural, thermal, and dynamic analysis to validate designs

Your Profile

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Empathy and excellent communication skills to enable great teamwork
  • Self-motivated with a passion for cutting-edge robotics technology
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on robust system design
  • Adaptable to fast-paced development cycles
  • Firmware development experience

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Productieplanner
description:
Activeer je potentieel – sluit je aan bij NORIT, de wereldleider in de productie van actieve kool!

Ben jij een gedreven en georganiseerde professional met een passie voor productieplanning? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Als Productieplanner ben je verantwoordelijk voor de wekelijkse productieplanning van onze Chemische Nabehandeling en Reactivatie fabrieken. Je stelt inzetplannen op voor halffabricaten en maakt productieorders aan. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen om een efficiënte planning te realiseren en bij te dragen aan de optimalisatie van de supply chain.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van een productieplan in samenwerking met de lokale productieafdeling om voldoende capaciteit te garanderen op korte en middellange termijn,
  • Zorg dragen voor een optimale voorraad en afroepen van; verpakkingen, grondstoffen en productiehulpmiddelen.
  • Coördineren van de bulkplanning en korte termijn voorraadplanning in samenwerking met verkoop, transport en externe partijen,
  • Uitvoeren van de werkvoorbereiding en klaar zetten van productieorders voor de chemische nabehandeling.
  • Actief bijdragen aan supply chain verbetertrajecten gericht op de optimalisatie van de korte- en lange termijnplanning.
  • Met de collega planners en logistiek zorg je voor opvolging van de verkooporders die via onze site in Zaandam lopen.

Requirements

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Analytics Engineering
description:
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to join our team and drive the next generation of our data platform and AI powered products at AWS scale. You will own end to end design, implementation, and operation of distributed systems that process petabyte scale data daily, serve hundreds of internal customers, and directly influence how AWS leadership makes decisions.

This is a high impact role where you will shape the architecture of both products, building workflow orchestration systems, multi agent AI frameworks, GenAI powered analytics capabilities, and scalable platform services. You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, data engineering, and applied AI/ML.

Key job responsibilities
Own and evolve system architecture. Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost effective distributed systems for workflow orchestration and AI powered analytics. Make sound technical trade offs between short term delivery and long term maintainability.

Drive architectural decisions that impact petabyte scale data processing and thousands of jobs.

Build multi agent AI systems. Design, implement, and optimize multi agent architectures including autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, and tool integrations

Build reusable components, APIs, and micro-services that other teams adopt. Continuously simplify, optimize, and remove bottlenecks across the stack.

Drive platform capabilities end to end. Own features from concept through deployment and operation. Examples include building new marketplace and IDE experiences, implementing validated query patterns, designing cross service governed metrics, or creating real time monitoring dashboards.

Solve complex ambiguous problems. Navigate unclear requirements and competing priorities to deliver innovative solutions.

Influence technical direction and mentor others. Provide technical leadership across the team and adjacent teams.

Drive operational excellence. Own the operational health of production systems.

Innovate with AI/ML technologies. Stay current with GenAI, LLM, and ML advancements.

A day in the life
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will work closely with your customers and stakeholders to understand their analytics needs, translating them into scalable technical solutions on our data platform. You will work with cross functional teams including data engineers, applied scientists, product managers, and business analysts. You will design and build distributed systems that orchestrate thousands of daily workflows and process petabyte scale data across AWS services. ou will spend time writing and reviewing code, diving deep into production issues, and mentoring engineers on best practices. You will participate in architecture design and review meetings to hold a high standard for our infrastructure. You will balance building new capabilities with operational excellence, ensuring our systems are reliable, secure, and performant at scale.

About the team
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS. We build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across all of AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We are a team of engineers and scientists supporting AWS product leaders to make high impact decisions through sophisticated analytical frameworks, trusted data science methods, and scalable ML products. We came from diverse backgrounds from statistics, computer science, engineering, and business analytics. We specialize in building data platforms that process at petabyte scale and the full end to end ML development process, from data ingestion to model deployment in production.
