title: System Development Engineer II, Region Flexibility Migration (RFM)
description:
As a System Development Engineer , you will take ownership of key workstreams within Amazon's Region Flexibility Migration team, driving critical infrastructure migration initiatives that enable Amazon's services to operate across multiple AWS regions. You will lead the development of automation frameworks, mentor junior engineers, and make technical decisions that shape the Boost Accelerator program's roadmap. you will drive efforts aimed at optimizing memory utilization across service fleets, identifying opportunities to right-size allocations, reduce infrastructure footprints, and preserve capacity to support continued growth and expansion. Join a team where you will have a direct impact on reducing migration burden for service teams and delivering zero-impact migrations at massive scale.

Key job responsibilities
● Design, implement, maintain, and deploy components that solve problems in a complex ecosystem. We work in lots of different languages (not limited to, but most often Python and Java). It is more important to us that you understand coding in the context of working in distributed systems and/or widely scaled web applications.
● Lead migration projects from planning through execution, including infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation
● Identify and implement cost optimization strategies to reduce per-offering costs of the Boost program through automation and streamlined operations.
● Drive technical decisions for Boost program offerings, including pipeline infrastructure setups, DDB replication, containerization solutions, and new offerings such as RDS, DocumentDB, and VFI builds.
● Mentor and guide junior engineers, conducting code reviews, providing technical direction, and fostering a culture of operational excellence within the team.
● Lead root cause analysis for high-severity incidents, implement preventive measures, and drive operational improvements across the team's processes and tooling.
● Collaborate with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration blockers
● Participate in on-call rotations to ensure operational support for critical migration activities
● Building AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operation or make our day to day job easier and faster.
● Perform deep dive on services with different compute type to generate recommendations for optimization of resources.


A day in the life
You will lead the technical direction for complex migration challenges using AWS technologies and modern development practices. You might collaborate with our Boost program team on pipeline infrastructure setups, build AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operations, or develop tools in Python and Java to automate critical migration tasks. You'll work closely with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration obstacles, analyze memory efficiency across service fleets, and contribute to expanding our Boost program offerings. Your work will span infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation, all while supporting operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You'll also mentor team members, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with Seattle-based leadership on strategic priorities.

About the team
The Region Flexibility Migration (RFM) team is part of Amazon's Intelligent Cloud Hosting (ICON) organization. The RFM team was formed in 2024 with the purpose of proactively discovering and mitigating issues that service teams would encounter when migrating services across AWS regions like eu-south-2 and eu-central-1. During the last year and a half, the team has developed expertise in identifying these issues and leveraging those findings to save builder effort. The team has also developed expertise in identifying undifferentiated work within these migration workloads and created the Boost program that reduces the migration burden for service teams by offloading foundational and undifferentiated migration work to a central team. In 2026, the RFM team structured its work across five themes: Region Flexibility Beyond ExitDUB, Optimizing Boost costs, Improving Boost’s customer experience, Memory Optimization, and Operational Excellence and Operational Support (KTLO).

title: Laboratory/Research Technician
description:
About the College

The College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (CALS) is a pioneer of purpose-driven science and Cornell University’s second largest college. We work across disciplines to tackle the challenges of our time through world-renowned research, education, and outreach. The questions we probe and the answers we seek focus on three overlapping concerns: We believe that achieving next-generation scientific breakthroughs requires an understanding of the world’s complex, interlocking systems. We believe that access to nutritious food and a healthy environment is a fundamental human right. We believe that ensuring a prosperous global future depends on the ability to support local people and communities everywhere. By working in and across multiple scientific areas, CALS can address challenges and opportunities of the greatest relevance, here in New York, across the nation, and around the world.

Cornell Cooperative Extension (CCE) provides the educational outreach functions for Cornell University’s role as New York State’s Land Grant University. Programmatically, Cornell Cooperative Extension connects the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (CALS) and the College of Human Ecology (CHE) with 55 off-campus Associations, Integrated Pest Management (IPM), New York State Sea Grant, Area Specialists, and CCE New York City.

What We Need

As a member of the team, you will provide technical support for area Extension Associates. Duties include:

• Provide technical support to area Extension Associates in carrying out research activities that will ultimately enhance the profitability and sustainability of the commercial horticulture industry in Eastern New York.

• Flag and sign cooperating field sites for field research.

• Assist with field maintenance.

• Maintain accurate records.

• Assist with crop harvests, measuring, and recording yields.

• Transport samples to storage sites or research facilities for further analysis.

• Assist in other fieldwork and projects in commercial farms as needed.

• Perform other related duties as assigned to support departmental priorities during the appointment period.

If you possess these experiences and skills, this may be the role for you! There are a few other qualifications that we would view as incredibly helpful in this role, including:

Required Qualifications

• Proven ability to work independently in collecting and summarizing data.

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to prioritize multiple activities and tasks while meeting deadlines.

• Must be able to work outdoors in all types of weather.

• Must be able to meet the travel requirements of the position and have reliable transportation as well as have and maintain a valid and unrestricted New York State driver’s license and be cleared to drive for university business.

• Visual concentration, attention to detail, and manual dexterity are required.

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

• Must exercise sound and ethical judgment when acting on behalf of the University.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate’s Degree with coursework in entomology, plant pathology, plant physiology, weed science, horticulture, and/or agronomy.

• Experience supporting research projects, including data collection and summary.

• Experience working in agriculture, horticulture, field crops, and/or cash crops production.

This is a part-time temporary position at 20 hours/week. This is a temporary two-month appointment. This on-site position is located in northern New York.

Rewards and Benefits

Compensation is $23.40/hour.

No relocation assistance is provided for this position. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Software Engineer (all levels) - Core Technology
description:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

Role Description

The AI Security Institute's Research Unit is looking for motivated and talented Software Engineers to join AISI's Core Technology Team. We are looking for exceptional candidates at all experience levels, from junior through to senior or staff, to work in small teams on a range of critical research-oriented software and infrastructure.

In this role, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies on research problems with real-world impact, and receive mentorship and coaching from your manager and the technical leads on your team. You'll also regularly interact with world-famous researchers and other incredible staff (including alumni from Anthropic, DeepMind, OpenAI, Google, Apple, and professors from Oxford and Cambridge).

About our Core Technology Team

AISI Core Technology Team comprises several teams building tools and infrastructure used across all of our research work. This includes projects like Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), systems for running evaluations at scale, and hosting frontier open-weights models for evaluations or human studies.

As a software engineer on one of these teams, you might:

  • Add a feature to one of our “sandbox plugins” for Inspect, supporting advanced agentic evals with safe mechanisms to let models write and execute arbitrary code
  • Implement support for a new class of open-weights model on our model hosting platform
  • Support a research team with designing custom infrastructure for a new research project
  • Collaborate with the open-source community on a feature in Inspect or Inspect's plugin ecosystem
  • Assist with an evaluation testing exercise of a frontier AI model, debugging issues that appear in Inspect from API changes in the lab's latest SDK

Person Specification

You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes:

  • Writing production quality code at fast pace.
  • Designing, shipping, and maintaining complex tech products.
  • Improving technical standards across a team, through mentoring and feedback.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with a world-class research team comprised of both scientists and engineers (e.g. in a top-3 lab).
  • Python experience, including understanding the intricacies of the language, the good vs. bad Pythonic ways of doing things and much of the wider ecosystem/tooling.
  • Experience building and maintaining systems on AWS or other cloud providers using infrastructure-as-code.

Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if you don't meet all the above criteria.

Required Experience

We select based on skills and experience regarding the following areas:

  • Writing production quality code
  • Writing code efficiently
  • Python
  • Written communication
  • Verbal communication
  • Teamwork
  • Interpersonal skills
  • Tackling challenging problems

Desired Experience

We additionally may factor in experience with particular areas like:

  • Expertise in Cloud Infrastructure or Dev Ops (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, CDK, Docker, etc.)
  • Cybersecurity expertise
  • ML Ops (vLLM, agent frameworks, fine-tuning, RAG systems, etc.)

What We Offer

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else

  • Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues.
  • Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally.
  • Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies.
  • Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security.

Resources & access

  • Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute.
  • Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly.
  • Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences.

Growth & autonomy

  • If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early.
  • 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations.
  • Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure.
  • Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally.

Life & family*

  • Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol.
  • Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment.
  • At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering.
  • Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time).
  • On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension.
  • Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms.

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments.

Salary

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary.

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures.

The full range of salaries are available below:

  • Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £39,850 + Technical Allowance £25,150–£35,150)
  • Level 4: £85,000–£95,000 (Base £47,355 + Technical Allowance £37,645–£47,645)
  • Level 5: £105,000–£115,000 (Base £61,620 + Technical Allowance £43,380–£53,380)
  • Level 6: £125,000–£135,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £50,395–£60,395)
  • Level 7: £145,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £70,395)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Internal Fraud Database

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented. For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Nationality requirements

We may be able to offer roles to applicant from any nationality or background. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard nationality requirements (opens in a new window).

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants. The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria. The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

Diversity and Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window) and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window). As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&I. You can see how we process this data here: Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK.

title: Architect/Surveyor
description:
**Summary**

Historic England is the public organisation that brings new life to heritage to build a better future for every place and everyone.

Historic England has a fantastic opportunity for a Architect/Surveyor.

**This is a part time (0.8 FTE), maternity cover contract.**

Salary is £40,778 - £41,400 pro-rata

The location of this role is Birmingham, inclusive with hybrid working.

We offer a wide benefits package including a competitive defined benefit **pension scheme to which we make 28.97% employer contributions,** a generous 28 days holiday, corporate discounts, free entry into English Heritage sites across the country and development opportunities to ensure you achieve your goals.

To view our full range of benefits please follow the link [here](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/employee-rewards-and-benefits/).

**What you will be doing**

To undertake the assessment of applications for grant-aided and Heritage at Risk projects, including examining and assessing specifications and drawings, and recommending appropriate action.

To take responsibility for the Historic England input into programmes of work at Heritage at Risk sites, supporting area-based grants in conservation area, and other priority places, working creatively with partners to advise and recommend actions on repair and alteration.

To work proactively with owners, local authorities, funding bodies and building preservation trusts to promote a sustainable and viable future for historic assets on the Heritage at Risk Register and help to encourage and facilitate applications for grant-aid, liaising with professional advisers as required.

To act as intelligent client in relation to the provision of feasibility studies, options appraisals, specialist advice, cost estimates and contractual arrangements.

To monitor grant-aided or commissioned work to confirm that it meets the necessary standard, recommend grant payments, and to undertake post-grant monitoring.

In support of Historic England’s placemaking agenda, to provide architectural and urban design advice to maximise the role of the historic environment in areas of change.

To provide urban design and technical advice to members of other regional teams (Development Advice, Listing, Business Management), including advising on statutory action in relation to listed buildings, drawing on national Technical Conservation Team colleagues as necessary.

To be an effective advocate of the benefits for local places of constructive conservation and to champion the work of Historic England.

To undertake any other reasonable duties commensurate with the grade and competencies required of the post requested by line management.

**Please note that the role:**

- requires regular travel to sites not serviced by public transport.

- may require visiting/inspecting sites where climbing scaffolding and negotiating confined spaces will be necessary.

Location requirement

You must already be living in Japan with valid work authorization. We are not sponsoring relocation or visa transfers from overseas for this role. Applications from outside Japan will not be considered.

Job Requirements/Responsibilities

  • IaC (Terraform/Pulumi)
  • CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions)
  • Docker + Kubernetes in prod
  • Observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog)
  • 'You build it, you run it'.

Interview Process

  • Screening intro (30 min, video call)
    • Call with an Abbeal Lead Engineer. We qualify your expectations, background, relationship to the craft. No technical quiz — a real conversation. By the end, you know whether we continue together.
  • Tech challenge (3-4 hours)
    • An open project, on your time, due within 5 days. No leetcode disconnected from the actual work. We evaluate your code under real conditions: prompt reading, architecture choices, tests, readability.
  • System design (1 hour video call)
    • You walk us through an architecture you know in depth (a recent project, or an in-house topic). We dig into trade-offs, constraints, pivots. We want to see your depth on a domain you master — not test your cramming.
  • Culture fit (45 min, in-person or video call)
    • With a founder (Sébastien or Vianney). We validate alignment: ownership, quality, client relationship, potential international mobility via Mobbeal. Your moment to ask all the hard questions.
  • References + offer (5-7 days)
    • Currently based in Japan with valid work authorization — no relocation or visa sponsorship from overseas for this role
    • Two technical references called (with your consent). If everything fits, a detailed offer is sent — full package, Mobbeal mobility conditions if applicable, onboarding plan. You have 7 days to decide.

title: Country LPG Operations & LMD Lead
description:
Job Location: Kenya

About the role:

This role oversees the end-to-end physical operations of Sun King’s PAYG LPG business in Kenya, covering supplier intake, bulk transport, depot management, cylinder asset lifecycle, shop replenishment, and last-mile delivery.

In parallel, the role will develop scalable Last Mile Delivery (LMD) capabilities to serve LPG operations today and accommodate additional product categories in the future. The position brings supply chain and asset management, depot infrastructure, and last-mile optimization into one integrated physical operations function.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product and Commercial teams to develop systems, processes, and features that enable the LPG supply chain to scale while maintaining a high standard of last-mile customer service.

1. LPG Supply Management
  • Coordinate LPG sourcing and intake with Commercial teams and supplier partners.
  • Oversee bulk transport from suppliers to refilling points or bulk storage facilities.
  • Maintain safe and timely movement of bulk LPG across the network.
  • Monitor refill turnaround times and maintain supply continuity.
  • Identify supply bottlenecks and implement measures to reduce stock-out risks.
  • Improve bulk transport costs and routing efficiency.
  • Provide market and operational insights to Commercial and Business Unit teams to inform supplier price negotiations.
  • Maintain continuous and safe LPG availability across the Sun King network.
2. Inventory Planning & Replenishment
  • Manage the flow of LPG-related inventory, including cookstoves, cylinders, FMCDs, accessories, and LPG, from suppliers to depots and shops.
  • Establish and monitor inventory levels across depots and shops.
  • Define and implement safety stock policies.
  • Minimize stock-outs while maintaining efficient working capital utilization.
  • Develop replenishment planning frameworks aligned with customer demand.
  • Coordinate demand forecasting with Sales teams.
  • Maintain service continuity while optimizing working capital.
3. Depot Infrastructure Management
  • Develop standardized layouts for cooking-related depots and shops.
  • Establish depot capacity benchmarks, including cylinder storage capacity and throughput limits.
  • Maintain compliance with safe storage standards.
  • Establish effective segregation of empty and full cylinders, including designated quarantine zones.
  • Improve depot workflows to reduce handling time.
  • Establish throughput targets for each depot.
4. Asset Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain cylinder tracking and visibility across markets.
  • Improve monthly cylinder working capital efficiency.
  • Ensure that more than 97% of assets recovered through repossession are redeployed.
  • Reduce asset shrinkage and the proportion of idle assets.
  • Manage the cylinder recertification pipeline.
  • Improve turnaround times from empty-cylinder collection to redeployment.
  • Maximize asset productivity and capital efficiency.
5. LPG Last Mile Delivery Performance
  • Improve rider productivity and delivery service quality.
  • Optimize delivery routing and geographic density.
  • Monitor and reduce cost per delivery.
  • Improve adherence to service-level requirements.
  • Optimize fleet utilization.
  • Improve LPG delivery performance and cost-to-serve efficiency.
6. Operational Safety & Compliance
  • Ensure compliance with depot storage requirements and safety limits.
  • Maintain adherence to rider safety protocols.
  • Coordinate incident investigations and follow-up actions.
  • Conduct depot safety audits and monitor corrective actions.
  • Maintain safe bulk LPG handling processes across operations.
7. Integrated LMD Infrastructure Across Product Categories
  • Develop scalable last-mile delivery infrastructure that can serve LPG and additional product categories, including inverters, mobile phones, and solar products distributed through agent stock points.
  • Develop a scalable last-mile operating model that accommodates LPG and future product categories.
  • Establish common routing frameworks and rider productivity standards.
  • Develop fleet utilization models across product categories.
  • Define cost-per-stop economics to guide distribution planning.
  • Standardize field performance management practices across the network.
8. Team Development & Capacity Building
  • Manage and develop multi-country LMD teams, building the capabilities required for scalable operations.
  • Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) to enable consistent execution and business growth.
  • Coordinate recruitment and training for depot, logistics, and LMD teams.
  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, and safety.
9. Financial & Performance Ownership
  • Oversee operational performance indicators including: LPG availability and stock-out percentage, Bulk transport costs, Depot throughput efficiency, Cylinder working capital, Cost per delivery, and Inventory loss percentage.
  • Develop and manage LMD operational budgets.
  • Monitor cost-to-serve metrics and distribution unit economics.
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities across transport, storage, and handling.
  • Establish relevant KPIs for the in-country team and monitor progress against targets.
  • Provide regular reports and evidence-based recommendations to senior management on delivery optimization strategies.
  • A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Finance, IT, or a related field.
  • Experience in LPG, downstream oil and gas, or FMCG distribution.
  • Strong knowledge of last-mile distribution networks and experience scaling operations in emerging markets.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including successful delivery of process improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with minimal supervision.
  • Experience monitoring and evaluating the impact of operational changes on delivery efficiency and rider productivity.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience managing cross-border teams and developing team capabilities across multiple markets.
  • Strong data interpretation and financial skills, with the ability to use operational information to inform business choices.
  • Familiarity with regulatory bodies, such as Energy Regulatory Authorities, is preferred.
  • Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high-social-impact industry
  • An open-minded, collaborative culture with enthusiastic colleagues driven by the challenge of innovation and making a profound impact on people and the planet.
  • A truly multicultural experience: you will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds.
  • Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun King Center for Leadership.

We place great importance on sustaining a diverse, inclusive work environment.

We believe that innovation and understanding comes from diversity on every spectrum. We work to make sure every Sun King team member knows that they belong, knowing that sustaining an inclusive workplace requires conscious effort and is a continuous journey, not an end-state.

Sun King recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes people based on their experience, skills, effort, and results. We explicitly prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, religion, caste, national origin, color, gender, marital status, family structure, sexual orientation, HIV/AIDS status, or disability.

title: PMO Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager Company Overview At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.

Role Overview

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing and executing Brownfield projects from early conceptual stages through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, start-up, performance testing, and contract closeout. This role provides leadership to high-performing project teams and maintains full accountability for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and customer satisfaction in alignment with contract requirements and Mitsubishi Power performance standards.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage a single large-scale project exceeding $200M or a portfolio of Power Generation projects, including leadership of project teams.
  • Communicate project health, risks, and status to stakeholders, customers, sponsors, and senior leadership.
  • Capture and document lessons learned and provide summary briefings as required.
  • Identify project risks, issues, and opportunities through detailed contract analysis and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Develop the project baseline income statement using approved estimates, pricing, and Division of Responsibility (DOR) splits.
  • Provide regular cost reporting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Oversee development and execution of integrated project schedules including critical path activities.
  • Ensure appropriate resource allocation and execution against baseline plans.
  • Support development of recovery plans when project deviations occur.
  • Lead scope expansion initiatives and develop change order technical, pricing, and execution strategies.
  • Direct all phases of assigned projects using established project management methodologies, tools, and quality standards.
  • Manage formal change control across scope, cost, schedule, performance, and configuration.
  • Provide timely performance feedback and support conflict resolution within project teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of project management practices and adoption of new processes.
  • Contribute to proposal development and bid support activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Project Excellence Manager
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical field; minimum 11 years of experience managing large power generation projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects exceeding $200M in value.
  • PMP certification preferred but not required.
  • Strong ability to analyze technical, contractual, and financial information.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills including cost, risk, and performance evaluation.
  • Advanced reasoning and problem-solving capabilities in complex project environments.
  • Proficiency with project management, scheduling, spreadsheet, word processing, and technical documentation software.
Why Should You Apply?
  • Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).
  • Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement and on-the-job training.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
  • Committed to quality products and services.
  • Great working environment and culture.
  • Employee Appreciation Programs and Event.

Mitsubishi Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: İkinci El Oto Ekspertiz Uzmanı - Kanyon AVM
description:
VavaCars'ta biz sadece bir teknoloji şirketi değiliz. Bizler, Türkiye'deki otomotiv sektöründe devrim yaratmaya kararlı, kullanılmış otomobil endüstrisinde vizyoner, yenilikçi ve öncüleriz. Şirketimiz, derin bir bağlılık, proaktif inisiyatif ve girişimci ruh kültürüyle büyümektedir. Çalışanlarımız sadece bir iş yapmıyor, sınırları zorluyor ve normları çiğniyor. Pratik, departmanlar arası işbirliğinin gücüne ve sadece kendi sektörümüzde değil, ötesinde statükoya meydan okumanın gücüne inanıyoruz.

Mesleki geçmişiniz, eğitim geçmişiniz veya sektörünüz ne olursa olsun, istisnai bir çalışma geçmişiniz ve yenilik tutkunuz varsa, sizi ekibimizde görmek isteriz. VavaCars'ta mesele sadece ne yaptığınız değil, neler yapabildiğinizdir.

Otomotiv endüstrisinin geleceğini yeniden tanımlarken bu heyecan verici yolculukta bize katılın. İşimiz sadece araba alıp satmak değil,

insanların kullanılmış araba pazarını nasıl algıladıklarını yeniden şekillendiren benzersiz bir kullanıcı deneyimi yaratmak. Sadece oyunu değiştirmiyoruz - yeni bir oyun yaratıyoruz.

Kariyerinizi hızlı şeride yönlendirmeye hazır mısınız? VavaCars yolculuğuna bugün başlayın!

OPERASYON

Alanında uzman ekspertizler, mekanik teknisyenleri, üretim çalışanları ve operasyon profesyonellerinin yer aldığı küresel bir ekibe katılın ve gezegenin en çeşitli araçlarını yenileyin.

Requirements

VavaCars'ta İkinci El Oto Ekspertiz Uzmanı pozisyonundan ne beklenir:

Araçların kaporta ve mekanik aksamına dair detaylı incelemeler yapar, gerekli fotoğraf ve raporları düzenleyerek bilgi akışına katkıda bulunur, VavaCars araç parkında hedeflenen kalite seviyesinin yakalanmasını sağlar.

  • VavaCars’ın standartlarına uygun bir şeklide araçların ekspertiz süreçlerini yürütmek
  • Araçların kaporta kondisyonunu incelemek, orijinal dışı herhangi bir onarım, boya, değişim olup olmadığını tespit etmek
  • Araçların mekanik aksamını ve elektronik donanımlarını kontrol ederek, bakım ihtiyacı veya aktif arızaların tespit edilmesi
  • Aracın VavaCars sistemlerinde kayıtlı olan versiyon/donanım/paket/opsiyon gibi değişken bilgilerini kontrol etmek, varsa önceki ekspertiz bilgileri ile karşılaştırmak, eksiklik ve/veya farklılıkları tespit etmek
  • Araçların ilk ekspertizleri ile ortaya çıkan her türlü farklılıkların değerlendirmesini yapmak.
  • Sürecin gerektirdiği tüm ölçümleme ve fotoğraflama işlemlerini gerçekleştirmek
  • Araç anahtar sayısı, dijital ekipmanları, yedek lastik, avadanlık ve kilitli bijon gibi detayları kontrol etmek

Bize ne katacaksın?

  • 3 yıl ve üzeri ikinci el araç ekspertiz deneyimi
  • Otomobil kaporta ve mekanik aksamları konusunda bilgi ve tecrübe sahibi (Boyalı yüzey/değişen parça kontrolü, mekanik arıza tespiti, diagnoz)
  • Ekspertiz süreçlerinde gerekli ekipmanı kullanabilen (Boya kalınlığı ölçüm cihazı, diagnostik test cihazları)
  • B sınıfı sürücü belgesi ve temiz sürüş kaydı
  • Teknolojiye yatkın, iyi seviyede bilgisayar ve tablet kullanabilen
  • Gelişime ve değişime açık

Biz Kimiz?

VavaCars olarak, Türkiye'de ikinci el araç alım satım işlemleri için bir platformdan daha fazlasıyız; otomotiv endüstrisinde devrim yaratıyoruz. Misyonumuz, otomobil alım satım deneyimini sorunsuz, şeffaf ve güvenilir bir sürece dönüştürmektir.

Sadelik, şeffaflık ve rahatlığa öncelik vererek, müşterilerimizin evlerinin rahatlığında çevrimiçi olarak arabalara göz atmalarını, değerlendirmelerini ve satın almalarını mümkün kıldık. Kapsamlı hizmetlerimiz sadece işlemlerin ötesine geçiyor, VavaServis ve VavaGaraj gibi girişimlerle, bakımdan lastik satın almaya kadar araçla ilgili her türlü ihtiyacı karşılıyor, kullanıcılarımıza stressiz bir deneyim sağlıyoruz.

2019'daki lansmanımızdan bu yana, VavaCars yalnızca binlerce otomobilin ticaretini başarıyla yapmakla kalmadı, aynı zamanda müşterilerin, küresel sponsorların ve yatırımcıların güvenini kazandı. Sadece istisnai hizmet sunmaya değil, sürekli yenilik yapmaya ve mümkün olanın sınırlarını zorlamaya inanıyoruz.

Başarımızın temelinde özverili ve deneyimli Vavan ekibimiz yer almaktadır. Büyümeye ve pazarı yeniden tanımlamaya devam ederken, inovasyon yolculuğumuza katılmaya hazır, ileri görüşlü bireyleri aramızda görmeyi dört gözle bekliyoruz. VavaCars'ta mesele sadece başardıklarımız değil, birlikte inşa ettiğimiz çığır açıcı bir gelecek. Sizi işbirliği fırsatlarını keşfetmeye ve heyecan verici devrimimizin bir parçası olmaya davet ediyoruz.

Benefits

Benzersiz ve heyecan verici bir paket sunuyoruz - yerel otomobil alanında böyle bir şey denenmedi ve en iyisini istiyoruz. Rekabetçi bir paket ve çalışan mutluluğuna odaklanan bir kültür sunuyoruz.

  • Performans bonusu
  • Bireysel özel sağlık sigortası
  • Ulaşım desteği
  • Yemek ücreti
  • Sıcak bir çalışma ortamı ve sosyal etkinlikler
  • Müşteri Merkezimiz Levent lokasyonludur.

title: Project Officer - Externally Funded Projects
description:

Historic England have multiple opportunities for you to join us as our Project Officers - Externally Funded Projects. - Midlands.

**These roles are Fixed-term contract until March 2030.**

- Proven experience of internal and external stakeholder engagement

title: Federal Project Manager
description:
Stanley Consultants is an award-winning and industry-leading global consulting engineering firm, with an unmatched commitment to culture, values, and ethics. We are dedicated to client experience and solve the most complex challenges to create a sustainable, connected, and enriched world for all. As the world changes, Stanley strategically evolves with it, integrating the latest technology, innovation, and resiliency practices.
 
With over a century of experience serving the energy, federal government, transportation, and water sectors, we have helped improve lives and shape the infrastructure systems that connect us. As an employee-owned organization with a People First approach, we stand apart from other engineering consulting and services firms. At Stanley, your voice counts, your growth matters, and your success is our success.
 
Stanley Consultants offers flexible work options, competitive pay and great benefits, a strong sense of community, and the chance to build a meaningful, long-term career!

What You Will Be Doing:
Participate in project scoping calls, costing and proposal preparation, interviews, and fee negotiations to the extent required.
Plan, organize, communicate, and coordinate project engagements.
Manage the day-to-day activities of project engagements including Client and Project Design Teams.
Review assigned projects after award to define project scope, determine work procedures/sequences, and develop schedules, budgets, staffing, and progress billing points.
Prepare project opening orders, project outlines, project initiation activities, project schedules, and lead project executions and closings.
Form and manage a Project Design Team (including outside subconsultants), and ensure responsibilities are assigned and the execution of tasks is completed according to the project scope, schedule, budget, risk constraints, and quality control requirements.
Lead and work closely with all disciplines on multi-discipline projects.
Make recommendations on design alternatives.
Organize, manage, and maintain project information and records.
Achieve project performance established for the engagement.
Achieve project objectives including quality, scopes, budgets, and schedules.
Maintain a continuing business relationship with clients as part of ongoing business development efforts.
Meet with client management as necessary to resolve issues and to obtain approvals throughout the project lifespan.
Assist in the coordination of pricing, estimating, scoping, and marketing strategies for proposed projects.
Perform as a civil engineering technical design SME when needed.

Required Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Architecture from an accredited four-year college or university.
Current U.S. Professional Engineer (PE) or Architecture license.
Must have experience with International Building Code (IBC), Department of Defense (DoD) Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), and Unified Facilities Guide Specifications (UFGS). OCONUS military planning and design experience a plus.
Must be willing and able to travel in the Indo-Pacific region – approximately 15% total travel per year.
Demonstrated capabilities and success in managing medium-to-large projects.
Ability to manage members from multi-offices and multiple projects concurrently.
Ability to lead both in-person and virtual teams.
Thorough understanding of inter-disciplinary design coordination.
General knowledge of construction techniques and an ability to read plans and specifications. Obtain a Common Access Card.
Pass a ten-year criminal background check as required by our Federal clients.
Read, write, and speak English fluently.
Available and willing to work flexible hours and occasional overtime.
Travel throughout the region, commonly on flights that are 10+ hours in duration, without issue.

Work-Life BalanceWe realize there’s more to life than just work. We help you meet the demands of work, family and personal life through several flexible options.
 
What we offer:
Member-Owned. Member-ownership is at the heart of our culture, aligning client satisfaction, company performance, and personal reward.
Paid Time Away. Stanley Consultants offers numerous paid holidays, generous paid time off (PTO), parental leave, and professional development leave.
Health Insurance. We provide a comprehensive insurance package including medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, Doctor On Demand, wellness reimbursement, and mental health resources.
Financial Health. We offer life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, identity theft protection, and many other benefits.
Professional Growth. When your skills grow, so do we, which is why we offer tuition assistance, professional society membership, and more.
Financial Rewards. We share our prosperity with members through company stock ownership, a generous 401K match, incentive compensation, and profit-sharing contributions to retirement 401K plans.

title: CEO / Business Co-Founder (f/m/d) role at startup IXPLAIN
description:
IXPLAIN
Kaiserslautern, Germany (DFKI) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Explainable AI

About iXplain
iXplain is an AI platform for time series analysis that doesn't just detect what is happening in sensor data, but explains why. It combines state-of-the-art machine learning (classification, forecasting, regression, anomaly detection) with Explainable AI and a neuro-symbolic rule engine to turn raw industrial signals into clear, actionable recommendations, already demonstrated in water quality monitoring, energy grids and automotive production.

**The opportunity
**iXplain grew out of DFKI (German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence) and has a functional demonstrator, shown at Hannover Messe 2025, with live discussions underway in the water and manufacturing sectors. The technology is proven; the company is not yet founded. We are looking for a CEO / Business co-founder to turn a validated research demonstrator into a company, own the commercial relationship with our first industrial partners, and build the business around technology our 3-person research team has already built.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up
- Lead the incorporation of iXplain as a company and define its go-to-market strategy and business model.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations for the seed stage.
Commercial validation
- Validate iXplain with real industrial partners in water, energy and automotive/manufacturing, turning early discussions (post-Hannover Messe 2025) into paying pilots.
- Define how iXplain integrates into customers' existing workflows and systems.
Business leadership
- Build the commercial organization, pricing and sales process from scratch alongside the technical co-founders (Dr. Dominique Mercier, CTO; Dr. Tobias Wirth, Advisor).
- Represent iXplain to investors, partners and industrial customers as CEO.

Requirements

What you bring

Core experience
- Entrepreneurial / business leadership experience, ideally as a founder or in early-stage B2B SaaS or industrial-tech commercialization.
- Track record in business development and closing deals with industrial or enterprise customers.
- Comfortable operating without a playbook, pre-product-market-fit.
Especially valuable
- Domain expertise in water, energy, or automotive/manufacturing industries.
- Experience fundraising from VCs or deep-tech grants (e.g., EXIST, German public funding).
- Ability to speak the language of both data-science researchers and industrial buyers.

Benefits

Why join iXplain
- Own the CEO seat of a deep-tech AI company with a working, demonstrated product, not a slide deck.
- Backed by DFKI's research and IP in Explainable AI and neuro-symbolic reasoning.
- Equity-based co-founder role with real influence on strategy, hiring and company direction from day one.

iXplain welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
Bid Coordinator

Leeds

About us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About the office

We have an opportunity for a Bid Coordinator to play a key role in delivering high quality, sustainable solutions across multiple built-environment projects.

You will join our team based in our Leeds office.

We have a well-established reputation for delivering outstanding design on built environment projects throughout the North. Located in the heart of the city, we're placed to take advantage of opportunities both locally and further afield, we have a rich project history within Leeds and a strong commitment to the region.

We are a recognised leader in the built environment, shaping some of the most ambitious and technically demanding projects across the residential, hospitality, leisure, commercial, and complex engineering sectors.

Our work spans cutting edge healthcare and research facilities, high-performance data centres, critical infrastructure and state-of-the-art manufacturing and technology environments projects that push boundaries and deliver real-world impact.

Driven by a commitment to excellence, we combine innovation, technical expertise, and practical delivery to create solutions that are not only robust and reliable, but forward-thinking and sustainable. Our teams work at the forefront of the industry, collaborating with leading clients across the public and private sectors, both locally and internationally.

About the role

This is a coordination role positioned at the top end of bid and proposal delivery, sitting close to bid writing and bid management responsibilities. It offers the opportunity to take on greater ownership, work on more complex submissions, and develop into a Bid Manager role over time.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring that opportunities are well-managed, bids are professionally delivered, and our teams are supported to perform at their best. Alongside this, you’ll gain exposure to high-value, multi-disciplinary bids, providing a strong platform for progression.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being hands-on, is ready to step up in responsibility, and wants to build a long-term career in work-winning and bid management.

In this role, you can expect to:

Regional Bid Coordination (Primary Focus)

•    Contribute to and coordinate the preparation and submission of proposals and bids within the Leeds office and wider North Business Unit (Manchester, Glasgow and Edinburgh).

•    Manage workflows and documentation (SharePoint, filing systems) to ensure structured delivery

•    Ensure submissions are compliant, well-presented, and aligned to Hoare Lea standards

•    Maintain strong document control, version management, and organisation

Opportunity & CRM Management

•    Manage and maintain opportunity data within our CRM system (Co-Op)

•    Open and structure opportunities at early stages

•    Work proactively with work winners to gather and complete key information

•    Support pipeline visibility, reporting, and forecasting

Bid Support

•    Support the coordination of priority bids

•    Assist with timelines, inputs, and multi-disciplinary collaboration

•    Contribute to content development, structuring responses, and shaping submissions

•    Provide additional support on key pursuits where required

Communication & Collaboration

•    Act as a central coordination point across bid teams

•    Ensure submissions are followed up and outcomes recorded

•    Capture and share client feedback to support continuous improvement

•    Represent the North Region within the firmwide bid community

Business Development Support

•    Attend internal key work-winning and forecast meetings

•    Support client events, local industry events and engagement activities where required

•    Assist with follow-up actions to maintain momentum post-submission

•    Use market research tools and platforms to inform business development activities across the North Business Unit.

Digital & Continuous Improvement

•    Use CRM and digital tools effectively to support delivery

•    Embrace emerging tools, including AI, to improve efficiency and quality

•    Contribute to improved and consistent ways of working

About you

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

•    Experience or ambition to work in a bid coordination or proposal role, ideally within construction, engineering, or consultancy

•    A clear desire and capability to progress into bid writing or bid management roles

•    Confidence working on, or readiness to step into, more complex or higher-value submissions

•    Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities

•    Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

•    High attention to detail and pride in producing quality work.

How to apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application, or for further information please contact aureliacherradi@hoarelea.com

If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.

Adjustments and accommodations

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to help you participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence or anything else) please let us know.

Data privacy

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click here to find out more.

Recruitment agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners who assist us when required. We do not acknowledge speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Kiro

The future of software development is agentic. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Konsulentbistand analyse hendelses- og problemhåndtering
description:
BAKGRUNN

Digdir forvalter og utvikler samfunnskritiske digitale fellesløsninger som Altinn og ID-porten. Fellesløsningene benyttes av virksomheter i offentlig sektor (inkludert kommuner og fylkeskommuner), innbyggere og næringsliv. Fellesløsninger kan sees på som byggeklosser som offentlige virksomheter kan dra nytte av i sin digitale tjenesteproduksjon. Løsningene utvikles sentralt for å dekke felles behov hos brukervirksomhetene. Ved å bruke fellesløsninger kan offentlige virksomheter gjenbruke både funksjonalitet og informasjon. Samtidig kan bruk av fellesløsninger bidra til at tjenestene blir mer gjenkjennbare for brukerne, bidra til økt utbredelse og effektiv ressursbruk.

Den sikkerhetspolitiske situasjonen gjør at norske virksomheter står overfor alvorlige sikkerhetsutfordringer. Situasjonen utgjør en sikkerhetsrisiko for offentlige virksomheter som benytter fellesløsningene i sin tjenesteproduksjon. Digdirs fellesløsninger er under angrep og skadepotensialet for et vellykket angrep er stort. I lys av en stadig endret sikkerhetssituasjon må Digdir være forberedt på at løsningene kan rammes av mer alvorlige sikkerhetstruende hendelser enn vi har erfart så langt. For å beskytte løsningene må det iverksettes nye og skjerpede sikkerhetstiltak og man må bruke vesentlig større ressurser på å holde de oppdaterte og redusere sårbarheter etter hvert som de blir oppdaget. Det må tas høyde for scenarioer som for få år siden virket utenkelige. Det er behov for å styrke forvaltningsorganisasjonen for fellesløsningene i Digdir. Resultatet av analysen som ønskes utført skal bidra med anbefalinger for organisering og videreutvikling av beredskap, hendelses- og problemhåndtering for fellesløsningene.

RESULTATER OG EFFEKTER Digdir ØNSKER Å OPPNÅ:

Det ønskes gjennomført en analyse som gir Digdir et godt beslutningsgrunnlag for å styrke hendelses-, problem- og kontinuitetshåndteringen for de digitale fellesløsningene. Analysen skal vurdere dagens organisering og praksis, identifisere vesentlige gap og anbefale et prioritert målbilde og en gjennomføringsplan.

Analysen skal svare på følgende hovedspørsmål:

Hvordan kan beredskapen for Digdirs fellesløsninger, herunder hendelses- og problemhåndteringen, styrkes i lys av en endret sikkerhetssituasjon?

For å belyse hovedspørsmålet ønsker vi at analysen også vurderer:

  • Hvordan forvaltningsorganisasjonen er innrettet i dag, og om roller, ansvar, kapasitet, kompetanse og arbeidsprosesser er tilpasset dagens trusselbilde.

  • Hvordan Digdir håndterer avhengigheter til leverandører og underleverandører, og hvilken risiko slike avhengigheter innebærer for fellesløsningene.

  • Hvordan driftskontinuitet og evne til gjenoppretting kan sikres dersom en eller flere fellesløsninger rammes av alvorlige hendelser.

  • Hvordan Digdir samhandler med relevante myndigheter og sektorer ved hendelser, og hvordan denne samhandlingen kan styrkes.

  • Om øvelser, opplæring og læring etter hendelser er tilstrekkelige, og hvordan disse kan videreutvikles.

  • Hvordan gjeldende krav i regelverket, for eksempel sikkerhetsloven, digital sikkerhetsloven, NIS2 og relevante EU-krav, ivaretas i forvaltningen av fellesløsningene.

SSA-O ligger til grunnlag for oppdraget.

Omfang og varighet: snarest mulig. Estimert oppstartsdato: 15.10.2026- oppdraget kan egne seg for et team av ressurser.

Fris for leveranse: 15.12.2026.

Arbeidssted: Teamet kan arbeide fra eget arbeidssted.

Søknadsfrist: 25.9

title: Heat Networks Policy Officer
description:
**This is an Expression of Interest (EOI) opportunity, available on a lateral move basis only. Applications are open to Core Scottish Government employees only****.

**Business Area/Directorate** - Heat Networks Regulation Team

**Location** - AQ / VQ

**Working Arrangement** – Staff in roles compatible with hybrid working should aim to spend 40% of their contracted working time working in person at their contractual workplace. More information can be found within [Hybrid Working Policy](https://scotsconnect.sharepoint.com/sites/saltireredirect?siteId=mylifeandcareer&pageId=8c5a454f-11b6-4349-a97e-96ba6acf3f51&pageParams=working-in-person-hybrid-working)

**Job description**

Do you want to help Scotland achieve its net zero commitments, deliver a just heat decarbonisation and release our economic potential?This is an exciting and rewarding role in a high priority policy area that offers the chance to contribute to decarbonising our energy system as a crucial part of our journey to net zero

We have an opportunity for a B2 Policy Official to join the Heat Networks Regulations team on a temporary basis to support the implementation of secondary legislation for heat network regulations, through the Heat in Buildings Bill and Heat Networks (Scotland) Act 2021. This is an ideal development opportunity for someone looking to broaden their experience in primary and secondary legislation.

**Responsibilities**

- Work flexibly with colleagues across the Division and beyond to contribute and lead on the ongoing development of policy and delivery approaches for Heat in Buildings.
- Supporting the team to ensure the proposed new heat network regulations are delivered within agreed timelines.
- Supporting the delivery of secondary legislation associated with the Heat in Buildings Bill and Heat Networks (Scotland) Act 2021.
- Maintain key stakeholder relationships with external organisations, relevant departments of other UK administrations and across Scottish Government to progress relevant policy and regulatory proposals, including developing and supporting possible public consultations on future legislation.
- Supporting on corporate tasks across the Division, including working on Ministerial submissions, Ministerial correspondence cases, Parliamentary Questions, Freedom of Information requests and to maintain relevant core briefs.

Success profiles are specific to each job and they include the mix of skills, experience and behaviours candidates will be assessed on, you should provide evidence of how you meet these in your statement.

**Experience:**

**Technical / Professional Skills:**

1. Participation and Engagement – Level 1: Developing
2. Policy Delivery and Systems – Level 1: Developing

You can find out more about the skills required here - [Policy Profession Standards - Annex](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6246c68de90e075f08be4229/UPDATED_PP_Standards_annex_v6_acc.pdf)

**Behaviours:**

- Working Together – Level 3

You can find out more about Success Profiles on gov.scot.

**Working pattern**

This post is a full-time role, but we welcome applications from staff with different working patterns, proposed working patterns will be assessed against the business requirements for this post.

Our standard hours are 35 hours per week and we offer a range of flexible working options depending on the needs of the role, including Flexi-leave. Scottish Government staff in hybrid-compatible roles should aim to work in-person 40% of the time, either in an office or other agreed work location.

**Further information**

Further information about this opportunity is available from [jacob.greenhalgh@gov.scot](mailto:jacob.greenhalgh@gov.scot)

Please submit an Expression of Interest (maximum 500 words) outlining your suitability for the role, relevant skills and experience, and what you would bring to the team. Please align this to how you meet the behaviours, experience and technical skills listed in the Success Profile above.

_Vacancies close at 23:59pm on Monday 28 September._

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Please see our[candidate guidance](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/use-of-ai-tools/) for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

Interviews are expected to be scheduled for w/c TBC.

Our staff are part of the [UK Civil Service](https://www.ukcivilservicejobs.co.uk/about-us/) observing the Civil Service Codeand working for Ministers and senior stakeholders to deliver vital public services which improve the lives of the people of Scotland.

title: Principal Researcher - A Fairer Start
description:
**We are hiring a Principal Researcher - A Fairer Start**

**About Nesta**

We are Nesta, the UK’s innovation agency for social good. We design, test and scale solutions to society’s biggest problems. Our three missions are to give every child a fair start; help people live healthy lives; and create a sustainable future.

For over 20 years, we have worked to support, encourage and inspire innovation. We work in three roles: as an innovation partner working with frontline organisations to design and test new solutions; as a venture builder supporting new and early stage businesses; and as a system shaper creating the conditions for innovation.

Harnessing the rigour of science and the creativity of design, we work relentlessly to change millions of lives for the better. Find out more at [www.nesta.org.uk](http://www.nesta.org.uk)

**About A Fairer Start mission**

We want every child to have the fairest possible start in life, so they can thrive and realise their potential.  Nesta’s A Fairer Start Mission is on a 10-year endeavour to ensure that from 2030 every child has the same chance of developing to their full potential in the early years.

We will work towards this goal by:

- supporting the development of a well-functioning ecosystem of effective parenting interventions

- designing, testing and scaling ways improve financial support for families

- identifying ways to improve the quality of early childhood education and care

- optimising the delivery of integrated family support

- advocating for a more impactful, sustained and efficient early years funding system.


**As a Principal Researcher, you will:**

- Work alongside a talented team of 30 with an unusual blend of skills - ranging from data analytics and behavioural science to design and communications

- Play a key role in undertaking high-quality and innovative research to inform our approach to reducing early childhood inequalities, including helping to shape government policy

- Manage some projects, and on others, be the methodological lead for work involving complex quantitative analysis, especially those using causal inference, and/or cost-benefit analysis


- Make judgements on the trade-off between robustness and pace in our research activities, on a case-by-case basis

- Supervise and mentor junior researchers/analysts and quality assure their work

- Support the development of the team’s subject and methodological expertise

- Disseminate research findings to relevant stakeholders, including government and other prominent organisations working on the early years

- Contribute to the mission’s strategic thinking through your knowledge of the evidence base and analysis of existing datasets

- Have opportunities to collaborate with and learn from other researchers in the team, as well as others with research, data science, behavioural science and design expertise across other teams at Nesta

- Model a caring, high challenge, high support culture in our team


You will report to one of the members of the AFS Mission Leadership Team. This is a fixed term position based in London.

**Candidate criteria**

**Essential**

We are looking for people who understand what we do, share our values and are keen to learn and develop their expertise. We are looking for candidates with the skills listed below.

- **Qualifications and experience:** You have PhD or equivalent professional experience in a quantitative discipline - for example: economics, statistics, social and public policy (quantitative), or a related discipline. You have experience working with public-sector stakeholders or a demonstrable interest in public policy, and in doing research with practical implications.

- **Technical skills:** You haveexpertise in a range of quantitative methods. Ideally, you are an expert in both non-experimental methods (e.g. theory and practice of regression analysis and quasi-experiments) and randomised-controlled trials.

- **Data analysis:** You have a proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g. Python, R, Stata, Julia), and are willing to learn Python if this is not already the language you use.

- **Domain knowledge:** You have experience working in early years, education, highly related public policy or a related sector

- **Research management:** You have practical experience of developing research proposals and analysis plans involving administrative and large-scale survey data and/or randomised-controlled trials.

- **Project management:** You have a track record of managing research projects, potentially involving multiple partners, and pushing them forward to completion. This includes managing timelines, staffing and project budgets.

- **Written communication:** You have excellent written and oral communication skills, especially in communicating the value of technical concepts and analysis to non-technical audiences.

- **Line management:** You have a capacity and willingness to manage and develop junior colleagues (the current incumbent manages one direct report).

- **Time management:** You are able to manage and develop yourself at work; you demonstrate high levels of initiative, and take responsibility for your own workload and development. You have experience working in multidisciplinary teams

- **Mindset:** You have a collaborative and solution-focused approach to problem solving, and are willing to work flexibly on topics outside of your immediate expertise.


**Desirable:**

- Experience of line management

- Experience of multi-disciplinary working eg with designers or behavioural scientists

- Experience doing research in contexts with non-academic stakeholders

- Experience in designing, running and analysing surveys

- Experience using Git and GitHub (or equivalent) for version control

- Python proficiency or high proficiency in coding other languages with willingness to learn

- Experience conducting qualitative research and analysis, or designing mixed-methods evaluations

- Knowledge and previous use of administrative and survey data sources relevant to early childhood development

- Experience collecting primary data on young children or other vulnerable populations


**What we offer**

**Salary**: £58,500 - £72,800 per annum (offers are expected to be made at the bottom of the band) plus an array of benefits, including private medical insurance, dental insurance, the ability to buy and sell annual leave, eyecare vouchers and more

**Location**: This role is based in London with a hybrid working arrangement; we expect all staff to work from our Blackfriars office at least two days a week.

**Term**: Fixed term, 14 months

**Hours**: This is a full-time role but we offer a range of flexible working arrangements and encourage our people to take advantage of them. Many do.

**Start**: **Early January 2027**

**_Please note:_** _We are looking to appoint one, and potentially two, Principal Researchers, for Nesta’s A Fairer Start mission team. Should we appoint a second Principal Researcher, the Job Description will be consistent with what is set out below, but with a greater focus on commissioning and overseeing evaluations. We will discuss this possibility with any finalists before making a second appointment._

**Making an application**

To apply for this role, please submit your application before **8:00am on Monday 5 October 2027.** Please submit a CV and answer the question on Applied.

**We encourage smart use of AI to help you work efficiently. However, our application questions are your chance to highlight your unique skills and experience. AI-generated answers often sound generic and miss what makes you a great fit. Because we’ll dive deeper into your answers during the interview, we want to hear your authentic voice from the start.**

Successful candidates will be invited to do a technical task. Following this successful candidates will be invited to **an interview, in person (though if a virtual interview is preferred by the applicant this will be accommodated).** We would hope that the technical task will be completedthe first half of the week commencing **12th October** and interviews the subsequent week.

**At Nesta, we believe that a diverse workforce leads to an organisation that is more innovative, more creative and gets better results.**

We want our workforce to represent the diversity of the people and communities we serve. We also want our workplace to be one where different experiences, expertise and perspectives are valued, and where everyone is encouraged to grow and develop.

This means that when we are recruiting, we actively seek to reach a diverse pool of candidates. It also means that we are happy to consider any reasonable adjustments that potential employees may need to in order to be successful.

We recognise the importance of a good balance between work and home life, so we do everything we can to accommodate flexible working, including working from home, compressed or part-time hours, job shares and other arrangements.

Please just let us know in your application or at any stage throughout the process (and beyond) if these are options you’d like to explore.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

Agile Robots SE is a high-tech startup based in Munich. Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI and robotics by developing robotic systems that offer state-of-the-art full-body force sensitivity and world-leading vision intelligence. This unique combination of technologies enables us to provide intelligent, easy-to-use, and affordable robotic solutions with safe human-robot interaction.

We are a dynamic and innovative software development company dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that transform industries and redefine user experiences.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a robust REST API and WebRTC-based communication server running on embedded Linux robot hardware
  • Expose and maintain a well-defined API layer consumed by browser-based clients, either desktop or mobile (layouting)
  • Integrate the backend server with communication middleware (e.g. ROS2) to bridge robot internals and external consumers
  • Own the server architecture end-to-end — including design, deployment, debugging, documentation, and release
  • Ensure API reliability, performance, and security within embedded Linux constraints
  • Collaborate with frontend and robotics software teams on interface contracts and integration
  • Develop both rapid proof-of-concept implementations and production-grade server components

Essential Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field • 5+ years of professional backend development experience
  • Proficient in Python; working knowledge of C++ in a systems or robotics context
  • Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and real-time communication protocols (WebRTC)
  • Experience with communication middleware (e.g. ROS2) and its underlying concepts (pub/sub, services, actions)

title: Front End Engineer, Amazon Security Experiences
description:
Amazon Security Experiences is building the unified security platform for every builder at Amazon. Our product brings together security reviews, issue management, and security metrics into a single, AI-powered experience. If you care deeply about interaction design and the quality of tools that help builders ship secure software, this team is for you.

You will work alongside exceptional senior engineering talent solving hard problems across front-end architecture, enterprise security tooling, and applied AI. You'll learn how to build a product that meets Amazon's high bar for availability, scalability, and security while shipping features that builders notice and love.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact, user-facing features, from technical spec to production

- Drive technical direction for client-side architecture, including micro-frontend composition, shared component libraries, and cross-product design patterns

- Work closely with designers and product managers to ensure every feature meets a high bar for builder UX and interaction quality

- Build and use AI agents to accelerate your own development workflow, and exercise high judgment about when to trust automation versus when the situation demands your direct involvement

- Mentor engineers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow their careers

- Deeply understand customer workflows, how builders conduct security reviews, triage issues, and interpret security metrics, and build backward from their needs

A day in the life
You use AI agents to write code and move fast, and attend design reviews with your PM and designer to keep the builder experience bar high. You own features end to end, from spec to production, for a product actively used by builders across Amazon. You participate in operational reviews, track the metrics that matter, and continuously measure and improve client-side performance. You help onboard new engineers, contribute to roadmap planning, and obsess over every interaction and every millisecond of latency, always choosing the path that serves users best.

About the team
Amazon Security Experiences is a team of engineers who believe the way builders interact with security is about to change permanently, and we are the ones defining that change. We are building a unified, AI-native security platform that brings together security reviews, issue management, and security metrics into a single experience for every builder at Amazon. We care about performance, interaction design, and the small details that make a tool feel fast and effortless. We prototype constantly, experiment boldly, and ship things that surprise and delight our customers. We dogfood our own product every day, which means every improvement we ship makes us more effective too. We have fun doing it, we reinvent how builders think about security, and we are always looking ahead to what comes next. If you want to build tools that make security intuitive, fast, and delightful for every builder at Amazon, this is the team for you.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading a large organization, managing department heads who own data center facility infrastructure including the operational availability of mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems. The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon’s data center platform will challenge you. Our uncompromisingly high standards as we continually seek to innovate on behalf of our customers will push you to new levels of creativity.

At this level, Amazon is unique in that we seek experienced senior leaders who have evolved to be highly strategic in their approach to managing their business unit, yet understand how to lead large teams by example who will not hesitate to roll up their sleeves when tactical needs dictate it.
