- Develop and implement operational strategies that align with AWS's global standards while addressing cluster requirements

- Manage complex multi-stakeholder coordination requirements with internal teams, vendors, and local authorities

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. title: Offshore Wind Policy Officer
description:
**This is an Expression of Interest (EOI) opportunity, available on a lateral move basis only. Applications are open to Core Scottish Government employees only****.**

**Job Title -** Offshore Wind Policy Officer

**Business Area/Directorate** – Offshore Wind Directorate

**Location** – Glasgow or Edinburgh

**Working Arrangement** – Staff in roles compatible with hybrid working should aim to spend 40% of their contracted working time working in person at their contractual workplace. More information can be found within Hybrid Working Policy

**Grade** - B2

**Advert type** – Lateral transfer

**Duration -** Permanent

**Eligibility** - Expressions of Interest are invited from substantive B2 colleagues on level transfer from Core SG only.

**Sponsorship -** Skilled Worker sponsorship is not available for this role. As a result, we are unable to appoint candidates who require Skilled Worker sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must have an existing and ongoing right to work in the UK.

**Overview**

An exciting opportunity has arisen within the Offshore Wind Directorate to be a Policy Officer in the Offshore Wind Policy and Skills Division. This is a varied and rewarding role and will give you the opportunity to gain experience working closely with ministers, senior officials and public and private sector stakeholders to support the development of Scotland’s offshore wind pipeline and marine energy sector.

The postholder will report to a B3 within the Policy Unit.

Overview of Directorate

The Offshore Wind Directorate leads on policy and programmes related to offshore renewables, marine energy and sectoral marine planning, to support the continued growth of the offshore wind sector.

The Directorate’s core aim is to maximise the significant economic benefits from the growth of offshore renewables for Scotland’s economy, citizens and environment as we transition to net zero. We also have a key role in ensuring the balance of economic and environmental objectives, with other users of the marine environment.

We support the development of Scotland’s offshore wind economy by:

- working across the public sector to deploy strategic investment in ports and supply chain that grows our manufacturing base, attracting capital, inward investment, driving economic growth and job creation;
- demonstrating the potential role for marine energy in Scotland’s low carbon energy system;
- delivering enabling programmes e.g. through the Energy Act to streamline consenting, improve regulatory certainty, and accelerate deployment;
- managing the constraints and opportunities of Scotland’s transition to net zero through the sustainable expansion of offshore renewables, enabled by sectoral marine planning that provides clarity, reduces risk, and supports balanced use of the marine space.

**Key responsibilities**

- Support the development of reliable and accurate policy advice to senior officials and Ministers on relevant issues, including briefing, speeches, MiCase correspondence, PQs, and core briefs.
- Support the maintenance and strengthening of stakeholder engagement with key public and private sector organisations.
- Support the development and delivery of future policy priorities and support for offshore renewables.
- Provide advice and guidance, and input into key policy and strategy documents from an offshore wind perspective when required by colleagues across SG.
- Work flexibly across the Offshore Wind Directorate to support priority work as and when it arises.


**Success Profile**

Success profiles are specific to each job and they include the mix of behaviours, experience and technical criteria (if applicable) that candidates will be assessed on.

**Skills:**

- Good planning and organisational skills, with the ability to work to tight deadlines with limited supervision.


- Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to present and communicate ideas and information in a clear and concise way.


- Good analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to organise and collate information from a variety of sources to support decision making.


- Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive and productive working relationships with internal and external colleagues and stakeholders.


**Behaviours (Level 3):**

- Making effective decisions

- Communicating and influencing

- Working together

- Delivering at pace


You can find out more about Success Profiles Behaviours, here: [Behaviour levels - Success profiles: candidate guide](https://www.gov.scot/publications/success-profiles-candidate-guide/pages/behaviour-levels/)

**Working Pattern**

This role is a permanent level transfer position.

This post is a full-time role, but we welcome applications from staff with different working patterns, proposed working patterns will be assessed against the business requirements for this post.

**Further Information**

Further information about this opportunity is available from [Michaela.Wilsonmartincova@gov.scot](mailto:Michaela.Wilsonmartincova@gov.scot) and [Hannah.Chillingworth@gov.scot](mailto:Hannah.Chillingworth@gov.scot)

**How to Apply**

Applications are invited from substantive B2 staff from Core SG for this vacancy.

Please submit your EOI (maximum 500 words) outlining your suitability for the role, relevant skills and experience, and what you would bring to the team. Please align this to how you meet the behaviours, experience and technical skills listed in the Success Profile above.

_Vacancies close at 23:59pm on Tuesday 22 September._

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Please see our[candidate guidance](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/use-of-ai-tools/) for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

**Selection Process**

Applications will be reviewed by panel. Shortlisted candidates who are considered to have the skills and experience will be invited to an informal interview with the hiring manager and another panel member. The panel will recommend the candidate considered most suitable for the post.

If invited for further assessment, this will consist of an informal discussion.

Discussions are scheduled for w/c TBC.

For any questions relating to your expression of interest please contact [Michaela.Wilsonmartincova@gov.scot](mailto:Michaela.Wilsonmartincova@gov.scot) and [Hannah.Chillingworth@gov.scot](mailto:Hannah.Chillingworth@gov.scot)

**Recruitment Principles**

As a government organisation, we adhere to the [Civil Service Commission Recruitment Principles](https://civilservicecommission.independent.gov.uk/document/02a-recruitment-principles-april-2018-final/?d102_cookies_enabled=all) and we investigate any complaints received in relation to recruitment cases.

**About us**

The Scottish Government is the devolved government for Scotland. We have responsibility for a wide range of key policy areas including: education, health, the economy, justice, housing and transport. We offer rewarding careers and employ people across Scotland in a wide range of professions and roles.

Our staff are part of the [UK Civil Service](https://www.civil-service-careers.gov.uk/about-us/) observing the Civil Service Codeand working for Ministers and senior stakeholders to deliver vital public services which improve the lives of the people of Scotland.

We offer a supportive and inclusive working environment along with a wide range of employee benefits. Find out more about [what we offer](https://www.jobs.gov.scot/what-we-offer).

As part of the UK Civil Service, we uphold the [Civil Service Nationality Rules](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/nationality-requirements/).

**Security checks**

Successful candidates must complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), before they can be appointed. BPSS is comprised of four main pre-employment checks – Identity, Right to work, Employment History and a Criminal Record check (unspent convictions).

title: Sr. Specialist, Systems Engineer (Systems/Software)
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Sr. Specialist, Systems Engineer (Systems/Software)**

**Job Code:  44742**

**Job Location:** **Camden, NJ (on-site)**

**Schedule: 9/80 Regular Schedule**(Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off)

**_About L3Harris Technologies – Maritime Power Systems:_**

_L3Harris Technologies Power Systems is an agile defense technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions for the US Navy Shipbuilding programs. With capabilities in ship control systems, manufacturing and turn-key ship overhauls that meet customers’ mission-critical needs._

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

This Systems Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, building and delivering a wide range of safety critical, cybersecure power solutions to military customers. Leading or participation in all stages of the systems/software development life cycle (SDLC).

The System Engineering portion of this role is to ensure the final system meets or exceeds all customer system requirements. The systems portion of this role involves working closely with electrical, mechanical, software and test engineers to capture system requirements and develop traceable contract SDRL documentation, customer specifications and operators’ manuals when required. Also work with Program Managers and Project Engineers to develop proposals, project schedules and participate in customer reviews of design and test artifacts.

The Software Engineering portionof this role involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications and systems. For most products this involves formal software design and test documentation traceable to system requirements.  PS software products require high reliability, safety critical, and cybersecure software operation with built in test features for mission critical power systems and switchgear. Coding effort can span from low level embedded DSP or ARM based controllers previously written in ASM/C/C++ to coding for Human Machine Interface (GUI design) in C# or other GUI based language.

IRAD Development may include hardware and software prototypes for proof-of-concept efforts involving the design and test of new embedded software with built in test features for integration with hardware and support for final qualification testing.

**Essential Functions:**

- Lead and represent the organization on technical aspects of assigned projects, including peer reviews and resolution of difficult technical issues.
- Coordinate system level requirements internally and among subcontractors and suppliers.
- Support evaluating, planning, and estimation of tasks.
- Generate design review materials and communicate design decisions.
- Adhere to budget and schedule commitments.
- Capable of providing technical supervision and training/mentoring to lower-level engineers.
- Develop subsystem architecture artifacts, including block diagrams, functional allocations, interfaces, and timing diagrams.
- Prepare system and subsystem level specifications.
- Generate Test Plans for systems and subsystems to ensure validation of requirements.
- Creation of Documentation in accordance with internal and/or customer standards.
- Risk identification and migration planning.
- Trade-off analysis and strategy.
- Represents organization in providing solutions to difficult technical issues associated with specific projects.
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Systems Engineering design, validation, and qualification processes.
- Comfortable working in a multi-disciplined engineering group to achieve results.
- Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- Travel up to ~10% as needed.
- Ability to obtain and maintain a US Security Clearance.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelors and minimum 6 years prior experience or Master’s Degree with a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
- At least 4 years of experience with systems engineering background, and knowledge of lifecycle and standards.
- At least 2 years of experience with system engineering principles including requirements writing, modeling, and verification testing.
- 2+ years of experience with C programming and familiarity with Assembly.
- 2+ years of experience writing systems and software test procedures.
- At least of 1 year of experience working with systems utilizing embedded software. Up to date on current Systems Engineering trends, technology, and tools (including DOORS and JIRA).
- At least 2 years of experience working through customer requirements to technical requirements to product solutions.
- 1+ year of experience reading PCB designs.
- At least 1 year of experience working with standard system engineering processes such as: MIL-STD-499, EIA-632, IEEE 1220 or ISO 15288.
- At least 1 year of experience writing experience, including experience generating and presenting technical documents to internal and external customers.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Active Secret clearance.
- Experience overseeing the systems/software development life cycle (SDLC).
- Experience with development of high-power electrical devices and interfaces
- Experience with PCB development and test jigs and test utilities for production
- Experience with administering projects using Atlassian JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket
- Experience with embedded processors including ARM, INTEL, TI TMS320 DSP micros
- Experience with JTAG/ICE programming and build versus runtime software image verification methods (CRC, HASH128,256…)
- Experience with various code development tools:
  - Visual Studio IDE
  - Texas Instruments Code Composer Studio IDE
  - Python IDE
  - Keil uVision IDE
  - Intel Quartis FPGA IDE
- Experience administering Software and Systems configuration management Server:
  - Atlassian Jira, Fisheye and Crucible Server and Clients management
  - SVN Server and Clients management
  - PostGRE SQL database
  - IBM DOORs
  - GIT and BitBucket
- Strong ability to communicate at different levels depending upon target audience.  Examples include technical presentations to current customers as well as defense of proposals for future business.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $106,500 - $197,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. title: 2027 Graduate Sustainability Consultant
description:
**2027 Graduate Sustainability Consultant**

**London**

**About Us**

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

**Why Join Us?**

- You’ll collaborate with the industry’s best, working with a wide range of built-environment specialists.
- You’ll be part of progressive and exciting projects from day one, able to experience innovative schemes across all sectors.
- You’ll advance your career, your way, thanks to our structured Career Paths framework.
- You’ll be encouraged through our accredited training and development scheme with a dedicated mentor and supervisor, supporting you to Chartership, if you wish.

**The Role**

Being part of one of the UK’s largest building engineering consultancies, we benefit from collaborating with some of the best engineers in the business, with access to state-of-the-art technical support, and have the opportunity to work on some of the largest and most high-profile projects as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

[Canolfan Pentre Awel](https://hoarelea.com/project-story/canolfan-pentre-awel/) in Carmarthen, [Multi-Megawatt Data Centre Campus](https://hoarelea.com/project-story/multi-megawatt-data-centre-campus/), [Oxford North](https://hoarelea.com/project-story/oxford-north/) in Oxford, [One Piccadilly Gardens](https://hoarelea.com/project-story/one-piccadilly-gardens-manchester/) in Manchester, [Gwynfaen](https://hoarelea.com/project-story/gwynfaen/) in Swansea, and the nature-based net-zero neighbourhood of [Earls Court](https://hoarelea.com/project-story/earls-court/) in London, are examples of some of the amazing projects where we have led the design with other Hoare Lea disciplines.

**As a Graduate Sustainability Consultant,** your day-to-day tasks will vary, as we’ll expose you to all aspects of our work so you can discover what suits you. You could be;

- Working on live projects from day one – [our exciting projects](https://hoarelea.com/projects/)
- In a variety of sectors from healthcare to hotels, retail to residential
- Undertaking building performance simulation and energy related workstreams, using a range of modelling approaches, tools, and techniques
- Developing energy strategies with our clients to lead sustainability innovation on a series of developments
- Assisting in the delivery of environmental assessments (such as BREEAM, WELL, HQM, etc) from early design stages through to completion
- Developing an understanding and knowledge of whole life carbon reporting to support clients Net Zero Carbon strategies
- Undertaking site surveys
- Researching ground-breaking technologies
- Continuous CPD and learning opportunities
- Supporting the development of holistic Sustainability Strategies, where necessary

As well as project-related work, the Group engages directly with industry undertaking research and development studies, and authoring industry guidance. We hold key positions on national design commissions and influential industry bodies. The role also presents the opportunity for involvement in this aspect of the Group’s work to those keen to have a direct influence on the industry.

Communicating will span all of these, as we regularly liaise with project teams, meet clients or end users, and attend collaborative meetings.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, **_you’ll need to be serious about sustainability_**, and have…

- An expected or achieved 2.1 or above degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Architecture, or the Built Environment, or similar
- An appreciation of broader sustainability issues, such as sustainability governance and reporting, sustainability strategies, climate change adaptation, behaviour change, etc.
- Excellent communication, analytical and organisational skills
- Ability to work in a team environment and independently
- A friendly, ambitious and confident individual with a flexible and resilient approach

_It would be an advantage, but not necessary, if you also had…_

- A Masters or other relevant post graduate qualification
- Previous placement or work experience in a similar industry
- Knowledge / awareness of one or more of the following: BREEAM, WELL, Whole Life Carbon, Energy Modelling

**Our Benefits**

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer both core and flexible benefits, a competitive salary and industry leading training and development to support you throughout your career.  We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality.

You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and up to 30 days of annual leave.

**How to Apply**

To apply simply complete a CV profile, answer a couple questions, and submit your application. For hints and tips in applying [click here](https://hoarelea.com/2018/10/02/tips-for-your-graduate-application/).

**Please only apply for one location for your discipline, if you are flexible with location, great! – you will have the chance to select your other location preferences, and this will be confirmed again with you at telephone interview.** If you apply for multiple locations, you will only be considered for the location you have applied for.

**_Please note:_** We do not offer visa sponsorship for this graduate role. Only candidates already authorised to work in the UK – e.g. British/Irish citizens, EU Settled/Pre-Settled, ILR holders – will be considered.

**Recruitment Process**

Our projects are human-centric, and so is our recruitment process. Once you’ve applied, you’ll speak to a person every step of the way. Here’s our planned timeline:

- Applications close – 6th November 2026
- Telephone Interviews – November/December 2026
- Selection Event – January/February 2027
- Start Date – September 2027

**Adjustments and accommodations**

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to ensure you can participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence, or anything else) please let us know.

**Flexible working**

We are committed to enabling a healthy work-life balance for all employees. So, we welcome applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements to suit their particular needs and lifestyle, including part-time, term-time-only, and remote working.

**Data privacy**

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click [here](https://hoarelea.com/app/uploads/2024/08/Candidate-Privacy-Notice-August-2024.pdf) to find out more.

title: 3D Art Lead
description:
The 3D Art Lead is responsible for the people, craft and technical development of the 3D discipline within StoryToys' mobile games development team. The role combines strong people leadership with expert knowledge of end-to-end real-time 3D production, from modelling, UVs and texturing through rigging, skinning, animation, Unity implementation and mobile optimisation.

The role owns the health and continuous development of StoryToys' 3D production workflow, establishing scalable standards, identifying bottlenecks and working across Art, Engineering, Technical Art, Production, QA and Creative to deliver high-quality, efficient and maintainable 3D content.

The 3D Art Lead is also responsible for developing team capability through mentoring, performance management, recruitment and resource planning, while remaining technically credible and sufficiently hands-on to investigate problems, prototype solutions and provide effective artistic and technical direction.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

Team Leadership lead, coach and support the 3D art team, creating an environment in which artists can do high-quality work, develop their skills and contribute effectively across projects.

People Management and Career Development: conduct regular 1:1s with direct reports, set expectations and development goals, provide timely performance feedback, identify training opportunities and performance interventions where required.

Recruitment and Onboarding: Participate in portfolio reviews, interviews, hiring decisions, onboarding, training and mentoring for 3D art roles, helping maintain a clear and consistent capability bar across the discipline.

Strategic Planning & Resource Management

Planning and Resourcing: Work with the Art Manager / Head of Art, Production and project leads to allocate 3D team members according to project needs, individual strengths and development goals. Forecast capability or capacity gaps and recommend resourcing or workflow solutions against the product roadmap.

Agile Delivery Support: Support task planning, estimation, prioritisation, dependency management and risk identification within an Agile production environment. Help ensure technical or art-pipeline concerns are represented during planning and delivery.

3D Pipeline Ownership & Process Improvement

Pipeline Ownership and Development: Own the health and continuous development of the 3D production pipeline from source asset creation through skinning, rigging, animation, Unity implementation and final runtime use. Establish and maintain best practices, technical standards, asset specifications, file structures, naming conventions, import settings and documentation.

Unity and Runtime Integration: Ensure 3D assets are correctly integrated into Unity and that workflows around prefabs, materials, animation, asset libraries, import settings and source files remain efficient, consistent and maintainable.

Technical Leadership & Quality Assurance

Technical Direction and Cross-Discipline Decision Making: Act as the 3D technical representative when working with Engineering, Technical Art, Production and other teams. Understand the implications of technical decisions on 3D asset creation, implementation, performance and maintainability. Question, challenge or propose alternatives when solutions create unnecessary production cost, technical debt or limitations for the Art team.

Technical and Craft Leadership: Review 3D work and provide clear, actionable feedback across modelling, topology, UVs, texturing, rigging, skinning, animation, Unity implementation and mobile optimisation. Maintain a strong quality bar while ensuring work remains appropriate to production and platform constraints.

Hands-On Technical and Production Support: Remain close enough to production to investigate problems, prototype solutions and contribute specialist knowledge or additional support as required. Retain sufficient hands-on proficiency to understand current workflows and provide credible technical and artistic direction.

Asset Optimisation Ensure assets are optimised for mobile platforms without compromising visual quality, user experience or adherence to Brand and Company guidelines. Work with Technical Art and Engineering to understand performance constraints and establish appropriate budgets and standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Partnerships

Technical Art Partnership: Partner closely with Technical Artists, providing requirements and priorities from the 3D discipline and collaborating on tools, automation, shaders, performance improvements and engine-side solutions. The 3D Art Lead is accountable for the effectiveness of the overall 3D production workflow; Technical Artists provide specialist technical implementation and engineering-facing expertise.

Collaboration Work closely with designers, programmers, technical artists, producers and QA to ensure 3D assets are implemented successfully, dependencies are understood and risks are resolved early. Communicate art requirements clearly and negotiate technical trade-offs constructively.

Continuous Improvement & Risk Management

Pipeline Troubleshooting and Risk Identification: Investigate recurring or high-impact issues affecting 3D production and implementation. Determine whether problems originate in asset creation, workflow, Unity configuration, tools or engineering systems, and coordinate the appropriate people to resolve them. Identify risks early enough to be addressed during planning rather than late in production.

3D Track Development: Support the growth of the 3D discipline within the Art Department by identifying skills gaps, training needs, workflow improvements, tooling opportunities and future capability requirements.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

3D Art & Production

  • Extensive professional experience in 3D art for games, animation, interactive media or a closely related field, including experience in leadership and/or people management roles.
  • Expert knowledge of real-time 3D production workflows, including modelling, topology, UV mapping, texturing, materials, rigging, skinning, animation, asset export/import and runtime optimisation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Maya across core 3D production disciplines, with the ability to inspect, troubleshoot and modify assets, rigs and scenes as required.
  • Strong working knowledge of Substance Painter and relevant Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Portfolio or showreel demonstrating high-quality 3D artwork and relevant production experience.

Unity & Technical Knowledge

  • Strong professional experience using Unity, including asset integration, prefab management, materials, animation implementation, import settings and performance-conscious workflows.
  • Strong understanding of mobile optimisation principles, including geometry, textures, memory usage, materials, draw calls, batching, level of detail (LOD) management and profiling concepts.
  • Experience collaborating with Technical Artists and Engineers to resolve pipeline, tooling and runtime challenges.
  • Experience using version control systems, such as Git, within a collaborative development environment.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of shaders, visual effects (VFX), lighting and Unity rendering pipelines beyond routine 3D production requirements.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring or managing artists, including 1:1s, performance feedback, development planning and day-to-day support.
  • Strong communication, listening, problem-solving and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across Art, Engineering, Production, Design and QA.
  • Confidence evaluating technical approaches, challenging assumptions and negotiating practical technical and production trade-offs.
  • Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding and team capability development.

Pipeline & Process Improvement

  • Proven experience improving 3D production pipelines or workflows within a shipped production environment.
  • Ability to identify bottlenecks, investigate root causes and implement improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, quality or scalability.
  • Experience establishing production standards, asset specifications, naming conventions, folder structures, validation requirements and documentation.
  • Strong systems-oriented approach to workflow, pipeline and process improvement.

Mobile Games & Industry Experience

  • Professional experience within the games industry, ideally in mobile game development.
  • Strong understanding of mobile game development, real-time asset creation and asset optimisation.
  • Experience working within Agile development environments and collaborating with Production on planning, capacity management, dependencies and delivery.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard creative software and tools relevant to 3D art production.

Desirable

  • Degree in Fine Arts, Game Design, Computer Graphics, Animation or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with licensed intellectual property (IP), strict brand guidelines and external stakeholders.
  • Experience developing games or applications for children, families or younger audiences.
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Slack, Float, Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with creative software including ZBrush, Blender and Adobe Premiere.

Education

Desirable

  • A degree in Fine Arts, Game Design, Computer Graphics, Animation or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

## Mishap Investigation Engineer

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems

Poway

California

Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

We have an exciting opportunity in San Diego, CA (Poway, CA.) for a Mishap Investigation Engineer in our Engineering Field Support (EFS) department at GA-ASI. The Mishap Investigation Group investigates root cause of aircraft crashes across all GA-ASI platforms and customers. We investigate complex failures spanning a wide range of aircraft systems—potentially any system on the aircraft or in the GCS. We inspect and test crashed aircraft hardware (when available), sometimes traveling to CONUS bases to do so. We interface with a wide variety of enterprise functions including hardware design, software, manufacturing, flight operations, and deployment logistics. At times, the workload is fast-paced and demanding. Our work is highly visible to company leadership. In the end, our mission is to identify root cause and drive mitigation in order to improve system safety.

Under general supervision, this position is responsible for leading a multidisciplinary team that provides technical support to mishap safety investigations. The position also coordinates with Subject Matter Experts, customer representatives (including active duty military officers), and various organizations within GA-ASI to conduct a root cause investigation. These investigations sometimes include hands-on inspection and testing of failed components and systems. This position will manage the investigation project, document investigation findings, produce written technical reports, and communicate results to engineering staff, leadership, and the customer.

- Obtain and maintain technical system-level knowledge of GA-ASI aircraft, ground control stations, and associated hardware, related operational procedures, and maintenance processes in order to understand failures.
- Perform investigations across all GA-ASI aircraft platforms and customers.
- Coordinate and participate in aircraft inspections, tests, and hardware tear-down events. Travel as required to conduct hardware inspections; requirements estimated between 1-4 multi-day trips per year.
- Maintain the strict confidentiality of privileged and sensitive information.
- Perform other duties as assigned.
- Responsible for observing all laws, regulations, and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company.
- Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

- Must have a complete understanding of engineering concepts, principles, codes, and theory; experience demonstrating a broad application of those concepts; and expanding knowledge of principles, concepts, theory, and practices in related technical specialties.

General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. We have an exciting opportunity for a Structural Analyst in Rancho Bernardo, CA. Assignments are normally outlined in terms of overall objectives and anticipated results. Work is reviewed at milestones or at completion for adequacy in meeting objectives. The ideal candidate would be an experienced mechanical engineer with a strong background in structural FEA simulations including modal, dynamic, and statics for broad range of applications.  Candidate should be familiar with structural design and fabrication of lightweight structures and vibration testing of those systems. May coordinate segments of a specific project and may have frequent inter- organization and customer contact on difficult technical issues. Provides direction to design or technical staff and may provide direction to less experienced professional staff.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Provides design and structural analysis support for lasers, advanced sensors, nuclear and nuclear thermal propulsion, electronics, electric motors, battery systems, space payloads and satellite systems.
- Provides practical solutions and insight into problems related to high performance systems.
- Supports cross-functional teams to integrate various design elements into a cohesive product, ensuring alignment with project objectives and customer requirements.
- Addresses complex and difficult technical issues requiring highly creative approaches, drawing on advanced engineering concepts.
- Documents findings and communicates reports and technical presentations at engineering meetings and participates in program reviews.
- Provides technical communication within the company management.

title: Principal Engineer - Corporate Technology
description:
Principal Engineer – Corporate IT

About Us

Globally acknowledged for its trustworthiness, integrity, and accuracy, the Financial Times is a leading news organisation. It aims to offer quality information and services internationally.

At the FT, curiosity flourishes and ambitious thinking is appreciated. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and motivate you. With no set route, you’ll uncover new skills and build a career that can lead you anywhere.

Develop a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the strength of diverse viewpoints and want every voice in our organisation to be acknowledged, respected and appreciated. A nurturing workplace is one where employees feel free to be themselves and perform at their highest potential. We are dedicated to eliminating obstacles for all, particularly focusing on challenges encountered by underrepresented groups.

The Role

Corporate Technology is part of Internal Products and manages the technology solutions that support several of the FT’s key internal business functions, including People, Finance, and Procurement. This area encompasses significant enterprise platforms like Oracle Fusion and Workday, as well as specialized platforms, integrations, data flows, and in-house developed tools.

As Principal Engineer – Corporate Technology, you will lead senior engineering efforts across this area. You will define the engineering strategy for the domain and collaborate with Engineering Leads and senior engineers. Together, you will ensure our platforms and services remain secure, resilient, scalable, well managed, and adaptable to business needs.

A key part of the role is to establish and enhance a solid engineering leadership approach across Corporate Technology. You will assign clear ownership and accountability to individual platforms. You will also offer technical direction, mentoring, and oversight to maintain a unified and sustainable technology infrastructure.

Partnering with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, and senior participants from People, Finance, and Procurement, you will develop technology strategy and roadmaps. You will find opportunities to simplify and modernise the estate. You will lead engineering for large-scale transformation efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the engineering vision for Corporate Technology covering People, Finance, and Procurement platforms and services, converting FT and Internal Products technology strategy into specific priorities and roadmaps.
  • Deliver senior technical direction across enterprise platforms, integrations, data flows, and internally developed capabilities.
  • Work with Architecture and Engineering Leads to establish appropriate technical standards, patterns and guardrails, ensuring significant decisions consider security, resilience, scalability, operability, maintainability and cost.
  • Recognize systemic technical risks, lifecycle challenges, technical debt, and possibilities to simplify the technology estate, cut down on duplication, and boost interoperability.
  • Ensure Engineering Leads have clear accountability for the engineering, operation and continuous improvement of their platforms, with consistent expectations for engineering quality and technical ownership.
  • Support complex technical decisions and issues spanning multiple platforms, while creating appropriate autonomy for Engineering Leads.
  • Direct and cultivate Engineering Leads and senior engineers, improving technical judgement, platform ownership, succession, and specialist capability across the domain.
  • Offer senior engineering direction for key People, Finance, and Procurement technology efforts, ensuring new capabilities are transferred into lasting internal stewardship.
  • Support platform selection, implementation and major technology investment decisions, challenging approaches that introduce unnecessary complexity, operational risk or long-term dependency.
  • Maintain oversight of operational performance and technology risk, including reliability, observability, incident and change management, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Ensure platforms meet relevant FT security, data governance, compliance and technology standards.
  • Strengthen internal capability and knowledge to reduce unnecessary reliance on individual specialists, vendors and implementation partners.
  • Build strong relationships across People, Finance, Procurement, Product and Technology, helping collaborators understand technical trade-offs, risks and investment requirements.
  • Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Data, and other engineering leaders on decisions that span organisational or technology boundaries, representing Corporate Technology in relevant FT engineering and technology forums.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Extensive background in senior engineering leadership within a complex technology organisation, including management across multiple enterprise platforms, products or technology capabilities.
  • Solid knowledge of enterprise SaaS ecosystems and the engineering methods necessary to integrate, operate, and develop business-critical platforms effectively.
  • Experience with leading enterprise platforms like Oracle Fusion, Workday, or similar People, Finance, or ERP systems.
  • Solid grasp of contemporary integration methods, APIs, data flows, and cloud technologies.
  • Experience leading technology through significant transformation, implementation or modernisation programmes.
  • Experience establishing clear technical ownership and sustainable operating models for business-critical platforms.
  • Solid grasp of reliability, security, operational risk, and technology lifecycle management.
  • Experience working effectively with third-party technology vendors, implementation partners and managed service providers while maintaining strong internal ownership.
  • Experience leading and developing Engineering Leads, senior engineers or other experienced technical professionals, including coaching leaders and creating clear decision rights and accountability.
  • A track record of influencing senior business and technology collaborators and translating complex technical considerations into clear, pragmatic decisions.
  • Experience formulating technology strategies and roadmaps spanning multiple platforms or capabilities.
  • Strong technical judgement, with the ability to balance longer-term technical direction with delivery and business priorities.

Desirable

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion, Workday, and their broader technology environments.
  • Experience working with Finance, People, Procurement or other enterprise business capabilities.

What's in it for You?

Our benefits differ depending on the location, but we are dedicated to offering top-tier perks at all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships, and opportunities to contribute to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Let us know if you require any reasonable modifications or accommodations as part of the application process or to support your participation in an interview. If you want to discuss your needs or have any questions, please email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be pleased to help.

Further Information

At the FT, we value innovation and technology and recognize that candidates might bring AI tools into their application process. You are welcome to harness AI to help with your application. However, it remains important that all details are authentic and accurately describe your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that AI may be monitored during the application process to maintain fairness and transparency for everyone involved.

Please be cautious of fake job listings and offers pretending to come from the Financial Times. Genuine roles will ask you to apply only via the official Financial Times careers website. The FT will never request financial details, payments, or referrals to outside parties during recruitment. If you doubt a job's authenticity or notice suspicious activity, email talent@ft.com.

title: Security Engineer II, Ads Security
description:
The Ads Security organization at Amazon is dedicated to creating innovative technical solutions that detect, assess, and mitigate security risks within Amazon's Advertising businesses. Our vision is to accelerate the development velocity of the Advertising business by ensuring that our products are inherently secure. We are seeking a talented Security Engineer to join our team, where you will have the opportunity to contribute to securing web applications and services critical to delivering exceptional customer and partner experiences at scale in Amazon Ads.

The ideal candidate

You are a threat hunter first, with a strong builder's mindset and a track record of proactively uncovering and stopping advanced threats that evade traditional detection. You have built and deployed AI-powered hunting mechanisms in production, measured how much faster and deeper they let you hunt, and iterated based on what you caught.

You have deep, hands-on expertise in threat hunting fundamentals: hypothesis-driven hunting, adversary tradecraft, the MITRE ATT&CK framework, behavioral and anomaly analysis, log and telemetry analysis, and turning findings into durable detections. You understand the specific tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPS) that malicious actors use to compromise systems, evade detection, and achieve their objectives. You are an expert in identifying indicators or compromise (IoCs) and think about threats from first principles.

You have proven experience using AI to conduct the full threat hunting lifecycle: generating and testing hypotheses, take action and response to findings, have a rigorous documentation of findings, and in creating detection feedback. You are experienced in correlating signals across massive datasets, triaging leads, and surfacing the needle in the haystack at a scale and speed that manual hunting cannot reach. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, defining what "good" looks like for a hunt before starting it, and influencing others through technical depth and clear communication. You set the bar for hunting rigor on your team and raise the level of everyone around you.

You are energized by the opportunity to pioneer a new discipline: applying generative AI and agentic systems to threat hunting challenges that were previously intractable through manual investigation or static rules alone. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring the protection of customer data and critical infrastructure within the Amazon Ads organization.

Key job responsibilities
- End-to-end ownership of AI-powered threat hunting capabilities — design, build, maintain, and expand hunting workflows that proactively surface threats at scale.
- Conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts across large-scale attack surfaces, using AI to accelerate signal correlation, lead triage, and anomaly discovery.
- Develop and maintain agentic AI hunting workflows that autonomously generate hypotheses, gather evidence, and investigate leads with human-in-the-loop oversight.
- Build evaluation frameworks and feedback loops to continuously measure and improve the accuracy, recall, and reliability of AI-driven threat hunting, minimizing false negatives and alert fatigue.
- Operationalize hunt findings ensuring appropriate action and response is taken, and converting them into durable, high-fidelity detections, and close detection coverage gaps.
- Map hunting coverage and findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and known adversary tradecraft relevant to Amazon Ads.
- Partner with other teams at Amazon to fine-tune and adapt models for specific hunting use cases, including anomaly detection, log analysis, and natural language security querying.
- Define technical roadmaps for AI-powered threat hunting initiatives, influencing org-level priorities and driving alignment across partner teams.
- Author and review technical design documents, threat models, and hunt playbooks for AI-driven hunting capabilities.
- Mentor engineers across the organization on threat hunting best practices and the use of AI/ML in hunting and detection.
- Establish operational excellence standards for AI hunting systems, including monitoring, alerting, and human-in-the-loop safeguards.
- Participate in on-call rotations including Ads Security, threat hunting, detection services, ensuring rapid response to emerging threats, production incidents, and service degradation.
- Provide regular updates to leadership on hunt outcomes, emerging threats, risks, and strategic decisions through written narratives and review mechanisms.
- Contribute to operational planning (OP1/OP2) including goal setting, resource planning, and roadmap prioritization for the team.
- Participate in helping to grow and develop a high-performing threat hunting team.
- Support team development through code reviews, technical mentoring, career coaching, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.
- Perform ad-hoc security-related initiatives as needed.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience across cloud, AI/ML, retail, and more.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Work/Life Balance

**Why choose Saint Paul University?**

Working at Saint Paul University means being part of a human-scaled university community where collaboration, proximity, and the opportunity to have a concrete impact are highly valued. The University offers working conditions that promote work-life balance, including a four-day work week as part of a regular 35-hour-per-week schedule for administrative staff, vacation time, a pension plan, and a benefits program. Subject to applicable conditions, staff also benefit from a tuition fee exemption for most programs offered by Saint Paul University and the University of Ottawa, thereby fostering lifelong learning and professional development.

We are looking for individuals who wish to put their expertise at the service of an engaged community, contribute to the development of their colleagues, and actively participate in the evolution of the University and the continuous improvement of its practices. At Saint Paul University, your expertise is recognized, your contribution is visible, and your work will have a concrete impact.

**Summary of Duties**

Under the supervision of the Director of the Teaching and Learning Technologies Department, the incumbent creates the necessary tools for the clients of the Teaching and Learning Technologies Department (uoCampus, Brightspace, Zoom, and others) to align technological solutions with the University's operational objectives and needs. They analyze business operations and implement process improvements in support of multidisciplinary teams.

**Main Duties**

**Business and Process Analysis**

- Thoroughly understand operational requirements to convert them into technical specifications that will facilitate the development of new subsystems that closely match client needs.
- Facilitate collaborative needs analysis workshops to gather, clarify, and prioritize requirements associated with stakeholder requests (various University departments and faculties) regarding processes and information subsystems.
- Inform decisions regarding the choice of new technological platforms to be deployed by providing analytical and technical expertise and ensuring maximum added value and alignment with institutional priorities.
- Plan, prioritize, and execute information subsystem implementation activities and maintain effective communication with stakeholders.

**Data and Reporting Management**

- Extract data from various internal and external sources to prepare statistical and analytical reports in semantic form or synthetic, interactive dashboards that support decision-making.
- Regularly review data from various information systems to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and errors. Analyze identified problems and their possible solutions. Implement required corrections.
- Actively promote best practices in data security and confidentiality, ensuring their integration into processes and technological platforms.
- Develop reporting structures and statistical methods for trend analysis and support the achievement of performance indicators. Verify the accuracy of data in various information systems such as uoCampus and Brightspace, which impact data on admissions, registration, registration reporting, and BIUs, so that official reporting is a faithful reflection of reality.

**Testing**

- Design and execute test scenarios and integration tests aimed at meeting operational and end-user needs, particularly by leveraging B.I. (Business Intelligence) modules.

**Documentation**

- Prepare technical reports and user guides to document system development and help users effectively utilize the implemented systems.
- Maintain documents on application functionality and various tested transactions, recording information on different error levels; consolidate service requests, problem logs, and system improvements in successive versions for the operational sector.

**Training and Support**

- Train employees in the use of new systems or in following new procedures, whether through information capsules, physical documents, in-person or video training, or other appropriate means.
- Provide expert advice to clients on system usage. Handle various special client requests, including data uploading or extraction and the management of specialized systems.

**Security Services**

- Investigate security breaches, recommend corrective measures, and implement necessary security measures to ensure data integrity.

**Continuous Improvement and Change Management**

- Monitor emerging technologies and contribute to the planning of continuous improvement initiatives for processes and information systems.
- Implement change resulting from the improvement of existing systems or the implementation of new information subsystems.
- Support the operations sector in implementing changes to existing procedures.

**Essential Education, Knowledge, Experience, and Qualities**

- University degree in computer science, management information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
- At least three (3) years of experience in supporting the IT needs of operational units
- Knowledge of Oracle PeopleSoft Campus Solutions
- In-depth knowledge of the university environment, its governance, academic regulations and processes, and study programs
- Knowledge of computer principles and understanding of operational processes and cycles
- Knowledge of project management methods and practices
- Knowledge of industry standards and best practices
- Knowledge of accounting principles to be able to align operational needs with financial needs
- Excellent understanding of structures, theories, principles, and practices related to databases
- Knowledge of computer security and access principles and best practices
- Analytical skills to convert operational requirements into technical specifications
- Ability to lead the work of multidisciplinary teams in designing a data model
- Advanced interpersonal skills to be able to ask the right questions, interact with employees at different levels, and deliver training in the most appropriate way
- Organizational skills to be able to prioritize work and meet numerous strict deadlines
- Ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms
- Proactive ability to follow technological evolution
- Bilingualism – French and English (written and spoken)

title: Manager III, User Experience Design, Talent Solutions
description:
As a UX Design Manager on the Talent Solutions team, you lead a team of designers who own the experiences Amazon's candidates, recruiters and hiring managers use every day. You are accountable for the quality of what your team ships, the growth of the people on it, and the design bar across the products in your domain.

This is a hands-on management role. You set direction, coach designers through hard problems, and hold the craft bar in reviews. You partner daily with product management, engineering and UX research, and you represent design in the forums where scope and sequence get decided. Where design has historically joined the conversation late, you move it earlier.

To succeed, you need judgement about which problems deserve your team's time, the credibility to hold a design position with senior partners, and the discipline to build a team that raises its own bar. Our environment is ambiguous and fast-moving. It rewards people who take ownership before being asked.


Key job responsibilities
People Leadership and Team Building :
▪ Manage, coach and grow a team of designers across levels, with clear expectations and honest, specific feedback
▪ Own hiring for your team, from bar-raising loop participation through onboarding and ramp
▪ Build career paths that develop craft and leadership together, and give designers work that stretches them
▪ Create a team culture where designers critique each other's work directly and improve it

Design Quality and Craft Bar :
▪ Hold the quality bar for everything your team ships, across interaction design, visual craft, content and accessibility
▪ Run design reviews that raise the work rather than approve it, and make the standard explicit enough that others can apply it
▪ Drive adoption of shared design system components and patterns so quality scales without your presence
▪ Partner with UX research so evidence, not preference, settles design debates

Prioritisation and Capacity :
▪ Decide what your team takes on and what it declines, against the domain's roadmap and the team's declared investment split
▪ Size design effort early enough that it lands in product plans rather than arriving as a constraint
▪ Match the engagement model to the ask, whether embedded, allocated, advisory or small-fix, and make the choice visible to partners
▪ Keep the team's commitments, owners and dates current so capacity is legible to the wider organisation

Partnership and Influence :
▪ Represent design in roadmap, intake and toll-gate forums, and hold a position when the evidence supports it
▪ Translate customer pain into a case senior partners act on, using the team's customer value and evidence framework
▪ Build the working relationships across product and engineering that let design shape decisions early
▪ Model behaviour that exemplifies Amazon Leadership Principles


A day in the life
Your day starts with your team. You spend it in design reviews and one-to-ones, unblocking designers on the problems that need a second pair of eyes and pushing on the ones that need a higher bar. You move between a small number of standing forums where the work actually gets shaped: a leadership sync where priorities get set, working sessions with product and engineering partners where scope and sequence get agreed, and an open session where anyone across the business can bring a design question. In between you are in the work itself, reviewing flows and prototypes, weighing accessibility and content alongside visual craft, and making sure the standards your team sets are written clearly enough for other people to apply them. You decide what your team takes on and what it declines, and you size design effort early enough that it lands in a plan rather than arriving as a constraint. Some days you spend more time defending a design position than producing one. Both matter.

About the team
The Talent Solutions team is made up of forward-thinking UX designers and researchers. It aims to revolutionize the hiring experience at Amazon. Our design work has a direct impact on the lives of millions of Amazonians and job seekers with the goal of hiring the highest quality candidates in the industry. We're also customer-obsessed, driving impact across the company by delivering on user-centered and business needs. We support Amazon's mission to become Earth's best employer through making it easier to acquire, train and retain employees.

About Side

Founded in 2009 and drawing on more than 30 years of experience through our parent company in Japan, Side has grown into a global business with studios across North America, Europe, South America and Asia.

As Head of Post Production, you will be responsible for the overall leadership, performance and development of Side's global Post Production function.

This is a senior leadership role combining audio Post Production expertise, people leadership, operational management, commercial responsibility and workflow transformation.

You will provide strategic and operational oversight across people, resources, quality, technology, workflows, capacity and continuous improvement, ensuring we consistently deliver high-quality audio Post Production services that meet client expectations and commercial objectives.

Working closely with Production, Audio, Finance and other business functions, you will ensure the department has the capability, resources and processes required to support both current and future client demand.

You will also lead and develop our Post Production Managers and wider team, establish clear technical and operational standards, and help evolve the function through improved workflows, automation and new technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead and develop the global Post Production function, creating a collaborative, accountable and high-performing environment.
  • Provide leadership and direction to Post Production Managers and the wider team.
  • Set clear departmental objectives, priorities and performance expectations.
  • Coach and develop managers and team members, building capability and supporting career progression.

  • Support succession planning and the effective rollout of new initiatives.
  • Partner with HR on organisational structure, recruitment, performance, progression and employee matters.
  • Empower managers to lead effectively rather than becoming unnecessarily involved in every day-to-day operational decision.

Operations, Capacity & Resource Management

  • Maintain effective escalation processes for complex technical, resource and client matters.

  • Maintain oversight of significant quality issues and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken.

  • Maintain oversight of Post Production hardware, software, DAWs and related technologies.
  • Provide sufficient technical leadership and credibility to support and challenge specialist teams without needing to personally execute every technical task.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Monitor utilisation, resource costs, overtime and external or freelance expenditure.
  • Ensure resourcing decisions support project budgets and wider commercial objectives.
  • Use operational and financial performance data to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and profitability.
  • Support commercial assessment and capacity planning for new and expanding client opportunities.
  • Provide Post Production input into pricing, resource requirements and capacity discussions.
  • Identify and escalate potential financial or operational risks.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the senior Post Production point of contact for significant client, quality and technical matters.
  • Build strong relationships across Production, Audio, Finance and other internal functions.
  • Provide expert Post Production input into client discussions where required.
  • Support the resolution of complex or escalated client issues.
  • Work closely with other department heads to ensure effective cross-functional delivery.
  • Represent Post Production within senior operational and business discussions.
  • Ensure client feedback and lessons learned are incorporated into future processes and service development.

Strategy, Technology & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and implement the Post Production operational roadmap in line with wider business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, scalability and commercial performance.
  • Lead the development and implementation of improved workflows, automation and technology.
  • Use AI-assisted tools and automated workflows to improve the efficient processing of large volumes of audio files.
  • Develop Post Production capabilities to support new services and changing client requirements.
  • Establish appropriate departmental KPIs and use operational data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure lessons learned are translated into meaningful operational improvements.
  • Collaborate with global teams to develop consistent standards and share best practice.

What We're Looking For

You will bring substantial commercial audio Post Production experience together with genuine leadership and operational responsibility.

We are particularly interested in candidates with:

  • 7+ years' relevant experience within commercial audio Post Production, ideally within video games, localisation, entertainment or creative services.
  • Significant experience operating in a Post Production leadership or management role.
  • Demonstrable experience leading, coaching and developing technical or creative teams and managers.
  • Strong knowledge of dialogue editing, QA, mastering and commercial audio Post Production workflows.
  • Demonstrable experience using AI-assisted tools and automated workflows to process high volumes of files efficiently, ideally across multiple languages.

  • Experience working within a high-volume, deadline-driven commercial services environment.
  • Strong analytical capability and experience using KPIs and operational data to inform decisions.
  • Experience working across multilingual or localisation projects would be highly advantageous.

What Success Looks Like

You will be comfortable operating strategically while retaining enough technical credibility to lead experienced Post Production professionals.

You will understand how decisions around people, technology, capacity and workflows affect quality, client satisfaction, cost and profitability, and you will be able to translate that understanding into practical improvements across the function.

You will also be expected to promote the safety and comfort of colleagues, freelancers, talent, clients and vendors, and to ensure compliance with Side's security, confidentiality, IT, HR, health and safety and ethical standards.

**Job Title:** **Lead, RF Engineer**

**Job Code:** **44388**

**Job Location:** **Palm Bay, FL**

**Job Schedule:** **9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a highly driven **RF Hardware Design Engineer** to support the design and development of advanced RF solutions for **space‑to‑ground communication systems**. In this role, you will contribute to mission‑critical hardware used in resilient, high‑reliability space platforms that enable secure connectivity for our customers. You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment focused on innovation, rapid development, and precision execution.

**Essential Functions:**

- Design, simulate, and implement RF circuits and subsystems including LNAs, PAs, filters, mixers, synthesizers, and transceiver modules for space‑to‑ground communication links.
- Develop and refine system‑level RF architectures that meet demanding environmental, performance, and reliability requirements for space applications.
- Lead schematic design, RF component selection, and PCB layout review with a focus on radiation tolerance, thermal performance, and high‑frequency signal integrity.
- Perform hardware bring‑up, tuning, and RF characterization using advanced lab equipment (VNA, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, etc.) for first article deployment
- Support environmental, thermal, and radiation‑effects considerations as part of design verification for space systems.
- Work closely with systems engineering, digital hardware, firmware, antenna engineering, and manufacturing teams to ensure seamless integration and efficient production.
- Troubleshoot complex RF issues, execute root‑cause analysis, and propose design improvements to enhance reliability and mission readiness.
- Create detailed technical documentation including requirements, design reports, test procedures, and verification artifacts consistent with L3Harris engineering standards.
- Ability to obtain a US Security Clearance.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering and a minimum of 9 years of prior relevant experience.  Graduate Degree in Engineering and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Experience designing for a space environment.
- Hold a current security Clearance or the ability to obtain a security clearance
- Knowledge of space communication standards, high‑frequency payload architectures, or ground‑segment RF equipment.
- Familiarity with environmental and qualification standards (MIL‑STD, NASA, ESA, or similar)
- Proficiency with RF simulation tools such as ADS, AWR Microwave Office, HFSS, or equivalent.
- Strong understanding of RF fundamentals including impedance matching, linearity, gain, noise figure, phase noise, and EMI/EMC.
- Experience with PCB design tools (Altium, Cadence Allegro, or similar).
- Experience in high‑volume or mission‑critical manufacturing environments
- Experience leading teams and project designs
- Trade study execution and ownership
- Problem-solving skills with ability to proactively identify alternate solutions to overcome difficult technical challenges.
- Detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Provide mentorship to early career engineers
