title: Archaeology and Built Heritage Consultant
description:
Salary: €41,380 – €50,975 depending on experience and level of expertise

Hours: Full time, 37.5h/week – we are open to discussion on flexible working including part-time hours

Locations: RSK Group office in Dublin, Republic of Ireland

Contract Type: Permanent, subject to 6-month probation period

Closing Date: 5pm on 30th October 2026. Headland Archaeology reserves the right to interview and appoint a suitable candidate before this point.

Headland Archaeology is offering an excellent opportunity for an archaeology and built heritage consultant to join our expanding team. This position is to help us to deliver our existing workload from across the island of Ireland and develop our business alongside other EIA services with RSK colleagues

Why Should You Apply?

We are a privately-owned archaeological business, part of the RSK Group, a leader in integrated environmental, engineering, and technical services. We provide heritage services to the development and construction sectors in UK and across the world.

The Headland Archaeology and Built Heritage Consultancy Team prides itself on offering independent, excellent technical advice to clients and colleagues which is rooted in years of experience in the sector. We tell clients what they need to know, rather than what they want to hear.

The team works on a wide range of projects, from large-scale energy and transport infrastructure to the remodelling of individual historic properties. Wherever development encounters the historic environment we are involved in understanding, assessing and shaping key decisions.

We wish to grow our archaeology and built heritage consultancy business in Ireland.

We offer our employees:

· Unique knowledge and expertise. For more than 25 years, Headland has provided not only business-focused archaeology but also a people-focused business. We are highly respected within our industry for our achievements in innovation, tailor-made coaching and training, and our expertise in commercial archaeology.

· Strong pioneering spirit. Our corporate culture is characterised by a healthy appetite for originality and development.

· Stable company with excellent growth. Over the years, we have demonstrated steady, positive economic development and formed successful partnerships.

· Good work environment. You will be surrounded by colleagues who are pleasant, professional, and enthusiastic about their work. There are opportunities to develop and we welcome your contribution to extending and improving our services. Consultants at Headland benefit from working alongside skilled colleagues in post-excavation, geophysics and field work teams– we can call upon the expertise of c200 archaeologists.

· Opportunity to influence. You get to work in an open climate, close to decision makers and with the possibility of making a difference.
· Part of RSK group. As part of RSK you will be working in multi-disciplinary teams alongside experts from other disciplines. Your work is valued as part of a spectrum of specialist environmental and engineering services. You will have opportunities to become involved in nationally and internationally prominent projects with exciting prospects for career development. The group has c.17,000 employees with 240+ leading companies.
We are looking to appoint an archaeological consultant with experience in the preparation of technical documents supporting clients in addressing heritage constraints.

The appointee will deliver technical outputs of a high standard to time and budget, such as Archaeological Impact Assessments (desk-based assessments), EIARs and ad hoc technical advice.

The appointee will have an understanding of the legislative, policy and regulatory framework within which commercial archaeology is undertaken in both Ireland and Northern Ireland.

Applicants should have demonstrable experience of contributing to technical reports (such as site reports, archaeological desk-based assessments, environmental impact assessments and/or built heritage statements and Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS).

We are looking for a candidate to liaise with clients, work with statutory consultees, assess impacts on the historic environment, oversee archaeological sub-contractors, and prepare technical advice. The level of responsibility will reflect the successful applicant’s skills and experience. We provide training and opportunities to develop staff and to help facilitate colleagues’ growth into the role. You will work on projects and with colleagues from across the RSK Group.

Key responsibilities (which will be supported and supervised) will include:

· Baseline data collection (from NMI / NMS archives, site visits, survey etc.)

· Contribute to or preparation of technical documents (AIAs, EIARs, Method Statements and Risk Assessments - RAMS)

· Prepare fee proposals for review

· Liaise with clients, consultees and oversee sub-contractors

· Manage project finances with support from colleagues

· Manage your own time whilst working across several projects

Overnight stays may be required at times, but will not be common.

You must have the following essential criteria:

  • Have an understanding of the policy and legislative context for archaeological practice across the island of Ireland
  • A degree in archaeology or related subject
  • Experience in archaeological consultancy and/or commercial field work
  • Experience of report writing, preferably preparing Archaeological Impact Assessment (AIAs) and/or contributing to technical reports
  • Full driving licence
  • Able and willing to carry out walk-over surveys in an outdoor environment in all weathers
  • Willingness to travel to work on projects across the island of Ireland
  • Be prepared to join a professional body for the historic environment
  • An understanding of the health and safety requirements relevant to the role
  • Good organisational & communication skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and use your own initiative
  • Embrace inclusion and diversity
  • Willingness to develop your people skills and attend mental health awareness courses
  • Substantial knowledge of MS Office & written/spoken English language
  • Be passionate, motivated and excited about what you do!
You may meet the following desirable criteria:
  • Be eligible to apply for archaeological licenses from the National Monuments Service
  • Membership of the Institute of Archaeologists of Ireland (MIAI)
  • CIfA membership at PCIfA level or above
  • Be able to relate research themes to projects
  • Working knowledge of a GIS package
  • Post graduate qualification
  • Publication record
  • EIAR and or Built Heritage experience.

Benefits we offer you:
  • Relocation package if eligible
  • Paid accommodation when applicable
  • Paid subsistence for away working
  • Annual profit discretionary bonus & performance-related bonus schemes
  • 35 days annual leave, rising based on service length
  • Employer contribution to pension scheme
  • Income Protection Policy
  • Paid professional membership
  • Leadership and management training and workshops
  • Use of cutting edge technology on site, e.g. paperless systems, iPads etc.
  • Ongoing regular training in various areas e.g. Health & Safety, Technical areas and Transferable skills
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Referral scheme with generous fee
  • A support group of 30+ Mental Health First Aiders
  • Regular offers through RSK Group (e.g. Tastecard, Gym membership discount, Holidays and Entertainment)
  • Regular performance, wellbeing & professional development check-ins
  • Extra annual leave purchase scheme
How to apply

To apply for this role, please click the Web/Apply button above and submit your application through the Headland Archaeology Applicant Tracking System.

Informal enquiries concerning the role can be made to Sinéad Marshall, Senior Archaeologist – tel: +353 86 8097793, sinead.marshall@headlandarchaeology.com.

As part of our commitment to fair and inclusive recruitment, our Applicant Tracking System removes certain identifying information from applications during the initial screening stage. This allows hiring managers to focus on candidates’ skills, experience and suitability for the role, helping to reduce the potential for unconscious bias and ensuring a more objective recruitment process.

You must have the right to work in the UK without restrictions. Proof of eligibility will be required prior to your commencement. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we may fill existing vacancies before the closing date, so you are advised to submit your application as early as possible.

Headland is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Headland Archaeology is committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. If you have a disability or need any adjustments to enable you to take part in the interview, please contact us at hr@headlandarchaeolgy.com so we can make suitable arrangements.

title: Principal Data Architect
description:
emagine is looking for: Principal Data Architect – Group Information Model and Data Architecture

emagine is looking for a Principal Data Architect for our client in the financial and information services sector. The client operates across four Nordic markets and is at the start of a multi-year transformation. Data from Oracle, Db2 and mainframe environments will be consolidated into a governed operational data platform on AWS, while existing systems continue to support the business.

This is the most senior architectural role in the programme. You will own the Group information model, domain model and data architecture. The core challenge is to distinguish genuine business differences between markets from historical inconsistencies, and to build a common model that endures regardless of technology choices. The programme is deliberately small: existing staff supported by a handful of senior specialists.

Responsibilities

  • Define the Group information model: common business concepts, entities and relationships, and where local variation is required.

  • Own the domain model, including bounded contexts, context maps, shared language and service boundaries based on DDD. The model is implemented through versioned data contracts, semantic models and domain services.

  • Introduce anti-corruption layers between new domain contracts and legacy systems of record.

  • Define how the model, governance and data contracts are implemented on the operational data platform, and contribute to platform decisions.

  • Design the migration architecture, covering patterns, reconciliation, dependency sequencing and acceptance criteria for a gradual transition without a big-bang cutover.

  • Design data governance: classification, lineage, information ownership, retention, access control and country-specific regulatory requirements.

  • Set architecture principles, standards and review processes, and support delivery teams.

Requirements

  • Principal-level experience in data architecture, information architecture or enterprise architecture within a regulated business.

  • Experience establishing common information models across multiple markets, business lines or organisations.

  • Practical experience with domain-driven design (bounded contexts, context maps, domain ownership).

  • Experience designing and governing large-scale analytical or operational data platforms, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent.

  • Experience with data migration or CDC from operational systems such as Oracle, Db2 or PostgreSQL.

  • Experience treating schemas, data contracts and semantic models as versioned engineering artefacts.

  • Solid understanding of GDPR, DORA and related governance requirements.

  • Strong ability to build consensus across business and technology teams.

  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Experience from Nordic financial services, information services or other regulated data businesses.

  • Domain knowledge in credit, risk, lending or decisioning.

  • Modernisation of mainframe, Db2 or Oracle environments.

  • ML/AI governance, feature stores or model lineage.

  • Evaluation of public-cloud, sovereign-cloud or hybrid deployment models.

  • Swedish

Technology landscape
AWS, Amazon S3, CDC from Oracle/Db2/PostgreSQL, SQL, Python, Java/Spring Boot, rules-engine based decisioning, and tooling for metadata, lineage and information governance.

Location
Stockholm, hybrid with remote work as required.

Start: October/November

title: ML Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for an ML Platform Engineer (m/f/d), who will build and operate the distributed training, deployment, and experimentation infrastructure that research, data, and robotics teams depend on to move models from prototype to production.

Your Responsibilities

  • Training Infrastructure: Design and scale distributed training workflows for large models using tools such as PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, and cluster schedulers like SLURM or Kubernetes.
  • ML Platform: Build and maintain containerised ML environments that support reproducible experimentation and benchmarking.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for machine learning systems to enable reliable testing, training, and deployment of models.
  • Lifecycle Management: Implement experiment tracking, model versioning, and reproducibility workflows using tools such as ClearML or Weights & Biases.
  • Observability: Set up monitoring systems such as Prometheus and Grafana to track model performance and system health and detect drift in production.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with research, data, and robotics teams to connect new models to robust production systems.

Essential Skills

  • Background and Experience: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with professional experience building and operating ML or software infrastructure in production.
  • Distributed Training: Experience designing and operating distributed training systems on Kubernetes and Docker, using PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, and schedulers such as SLURM.
  • CI/CD for ML: Experience building CI/CD pipelines that support reliable model testing, training, and deployment.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience operating ML workloads on cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  • Experiment Tracking: Hands-on experience with experiment tracking and model versioning using tools such as MLflow or Weights & Biases.
  • Observability: Experience with monitoring and drift detection using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Software Engineering: Python and system design skills, with experience building and operating ML systems beyond the prototype stage.

Beneficial Skills

  • Multimodal Systems: Experience with large-scale or multimodal ML systems such as vision-language-action models.
  • Infrastructure As Code: Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
  • ML Orchestration: Experience with ML pipeline and orchestration tools.
  • Distributed Compute: Exposure to high-performance or distributed compute environments.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Solutions Architect | Architecte de solutions, Frontier AI Startups
description:
The companies defining the future of AI are a small number of startups training, tuning, and operating models at scale. They are run by ambitious founders, who solve the hardest problems across a variety of different industries. They are moving fast, operating at the edge of what technology can do, and defining the possibilities of computing for years to come.

We are looking for technical builders who are passionate about helping startups at the frontier of AI to grow. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable in deep architectural conversations and advisory discussions. For someone who understands that for a startup, the right technical decision and the right business decision are rarely separate.

In this position, you will work directly with a portfolio of frontier AI startups, helping them architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy AI systems at scale. Your conversations will range from low-level discussions about chip types to high-level explorations of advanced prompt engineering.

Your work will extend beyond individual customer relationships. You will serve as a direct feedback channel to product teams, translating patterns you observe across your portfolio into concrete input on what should be built and improved. You will contribute to the broader technical community through written content and conference presentations, sharing knowledge at a scale that one-on-one work alone cannot reach
----------------------------------------------
Les entreprises qui façonnent l'avenir de l'IA sont un petit nombre de startups qui entraînent, peaufinent et exploitent des modèles à grande échelle. Elles sont dirigées par des fondateurs ambitieux qui s'attaquent aux défis les plus complexes dans des secteurs variés. Elles progressent rapidement, repoussent les limites technologiques actuelles et définissent les perspectives de l'informatique pour les années à venir.

Nous sommes à la recherche de profils techniques passionnés par la croissance des entreprises en démarrage à la fine pointe de l'IA. Ce poste exige une personne aussi à l'aise dans des discussions approfondies sur l'architecture que dans des échanges de conseils stratégiques ; quelqu'un qui comprend que, pour une startup, les décisions techniques et commerciales sont rarement dissociables.

À ce poste, vous travaillerez directement avec un portefeuille de startups pionnières dans le domaine de l'IA, en les aidant à concevoir l'architecture, à entraîner, à peaufiner et à déployer des systèmes d'IA à grande échelle. Vos échanges couvriront autant des aspects techniques pointus, comme le choix des types de puces, que des réflexions stratégiques sur les techniques avancées de *prompt engineering*.

Votre travail dépassera les relations individuelles avec les clients. Vous servirez de canal de rétroaction direct auprès des équipes produit, en traduisant les tendances observées au sein de votre portefeuille en recommandations concrètes sur les fonctionnalités à développer ou à améliorer. Vous contribuerez également à la communauté technique au sens large par la rédaction de contenus et des interventions lors de conférences, partageant ainsi vos connaissances à une échelle impossible à atteindre par le seul travail individuel.

Key job responsibilities
- Advise a range of funded AI Startups to adopt the right architecture for them.
- Support startups in architecting scalable, reliable, and secure solutions.
- Support adoption of a broad range of AWS services to deliver business value and accelerate growth.
- Support the evolution and roadmap of the AWS platform and services, connecting our engineering teams with our customers for feedback.
- Establish and build technical relationships within the startup ecosystem, including accelerators, incubators, and VCs.
- Develop startup specific technical content, such as blog posts, sample code, and solutions to assist customers solve technical problems and reduce time-to-market.
-------------------------------------------
- Conseiller diverses entreprises en démarrage du secteur de l'IA qui ont amassé des fonds sur le choix de l'architecture la plus adaptée à leurs besoins.
- Aider les entreprises en démarrage à concevoir des architectures évolutives, fiables et sécurisées.
- Favoriser l'adoption d'un large éventail de services AWS afin de générer de la valeur commerciale et d'accélérer la croissance.
- Contribuer à l'évolution et à la feuille de route de la plateforme et des services AWS en facilitant les échanges entre nos équipes d'ingénierie et nos clients pour recueillir leurs retours.
- Établir et développer des relations techniques au sein de l'écosystème des startups, notamment auprès des accélérateurs, des incubateurs et des fonds de capital-risque.
- Élaborer du contenu technique spécifique aux startups (articles de blogue, exemples de code, solutions) pour aider les clients à résoudre des problèmes techniques et à réduire leurs délais de mise en marché.

A day in the life
A day in the life of a Frontier AI Solutions Architect is rarely the same. Expect to have a variety of different types of technical conversations revolving around applied AI and infrastructure, meetings with VCs and incubators, and opportunities to build and present AI content and projects.
--------------------
Le quotidien d'un architecte de solutions d'IA de pointe (Frontier AI) est rarement le même. Attendez-vous à mener des échanges techniques variés portant sur l'IA appliquée et l'infrastructure, à rencontrer des investisseurs en capital-risque et des incubateurs, ainsi qu'à saisir des occasions de concevoir et de présenter du contenu et des projets liés à l'IA.

About the team
Frontier AI is a team of builders. We work with our customers, peers, and cross-functional teams to build out what is possible with AI. Learning by doing, collaborating, and scaling knowledge is the culture of the team.
-------------------
Frontier AI est une équipe de bâtisseurs. Nous collaborons avec nos clients, nos pairs et des équipes multidisciplinaires pour repousser les limites de l'IA. L'apprentissage par la pratique, la collaboration et le partage des connaissances constituent la culture de notre équipe.

title: Historic Places Regeneration Officer
description:
**Summary**

Historic England is the public organisation that brings new life to heritage to build a better future for every place and everyone.

Through our work, we demonstrate how heritage can contribute powerfully to help the country meet pressing societal issues – supporting places and communities and helping create good homes, good jobs and good growth.

Historic England has a fantastic opportunity for you to join us as our Historic Places Regeneration Officer.

**There are two, full time, permanent positions available.**

The location of this role is London, with regular opportunities to visit places throughout Greater London and the South East.

We offer a wide benefits package including a competitive defined benefit **pension scheme to which we make 28.97% employer contributions,** a generous 28 days holiday, corporate discounts, free entry into English Heritage sites across the country and development opportunities to ensure you achieve your goals.

To view our full range of benefits please follow the link [here](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/employee-rewards-and-benefits/).

**What you will be doing**

The work of the Historic Places Regeneration Team demonstrates the transformational power of heritage in creating successful places. The team works collaboratively to deliver for people and places where we can make the biggest difference.

The team leads place-shaping activity and investment across the region. It is responsible for the initiation, development, delivery, evaluation and celebration of targeted interventions and engagement in priority places. To support its work, the Historic Places Regeneration Team draws on the breadth of expertise and tools we have available, including the heritage at risk programme, engagement, expert advice, grants and research, to effect positive and long-lasting change.

Meaningful partnerships with regional and local authorities, businesses, community groups, charities and other national agencies are central to the work of the team, helping to deliver creative projects that leverage the value of heritage to deliver wider societal benefits. We work at a range of scales and degrees of engagement in diverse places across the region.

The Historic Places Regeneration Officer will support delivery of our programme for priority places, working closely with the Historic Places Regeneration Advisers and other colleagues in the Historic Places Regeneration Team. Regeneration Officers will draw on their skills, whether project management, archaeology, urban design and regeneration, community engagement, etc., to devise, manage and deliver exemplary and impactful projects.

Regeneration Officers make full use of Historic England’s breath of expertise and tools, including grants (both Historic England and DCMS funded) and the heritage at risk programme, and they work with external partners and with a variety of internal colleagues to transform the heritage that matters to communities through heritage led regeneration.

**Who we are looking for**

- Experience of partnership working

- Experience of assessing, managing, delivering grant funded projects

- Experience of working with grassroots / community organisations

- Ability to advocate for the value of heritage in place based regeneration

- Ability to solve problems and work creatively to achieve results

- Readiness to work with a range of heritage assets, including archaeology, historic buildings, landscapes and townscapes


**Please note your application will be scored and assessed against the above criteria.**

Historic England is a Disability Confident Leader and normally offers guaranteed interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role, where it is practical and appropriate to do so. We want all candidates to shine in the recruitment process, so please tell us what we can do to help you show us your very best self. For more information, please visit our [Everyone is Welcome page](https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/everyone-is-welcome/ "https://historicengland.org.uk/about/jobs/everyone-is-welcome/"), or contact us at [recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk](mailto:recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk) if you have any recruitment queries.

We are an equal opportunity employer which values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability or neurodiversity, we would be happy to discuss reasonable adjustments to the job with you. Having won the Gold Award from MIND for workplace wellbeing in seven consecutive years, we also recognise the importance of a healthy work-life balance.

We are an inclusive employer and believe that flexible working options are for everyone. We want to make sure our working arrangements don’t prevent anyone from joining us because of their personal circumstances. We also want to provide you with the best balance in your home and work life that we can.

We are open to considering options including job sharing, part-time working, compressed hours working and different working locations, including hybrid working. Please visit our jobs pages or contact us to find out more.

**Why work for Historic England**

We are committed to promoting equality of opportunity for everyone. Diversity helps us to perform better and attract more people to support our work. We welcome and encourage job applications from people of all backgrounds.

We particularly encourage applications from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic candidates and candidates with disabilities as they are underrepresented within Historic England at this level.

Historic England wants all of our candidates to shine in the recruitment process. Please tell us what we can do to make sure you can show us your very best self. You can contact us by email at [recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk](mailto:recruitmentTeam@Historicengland.org.uk) if you have any recruitment queries.

**At Historic England we use a hiring system called Applied. Applied is a behavioural science-backed recruitment platform that reduces bias, improves quality of hire and increases diversity. We do not use CV application for the majority of our hiring processes. You will answer a selection of questions that allow our hiring teams to test your skills and suitability for the role.**

At Historic England, we value the expertise and individuality each candidate brings and want to hear about this in your own words. If you require the use or AI tools or other resources to support your application, we ask that all information is factually accurate, original, and reflects your own experience. To best represent yourself, we encourage you to write in your own words and use AI-generated content only as inspiration—not as direct input.

Provisional interview dates: 26th October and 02nd November 2026.

Please follow the link for a full copy of the Job Description –

[https://historicengland.org.uk/media/5zbap4uk/zw-historic-places-regeneration-officer-lse-jd-sep-2026-1.odt](https://cms.historicengland.org.uk/media/5zbap4uk/zw-historic-places-regeneration-officer-lse-jd-sep-2026-1.odt)

title: Retail Lead Associate (Reduced-Time), Customer Experience Operations
description:
Pay starts at $22.40 per hour with benefits available.

Reduced Time Hours: Average work between 30-39 hrs per week.

This role requires open availability BH 15:45-22:15

As a Retail Lead Associate, you will be the face of Amazon and contribute to the culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. You possess strong attention to detail, the ability to quickly prioritize tasks, the willingness to learn new things, and a commitment to delighting our customers. You will assist with customer service operations and floor leader responsibilities.

Key job responsibilities
- Interact with customers by effectively using customer engagement strategies and model desired behavior for the rest of the team.
- Utilize inventory management systems to scan, process, and count product.
- Provide peer-to-peer feedback on processes and standards, serving as the escalation point to assist associate peers in solving customer issues, where appropriate.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of the customer experience and operations by participating in the development of best practices.
- Help identify and communicate barriers and trends that contribute to the customer and associate experience and support the manager in building a strong site culture.
- Work with a manager to maintain the physical safety and quality standards of the site.
- Work in a fast changing and ambiguous environment.
- Perform additional duties, as assigned
- Work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs.

About the team
Interested in joining our dedicated team at Amazon that makes the return of pickup and packages convenient for our customers at our Locker+ retail locations? Curious to be at the heart of where innovation meets customer obsession?

Customer Experience Operations (CXO) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with quality service in an ever-changing environment. Our goal is to go beyond assisting with customer orders. We strive to connect personally with our customers and uplift their lives – even if for just a few moments. We operate out of designated retail locations – where it’s convenient for our customers – helping facilitate the delivery and return of customer orders.

title: Senior Generative AI Research Engineer (Foundation Models) — Tokyo
description:
Applications: candidates must already be in Japan. Visa sponsorship: not available. Japanese: Not required. English: Fluent. Japan Dev tags: Engineering, AI, Python, Research.

Location requirement

You must already be living in Japan with valid work authorization. We are not sponsoring relocation or visa transfers from overseas for this role. Applications from outside Japan will not be considered.

About Abbeal

Abbeal is an international IT consulting firm (France, Japan, Canada) placing senior engineers on high-impact R&D teams. Through Abbeal, build a custom foundation model for sustainable cosmetics & pharma R&D with a Tokyo-listed group.

Context

You will build a custom foundation model that generates sustainable cosmetic & pharmaceutical formulations in unsupervised mode, for a Tokyo-listed pharma & cosmetics group. Deep generative AI / foundation-model research, remote-friendly (Tokyo / Paris / remote). English is the working language; Japanese is not required (no JLPT requirement).

Your Mission

  • Design and train custom foundation / generative models for molecular & formulation generation
  • Work with GNNs, diffusion models, and unsupervised learning on chemistry data
  • Leverage RDKit / DeepChem and modern deep-learning tooling (PyTorch / JAX)
  • Build RAG and evaluation pipelines around the models
  • Collaborate with R&D scientists to translate research into usable outputs

Profile

  • Currently based in Japan with valid work authorization — no relocation or visa sponsorship from overseas for this role
  • 5+ years (ideally 8–12) in ML / deep learning, with generative or foundation-model experience
  • Strong PyTorch / JAX; GNN, diffusion, unsupervised learning
  • Familiarity with cheminformatics (RDKit / DeepChem) a strong plus
  • Fluent English; Japanese not required

Location and Setup

Remote-friendly (Tokyo / Paris / remote). Freelance (senior FR/EU day rate) or permanent in Japan via Abbeal KK. Hired and supported by Abbeal (visa sponsorship + Mobbeal expat package). Indicative permanent range ¥14M–¥20M/year depending on experience.

title: (Seoul) Product Manager · AI Platform
description:
This position is open for candidates who reside in Korea and have a Korean proficiency appropriate for working in a Korean business.

"Conquering cancer through AI"

Lunit은 "Learning Unit"을 줄여 만든 이름으로, 암 진단 및 치료에 기여하는 인공지능 솔루션을 개발하고 제공하는 의료 AI 기업입니다.
루닛은 인공지능 기술을 통해 더 정확한 암 진단과 치료 효과 예측이 가능해지고, 환자를 위한 신속한 맞춤형 치료가 가능해지는 시대를 열고자 합니다.

💭 About the team

  • AI가 실제 의료 현장에서 작동하기 위해서는 좋은 모델만으로는 충분하지 않습니다. Lunit AI Platform Department는 전 세계 환자의 진단과 치료에 실제로 활용되는 의료 AI 모델이 안정적으로 개발되고 운영될 수 있도록 데이터·학습·검증·서빙 전반을 연결하는 AI 플랫폼을 구축합니다. 사내 Research/Development를 지원하는 플랫폼뿐 아니라, 최근에는 북미 시장과 국내외 정부 사업 및 의료기관에 제공되는 외부 서비스 플랫폼까지 직접 개발하고 운영하고 있습니다. 우리는 암의 조기 발견과 더 정확한 치료라는 Lunit의 미션을 기술과 제품의 관점에서 실현하고자 합니다.
  • 빠르게 시도하고 실제 사용자의 피드백을 바탕으로 지속적으로 개선하는 개발 문화를 지향합니다. 문제를 정의하는 단계부터 PM, AI 연구자, 엔지니어가 함께 참여해 해결 방향을 구체화하며, 품질을 유지하면서도 개발 속도를 높일 수 있도록 AI 기반 개발 및 자동화 도구도 적극적으로 활용하고 있습니다.

💭 About the position

AI Platform Department의 PM은 의료 데이터 관리, AI 모델 학습·검증·운영 등 복잡하게 연결된 문제를 하나의 제품과 시스템으로 구체화합니다. 사내 AI 개발·운영을 지원하는 In-house Data Platform부터 의료기관 및 외부 고객이 자신의 의료 데이터로 AI 모델을 개발·파인튜닝·검증·배포할 수 있는 외부 플랫폼을 함께 만들고 있습니다.

단순히 요구사항을 정리하는 데 그치지 않고, 무엇을 왜 만들어야 하는지 정의하고 제품의 방향과 우선순위를 설정하며 실행까지 주도합니다. 이를 위해 AI Research, Medical, Engineering, Business 등 다양한 분야의 전문가들과 협업하며 서로 다른 요구사항과 기술적·비즈니스적 제약을 제품의 방향성과 실행 계획으로 연결합니다.

  • Focus Area: What challenges will I face?
    • 서로 다른 이해관계와 요구사항을 이해하고 제품의 우선순위를 결정하는 일
    • 개발 속도뿐 아니라 유지보수성, 확장성, 운영성까지 고려해 제품과 기술의 균형점을 찾는 일
    • 새롭게 시작하는 외부 고객용 제품에서 아직 명확하지 않은 문제를 구조화하고 제품의 형태로 구체화하는 일
    • 변화하는 상황에 맞춰 계획을 유연하게 조정하면서도 목표한 결과를 끝까지 만들어내는 일
  • Ideal Profile: What kind of PM fits well here?
    • 정해진 업무를 실행하는 것보다 문제를 정의하고 구조와 시스템을 설계하는 데 흥미를 느끼는 분
    • 문제가 명확하지 않은 상황에서도 필요한 정보를 직접 찾아보고 가설과 대안을 제시하며 논의를 이끌어가는 분
    • AI Researcher/Medical/Engineering 전문가의 복잡한 요구사항을 그대로 전달하는 것이 아니라 제품의 문제와 우선순위로 구조화할 수 있는 분
    • 제품의 방향성뿐 아니라 일정·리소스·리스크까지 함께 고려하며 실제 결과물을 끝까지 만들어내는 분
    • 의료 분야 경험이 없더라도, 새로운 도메인을 빠르게 학습하고 이해하려는 의지가 있으신 분
    • AI와 기술의 변화를 빠르게 학습하고 새로운 도구를 실제 업무에 적용해보는 것을 좋아하는 분
    • 다양한 직군 및 글로벌 동료들과 적극적으로 소통하며 서로 다른 관점에서 함께 답을 만들어가는 것을 좋아하는 분
  • Opportunities: How will I grow?
    • 도메인 전문가들과 협업하며 의료 데이터와 AI가 결합된 복잡한 시스템을 제품으로 구체화하는 경험을 쌓을 수 있습니다. 또한 기존 In-house 플랫폼의 운영을 넘어, 의료기관을 대상으로 하는 새로운 플랫폼을 0-to-1으로 기획하고 제품화하는 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 의료 AI라는 규제 산업의 특성과 글로벌 동료들과의 협업을 경험하며, Product Management와 Project Management를 아우르는 PM으로 성장할 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다.

🚩 주요 업무

의료 데이터를 기반으로 AI 모델이 개발·검증·운영되는 전체 과정을 이해하고, 이를 지원하는 사내 플랫폼과 외부 고객용 서비스 플랫폼을 기획하고 구축합니다. 단순히 요구사항을 정리하는 역할을 넘어, 무엇을 왜 만들어야 하는지 정의하고, 우선순위를 결정하며 다양한 전문가들과 함께 실제 제품으로 구현하여 출시까지 이끄는 역할을 담당합니다.

  • 제품 전략 및 연간 제품 로드맵 수립·관리
  • 의료 데이터 → AI 모델 학습 → 검증 → 배포·운영까지 End-to-End Workflow를 이해하고 제품으로 구체화
  • 비즈니스 가치, 사용자 니즈, 기술적 제약을 종합적으로 고려한 제품 기능 기획 및 우선순위 결정
  • AI Research, Medical, Engineering, Business 등 다양한 전문가와 협업하여 복잡한 문제를 제품 요구사항과 실행 계획으로 구체화
  • Sprint 기반 Software Development Life Cycle 및 프로젝트 End-to-End 관리
  • 일정, 리소스, 기술적 제약 및 의존성을 고려한 프로젝트 리스크 식별 및 대응
  • 사내 AI 개발·운영 플랫폼을 넘어 향후 외부 고객을 위한 플랫폼으로 확장하기 위한 제품 기획 및 운영

담당 제품군

  • 의료 및 AI 관련 규제를 충족하는 Radiology 및 Digital pathology 데이터 저장소 시스템
  • 데이터 탐색 및 큐레이션 도구
  • AI 모델 학습에 사용되는 데이터에 어노테이션을 수행하는 도구
  • 데이터 수집부터 AI 모델 학습까지 하나의 흐름으로 연결하는 AI 플랫폼

Requirements

🎯 자격요건

  • 5년 이상의 Product/Project Management 경험 또는 이에 준하는 경험을 보유하신 분

title: Sr Security Solutions Architect, AWS
description:
Are you passionate about Cloud Security and Artificial Intelligence? Do you have a unique combination of deep technical knowledge, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Security Solutions Architect to work with our largest customers. In this vital role, you will help overcome barriers to AWS adoption by identifying and tackling major security, risk, and compliance questions from stakeholders, as well as build and maintain CIO/CISO/CRO and executive-level relationships becoming their Security Advisor. You will work directly with customer security, audit, risk and compliance teams to help them understand how to confidently utilize AWS, identify risk and design controls, setup ongoing assurance, and establish automated compliance.

At AWS, customer obsession is in our DNA. The successful candidate will become a trusted advisor to customers and will work with AWS sales, business development, solutions architecture and product teams to help accelerate adoption by removing compliance and audit as barriers and suggest improvements to our services to meet the customer needs.

This position is based in São Paulo, Brazil, and the role requires approximately 15% travel (including international).

Key job responsibilities
- Work with AWS customers to convey cloud computing security and risk management best practices
- Work with other teams within AWS develop the internal security expertise and to drive revenue
- Develop technical content, such as white papers, reference architectures, blogposts, workshops, or code samples that can be used by our customers to assist them in deploying secure cloud-based solutions
- Assess security-related knowledge across AWS sales and solutions architecture teams and develop plans to address gaps
- Presenting about security topics at AWS events, and represent AWS at security conferences by delivering presentations and lectures

About the team
The Security, Networking and Compliance team is a team of specialists distributed in the main LATAM cities that handles the expert-level customer requirements that are too complex for generalist solutions architects to handle.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture: Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth: We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance: We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

## Actuated Systems Engineer

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems

Job Summary

General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), an affiliate of General Atomics, is a world leader in proven, reliable remotely piloted aircraft and tactical reconnaissance radars, as well as advanced high-resolution surveillance systems.

We have an exciting opportunity located in Poway, CA as an Actuated Systems Engineer. In this position, you will lead development of actuated systems for aircraft flight control, deployment and utility systems. The GA-ASI’s actuated systems consist of a wide array of control/deployment mechanisms and rotary and linear electro-mechanical actuators comprising BLDC Motor, gear train, ball screw, bearings, feedback devices, brakes, and other components. You will also collaborate with interdisciplinary functional teams including EE, Controls, Software, Flight Technologies, Landing Gear, and Aero Structures to ensure system level success. The Engineer will participate in Actuated system lifecycle development activities including requirements definition, design reviews, procurement/manufacturing, and qualification/certification. You will also perform trade studies of relevant technologies, devices and components. Additionally, you will provide product support for the GA-ASI's existing range of actuators and mechanisms.

title: Credit Controller - (25 Hours part-time)

In this role, you’ll play a key part in protecting the business through effective credit risk management. You’ll ensure processes are followed and deliver accurate, timely and insightful reporting. Working closely with Site and Area Managers, you’ll proactively manage arrears, support the resolution of customer disputes, and guide accounts through the collection process — including litigation where appropriate.
If you’re proactive, collaborative and keen to develop in a supportive and fast-moving environment, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a part-time position 25 hours per week across 4 or 5 days. The salary is £28,000 to £35,000 per annum (pro rata).
  • Ensure the consistent use of Yardi systems -All notes to be kept up to date.

  • Ensure site management collection of receivables from customers as they fall due to strict collection targets to achieve.
  • Identify and register customer queries on Yardi and monitor progress of queries to their satisfactory resolution.
  • Prepare and dispatch monthly chase letters and legal notifications.
  • Proactively communicate to site and area management any debt risks and arrange Monthly Aged Debt Review.

description:

The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy. We achieve this through open source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies.

The Role

The OSINT Investigator will work in a team dedicated to investigating malign influence. They will use open-source tools, techniques and methodologies to monitor, collate, verify and analyse information shared across social media platforms and other media outlets, generating products and relevant leads for further investigation. They will also support the team with understanding the entities, networks and infrastructure that conduct and enable malign influence.

  • Record information in databases and code that data to pre-set information fields as required.
  • Analyse data from multiple sources to build comprehensive reports on events and entities to generate insight into patterns of behaviour.
  • Contribute to the design and production of project-wide high-quality reports that effectively communicate key insights, findings, and the evidence and methodology underpinning them.

title: Konseptutredning
description:
Avd. Fellesløsninger (FEL) i Digitaliseringsdirektoratet (Digdir) har behov for bistand tilknyttet arbeidet med å få et helhetlig kunnskapsgrunnlag som skal brukes i arbeidet med nyttestyring for innføring av digital identitetslommebok i Norge.

Vi vurderer at oppdraget kan egne seg for et team av ressurser.

BAKGRUNN

Leveransen knytter seg til tidligere utarbeidet konseptvalgutredning (KVU ) og KS1-rapport.

Mars 2026 leverte Digdir sammen med Politidirektoratet, Skatteetaten og Utlendingsdirektoratet en konseptvalgutredning (KVU) om hvordan den felleseuropeiske digitale identitetslommeboken kan utstedes i Norge. KVU’en ble utført på oppdrag fra Digitaliserings- og forvaltningsdepartementet (DFD), Finansdepartementet (FIN) og Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet (JD) med bakgrunn i flere utfordringer ved dagens eID-løsninger i Norge.

Juni 2026 leverte ekstern kvalitetssikrer sin rapport. Grundigere arbeid med gevinster og etablering av et styringssystem for gevinstrealisering var noen av tilrådningene fra ekstern kvalitetssikrer. Oppfølging av forventet nytte og gevinstrealisering er også krav i prosjekt omfattet av Statens prosjektmodell, jf. FINs Rundskriv 108/2025.

Konseptvalgutredningen er avgrenset til å vurdere hvordan digital lommebok kan tilgjengeliggjøres til brukerne, altså utstedelse, og dekker ikke bruken av digital lommebok i samfunnet. Dette innebærer at nyttevirkninger av bruken av digital lommebok ikke er fullt ut utredet i KVU’en.

I parallell med konseptvalgutredningen har ekstern leverandør på vegne av Digdir utført en analyse av det samfunnsøkonomiske gevinstpotensialet ved å ta i bruk slike lommebøker, med utgangspunkt i noen utvalgte brukstilfeller. Målet var å gi et strukturert grunnlag for å vurdere hvilke brukstilfelle som kan gi størst verdi i norsk kontekst og hvilke forutsetninger som er sentrale for å lykkes med bruk av digital identitetslommebok i Norge. Utredningen viste at digital identitetslommebok kan gi betydelige gevinster for Norge, men realiseringen avhenger av en trinnvis innføringsstrategi, tydelig koordinering og aktivering av økosystemet.

Digdir skal i løpet av 26/27 gå i gang med forprosjektfasen for arbeidet med digital lommebok. Det er behov for en grundigere kartlegging og identifisering av gevinster i bruksfasen av digital lommebok. Arbeidet vil benyttes inn i nyttestyringen av innføringen av digital lommebok i Norge

RESULTATER OG EFFEKTER Digdir ØNSKER Å OPPNÅ:

Formålet med anskaffelsen er å få utarbeidet et helhetlig kunnskapsgrunnlag som skal brukes i arbeidet med nyttestyring for innføring av digital identitetslommebok i Norge.

Kunnskapsgrunnlaget skal omfatte bruksfasen av digital lommebok med eID på høyt nivå. Arbeidet skal bygge videre på arbeidet som allerede er gjennomført, herunder konseptvalgutredning (KVU), ekstern leverandør sin analyse av det samfunnsøkonomiske gevinstpotensialet for digital lommebok og erfaringer fra Digdirs sandkasse for digital lommebok.

Den skal også følge opp tilrådningene fra ekstern kvalitetssikrer om behov for et grundigere arbeid med gevinster og etablering av et styringssystem for gevinstrealisering, i tråd med kravene til gevinstrealisering i Statens prosjektmodell, jf. Finansdepartementets rundskriv R-108/2025.

KRAV TIL SLUTTRESULTAT

Kunnskapsgrunnlaget skal:

  • identifisere og tallfeste (der dette er mulig) forventede samfunnsøkonomiske nytte- og kostnadsvirkninger for bruksfasen av digital identitetslommebok. Utredningen skal kunne gi et utgangspunkt for prioritering av brukstilfeller som er mulig å realisere i en tidlig fase og som gir størst verdi i norsk kontekst.

  • kartlegge forutsetningene som bør være på plass for at gevinstene kan realiseres samt avhengigheter og rekkefølge som grunnlag for gevinstkart og en trinnvis innføringsstrategi.

  • gi en oversikt over hvilke bevis og tjenester andre EU-land planlegger å ta i bruk, som underlag for prioritering i bruksfasen og for å sikre interoperabilitet

  • gi råd om viktige suksessfaktorer for å drive god nyttestyring av innføring av digital lommebok i Norge.

DIGDIR ESTIMERER AT DETTE ER ET OPPDRAG FOR ETT TEAM AV RESSURSER

Etter leveranse av kunnskapsgrunnlaget medio desember, åpner vi for behov for videre dialog/avklaringer/justeringer – alt etter respons på leveransen.

title: Data Engineer II, WW Ops Finance S&A
description:
Amazon's Outbound Transportation business relies on an activity-based costing platform that provides package-level and item-level cost visibility across all nine segments of the transportation network, covering billions of dollars in annual shipping spend across multiple regions. Cyclops is a metadata-driven self-serve platform supporting hundreds of finance professionals replacing manual Excel workbooks to track approximately 600+ Outbound transportation metrics at weekly and monthly granularity.

As a Data Engineer on this team, you will build and scale the data infrastructure behind this source-of-truth dataset, enabling finance and operations teams to assess network execution and understand cost drivers. This role sits at the center of network topology analytics, where the ability to understand Amazon's complex supply chain network and drive data model, mapping, and dimensional standardization is critical. You will onboard 100+ metrics into our central "metrics-as-a-code" platform enabling self-service reporting and analytics for finance and controllership teams. You will design, implement, and support scalable data solutions and complex data models for Amazon's Operations Finance organization. Your work will integrate heterogeneous data sources, automate ETL workflows, and deliver curated datasets used for reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc requests. You will partner with finance stakeholders, BI Engineers, and product teams to gather requirements, architect pipelines, and ensure that data is reliable, accessible, and trusted for data-driven business decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL pipelines and data solutions using Python, SQL, Spark, and AWS services (S3, Glue, Redshift, Airflow, EMR, Lambda)
- Create coherent logical and physical data models that drive the metadata-driven configuration layer, enabling finance teams to define new metrics and views without code changes
- Collaborate with finance stakeholders, BI Engineers, and partner teams to gather requirements, integrate automated and manual data feeds, and deliver trusted datasets

Our team within Operations Finance builds and operates the self-serve data platform that powers financial reporting, bridging, and analytics for over 2,500 finance customers across multiple regions. title: (Senior) AI / Reinforcement Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

Agile Robots SE is a high-tech startup based in Munich. Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI and robotics by developing robotic systems that offer state-of-the-art full-body force sensitivity and world-leading vision intelligence. This unique combination of technologies enables us to provide intelligent, easy-to-use and affordable robotic solutions with safe human-robot interaction.

We are a dynamic and innovative software development company dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that transform industries and redefine user experiences.

We are building humanoid robots that work reliably, autonomously, in the real world. As a Reinforcement Learning Engineer, you will own the development of end-to-end control policies for Agile One: from training in simulation to deployment on hardware, across locomotion, manipulation, and whole-body coordination in unstructured environments.

This is a high-ownership role. You will work at the frontier of what's possible with humanoid robots, make decisions with incomplete information, and iterate directly on physical systems. Success in this role requires both technical excellence and the ability to adapt and make decisions under uncertainty.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain and deploy scalable, end-to-end training pipelines, including hyperparameter optimization
  • Transfer control policies from simulation to real robotic hardware
  • Integrate learned policies into a full-stack robotic system, including perception, planning, and actuation
  • Analyze robot behavior and learning performance,e and iterate quickly based on real-world results
  • Evaluate and benchmark state-of-the-art algorithms
  • Stay updated with the latest research in RL and IL
  • Work autonomously on open-ended, evolving tasks

Essential Skills

  • Master’s or PhD in robotics, computer science, engineering, or a related field
  • Proven experience (5+ years) applying RL or IL in physical systems, preferably on high DOF robots
  • Familiarity with common RL algorithms (PPO, SAC, ...)
  • Proficiency in Python and/or C++, PyTorch, ONNX, and common RL frameworks (e.g, Stable Baselines 3, RSL-RL)
  • Experience with physics-based simulators (IsaacSim, MuJoCo or equivalent) for large-scale policy training
  • Strong understanding of control theory, motion planning, and robot kinematics/dynamics
  • Demonstrated success in sim-to-real transfer and deploying learning-based policies on physical robots
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in uncertain scenarios

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience in training locomotion and locomanipulation policies
  • Experience in training and deploying on humanoid robots
  • Track record of publishing at CoRL, ICRA, RSS, NeurIPS, or ICLR

What we offer

  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

title: Area Occupancy Planner, Regional Portfolio Management (RPM-AMER) GREF
description:
Work hard, have fun, make history. That's what we do every day at Amazon. As a key member within Amazon's Global Real Estate & Facilities (GREF) team, the Occupancy Planner will own end-to-end space allocation and occupancy planning for their assigned area, driving results by managing complex programs across multiple stakeholders with competing priorities and tight timelines.

The Occupancy Planner will take full ownership of aligning real estate strategy to business needs — proactively identifying gaps, driving solutions, and delivering outcomes without waiting for direction. This role requires strong program management discipline: structuring multi-workstream initiatives, managing dependencies and trade-offs, and delivering on commitments in a fast-paced environment where requirements shift rapidly. The Occupancy Planner will partner directly with business managers, GREF stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to develop data-driven recommendations regarding space allocation, occupancy scenarios, and migration plans that enable effective solutions in alignment with Amazon's workplace strategy.

The ideal candidate demonstrates a bias for action — making high-quality decisions quickly with available data, taking calculated risks, and iterating rather than waiting for perfect information. They bring a strong stakeholder management capability: navigating conflicting needs across multiple business units, building trust through transparency and data, and influencing outcomes at varied levels of the organization. They approach planning with rigor — developing structured programs with clear milestones, tracking progress against metrics, and proactively mitigating risks. The candidate must be comfortable owning ambiguity, escalating appropriately, and delivering results even when operating in incomplete-information environments.

Key job responsibilities
Own space allocation and occupancy planning for assigned areas end-to-end — from data collection through recommendation delivery and implementation

Drive the collection, verification, and analysis of headcount and space data (current capacity and future projections), proactively resolving discrepancies and ensuring planning accuracy

Manage occupancy planning programs as structured initiatives with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, and defined success metrics

Act as the primary liaison between occupancy planning teams, GREF partners, and business units — building trust, gathering requirements, aligning competing priorities, and delivering recommendations stakeholders can act on

Develop occupancy scenarios and migration plans, evaluating multiple options with quantified trade-offs to deliver data-driven recommendations that support real estate strategy and business goals

Take ownership of defect resolution related to space allocation — identifying root causes, implementing fixes, and preventing recurrence

Deliver reporting on occupancy metrics, space allocations, and portfolio-level data that enables leadership to make informed real estate decisions

Identify and implement process improvements in move management, space planning, and occupancy operations — measuring impact and scaling what works

Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple business units and organizational levels, navigating conflicting needs with a consultative, data-forward approach

**Job Title: Senior Associate, Production Planning - Over & Above (O&A) Task Estimator**

**Job Code: 43574**

**Job Location: Waco, TX**

**Job Schedule: 9/80 - Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off.**

**Job Description:**

The Over & Above Estimator is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and pricing work that falls outside the original scope of a maintenance, repair, overhaul, modification, or production contract. This role supports accurate cost estimating, customer communication, and timely approval of additional labor, materials, and services required to complete aircraft or component work. The estimator works closely with engineering, planning, supply chain, production, quality, and program/customer teams to ensure all O&A items are documented, justified, and priced in accordance with contract requirements and company procedures.

**Essential Functions:**

- Review maintenance findings, engineering dispositions, inspection reports, and teardown results to identify over-and-above work.
- Develop detailed cost estimates for non-routine or out-of-scope repairs, including labor hours, materials, outside services, tooling, and subcontract support.
- Interpret technical data such as aircraft manuals, drawings, work scopes, bills of material, and repair instructions.
- Prepare and submit O&A quotations, change requests, and support documentation to internal stakeholders or customers for approval.
- Coordinate with production, engineering, supply chain, and quality teams to validate scope, pricing, and schedule impacts.
- Track estimate status, approvals, and execution to ensure authorized work is released in a timely manner.
- Maintain cost history, pricing databases, labor standards, and estimating templates to improve estimate accuracy.
- Analyze historical actuals versus estimates and recommend process improvements.
- Ensure compliance with contract terms, customer requirements, regulatory standards, and company policies.
- Support audits, contract reviews, and customer inquiries related to O&A charges.
- Monitor turnaround time and prioritize estimates to minimize aircraft or component downtime.
- Assist program management and finance with forecasting, variance analysis, and revenue recognition support as needed.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience.
- Graduate Degree or equivalent with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience.
- In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.
- Demonstrated experience in aerospace MRO, depot maintenance, modification programs, or military aviation support.
- Demonstrated familiarity with FAR/DFARS, government contracts, or commercial aviation service agreements.
- Demonstrated understanding of cost estimating methods, labor standards, and pricing strategy.
- Demonstrated experience working with customers, DCMA/DCAA environments, or contract change processes.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- A&P, or cost estimating-related certification is a plus.
- Cost estimating and pricing
- Aerospace maintenance knowledge
- Contract and scope analysis
- Technical document interpretation
- Cross-functional coordination
- Data analysis and reporting
- Attention to detail
- Negotiation and customer support
- Schedule awareness
- ERP/MRP proficiency

title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team. This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you’ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You bring proven knowledge in building and operating sophisticated search platforms and engineering robust, high-performance software systems.
  • Experience mentoring expert engineers, providing both technical and professional guidance.
  • Experience defining a long-term technical vision for a core search or retrieval system, working across teams and organizations to collaboratively shape the technical roadmap.
  • Hands-on experience with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, or Solr,
  • Strong skills in core Java and familiarity with advanced data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features like lambdas. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.
  • Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.
  • Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Collaborating across distributed teams is challenging, we value being supportive, empathetic, and trusting in all interactions, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before, and you have experience in the search and information retrieval space and understand the constructs and theory behind it.
  • Experience working with open source projects and familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

- **Broad knowledge of machine learning inclusive of tradition machine learning, deep learning and Gen AI architectures.**

- Demonstrated success in competitive proposal calls in space-related areas

- ML publication record in respected, peer reviewed venues, or equivalent industry delivery experience.

- Experience with software engineering best practices.

- Demonstrated experience with rigorous validation for scientific investigations

- Strong written and oral communication skills including data visualization, presentation, and explanation of results.

- Team-building mentality, can-do attitude, and relentless commitment to project success.

- Experience working with HPC and/or cloud-based distributed computing systems.


**Preferred Skills:**

- Optimizing and delivering algorithms to onboard, large-scale computing, or real-time operational systems.

- Working knowledge of uncertainty quantification and generative modeling.

- Experience working with imaging spectroscopy data for airborne or orbital instruments.

- Experience creating and validating large-scale data products based on machine learning.

title: Senior Backend Engineer — Authentication & Security Platform (Digital Bank)
description:
Applications: candidates must already be in Japan. Visa sponsorship: not available. Japanese: Not required. English: Fluent. Japan Dev tags: Engineering, Backend, Security, Java, Kotlin, PostgreSQL, Spring.

Location requirement

You must already be living in Japan with valid work authorization. We are not sponsoring relocation or visa transfers from overseas for this role. Applications from outside Japan will not be considered.

About Abbeal

Abbeal is an international IT consulting firm (France, Japan, Canada) placing senior engineers on high-impact product teams. Through Abbeal, join the Authentication & Authorization platform of an FSA-regulated digital bank launching in Japan.

The Context

We support an FSA-regulated digital bank launching its platform in Japan. You will join the team building the Authentication & Authorization foundation: OAuth 2.0/OIDC login, token lifecycle and identity management across four banking channels (officer dashboards, customer apps, BaaS APIs, third-party integrations). The team is distributed across Japan, Vietnam and India; the role is anchored on Tokyo with a remote-friendly setup. English is the working language — Japanese is not required.

What You Will Build

  • Token lifecycle — DPoP-bound access tokens, silent refresh, session management
  • Passkey / FIDO2 — WebAuthn registration and login flows, step-up authentication
  • mTLS integrations — certificate-based service-to-service auth with external financial platforms
  • Shared security library — Spring Boot starter providing standardized auth filters
  • Integration testing — Karate-based suites covering all auth flows at scale
  • Monitoring — auth event observability, anomaly detection, audit trail completeness

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years in server-side backend engineering, including 5-7 years in Kotlin or Java + Spring Boot
  • Spring Security (filter chains, OAuth2 Resource Server) and strong OAuth 2.0 / OIDC knowledge
  • At least one of DPoP, mTLS, PKCE, FIDO2 / WebAuthn — plus JWT (claims, JWKS, key rotation)
  • Redis (sessions, distributed locking, caching) and PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations)
  • AWS (ECS/Fargate, Secrets Manager) and Terraform or equivalent IaC
  • Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and secure web application development
  • Professional English (working language); Japanese not required

Nice to Have

  • Currently based in Japan with valid work authorization — no relocation or visa sponsorship from overseas for this role
  • Authlete; FAPI 2.0 Security Profile; Microsoft Entra ID; Cloudflare / Akamai (mTLS termination, WAF)
  • Fintech / regulated banking background (FSA, maker-checker, audit logging); Japanese ability

Why This Role

A real FSA-supervised bank — cutting-edge security standards (FAPI 2.0, DPoP, WebAuthn/FIDO2), high ownership of entire authentication channels, global collaboration on a greenfield platform.

Compensation and Setup

Permanent role, anchored on Tokyo, distributed team, remote-friendly. Indicative range ¥8M–¥17M/year depending on experience. Hired and supported by Abbeal (visa sponsorship + Mobbeal expat support); relocation support possible depending on profile.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team. This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you’ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You bring proven knowledge in building and operating sophisticated search platforms and engineering robust, high-performance software systems.
  • Experience mentoring expert engineers, providing both technical and professional guidance.
  • Experience defining a long-term technical vision for a core search or retrieval system, working across teams and organizations to collaboratively shape the technical roadmap.
  • Hands-on experience with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, or Solr,
  • Strong skills in core Java and familiarity with advanced data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features like lambdas. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.
  • Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.
  • Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Collaborating across distributed teams is challenging, we value being supportive, empathetic, and trusting in all interactions, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before, and you have experience in the search and information retrieval space and understand the constructs and theory behind it.
  • Experience working with open source projects and familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€80.400—€127.200 EUR

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that.
