Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

title: Software Development Engineer II, OrcaLabs
description:
Do you want to build systems that sit at the heart of how Amazon runs its business and help define how AI agents interact with those systems in the future? Are you excited by distributed systems, workflow orchestration, and agentic AI at Amazon scale?

The Center of Excellence for Orchestration (ORCA) is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help build and evolve Amazon’s tier-1, multi-tenant orchestration platform. ORCA powers mission-critical business workflows across Amazon and is used by thousands of developers to automate complex processes without building and operating their own orchestration infrastructure.

ORCA handles the hard parts of distributed workflow execution so customers can focus on business logic. We’re now evolving the platform for an AI-native world by building AI-assisted workflow development, automated testing and diagnostics, intelligent operational support, and new ways for AI agents to safely discover, invoke, and compose business capabilities.

As an SDE II on ORCA, you’ll design and build highly available distributed systems, solve challenging scalability and reliability problems, and help shape the foundation that connects traditional workflow automation with emerging agentic experiences. You’ll own projects from design through production and work closely with experienced engineers and customers across Amazon.

If you enjoy solving hard systems problems, building platforms that simplify development at scale, and shaping how workflows and AI agents come together, we’d love to have you join ORCA!

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate scalable features for ORCA’s tier-1 orchestration platform, owning work across the full software development lifecycle.
- Build agentic and AI-assisted capabilities that help developers design, test, troubleshoot, and operate workflows, and enable AI agents to safely discover, invoke, and compose business capabilities.
- Design reliable distributed systems that handle workflow execution, scheduling, retries, throttling, fault tolerance, scaling, and observability across a multi-tenant platform used by thousands of developers.
- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical planning, providing thoughtful feedback and incorporating input from senior engineers to improve system quality.
- Collaborate with product, security, architecture, and customer teams to understand requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver simple, scalable solutions aligned with ORCA’s long-term platform strategy.
- Help shape emerging patterns for how workflows, business capabilities, and AI agents interact securely and reliably at Amazon scale.

A day in the life
Your day might start by building a new ORCA platform or agentic capability, reviewing code, or working through a design for how AI agents discover and invoke business capabilities. Later, you may collaborate with teammates on a scaling or reliability challenge, meet with customers to understand a new use case, and ship your work through the deployment pipeline. Along the way, you’ll contribute to design discussions and help shape how ORCA evolves for an AI-native future.

About the team
The Center of Excellence for Orchestration (ORCA) is a collaborative team focused on making it easier for Amazon teams to build and operate complex business processes at scale. We work across distributed systems, developer experience, and emerging agentic technologies, partnering closely with customers and teams across Amazon.

We’re shaping the next generation of orchestration, where workflows, business capabilities, and AI agents come together securely and reliably. You’ll have the opportunity to work on foundational technology with broad impact while learning from experienced engineers and helping influence ORCA’s future.

title: Sr Product TPM, Amazon Infrastructure Service - Manufacturing Operation
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS’ Infrastructure Services & Supply Chain (AIS-SC) organization works to deliver leading-edge solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. We are seeking a highly effective candidate to identify, create, develop and integrate innovative technology to deliver the best operating, lowest cost infrastructure in the world.

Key job responsibilities
You will lead a cross function team to deliver AWS roadmap and achieve manufacturing operation readiness for new product release in our global manufacturing locations. You will work on new product development program from concept phase and drive manufacturing capability and capacity enablement strategy and implementation. You will work with R&D and ODM to manage new product/ technology deployment risk. You ensure manufacturing infrastructure and manufacturing capability (automation, assembly, test) are planned ahead and enabled for NPI release. You drive DFx to achieve better design for manufacturability, quality, serviceability and cost. You define integration strategy to drive cost-effective and reliable supply chain setup. You manage supply chain readiness through extended team and drive critical commodity supply readiness (both quality and supply continuity). You'll ensure seamless teamwork and synergy among AWS, ODM and CMs on NPI program on every details from product/process qualification plan, material readiness, process/test readiness, change management, quality management and production ramp plan etc. Your objective is to achieve Factory Readiness Complete on time with required capability and capacity to serve customer demand.

A day in the life
You represent Manufacturing Operation in NPI product development core team and work closely with Engineering TPM and Lead Engineer to understand new product requirements and develop manufacturing capability & capacity enablement plan with your extended team. You will drive engineering rigor and due diligence and practice Amazon LPs to achieve NPI release objective. You actively manage program risk and prepare your team for rapid/frequent change request in need to serve customer. You pay attention to details and hold your team aligned to the big picture. You are effective program leader and help your team overcome NPI release risk & issue.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team. This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you’ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You bring proven knowledge in building and operating sophisticated search platforms and engineering robust, high-performance software systems.
  • Experience mentoring expert engineers, providing both technical and professional guidance.
  • Experience defining a long-term technical vision for a core search or retrieval system, working across teams and organizations to collaboratively shape the technical roadmap.
  • Hands-on experience with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, or Solr,
  • Strong skills in core Java and familiarity with advanced data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features like lambdas. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.
  • Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.
  • Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Collaborating across distributed teams is challenging, we value being supportive, empathetic, and trusting in all interactions, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before, and you have experience in the search and information retrieval space and understand the constructs and theory behind it.
  • Experience working with open source projects and familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

title: Business head - Pharma Channel
description:
**What We Are**

CHOSEN is India's first dermatologist-built personal care brand — engineered from the ground up for the Indian exposome: the specific combination of UV intensity, PM2.5 pollution, humidity, and pigmentation biology that defines how Indian skin ages, reacts, and heals. Most personal care products sold in India were formulated for European skin or a generic tropical consumer. CHOSEN was built to close that gap.

The brand was founded by Dr. Renita Rajan, a dermatologist with 20 years of clinical practice and the published author of *Sunscreens for Skin of Colour* (Springer Nature, 2024). Every CHOSEN product begins with a clinical problem, moves through published science, and reaches the consumer only when the evidence holds. The science is not a marketing layer — it is the foundation.

We operate through two distinct channels:

**CHOSEN D2C** (chosenstore.in) — science-first skincare for sensitive skin, sold direct to consumers.

**IZONIS powered by CHOSEN** — an HCP-exclusive line distributed through the dermatologist channel, keeping clinical-grade formulations where they belong.

Backed by Fireside Ventures and BOLD (L'Oréal's venture arm).

---

**The Founder**

*"Indian dermatologists have contributed significantly to therapeutic dermatology. Personal care has been left behind… CHOSEN is dermatology stepping up to close that gap. Built for the Indian exposome. Built for the Indian genome."* — Dr. Renita Rajan, Founder & CEO

---

**Where We Are**

Series A. Fireside Ventures and L'Oréal BOLD have backed us to grow — not to consolidate. The roles we are hiring for are growth-critical. We are looking for builders: people who write the playbook, not follow one. Candidates will have meaningful ownership and visible impact from day one.

---

**Who We Are Hiring**

We are a good fit for people who:

**Think in evidence, not in trends.** We sell science, not SKUs. The best candidates we have hired have worked on products where the mechanism of action *was* the marketing story — and they were comfortable explaining it plainly.

**Have builder instinct.** We are early. The infrastructure, the processes, and the playbooks are being written now. People who need a fully built system to operate in will find this hard. People who find that energising will thrive.

**Have genuine Indian market and Indian skin fluency.** This is not a Western brand localising for India. It was built here, for here. Candidates who have worked in Tier 2 markets, with the dermatologist channel, or in categories where the Indian consumer's biology and behaviour is the starting point — not an afterthought — will adapt fastest.

**Hold complexity without collapsing it.** Our category — dermo cosmetics, UV filters, exposome science — is genuinely nuanced. We do not expect candidates to arrive with all of it. We do expect them to be curious about it, and rigorous when they engage with it.

We are looking for a Business Head – Pharma Channel to lead and scale this business. This is a leadership role with end-to-end ownership of the commercial strategy, sales organization, distribution network, and growth of the dermatologist channel. We're looking for a builder who can create playbooks, grow teams, and establish IZONIS as the preferred partner for dermatologists across India.

### Key Responsibilities

- Own the growth strategy and commercial performance of the IZONIS business.

- Lead the national sales organization across Medical Representatives and regional sales teams.

- Expand and strengthen relationships with dermatologists, clinics, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).

- Build and optimize distributor and stockist networks across geographies.

- Drive doctor onboarding, repeat engagement, and channel expansion.

- Own sales forecasting, business planning, and revenue performance.

- Partner closely with the Founder and leadership team on product launches and channel strategy.

- Represent the brand at dermatology conferences and industry events.

### What We're Looking For

- 12–18+ years of commercial leadership experience.

- Strong experience in the dermatology, dermocosmetics, cosmeceuticals, or pharma ecosystem.

- Proven experience leading national sales teams and distributor networks.

- Track record of scaling a business, business unit, or commercial function.

- Experience managing senior stakeholders, KOLs, and healthcare professional relationships.

- Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue and business performance.

**Job Description:**

The L3Harris Spectral Solutions division is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to support space vehicle–level development for missile warning and missile defense missions. This role leads the technical planning, requirements development, integration, verification, and lifecycle execution of advanced space-based systems supporting national security objectives. The Lead Systems Engineer works across multidisciplinary teams to ensure that payload, bus, software, ground, and mission interfaces are defined, allocated, and managed in alignment with program goals and customer expectations. This position is responsible for guiding system architecture trades, assessing technical risk, and driving balanced solutions that meet performance, schedule, cost, and mission assurance requirements. The role supports the decomposition of mission needs into actionable system and subsystem requirements and ensures traceability throughout design, integration, and test activities. The Lead Systems Engineer also serves as a key technical interface with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, representing system-level priorities, issues, and recommendations. In addition, this position helps coordinate verification and validation efforts, anomaly resolution, configuration management, and readiness reviews across the space vehicle lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership, systems thinking, and technical communication skills, along with experience supporting complex aerospace or defense programs in a collaborative engineering environment.

**Essential Functions:**

•    Lead space vehicle-level systems engineering for satellite programs from concept development through design, integration, test, launch, and mission operations support.

•    Own the development, decomposition, allocation, and management of spacecraft system requirements to subsystem and component levels.

•    Coordinate cross-functional technical efforts among systems, payload, avionics, flight software, mechanical, thermal, power, propulsion, guidance and control, integration and test, and mission operations teams.

•    Lead development and maintenance of the space vehicle architecture, technical baseline, and interface definitions to ensure system compatibility and mission success.

•    Manage system-level trades, performance analyses, and design decisions affecting spacecraft capability, cost, schedule, reliability, and risk.

•    Lead system integration, verification, validation, and test planning to ensure compliance with program requirements and mission objectives.

•    Support major technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, FRR, and post-launch readiness activities, and present technical status to internal and external stakeholders.

•    Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks and opportunities associated with spacecraft design, manufacturing, integration, environmental test, and launch vehicle interfaces.

•    Collaborate with program management, production, quality, supply chain, and subcontractor teams to ensure successful execution of the space vehicle build and delivery.

•    Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to systems engineers and cross-disciplinary engineering teams while fostering disciplined engineering execution and continuous improvement.

•    Job is onsite in Palm Bay, FL

**Qualifications:**

•    Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline and a minimum of 9 years of relevant experience; or a Graduate degree and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

•    Ability to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

•    Experience leading space vehicle systems engineering on government, civil, or commercial satellite programs.

•    Experience supporting spacecraft integration and test, environmental qualification, launch site operations, or on-orbit anomaly resolution.

•    Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), requirements management tools, and configuration management processes.

•    Familiarity with System-level performance analysis (e.g., image analysis, thermal analysis, structural analysis, end-to-end performance, reliability analysis)

•    Strong understanding in space vehicle design considerations in various orbital regimes: radiation, space charging, thermal, telecom, power, propulsion, disposal, etc.

•    Familiarity with top level mission analysis and trades such as conops, DITL, coverage maps, revisit rates, etc. in support of mission formulation

•    Well versed in functions, responsibilities and interconnectivities between Space Segment, Ground Segment and Launch Segment

•    Active security clearance

•    Experience in spacecraft, satellite, or other complex aerospace system development with demonstrated responsibility at the system or vehicle level.

•    Experience with requirements management, interface control, system integration, verification and validation, and technical baseline management across the product lifecycle.

•    Ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams, communicate technical issues clearly to leadership and customers, and support execution in a multi-site development environment.

title: ​​Senior DevOps Engineer​
description:
Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients.

There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Place to Work 2025 & 2026'.

If this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on…

The Function

The Digital and Technology team designs, builds and maintains the systems that power Triple Point. The function enables seamless connectivity, security and innovation across the organisation, creating tools and platforms that help colleagues and partners work smarter and deliver excellent outcomes.

The Team

This role sits within Technical Operations & Cyber, within the wider Digital and Technology function. The role works closely with colleagues across D&T, our MSP, our SOC and stakeholders across the business. The team is responsible for keeping our technology secure, reliable and high performing while improving delivery pace through automation, cloud engineering and emerging technology.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to lead hands-on DevOps and platform engineering across Triple Point’s Microsoft cloud and AI delivery landscape.

You will design, build and operate secure deployment pipelines, automation, monitoring and infrastructure-as-code patterns that enable cloud and AI workloads to move safely and at pace. As our use of Claude Code, AI agents and automation grows, this role will provide the engineering foundations to run these capabilities reliably, securely and with clear governance.

Working closely with the Head of Technical Operations & Cyber and our Senior Cyber Engineer, you will help enable pragmatic, risk-aware decisions on cloud and AI tooling, ensuring a balance between delivery pace and security, governance and operational sustainability.

This is a delivery-focused role owning engineering work end-to-end, from discovery and design through to implementation, documentation and transition into BAU. You will help remove delivery bottlenecks, strengthen platform maturity and make practical recommendations that balance pace, reliability, security and usability.

Key Responsibilities

DevOps, Cloud Platform & CI/CD Engineering

  • Design, build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for cloud, integration, automation and AI workloads.
  • Create reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns, templates and standards for secure, consistent cloud deployments.
  • Improve release management, environment management and deployment controls across development, test and production environments.
  • Support source control, branching, build, test and deployment practices that help teams deliver safely and efficiently.
  • Build practical engineering standards for service principals, managed identities, secrets, configuration, certificates and environment separation.

Automation, AI Enablement & Developer Experience

  • Enable safe, reliable deployment and operation of Claude Code, AI agents and similar AI-assisted development tooling.
  • Automate repeatable operational, deployment and monitoring tasks to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
  • Develop self-service patterns, reusable scripts and documentation that make it easier for colleagues to adopt approved engineering practices.
  • Work with current and future AI Team colleagues to lay the technical foundations for agent automation and cloud-based AI delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify tooling, reduce friction and improve the developer and stakeholder experience.

Reliability, Monitoring & Operational Readiness

  • Design and improve monitoring, logging, alerting and reporting across pipelines, platforms and cloud workloads.
  • Create runbooks, deployment checklists and operational handover materials that support effective BAU ownership.
  • Support incident response, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement for deployment or platform reliability issues.
  • Improve resilience, recovery and performance practices for key services and automation workloads.
  • Use data from monitoring and service performance to recommend improvements and prioritise platform work.

Security, Governance & Documentation

  • Embed security-by-design into DevOps practices, including least privilege, secure configuration, secrets management and change control.
  • Work closely with Technical Operations & Cyber, the SOC and MSP partners to ensure cloud and AI tooling is operated securely.
  • Maintain clear documentation of pipeline designs, infrastructure standards, access models, monitoring arrangements and operational guardrails.
  • Support audits, assurance activity and evidence gathering where DevOps, cloud or platform controls are in scope.
  • Balance security, usability and delivery pace when assessing risks, trade-offs and recommendations.

Collaboration, Planning & Continuous Improvement

  • Plan and prioritise DevOps improvements based on impact, value, risk and delivery needs.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner constructively across Digital and Technology, internal stakeholders and external technology partners.
  • Challenge current ways of working where needed and recommend pragmatic improvements with clear rationale.
  • Share knowledge generously and help raise DevOps capability across the function and organisation.

Knowledge & Experience

Essential

  • Significant hands-on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering or a closely related engineering role.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or equivalent.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Microsoft cloud services, including deployment, access, monitoring and governance considerations.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, PowerShell or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation and tooling able to write, read and maintain production-quality scripts, not just adapt examples.
  • Working knowledge of core Azure networking concepts, including VNets, NSGs, DNS, private endpoints and load balancers, with practical experience applying these in cloud and containerised workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Git, source control workflows, release management, environment management and secure software delivery practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging and alerting for cloud platforms, pipelines or application workloads.
  • Strong grounding in cloud security principles, including identity and access, least privilege, secrets management, network security and secure configuration.
  • Awareness of cloud cost management principles, including resource tagging standards, right-sizing, and governance for spend able to recommend efficient, cost-conscious approaches rather than just functional ones.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements and risk considerations into pragmatic, well-documented engineering solutions.
  • Comfortable working with the Head of Technical Operations & Cyber to make pragmatic, risk-aware decisions that balance delivery pace with security and governance requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, senior stakeholders and external partners.
  • A self-starter mindset, with strong planning, problem-solving and ownership of delivery outcomes.

Desirable

AI & Automation

  • Experience deploying, governing or operating AI-assisted development tools, agent automation or cloud-based AI workloads.

Microsoft Platform

  • Experience working with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or similar Microsoft tooling.
  • Relevant certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-500, Terraform Associate, GitHub certifications or equivalent hands-on experience.

Containers & Orchestration

  • Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes or Azure Container Apps.

Broader Platform & Integrations

  • Experience supporting Salesforce, data platform, integration or business automation workloads.

Regulated Environments

  • Experience working in a regulated services environment, ideally FCA-regulated.

Why Join us?

This is a key role at the point where DevOps, cloud automation and AI capability are becoming central to how Triple Point delivers technology safely and effectively.

  • You’ll join a talented, collaborative team in a connected environment where ideas and initiative are valued.
  • Be part of a growing and innovative team.
  • We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and genuine opportunities for growth and progression.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

At Triple Point, high performance means living our values every day:

  • Stay Curious.
  • Be Generous.
  • Take Thoughtful Action.
  • Pull Together.
  • Own It.

In line with our values Stay Curious and Take Thoughtful Action every employee has access to AI tools.

We see technology as a co-pilot, helping us improve efficiency and insight while keeping decisions grounded in thoughtful human judgement.

Triple Point offers a wealth of benefits including a contributory pension, hybrid/flexible working and ongoing learning and development opportunities. Check out our comprehensive list of benefits HERE.

Apply today for further information!

title: Program Associate, MITM
description:
GW’s Department of Microbiology, Immunology, and Tropical Medicine (MITM) conducts innovative, fundamental, basic and translational research for HIV/AIDS and neglected tropical diseases. MITM has a strong tradition of training and policy advocacy for these infectious and parasitic diseases, which initiate and perpetuate poverty and suffering worldwide. Additional information on MITM can be found at the following link: [**http://smhs.gwu.edu/microbiology/**](http://smhs.gwu.edu/microbiology/)

MITM is recruiting an administrative professional to coordinate all organizational and functional activities in support of the regular administrative work performed by the Chair as well as a variety of special projects.

This role will serve as a point of contact for the program, will answer program questions from faculty, staff, and students, and will provide functional support for the program administration. Functional support includes organizing scientific meetings and seminars, facilitating all activities related to faculty affairs, supporting MITM’s educational activities, coordinating the department communications, and managing a variety of special projects. It also includes answering most inquiries, enrollment guidance, drafting program materials, planning and executing events, tracking spending and processing payments, preparing and analyzing reports, and similar duties. This role is tasked with outreach to other GW stakeholders in order to assist in maintaining standard operational efficiencies. The duties often are administrative in nature including tasks that are routine, and under limited supervision of more senior personnel within the department.

The responsibilities include:

- Coordinates the data entry of research positions in PA7 and assists with the onboarding process of research staff. Coordinates the Visa process as needed.
- Provides the MITM Chair with support to include preparation and coordination of a variety of written communications, including but not limited to department correspondence.
- Organizes and participates in various departmental committee meetings (Faculty, ATP, Education, Space, etc); Creates agendas and take minutes.
- Coordinates various Chair led projects and initiatives. Develops and implements project tasks, monitors and tracks project progress and participates at meetings that affect projects.
- Coordinates the activities related to Faculty Affairs including monthly departmental faculty meetings, faculty annual reviews, new faculty recruitments, new appointments and promotions.
- Coordinates MITM’s teaching activities (course catalog, classrooms…) and researches and prepares reports as required by the Chair; Helps facilitate the development of MITM courses.
- Manages Chair calendar and travel and assist with management of facilities requests and repairs. Manages departmental lab coat cleaning contract; Assists with departmental FedEx account and p-card purchases.
- Updates the MITM and faculty webpages as needed, working closely with the SMHS biomedical communications staff. Manages departmental intranet site.

Performs other work-related duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

  • Strong understanding of API design, data modelling, and distributed system architecture
  • Hands-on experience with containers, relational databases, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and an openness to work across different technologies. We currently work with Python, Go, .NET, and Rust
  • An AI-native mindset. You actively leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality, while understanding their strengths and limitations
  • A structured and quality-focused way of working, particularly in regulated environments

title: Customs Handling Agent/Specialist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and knowledge-driven Customs Handling Agent/Specialist to manage import and export customs documentation, compliance procedures, and clearance operations. In this role, you will act as a primary liaison between our organization, international freight forwarders, and customs authorities. The ideal candidate will ensure that all shipments are cleared accurately, efficiently, and in full compliance with local and international trade laws.

  • Customs Documentation & Filing: Prepare, review, and process required import/export documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and customs entry forms.
  • Tariff Classification & Valuation: Correctly classify goods according to the Harmonized System (HS) codes and ensure accurate declaration of duties, taxes, and fees.
  • Compliance & Clearance: Monitor customs entry status, coordinate inspections with customs officials, and proactively resolve holds, delays, or clearance issues.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain clear communication with logistics partners, freight forwarders, carriers, warehouse staff, and internal teams to facilitate seamless cargo movement.
  • Record Keeping & Auditing: Maintain organized digital and physical archives of customs entries, audit documentation for compliance, and assist during internal or regulatory audits.
  • Regulatory Tracking: Stay up to date with changes in trade regulations, customs tariffs, trade agreements, and import/export compliance laws.

Requirements

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, International Trade, Logistics, or related field preferred.
  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in customs brokerage, import/export handling, or logistics operations.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience using Customs Management Systems (CMS), ERP software, and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace (Excel, PPT, Doc).
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of Harmonized System (HS) coding, customs valuation rules, and local customs regulations.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Licensed Customs Broker (LCB), Certified Customs Specialist (CCS), or equivalent industry credentials are a strong plus.
  • High accuracy in review and entry of complex international documentation.
  • Ability to quickly resolve clearance bottlenecks and regulatory discrepancies.
  • Professional written and verbal communication with customs authorities and clients.
  • Ability to manage multiple shipment deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • This role needs the person to be able to travel to Head office and import export customs office.

Benefits

We offer great career growth, Gratuity, PF and Health Insurance.

**Job Description:**

L3Harris in San Diego, CA is seeking a senior professional with strong knowledge of RF/microwave engineering and communication theory to support the design and manufacture of Tracking, Telemetry, and Command products for airborne and space-based applications. This role involves circuit card and subsystem design, integration, and testing of RF hardware. The ideal candidate will have proficiency in RF/microwave engineering, digital modulation techniques, and communications theory.

**Essential Functions:**

- Responsible for RF/microwave product development, including circuit card and subsystem design, schematic capture, circuit design, derating, and Worst-Case Analysis (WCA).
- Manage complex projects or processes with general oversight.
- Determine design approaches and parameters.
- Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, and evaluate results.
- Select components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability.
- Perform simulations and present design reviews.
- Lead and perform trade studies for technical decisions.
- Conduct design verification testing to validate performance.
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to RF hardware and digital communication systems.
- Provide mentoring and leadership to early career engineers.
- Ability to obtain and maintain a minimum of a secret level DoD security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

- BS degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with at least 6 years of prior relevant experience, or MS degree with at least 4 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Qualifications:**

- Experience designing X-Band or higher RF/microwave transmitter, receiver, and/or converter circuits at the circuit card or module level.
- Knowledge of RF/microwave engineering principles and hands-on experience with RF/microwave and communications test equipment.
- Working knowledge of digital modulation techniques including BPSK, QPSK, and related distortion metrics like EVM.
- Ability to troubleshoot RF/microwave subassemblies to the component level.
- Ability to independently conduct design verification testing.
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
- Experience performing RF/microwave system and circuit analysis using ADS, AWR VSS, or similar.
- Experience in transmitter design: gain distribution, linearity, modulation formats, synthesizer architecture, and EVM performance.
- Experience in receiver front end design: Noise figure, dynamic range, acquisition and tracking threshold, and BER performance.
- Experience with 3D Electromagnetic analysis using HFSS or similar.
- Understanding of digital design fundamentals, including modem architectures, power supplies, interfacing with ADCs, FPGAs, and more.
- Experience with military or space-qualified hardware designs.
- Design experience with K band frequencies.

title: Network Architect and Specialist (m/f/d) onsite
description:
About the role

Agile Robots SE is seeking a Network Architect / Network Specialist to define and operate our global on‑premise network across multiple geographies and regional offices. You will lead the design and lifecycle of our campus, branch, and data‑center networks—including high‑performance NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics that power AI/HPC workloads—while ensuring our controls meet TISAX expectations and internal ISMS requirements

Your Responsibilities

1) Global Architecture & Standards (On‑Site Only)

  • Design and document end‑to‑end on‑prem architectures (core/distribution/access/WLAN; DC leaf‑spine)
  • Establish and maintain global standards: IP addressing & IPAM (NetBox), routing policy, QoS, naming, security baselines, and change control (HLD/LLD, MOP/SOP, rollback)
  • Define network zoning & segmentation (VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across Office and DMZ networks with clear trust boundaries
2) Routing, Switching, WLAN & Regional Sites
  • Engineer BGP/OSPF for WAN & DC; deliver redundancy/failover across carriers and sites
  • Own Aruba campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise)
  • Plan and execute site builds/moves/expansions (circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows
3) Security, Remote Access & Identity
  • Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks
  • Implement 802.1X NAC (e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with RADIUS/Active Directory integration; enforce device posture and guest segmentation
  • Operate DMZ patterns (reverse proxying, jump hosts, constrained admin planes) and align with TISAX/ISMS requirements
4) High‑Performance Networking for AI/HPC
  • Design, deploy, and maintain NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics (topology, cabling/optics, partitioning), including subnet managers (UFM/opensm), congestion control, and path optimization
  • Coordinate with compute/storage teams (e.g., DGX/HPC clusters) on throughput, latency, and scale; plan upgrades and fabric expansions
5) Reliability, Observability & Automation
  • Deliver high availability (fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested DR/failover
  • Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g., Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs
  • Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits
  • Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes
6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)
  • Map network controls to TISAX expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection)
  • Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on risk assessments, controls testing, and evidence preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records)
  • Manage carriers and vendors (Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning
  • Mentor regional IT; act as L3 escalation for incidents and major changes
Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE
  • Security & Remote Access: FortiGate NGFW, FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer
  • Campus/Branch & WLAN: Aruba CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs, ClearPass (802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt)
  • Data Center & Fabric: Dell PowerSwitch (OS10), VLT/MLAG; NVIDIA InfiniBand (UFM/opensm).
  • Foundational Services: VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, QoS; DHCP/DNS, Active Directory, RADIUS; NetBox(IPAM/DCIM)
  • Observability & Automation: Zabbix, rsyslog (retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow; Ansible/Python, Git

Essential Skills

  • 7+ years in enterprise on‑prem networking across multi‑site/multi‑region environments
  • Deep hands‑on with FortiGate, Aruba (switching/WLAN), Dell data‑center switching, and NVIDIA InfiniBand basics
  • Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns
  • Proven delivery of secure remote access, 802.1X NAC, and logging/monitoring at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS)
  • Experience aligning network controls to ISMS/TISAX (policy ↔ design ↔ evidence)
  • Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication

Beneficial Skills

  • Certifications: Fortinet NSE (4/5/7+), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP/ACSP/ACDX), CCNP/CCIE, Dell networking, and/or NVIDIA networking
  • ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; EVPN/VXLAN familiarity
  • Exposure to RADIUS/AD integration and FreeRADIUS stack
  • Familiarity with Zabbix tuning, syslog retention strategies, and ITSM/change tooling
  • Experience segmenting AI/HPC clusters and integrating with storage/compute pipelines

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team. This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you’ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You bring proven knowledge in building and operating sophisticated search platforms and engineering robust, high-performance software systems.
  • Experience mentoring expert engineers, providing both technical and professional guidance.
  • Experience defining a long-term technical vision for a core search or retrieval system, working across teams and organizations to collaboratively shape the technical roadmap.
  • Hands-on experience with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, or Solr,
  • Strong skills in core Java and familiarity with advanced data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features like lambdas. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.
  • Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.
  • Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Collaborating across distributed teams is challenging, we value being supportive, empathetic, and trusting in all interactions, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before, and you have experience in the search and information retrieval space and understand the constructs and theory behind it.
  • Experience working with open source projects and familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

326.400 Lei—516.400 Lei RON

title: Software Dev Engineer II, EC2 Capacity Reservations
description:
Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is the centerpiece the Amazon Web Services (AWS) family of cloud computing services. Customers depend on EC2 to provide secure and reliable computing power for business, research, education, or anything else they need to accomplish their goals. Our team is building new and exciting services that help our customers reduce their costs and improve their overall experiences using EC2. We are looking for software engineers who care about the customer and are excited at the thought of providing simple and well-designed solutions to meet our customers’ needs.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

We are seeking technical leaders to build and a grow a team of engineers. The successful candidate will have technical leadership experience, and track-record to deliver results. You have a software engineering background, with a working knowledge of large-scale systems. You engage with customers to understand their needs, show judgement in establishing priorities, and can successfully manage implementation in an fast changing environment. We work closely together on small teams to solve big problems.


Key job responsibilities
Write clean, testable, and well-documented code while following software engineering best practices.

Identify and resolve ambiguity in technical spaces with high problem complexity. Translate product and technical requirements into scalable solutions.

Participate in the full software development lifecycle - design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support.

Work closely with teams across EC2 and AWS (Placement, MIST, Paperwork, EC2 Capacity Blocks, EC2 UltraServers, EC2 Console) to build scalable, flexible interfaces enabling fast-paced delivery of customer facing features.

Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality across the team. Contribute to on-call rotations and operational excellence.

Engage regularly with cross-functional stakeholders (Product Managers, Application Security Engineers) and drive two-way dialogue to identify product requirements and build robust, secure features

About the team
On-Demand Capacity Reservations enables customers to reserve capacity for your Amazon EC2 instances in a specific Availability Zone for any duration. Our team owns the front-end service layer for EC2 Capacity Reservations — the APIs that enable customers to reserve capacity and manage the full lifecycle of their reservations.

title: Information Security Systems Engineer
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Information Security Systems Engineer (ISSE)**

**Job Code: 44525**

**Job Location: Chantilly, VA**

**Job Schedule: 5/8 Monday - Friday**

**Job Description:**

The successful candidate will support a highly motivated engineering team in defining, designing, implementing, documenting, testing and sustaining security solutions on National Security Systems, or other systems engineered for our government customers, using current standards within National Institute of Standards & Technology (NIST) Risk Management Framework, Special Publications 800-37, 800-53, 800-171, and other NIST publications; Committee on National Security Systems Instruction (CNNSI) 1253, Joint SAP Implementation Guide (JSIG), and Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) to certify and achieve system accreditations. The successful candidate will work with system developers or commercial product vendors in the design and evaluation of state-of-the-art secure systems, networks, and database products, using methods such as encryption technology, vulnerability analysis and security management.

**Essential Functions:**

• Perform incident response cyber threat identification, incident response support, defensive cyber operations coordination, malware analysis, supply chain risk management assessments per NIST SP 800-161, vendor provenance, counterfeit detection

• Exercise skills in NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and all related NIST publications, to include writing System Security Plans, Security Control Traceability Matrix, Continuous Monitoring Plan, Security Assessment Plans & Procedures, Security Concept of Operations, Plan of Action and Milestones

• Perform skills in implementing/assessing security controls, to include writing system security categorization memorandum, recommending appropriate security control overlays, define security control baseline based on defined system security categorization and approved security overlays, and apply security controls to computing/network nodes and verify implementation of security controls

• Assist in systems/software engineering functions, to include creation of data flow diagrams, interface control documents, perform trade studies, and Static Application Security Testing (SAST) for Application Security and Development Secure Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) compliance using tools such as Fortify/Coverity and Gitlab as part of a DevSecOps Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) Pipeline, and generation of summary reports

• Define/manage systems/security architectures including system security boundaries, vulnerability management and risk mitigation and remediation strategies within networks, systems, applications and new technology initiatives (hardware, software, firewalls, intrusion detection systems, anti-virus systems and software deployment tools); and Infrastructure/Platform/Software-as-a-Service (IaaS/PaaS/Saas) implementations in cloud environments

• Define/manage systems/security architectures including system security boundaries in on-premises data center systems and ultimately deploy to secure cloud-based system, to include configuration and use of defense and assessment tools specific to each environment type

• This position is performed 100% onsite and cannot be performed remotely

**Qualifications:**

• MUST have an active Top Secret/SCI security clearance with ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance after hire

• Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 6 years of prior relevant experience; Or, Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience; Or, in lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience

• DoD 8140.03 Level 3 or 4 certification

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

• Perform Model Based System Engineering (UML, SysML, UAF)

• Confugure/operate vulnerability analysis tools such Tenable NESSUS Security products

• Develop dashboards, configure rules and operate/administer SEIM/audit reduction tools (e.g., Splunk)

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in Virginia state is $106,500-$197,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

description:
